hypothesis: Ukuba yingxenye yoHlelo Lwezimo Eziphuthumayo Lwezempilo lwe-WHO, i-WHO Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence (i-WHO Pandemic Hub), yenza lula ukubambisana komhlaba wonke kwabalingani abavela emikhakheni eminingi esekela amazwe nabathintekayo ukubhekana nobungozi besikhathi esizayo besifo esiwumshayabhuqe kanye nobungozi besifo esiwumshayabhuqe ngokufinyelela okungcono kwedatha, amakhono angcono okuhlaziya, namathuluzi angcono nokuqonda kokwenza izinqumo. Ngokusekelwa nguHulumeni we-Federal Republic of Germany, i-WHO Pandemic Hub yasungulwa ngoSepthemba 2021 eBerlin, ekuphenduleni ubhubhane lwe-COVID-19, olukhombise ubuthakathaka emhlabeni wonke ekutheni amazwe athola kanjani, aqaphe futhi aphathe izinsongo zezempilo zomphakathi. I-WHO Pandemic Hub isebenza ngokubambisana namazwe angamalungu kanye namahhovisi esifunda kanye nawamazwe e-WHO ukuze kuqiniswe amakhono abo okwabelana ngemininingwane futhi anike amandla abalingani abavela emhlabeni wonke ukuthi babambisane futhi bakhe amathuluzi okuqoqa nokuhlaziya idatha yokuqapha okusheshayo. Ngokuba khona emazweni angaphezu kwe-150, amahhovisi esifunda ayisithupha, kanye nendlunkulu yayo yaseGeneva, i-WHO's reach inikeza amandla okuphatha ubungozi besifo, ubhubhane kanye nezinsongo zezempilo zomphakathi ngokuphuthuma okulinganayo nokukhuthala emhlabeni jikelele. Ngokuxhumanisa imizamo yasendaweni, yesifunda, kanye neyomhlaba wonke, i-WHO Pandemic Hub ikhuthaza indawo yokubambisana yabathuthukisi, ososayensi kanye nochwepheshe abavela kuyo yonke imikhakha ehlukahlukene, okusivumela ukuthi sisebenzise futhi sabelane ngobuchwepheshe obusezingeni eliphezulu futhi sigxile emsebenzini wethu ezidingweni zabathintekayo emhlabeni jikelele.

Ngasekupheleni kuka-2022, amazwe amaningi abike izimpawu eziyingxenye zokubuyiselwa kwensizakalo, kufaka phakathi izinsizakalo zezempilo yezocansi, ukuzala, umama, usana, ingane nentsha; ukudla okunomsoco; ukugoma; izifo ezithathelwanayo (kufaka phakathi umalaleveva, i-HIV, i-TB, nezinye izifo ezithathelwana ngocansi); izifo ezingalapheki ezishisayo; izifo ezingathathelwanayo; ukuphathwa kwezifo zengqondo, zezinzwa kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa; ukunakekelwa kwabantu asebekhulile; kanye nokunakekelwa kwendabuko kanye / noma ukunakekelwa okuhambisanayo. Inani lamazwe abika ukuphazamiseka ohlelweni lwawo lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zikazwelonke lancipha lisuka cishe engxenyeni (29 kumazwe angama-59 aphendulile) laya cishe engxenyeni eyodwa (18 kumazwe angama-66 aphendulile) ngonyaka odlule. Naphezu kwezimpawu zokululama, ukuphazamiseka kwensizakalo kuyaqhubeka emazweni kuzo zonke izifunda kanye namazinga wemali engenayo, futhi kuzo zonke izindawo zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo kanye nezindawo zokulandelela. Amazwe abhekana nokwanda kwe-backlog yezinsizakalo - kaningi kakhulu ezinsizakalweni zokuhlola, ukuxilongwa nokwelashwa kwezifo ezingathathelani - okungaholela emiphumeleni emibi njengoba abantu bebambezele ukufinyelela ekunakekelweni okufika ngesikhathi. Ukubuyiselwa kokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ezibalulekile kwezempilo kubalulekile ngoba ukuphazamiseka - kufaka phakathi kwezinsizakalo zokukhuthaza impilo, ukuvimbela izifo, ukuxilongwa, ukwelashwa, ukuvuselelwa kanye nokudambisa - kungaba nemiphumela emibi kakhulu empilweni yabantu kanye nezinga lomuntu ngamunye, ngisho nangaphezulu kwalolu bhubhane uqobo, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abasengozini.

Lezi zihlanganisa ukusetshenziswa kwezindlela ze-telemedicine, ukukhuthazwa kokunakekelwa kwasekhaya noma ukuzinakekela, izindlela zokuqinisa ukutholakala kwabasebenzi bezempilo, amakhono kanye nezindlela zokusekela, izinto ezintsha ekuthengeni nasekuhlinzekeni imithi nezinsiza, ukuxhumana okuvamile nomphakathi, kanye nobambiswano nabahlinzeki bomkhakha wangasese. Izingxenye ezintathu kwezine zamazwe zabika ukwabiwa kwemali eyengeziwe ukuze kulungiswe uhlelo lwesikhathi eside, ukuqina kanye nokulungela. Amazwe abonisa isidingo sokusekelwa yi-WHO ukubhekana nezinselelo ezisele kumongo we-COVID-19 nangaphezulu, ngokuvamile ezihlobene nokuqiniswa kwabasebenzi bezempilo, ukwakha amakhono okuqapha izinsizakalo zezempilo, ukuklama amamodeli okunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo, ukuphathwa, inqubomgomo kanye nokuhlelwa kanye nokuhlelwa kwezimali. Qaphela kubahleli: Emjikelezweni wesine wocwaningo lwe-WHO lomhlaba wonke, amazwe angama-222, izindawo nezindawo zamenywa ukuba ziphendule ucwaningo olujwayelekile olususelwa kuwebhu phakathi kukaNovemba 2022 noJanuwari 2023. Ucwaningo lwesine lulandele ucwaningo lwangaphambilini lwe-WHO lwango-2020 no-2021: Umjikelezo 1 (Meyi-Septemba 2020), Umjikelezo 2 (Januwari-Mashi 2021), kanye noMjikelezo 3 (Novemba-Disemba 2021) okukhombisa ukuthi lolu bhubhane luthinta kangakanani ukuqhubeka kwezinsizakalo zezempilo ezibalulekile nokuthi amazwe athatha kanjani izinyathelo.

I-UAE igxile kakhulu ekuhlinzekeni amaqembu asengozini kakhulu athintwe yisimo saseSudan, ikakhulukazi abagulayo, izingane, asebekhulile, nabesifazane abasengozini enkulu ngenxa yezingxabano eziqhubekayo - futhi lezi zindiza zosizo zizobhekana ngqo nezikhala eziphuthumayo kakhulu ekunikezelweni kwezokwelapha nokudla. Izindinganiso zobuntu ezijulile ze-UAE zisho ukuthi iqinisekise ukuthi iyaqhubeka nokuxhumana nomhlaba ngokuzinikela kwayo okuqinile nokungapheli ekuqiniseni ukuthula, ukuphepha nokuzinza, hhayi esifundeni kuphela, kodwa nasemhlabeni wonke, ngenkathi kanye nabalingani bayo kanye nomphakathi wamazwe omhlaba, izwe liqhubeka nokusiza abantu baseSudan ngezikhathi zobunzima. Izinsiza zezempilo zifaka phakathi ukulimala okwanele, izinto zokuhlinza eziphuthumayo, nemithi ebalulekile ukuze zifinyelele ngokushesha kubantu abangu-165 000 abadinga usizo lwezenhlalakahle. Izikhungo zezempilo ezweni lonke zibika ukuthi ziphelelwe izinsiza zezempilo eziyisisekelo nokuthi izitolo zezokwelapha zikazwelonke azisafinyeleleki ngenxa yesimo sokuphepha. Phakathi kokunye ukwesekwa, i-WHO ithumela ochwepheshe ababili bezimo eziphuthumayo abahamba nomthwalo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zinsiza zisatshalaliswa ngokushesha ezikhungweni eziyi-13 ezinkulu zezempilo ukusekela abasebenzi bezempilo nokunikeza ukunakekelwa kulabo abaswele.

Manje, esikhundleni sokuthi impilo yabo bonke ibhekwe njengesikhonzi sokukhula komnotho, sinohlelo lokwakha umsebenzi wezomnotho ngendlela ezosivumela ukuba sifinyelele umgomo wokubona bonke abantu bethola izinsizakalo zezempilo ezibalulekile ngokushesha nangemiphumela engcono, "kusho uDkt Tedros. "Eminyakeni emibili edlule, uMkhandlu we-WHO wezomnotho wezempilo yabo bonke usebenzele ukwakha indaba entsha yezomnotho - eyashintsha ukuxhaswa ngezimali kwezempilo kusuka ekusetshenzisweni kuya ekutshalweni kwemali, "kusho uSihlalo woMkhandlu, uProfesa Mariana Mazzucato. "Sihlolisise izinguquko ezidingekayo - kuhlanganise nesakhiwo samalungelo obunikazi, ubudlelwano bomphakathi nabazimele, kanye nezabelomali - ukuklama umnotho ohlinzeka ngezeMpilo Yabo Bonke. Embikweni wethu wokugcina, sicela inqubomgomo entsha yezomnotho engahloselwe ukulungisa imakethe kodwa ehlose ukwakha izimakethe ezibeka phambili impilo yabantu neyomhlaba. " Umyalezo, onesihloko esithi Impilo Yabo Bonke: Ukuguqula Umnotho Ukuze Ulethe Okubalulekile (https://www.who.int/groups/who-council-on-the-economics-of-health-for-all), wethulwa namuhla ngokubambisana ne-76th World Health Assembly, futhi unikeza uhlaka olusha olwakhelwe phezu kwezinsika ezine ezingenhla, kanye nezincomo ezithile ngaphansi kwazo zonke.

Uhlelo lwe-INTERSUN luyintsebenziswano phakathi kwe-WHO, i-United Nations Environment Programme, i-World Meteorological Organization, i-International Agency on Cancer Research kanye ne-International Commission on Non-Ionizing Radiation Protection. Ikhuthaza futhi ihlola ucwaningo ngemiphumela yezempilo yemisebe ye-UV, futhi ithuthukise impendulo efanelekile ngokusebenzisa imihlahlandlela, izincomo kanye nokusatshalaliswa kolwazi. Izinhloso zohlelo zifaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngezeluleko ezisebenzayo nezizwakalayo ngemiphumela yezempilo nemvelo yokuchayeka kwe-UV, ukukhuthaza amazwe ukuthi athathe izinyathelo zokunciphisa ubungozi bezempilo obubangelwa yi-UV kanye nokunikeza isiqondiso kuziphathimandla zikazwelonke mayelana nezinhlelo zokuqwashisa ngelanga. Ngale njongo, uhlelo lusebenzisana nochwepheshe kanye nama-ejensi akhethekile ukuqhuba imisebenzi ebalulekile yocwaningo, ukukhomba nokulinganisa ubungozi bezempilo obuvela emisebeni ye-UV, ukuthuthukisa izibikezelo ezinokwethenjelwa zezempilo nemiphumela yezemvelo yezinguquko ekuchayekeni kwe-UV ngokuncipha kwe-ozone stratospheric, nokuthuthukisa izindlela ezisebenzayo zokuqapha ushintsho emiphumeleni yezempilo ebangelwa yi-UV ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Uhlelo lunikeza amathuluzi kanye nemihlahlandlela ehlobene nenkomba ye-UV, ukuvikelwa kwelanga kwezingane, izibhedlela zokukhanyisa, ezokuvakasha kanye nezempilo yomsebenzi.

Lo mzamo wezizwe eziningi kanye nezinye izinhlelo zakamuva zokukhiqiza zendawo zidinga amasu okuthuthukisa abasebenzi ukuze kuqashwe, kuthuthukiswe futhi kugcinwe abasebenzi abasebenza kulezi zikhungo, abanamakhono ayingqayizivele adingekayo ekukhiqizeni izinto eziphilayo. Ukuze kuxazululwe le ngxenye, i-WHO kanye neRiphabhulikhi yaseKorea baye bahlanganyela ekusebenzisaneni okuvaliwe isikhathi esingaphezu konyaka futhi manje sebeqala ukwenza ngokusemthethweni ukuzibophezela kwabo ekusunguleni isikhungo sokuqeqesha somhlaba wonke ekukhiqizeni izinto eziphilayo. "Siyajabula ukusayina le Memorandum of Understanding ukukhuphula ubudlelwano bethu ezingeni elilandelayo futhi sibambisane ekuthuthukiseni uhlelo lokuqeqesha olunzulu. Sithemba ukuthi lesi sikhungo sokuqeqesha somhlaba wonke sizosiza ukwakha abasebenzi abanamakhono futhi siqinisekise ukuthi imikhiqizo yezempilo esezingeni eliphezulu ingakhiqizwa emhlabeni wonke", kusho uDkt Yukiko Nakatani, uMsizi kaMqondisi-Jikelele we-WHO, Ukufinyelela Kumithi Nemikhiqizo Yezempilo. Uhulumeni weRiphabhulikhi yaseKorea unikeza uhla olukhulu lwezikhungo zokuqeqesha zikazwelonke nezinhlelo ezihlanganisa lonke uhla lokukhiqiza izinto eziphilayo futhi wandisa imisebenzi yayo ukuze kuhlaliswe abaqeqeshiwe abaningi abavela kwamanye amazwe ngokwakhiwa kwe-Global Bio Education Campus ezokwethulwa ngo-2025.

UMkhandlu wasungula i-MSM ngo-2012 ukubhekana nemikhiqizo yezokwelapha engekho ezingeni futhi engamanga ngokombono wezempilo yomphakathi nangendlela esobala nebandakanya wonke umuntu. Inhloso ye-MSM ukuvikela impilo yomphakathi nokukhuthaza ukufinyelela emikhiqizweni yezokwelapha engabizi, ephephile, esebenzayo nekhwalithi. Ngokubheka izehlakalo zakamuva zemithi engcolisiwe etholakala ezimakethe ezahlukahlukene kanye nokufa okuhlobene nokugwema, amazwe angamalungu agcizelele ukwesekwa okudingekayo ukuthuthukisa ikhono lawo lokuvimbela, ukuthola nokuphendula imikhiqizo yezokwelapha engekho ezingeni futhi engamanga ngokusebenzisa ukufinyelela kubuchwepheshe obufanele, kufaka phakathi izikhungo zokuhlola zaselabhorethri, kanye nokuqondiswa okuthuthukisiwe ezimakethe ezingekho emthethweni nasekukhangiseni, kanye nokuthengiswa kwe-inthanethi kwemikhiqizo yezokwelapha. Amazwe angamalungu acele ukwamukela nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokulandelela nokulandelela ukulawula imakethe nokubhekwa, kanye nesidingo sokubambisana okusemthethweni ngabalingani bendawo nabomhlaba abafanele njengokuphoqelela umthetho kanye nokuphatha amasiko. Amazwe angamalungu akhuthazwa ukuthi ahambisane nezivumelwano ezihlose ukuthuthukisa umthetho kanye nokubeka izigwebo ezivimbela ukuthengiswa okungalungile kwemikhiqizo yezokwelapha engekho ezingeni.

Umhlangano wabalingani be-Global Neglected Tropical Diseases Programme, 12-13 Juni 2023 Abamele umphakathi we-NTD womhlaba wonke bazohlangana eGeneva ngesonto elizayo ukuze babambe iqhaza eMhlanganweni wabalingani be-Global Neglected Tropical Diseases Programme, ozoba seholo lasekhaya ngomhlaka 12-13 Juni 2023. Izinhloso zalo mhlangano ukubuyekeza inqubekela phambili yohlelo lwe-WHO lwezifo ezishisayo ezinganakiwe 2021-2030 nokwakha ukuqonda okungcono ngemisebenzi ye-NTD yomhlaba wonke ngokombono oqondene nezifo kanye nokubheka okuhlangene, kanye nokuzibandakanya ezingxoxweni ezibanzi ezungeze umbono we-One WHO delivering on one Global NTD Programme. Ngenkathi imihlangano yangaphambilini yomhlaba wonke yabalingani be-NTD ibibizwe yi-WHO ngo-2007 nango-2017, lo mcimbi wesithathu ozayo ngowokuqala selokhu kwethulwa yohlelo lwe-Global Neglected Tropical Diseases Programme 2021-2030. I-Global Neglected Tropical Diseases Programme 2021-2030 iyisisekelo esibanzi esichaza imigomo, izindlela zokuhambisana neZinhloso Zentuthuko Eqhubekayo kanye nezinye izinhlelo zomhlaba wonke futhi icela ukuguqulwa kwamasu ezindleleni ze-NTD ngenhloso yokuqeda ubhubhane lwezifo ezishisayo ezinganakiwe ngo-2030.

Abacimi-mlilo kanye nabasebenzi bezimo eziphuthumayo nabo bathinteka kakhulu ngenxa yokulimala, ukushiswa nokuphefumula intuthu, ikakhulukazi lapho kunentuthu eningi. Ucwaningo oluningi oluhlanganisa imikhakha eminingi luyadingeka ukuze kuqondwe imiphumela yempilo efihlekile neyesikhathi eside yokuchayeka emlilweni wasendle kubantu abasengozini (izingane, abantu asebekhulile, abantu abakhulelwe, abantu abagula isikhathi eside), ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezibhekene nokuchayeka ngokuphindaphindiwe nangezikhathi ezithile kulezi zehlakalo zomlilo wasendle. Impendulo ye-WHO: Ubukhulu bezindleko ezingokwenyama nezomuntu ezibangelwa imililo yasendle bungancishiswa uma kusetshenziswa izindlela ezanele zokuvimbela, ukulungiselela, ukuphendula nokululama ezimweni eziphuthumayo nasezinhlekeleleni, kubandakanya ukuchayeka kwemvelo, njengokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuxwayisa kusenesikhathi nokukhipha izeluleko zezempilo nezinga lomoya;

Inikeza uhla olubanzi lwezinhlelo nemisebenzi ethuthukisa ukukhuthazwa kwezempilo kubantu asebekhulile, kusukela ekuqondeni kangcono izimbangela zokugula nokufa ngokusebenzisa ukuqapha kuzwelonke kwezifo ezingezona ezithathelwanayo, ucwaningo, amarekhodi okufa kanye nocwaningo, kuya ezinhlelweni ezenzelwe ukukhuthaza ulwazi lwezempilo kanye nezinqubomgomo ezisekelwe ebufakazini. Izinhlelo zihlanganisa ithuluzi elizinikezele kubantu asebekhulile, ukwakhiwa kwamakhono abasebenzi bezokunakekelwa okuyisisekelo abangama-2000, isonto lokukhuthaza impilo elinikezelwe kubantu asebekhulile, kanye nephrojekthi entsha yokuthuthukisa impilo yengqondo nokwazi kwabantu asebekhulile abangaphezu kwesigamu sesigidi ezindaweni zasemadolobheni nasemaphandleni. UDkt Abla Mehio Sibai unguprofesa we-Epidemiology kanye noDekan we-Faculty of Health Sciences e-American University of Beirut eLebanon. Wenze umnikelo ovelele empilweni yabantu asebekhulile eLebanon nasesifundeni, wenza indlela ephelele yokukhuthaza ukuguga okunempilo. Uhola isinyathelo esisha sokubhalisa abantu asebekhulile abacishe babe ngu-600 unyaka nonyaka e-University for Seniors e-American University of Beirut, ngaphezu kokuqeqesha ochwepheshe bezempilo yomphakathi.

Isitatimende somkhosi weminyaka engu-50 ye-HRP: ISweden ne-United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland Ukubamba umoya wamalungu eKomidi Lezinqubomgomo Nokuxhumanisa (i-PCC) eligubha iminyaka engu-50 ye-HRP kanye nempumelelo yalo eminingi, iSweden ne-United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland bafunda inothi elilandelayo lokubonga nokuncoma emhlanganweni wama-36 we-HRP PCC. Isizukulwane sethu sibone intuthuko enkulu kwezesayensi nakwezobuchwepheshe kunazo zonke izizukulwane ezandulele ndawonye futhi sabona izinguquko eziningana ezingokwengqondo, ezobuchwepheshe, ezokwelapha nezenhlalo eziholwa yinguquko yokuvimbela inzalo futhi zilandelwa intuthuko empilweni yokuzala, izinto ezintsha zezempilo kanye namalungelo nokulingana ngokobulili. Kodwa-ke, izinselelo ezinkulu emkhakheni we-SRHR ziyaqhubeka, futhi, ngokusobala, ezinye izintuthuko ziyaphikiswa futhi namuhla. Siyayincoma i-HRP, abasebenzi, abalingani nabasekeli ngempumelelo yabo eminingi kuze kube manje futhi siqaphela intuthuko enkulu eyenziwe phakathi nengxenye yekhulu leminyaka ekukhiqizeni ubufakazi obusekela ukufinyelela okugcwele nokulinganayo kwezempilo nokuzala kanye namalungelo.

Isinqumo sokuqala esiphathelene nesayensi yokuziphatha ukuze kube nempilo engcono samukelwa namuhla Amazwe angamalungu amukele isinqumo esiphathelene nesayensi yokuziphatha ukuze kube nempilo engcono lapho amazwe angamalungu ebonisa ukuvumelana okubanzi mayelana nesidingo sokuhlanganisa ngokuhlelekile imfundiso yesayensi yokuziphatha, izindlela nezindlela ezihlanganisa izihloko zezempilo nemisebenzi yezempilo yomphakathi. Isinqumo sinxusa amazwe angamalungu ukuba aqaphele indima yesayensi yokuziphatha ekufezeni imiphumela engcono yezempilo, ukukhomba amathuba okusetshenziswa okwengeziwe futhi, ukusungula imisebenzi namayunithi okukhiqiza nokuhumusha ubufakazi ukuze kusetshenziswe izinqubomgomo nezinhlelo. Iphinde yacela uMqondisi-Jikelele ukuba ahlanganise ukusetshenziswa kwesayensi yokuziphatha ngaphakathi kwenhlangano futhi anikeze ukwesekwa kumazwe angamalungu ngokuthuthukiswa kokuqondisa nokunikezwa kosizo lobuchwepheshe. Amazwe angamalungu aqaphela ukufezeka kwe-Behavioural Sciences for Better Health Initiative eholwa yisikhonzi, ancoma iMalaysia, umxhasi wesinqumo, kanye namanye amazwe angu-19 ajoyine njengabaxhasi, futhi abonga uMqondisi-Jikelele ngombiko.

Njengengxenye yemizamo yokuqinisa ukwakheka komhlaba wonke kokulungela izimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo, ukusabela, kanye nokuqina i-UAE, i-WHO, kanye nabalingani basebenza ngokubambisana ukuletha izimpahla ukuze zifinyelele kubantu abasengozini enkulu emhlabeni ngesikhathi sabo sokudinga kakhulu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uDkt Ahmed Al-Mandhari, uMqondisi Wesifunda we-WHO eMpumalanga yeMedithera, uthe, "I-World Health Organization iyaqhubeka nokuxhumana neziphathimandla zezempilo zaseSudan ukuletha izimpahla zezempilo ezibalulekile, ezisindisa impilo kuzo zonke izindlela ezitholakalayo. Ngenxa yengxabano, izibhedlela, amakhemisi kanye nezikhungo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo eziyisisekelo zibekele phansi imithi ebalulekile, esindisa impilo. Ukufika kwamamitha angu-30 engeziwe ezimpahla zokulimala kanye nokuhlinzwa okuphuthumayo kanye nemithi ebalulekile kuzokwenza i-WHO ikwazi ukusekela izikhungo ezinkulu zezempilo eziyi-13 futhi ibuyisele izinsizakalo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo kulabo abaswele. Ihabhu lethu lokuthutha emhlabeni wonke eDubai lidlala indima ebalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukunikezwa okungaphazanyiswa kwezimpahla zezempilo futhi siyabonga ngosizo olunikezwe yi-United Arab Emirates ukwenza lula indiza yethu yokuqala yezimpahla ezidingeka kakhulu.

I-WHA76 izobukeza inqubekela phambili yonyaka odlule, impumelelo kanye nezinselelo kanye nezinto eziza kuqala esikhathini esizayo kuzo zonke izinsika ezibalulekile zomsebenzi we-WHO: Ukunakekelwa Kwezempilo Emhlabeni Wonke, Izimo Eziphuthumayo, Ukukhuthaza Impilo Nenhlalakahle. I-WHA76 izobanjelwa ePalais des Nations eGeneva ngoMeyi 21-30. Njengoba sigubha iminyaka engu-75 ye-WHO, singaziqhenya ngezinto esizifezile esikhathini esidlule, kodwa kufanele sikhumbule izifundo esizifundile, njengoba sisuka esigabeni esiphuthumayo se-COVID-19, futhi sakha ikusasa lapho wonke umuntu ekwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zezempilo azidingayo, futhi sakha i-WHO eqinile, exhaswa ngokuzinzile futhi enokwethenjelwa. "Ukuqala i-WHA76 ngeSonto ngoMeyi 21, uhlelo lwesine lwe-Walk the Talk: Health for All challenge luzoqala ePlace des Nations ngo-8:30 ekuseni CEST (ukuqala kokufudumala ngo-7:30 ekuseni CEST), ukukhuthaza impilo yomzimba nengqondo nokugubha ukubaluleka kobambiswano ngesikhathi se-WHO's 75th anniversary.

I-WHO inamanye amathani angu-30 ezimpahla zokwelapha umalaleveva nezifo ezingezona ezithathelwanayo ezifana nesifo sikashukela nomfutho wegazi ophakeme, izimo ezingaba yingozi uma zingelashwa. Lezi kanye nezikhwama zegazi ezingaba ngu-23 000 zilungiselelwa ngaphakathi kwesikhungo se-WHO sokuthutha impahla emhlabeni wonke e-International Humanitarian City, futhi i-WHO njengamanje ihlola wonke amathuba okuletha lezi zimpahla eSudan ngokushesha ngangokunokwenzeka ngokubambisana noMnyango Wezempilo waseSudan. UDkt Michael Ryan, uMqondisi Omkhulu, we-WHO Health Emergencies Programme, uthe, "I-WHO Global Logistics Hub e-UAE isibe yindawo ebalulekile yokuphendula ngokushesha ezimweni eziphuthumayo emhlabeni jikelele. Ukusekela amazwe angaphezu kuka-140 kuzo zonke izifunda eziyisithupha ze-WHO, isikhungo sinikeza indlela yokuphila emazweni angamalungu abhekene nezimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo ezibangelwa ukuqubuka kwezifo, izinhlekelele ezifana nezikhukhula nokuzamazama komhlaba, kanye nomthelela wezingxabano ezinhlelweni zezempilo. Ukusekela okunikezwa yi-UAE kwenza i-WHO ibe phambili kulezi zimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo - ukuletha usizo lwezokwelapha olukhethekile kulabo abaludingayo noma nini lapho ludingeka khona.

Lokhu kwakukhathele ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa ngenxa yenani labalimele. Ukuthunyelwa kwendiza kuza njengengxenye yemizamo eqhubekayo yokusiza i-UAE ukusekela abantu baseSudan futhi kukhombisa ubudlelwano bayo obujulile neSudan, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yesimo izwe elibhekene naso. Usizo futhi luyisandiso sombono we-UAE wobuntu futhi lugcizelela ubudlelwano balo namanye amazwe ngokususelwa ebuzalwaneni babantu nokuzibophezela kwalo ekusizeni abanye ngesikhathi sezinkinga nezimo eziphuthumayo. UDkt Reem bint Ebrahim Al Hashimy, uNgqongqoshe Wezwe Wokubambisana Kwamazwe Ngamazwe, uthe i-UAE "iyaqhubeka nokusebenza eduze ne-World Health Organization ukuqinisekisa ukuthunyelwa ngempumelelo kwemisebenzi ebalulekile yokuthumela usizo lwezokwelapha nokudla ukusiza ukubhekana nenkinga yamanje eSudan. Ngokuhambisana nezicelo zazo zonke izinhlangothi zengxabano yamanje ukuba ziqede ngokushesha izimpi futhi zinciphise isimo esibangela ukuhlupheka okungachazeki kubantu baseSudan, i-UAE iqinile ekuzibophezeleni kwayo ekunikezeni usizo nosizo emazweni ngezikhathi zesidingo.

Lezi zinhloso ziqondisa amaphrojekthi nezinqubomgomo kuyo yonke iNhlangano, kufaka phakathi imihlahlandlela yezindlu, ukuthuthukiswa kwamadolobha, izinhlelo zokuhamba kanye nokuhlinzekwa kokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Isibonelo, imihlahlandlela ye-WHO yezindlu nezempilo, eyanyatheliswa okokuqala ngo-2018, igqamisa umthelela okhulayo wezimo zezindlu empilweni yabantu ngenxa yokukhula kwamadolobha, isimo sezulu kanye nezinguquko zabantu. Imihlahlandlela inikeza amazwe angamalungu, abalingani kanye nomphakathi ngezincomo ezisekelwe ebufakazini ezihambisana nendawo yokuhlala enganele (ukugcwala), amazinga okushisa aphansi futhi aphezulu endlini, izingozi zokulimala ekhaya, kanye nokufinyeleleka kwezindlu kubantu abanokukhubazeka okusebenzayo. I-Urban Health Initiative (UHI) nayo igxile ezindleleni zamadolobha zokuvumela impilo enhle ngokukhuthaza isenzo esisebenzayo ekungcoleni komoya emadolobheni kanye nezinto ezingcolisa isimo sezulu esifushane (SLCPs) - ukusindisa izimpilo ngokuxhumanisa impilo, imvelo kanye nentuthuko eqhubekayo. I-WHO ibuye ibambisane ne-Climate and Clean Air Coalition (CCAC) emkhankasweni we-Breathe Life, okuhlose ukunciphisa ukungcola komoya nokunciphisa ukufa okungapheli kwezigidi eziyi-7 ngonyaka okubangelwa yikho.

Ngokuthatha izinkomba zabo ezivela kuzinguquko ezintathu ezibalulekile ezikhuthazwe kule roadmap - ubunikazi bezwe obukhulu, ukulinganisa imiphumela hhayi inqubo, nokuzibophezela emisebenzini ehlanganisa izinto eziningi kanye nokubambisana ukuze kube nokusebenza kahle okukhulu - izingxoxo zazinengqondo, zinombono ocacile futhi zigcwele nesidingo sokulingana kwezempilo nobulungiswa bokubhekana nama-NTDs. Umhlangano wezwa ukuthi indlela enjalo kuphela engaletha ushintsho oludingwa yiminye yemiphakathi empofu kakhulu emhlabeni ukufeza izinhloso ze-United Nations 2030 Sustainable Development Goals. Emhlanganweni wokuqala onjalo womhlaba wonke selokhu kwethulwa i-roadmap ngoJanuwari 2021, izihambeli zezwa futhi kuMqondisi-Jikelele we-WHO uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. Wamukela ababambiqhaza ekuqaleni kwengqungquthela yezinsuku ezimbili, uDkt Tedros wathi, "Lo mhlangano ubonisa ukuthi i-WHO iyini - abalingani abahlangana ndawonye ukuze basebenzise amandla abo ahlangene ukubhekana nezinselelo zezempilo zomhlaba wonke okungekho noyedwa kithi obengazisingatha yedwa. "Inselelo enezici eziningi efana nezifo ezishisayo ezinganakwa ithatha indlela enezici eziningi, futhi yilokho esikuletha, ndawonye".

Ukunikela: Iminikelo evela kubantu abashonile kufanele ithuthukiswe ukuze kusetshenziswe amandla ayo okwelapha ngokugwema, lapho kungenzeka khona, izingozi ezihambisana nabantu abanikelayo abaphilayo, njengoba kushiwo ku-WHO Guiding Principle 3. Kunesidingo esivunyiwe sokuthi imiphakathi, kanye nabasebenzi bezempilo, bafundiswe kangcono ngokunikela nokufakelwa futhi lokho kuyisihluthulelo sempumelelo yezinhlelo zokunikela ngokufa. Kodwa-ke, naphezu kokusetshenziswa kaningi kwezinto ezinikelwe ngabanikeli abashonile, iminikelo evela kubanikeli abaphilayo iyadingeka kwezinye izinhlobo zokufakelwa futhi ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nokunikezwa okulinganiselwe kwezinto ezitholakala kubanikeli abashonile ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zeziguli. Ngakho-ke, ukunikela okuphilayo kuyenziwa naphezu kweqiniso lokuthi kuhilela izingozi kumnikeli ezingase zingabi zinkulu. Njengoba ukuthengwa kwezinto zomuntu zokufakelwa okuvela kubanikeli abashonile noma abaphilayo kanye nokufakelwa kwe-allogeneic okwalandela kungabangela izingozi zokuziphatha nezokuphepha kubo bobabili umamukeli nomnikeli, ukulawula okuqinile nokwengamela okusebenzayo kufanele kwenziwe yiziphathimandla zezempilo ukuze zivikele.

Ngaleli lwazi, ososayensi nezikhulu zezempilo zomphakathi bangakwazi ukukhomba nokulandelela izifo ukuze zivikelwe futhi zisabele ekuqubukeni kwazo njengengxenye yohlelo olubanzi lokuqapha izifo, kanye nokuthuthukisa izindlela zokwelapha nemithi yokugoma. I-IPSN, enobuNobhala obusingathwa yi-WHO Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence, ihlanganisa ndawonye ochwepheshe emhlabeni wonke abasezingeni eliphakeme kwezokwelapha kanye nokuhlaziywa kwedatha, abavela kohulumeni, izinhlangano ezisiza umphakathi, izinhlangano zamazwe amaningi, umphakathi, izifundiswa kanye nomkhakha wangasese. Bonke bahlanganyela umgomo ofanayo: ukuthola nokusabela ezinsongweni zezifo ngaphambi kokuba zibe izifo eziwumshayabhuqe, nokwenza ngcono ukuqapha izifo okujwayelekile. Umgomo wale nethiwekhi entsha unamandla, kodwa futhi ungadlala indima ebalulekile ekuvikelekeni kwezempilo: ukunikeza wonke amazwe ukufinyelela ekuhlaziyweni kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokuhlaziywa kwedatha njengengxenye yohlelo lwawo lwezempilo yomphakathi, "kusho uMqondisi-Jikelele we-WHO uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. "Njengoba kuboniswe ngokucacile kithi ngesikhathi sobhadane lwe-COVID-19, umhlaba unamandla uma umile ndawonye ukulwa nezinsongo zezempilo ezihlanganyelwe. "

Inqubekela phambili emkhakheni wezempilo yomama nezinsana, kanye nokuvimbela ukuzalwa kwezinsana ezifile, manje isibuyiselwe emuva ngenxa yokuhlanganiswa okubhubhisayo kwe-COVID-19, ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu, ukwanda kwezingxabano nokwenyuka kwezindleko zokuphila. "Ngokusebenza ngokubambisana - ohulumeni, abanikeli, umkhakha wangasese, umphakathi, abazali, kanye nochwepheshe bezempilo - singakwazi ukukhulisa isixwayiso ngalesi "simo esiphuthumayo esithule", futhi silethe imizamo yokuvimbela nokunakekela ngaphambi kwesikhathi emaphethelweni emizamo kazwelonke yezempilo nentuthuko, ukwakha ingcebo yabantu ngokusekela imindeni, imiphakathi kanye nezomnotho yonke indawo. "UGabriela noJerome Foster, eLas Vegas, e-United States: abazali bakaJalen Foster, kanye nabasunguli beJalen's Gift Foundation "Isisekelo sethu sasungulwa ngemuva kokulahlekelwa yindodana yethu, uJalen Foster, owazalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi esingamasonto angama-27 ngenxa yokuqala kwegciwane elaziwa ngokuthi yi-group B streptococcus. Ukulahlekelwa yindodana yethu kwakubuhlungu, futhi kwakungekho ukusekelwa emphakathini futhi yilapho sanquma khona ukunikeza indawo yokududuza nethemba emindenini elahlekelwe yingane.

Njengengxenye yokuvumelana neSimemezelo, i-SIDS yasayina ukuthatha izinyathelo eziningi, ezihlanganisa izindawo ezinjengokubandakanya wonke umphakathi, ukusheshisa ukuqaliswa, ukuqinisekisa ukutshalwa kwezimali, ukuvumelanisa ohulumeni kanye nokubika inqubekela phambili. Ingqungquthela ibuye yabonisa ukuzibophezela okuqondile kwe-SIDS kuma-NCD kanye nempilo yengqondo, kufaka phakathi ukuthuthukisa ukufinyelela ekunakekelweni kwezempilo yengqondo ezikhungweni zokunakekelwa okuyisisekelo, ukuvuselela umthetho wokulawula ugwayi ukuze uhlanganise i-e-cigarettes kanye ne-vaping, kanye nokunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kukasawoti noshukela ngabantu. Lezi zibopho zihambisana ne-WHO's "best buys" - isethi yokungenelela okusebenzayo, okusekelwe ebufakazini ukubhekana nama-NCD. Uhlu lwezinto ezihamba phambili lwalusanda kuvuselelwa eMhlanganweni Wezempilo Womhlaba ngoMeyi ukuze kufakwe ukuvimbela okwesibili kwe-rheumatic fever, ukuphathwa okubucayi nokuhlala isikhathi eside kwe-asthma kanye nesifo samaphaphu esingapheli kanye nokungenelela okuningana kwe-cervical, breast, colorectal, liver kanye nomdlavuza wobuntwana, kanye nokwelashwa okuphelele komdlavuza kulabo abaphila ne-HIV. I-SIDS eMelika ihlala isengozini enkulu kakhulu kuma-NCD.

Ngijabule kakhulu ukubona inqubekela phambili eyenziwe ngesikhathi esifushane kangaka futhi ngiyakwamukela ukwesekwa okuvela emazweni amaningi ahlukene - amazwe afana neNingizimu Afrika anekhono elinamandla lokukhiqiza izinto eziphilayo futhi azimisele ukusebenza ngokubambisana, ukufunda nokwabelana omunye nomunye. UNgqongqoshe weMfundo Ephakeme neSayensi uBlade Nzimande uthe: "Umbono wethu yi-mRNA Technology Transfer Hub ngaphezu kwe-COVID-19 kuphela. Amakhono esiwakhayo afuna ukusinika amandla okubhekana nezinye izifo zesikhathi esizayo ezinemithi yokugoma engasebenzisa ipulatifomu efanayo yobuchwepheshe be-mRNA. Lo mbono ubheke izifo ezivame kakhulu ezindaweni zethu ezifana neMalaria, Isifo sofuba kanye ne-HIV ne-AIDS. Lesi senzakalo futhi sibonisa ingqophamlando ebalulekile yoHlelo ngokwethulwa kwesikhungo se-mRNA Technology Hub e-Afrigen eKapa phambi kukaDkt Tedros noDkt Matshidiso Moeti, uMqondisi Wesifunda we-WHO e-Afrika, uCharles Gore, uMqondisi Omkhulu we-MPP kanye noNgqongqoshe abahloniphekile ababambe iqhaza emcimbini wokunqamula iribhoni e-Afrigen.

UProfesa Tienthavorn naye wadlala indima ebalulekile ekubhekaneni nenselelo yokusatshalaliswa okungalingani kwabasebenzi bezempilo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemngceleni nasemaphandleni aseThailand. Wahola ukusungulwa kobambiswano nezikole zasemakhaya ukuqasha abafundi besikole esiphakeme, ukubaqeqesha nokubasiza ukuthi babuyele endaweni ngemuva kokuphothula uhlelo lwezifundo lwezokwelapha olusheshayo. Umklomelo we-United Arab Emirates Health Foundation Prize2023: UDkt Maria Asuncion Silvestre wasePhilippinesNgaphezu kokuba ngudokotela owaziwayo nomcwaningi, uDkt Maria Asuncion Silvestre ungummeli oshisekayo wokuncelisa ibele kuphela kanye nomsunguli weKalusugan ng Mag-Ina (Impilo Yomama Nengane) - inhlangano engekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni yasePhilippines. UDkt Silvestre usebenzise ulwazi lwakhe njengodokotela womphakathi ukwenza ucwaningo nokuklama inqubo yokusiza ukuthuthukisa impilo yomama nezinsana. Inqubo eyiphayona ayidala ichaza isethi elula yezenzo okufanele zenziwe ngabasebenzi bezempilo abahambela umama ngesikhathi sokubeletha kanye nengane yakhe ngemuva kokuzalwa.

"Ngiyajabula ukuba lapha eKapa kanye nabalingani bethu ukusekela imodeli eqhubekayo yokudluliswa kobuchwepheshe be-mRNA ukunikeza amazwe anemali ephansi naphakathi ukufinyelela okulinganayo emithini yokugoma nakwezinye izinto zezempilo ezisindisa izimpilo", kusho uMqondisi-Jikelele we-WHO uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. "Ngiyaziqhenya kakhulu ngempumelelo yabo bonke labo ababambe iqhaza kulo msebenzi; eminyakeni engaphansi kwemibili sibonise ukuthi uma sisebenza ngokubambisana, siphumelela ngokuhlanganyela. Abahlanganyeli bomhlangano bahlanganisa abalingani be-biomanufacturing abavela emazweni ayi-15 ohlelweni, ochwepheshe abahamba phambili, imboni, abameleli benhlangano yomphakathi, kanye nabaxhasi. Phakathi nomhlangano wezinsuku ezinhlanu, abahlanganyeli bazokwabelana ngentuthuko futhi baxoxe ngezinto ezibalulekile ezenza ukuthi uhlelo lube nokusimama njengezindaba zempahla yengqondo nezici zokulawula, kanye nesayensi yezobuchwepheshe be-mRNA kanye nezicelo ezibalulekile ezihlobene nama-LMICs kwezinye izindawo zezifo ezifana ne-HIV kanye nesifo sofuba. Ubhadane lwe-COVID-19 lugcizelele ukuthi ukungalingani okukhulu kukhona ekufinyeleleni kwemikhiqizo yezempilo, ikakhulukazi imithi yokugoma.

Ukwehliswa kwamazinga okuzibulala emazweni kuyinkomba kuma-UN Sustainable Development Goals (ukuphela kwesibonakaliso sempilo yengqondo), i-WHO's General Programme of Work kanye ne-WHO's Comprehensive Mental Health Action Plan 20132030. Umbiko wokuqala we-WHO womhlaba wonke wokuzibulala, Ukuvimbela ukuzibulala: isidingo somhlaba wonke, esishicilelwe ngo-2014, sihlose ukukhulisa ukuqwashisa ngokubaluleka kwempilo yomphakathi kokuzibulala nokuzama ukuzibulala nokwenza ukuvimbela ukuzibulala kube yinto ephambili yezempilo yomphakathi. Ohulumeni bayakhuthazwa ukuthi basebenzise iphakethe le-WHO le-LIVE LIFE lokungenelela okusebenzayo nokusekelwe ebufakazini bokuvimbela ukuzibulala, futhi bathuthukise noma baqinise amasu okuvimbela ukuzibulala kazwelonke ngendlela yezempilo yomphakathi enezigaba eziningi. Ukuhola nokuxhumanisa kwezwe ngokuvimbela ukuzibulala kusekelwa ngokwengeziwe ngokushicilelwa kwezinhlelo zokuvimbela ukuzibulala kuzwelonke: inqubekela phambili, izibonelo nezinkomba. Ukuqaphela ukuthi idatha nezibalo ziyadingeka ekukhuthazeni nasekwenzeni izinqumo, i-WHO yashicilela i-Suicide emhlabeni wonke ngo-2019: Izilinganiso Zempilo Yomhlaba.

Umhlangano we-Global Neglected Tropical Diseases Programme Partners' Meeting we-WHO uphela ngesimemo esivusa amadlingozi sokuthi umhlaba wonke uthathe izinyathelo. Izithunywa kanye nabamele bashiye umhlangano we-Global Neglected Tropical Diseases Programme Partners' Meeting ngesimemo esivusa amadlingozi sokuthi bathathe izinyathelo. Njengoba umhlangano wamazwe amaningi, owawuhanjelwe ngabalingani abalulekile abangama-300, waphela eGeneva ngoLwesibili, ngoJuni 13, uDkt Fall wanxusa ababambiqhaza ukuthi bathathe umyalezo wokuthi, "uma singaziphikisi, ngeke sikwazi ukuthuthuka futhi sithuthuke". Emcimbini obanzi owawubanjelwe ukubuyekeza inqubekela phambili ngokuhambisana ne-Global Roadmap ye-WHO yezifo ezishisayo ezinganakiwe 2021-2030 futhi wakha ukuqonda okungcono kokusebenza kwe-NTD emhlabeni wonke kusuka kuzo zombili izindlela ezikhethekile nezihlanganisiwe, abalingani, abanikeli, abalingani bezobuchwepheshe, izikhungo kanye nabamele amazwe baqinise ukuzibophezela kwabo ekufezeni umgomo ophakeme: umhlaba ongenazo izifo ezishisayo ezinganakiwe ngo-2030. Isihloko esiyinhloko somhlangano sasigxile embonweni othi "Umphakathi owodwa ohlinzeka ngoHlelo Olulodwa Lwe-NTD Lomhlaba Wonke".

Izithunywa nababambiqhaza bachitha izinsuku ezimbili ezilandelayo behlonza izikhala ezinkulu nezinselelo zokufeza izinhloso ezisezingeni eliphezulu kanye nezinselelo zasendaweni. Lezo zinselelo zasendaweni zifaka ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abathinteka ngqo ngama-NTD, nalabo ababhekele ngqo ukuphatha ukungenelela ngokumelene nama-NTD, bayacelwa futhi bayavunywa, ikakhulukazi ngokuya ngokuxhumana nokuzibandakanya komphakathi. Umhlangano uphinde waphawula ukubaluleka kokuthuthukisa imiphakathi yokusebenza, ukuze kwakhiwe amandla nokuzethemba kwabasebenzi be-NTD emhlabeni jikelele. Ezingxoxweni ezilandelayo, izithunywa zavumelana ngezimiso nezinyathelo ezingokoqobo zokusebenzisa isenzo maqondana nezinhloso ezishiwo futhi zihlelwe ndawonye uHlelo Lokusebenza Lomhlaba Wonke lwango-20252030. Izenzo ezibalulekile nezinqumo ezivela emhlanganweni zifaka izincomo zokuqinisa nokusebenzisa amapulatifomu okuxhumanisa kazwelonke ukuqinisekisa ukuhlanganiswa kokuhlela okuhlangene nokubheka nokuhlola, nokuqinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kwe- supply chain ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo zikazwelonke.

Kulinganiselwa ukuthi izingane eziyizigidi ezingu-13.4 zazalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi ngo-2020, kanti cishe isigidi esisodwa sabulawa yizinkinga zokubeletha ngaphambi kwesikhathi, ngokusho kombiko omusha okhishwe yizinhlangano zeZizwe Ezihlangene kanye nabalingani namuhla. Lokhu kulingana cishe nezingane eziyi-1 kwezingu-10 ezizalwe ngaphambi kwesikhathi (ngaphambi kwamasonto angu-37 okukhulelwa) emhlabeni wonke. Ukuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi: iminyaka eyishumi yokusebenza ngokuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi, ekhiqizwe yi-World Health Organization (WHO) kanye ne-United Nations Children's Fund (UNICEF) kanye ne-PMNCH - umfelandawonye omkhulu kunayo yonke emhlabeni wabesifazane, izingane kanye nentsha, uzwakalisa ukukhathazeka "ngokuphuthuma okuthulile" kokuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi, okungakaqashelwa ngokwanele ngobukhulu nobunzima bako, okuvimbela inqubekela phambili ekuthuthukiseni impilo nokusinda kwezingane. Umbiko uhlanganisa izilinganiso ezibuyekeziwe ezivela ku-WHO naku-UNICEF, ezilungiselelwe yiLondon School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine, mayelana nokwanda kokuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Ngokuvamile, kutholakala ukuthi amazinga okuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi awashintshile kunoma iyiphi indawo emhlabeni kule minyaka eyishumi edlule, kanti izingane eziyizigidi ezingu-152 ezisengozini zazalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi kusukela ngo-2010 kuya ku-2020.

Izizathu zokungafani Ukufinyelela ku-morphine ukuze isetshenziswe kwezokwelapha kuthonywa yizinto eziningi ezisebenzisanayo ezibandakanya abagqugquzeli abahlobene nokubusa okuhle, izinqubo zokuthengwa nokunikezwa ezinokwethenjelwa / ezisebenza kahle, ukutholakala kwemithombo kanye nemisebenzi yokwakha amakhono, kanye nezingqinamba ezihlobene nomthetho nezinqubomgomo ezivimbela ngokweqile, ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo okunganele, kanye nesimo sengqondo esingalungile. Ngenxa yezimo ezahlukahlukene zezwe, abagqugquzeli, izingqinamba kanye nezinto eziza kuqala zokusebenza ziyahlukahluka; ucwaningo lwababambiqhaza olwethulwe kulo mbiko, nabaphenduli abavela emazweni angu-105 angamalungu e-WHO, luqinisekisa lokhu kwehluka. Isibonelo, ukunikezwa okungajwayelekile kwe-morphine nezinye i-opioids enamandla ezikhungweni zezempilo kwaphawulwa njengomgoqo emazweni anemali ephansi naphakathi uma kuqhathaniswa namazwe anemali ephezulu. Ngaphezu kwengxenye yesithathu yabaphenduli kuzo zonke izifunda baphawule nezingqinamba ezivela ezintweni zomthetho nezokulawula ngenkathi beqaphela ukubaluleka kohlaka lomthetho nezokulawula ekufezeni ukufinyelela okuphephile.

Ukuphazamiseka okuqhubekayo kubangelwa yizici zombili zokufunwa nokunikezwa, okubandakanya amazinga aphansi okufuna ukunakekelwa kwezempilo emiphakathini kanye nokutholakala okulinganiselwe kwabasebenzi bezempilo nezinye izinsiza zokunakekelwa kwezempilo ezifana nemitholampilo evulekile noma izinqolobane zemithi nemikhiqizo etholakalayo. "Kuyizindaba ezimnandi ukuthi izinhlelo zezempilo emazweni amaningi seziqala ukubuyisela izinsizakalo zezempilo ezibalulekile ezigidini zabantu abaphuthelwe yizo ngesikhathi salo bhubhane", kusho uDkt Rudi Eggers, uMqondisi we-WHO wezinsizakalo zezempilo ezihlanganisiwe. "Kodwa sidinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke amazwe ayaqhubeka nokuvala leli thuba ukuze abuyisele izinsizakalo zezempilo ezibalulekile futhi asebenze ngokwengeziwe esimisweni esibanzi sokusebenza esikhathini esizayo". Izimpawu zokuqala eziphawulekayo zokululama Kule nhlolovo entsha, amazwe ambalwa abike ukunciphisa ngamabomu ukufinyelela kuwo wonke amapulatifomu okuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo kanye nemisebenzi ebalulekile yezempilo yomphakathi kusukela ngo-2020-2021, okukhombisa isinyathelo esibalulekile sokubuyela emazingeni angaphambi kobhubhane wokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo kanye nokusebenza kwesistimu ebanzi.

Ukuhlanganisa izinsizakalo ze-COVID-19 ezinsizakalweni zezempilo ezibalulekile Kulesinye isinyathelo esibalulekile sokubuyiselwa kwesistimu nokuguquka, amazwe amaningi enze inqubekela phambili ekuhlanganiseni izinsizakalo ze-COVID-19 ekunikezelweni kwezinsizakalo zezempilo ezijwayelekile. Cishe amazwe angama-80-90% ahlanganise ngokuphelele izinsizakalo zokugoma ze-COVID-19, ukuxilongwa kanye nokuphathwa kwamacala kanye nezinsizakalo zangemva kwesimo se-COVID-19 ekunikezelweni kwezinsizakalo ezijwayelekile. Noma kunjalo, amazwe amaningi (ama-80% amazwe angama-83 aphendulile) abike okungenani isithiyo esisodwa ekwandiseni ukufinyelela kumathuluzi abalulekile we-COVID-19 (isib. Ukuxilongwa kwe-COVID-19, ukwelashwa, imithi yokugoma kanye nemishini yokuzivikela - i-PPE), nezinkinga zabasebenzi bezempilo kanye nokuntuleka kwemali okumelela izithiyo ezivame kakhulu. Ukusekelwa okwengeziwe okudingekayo ukuze kulungiswe, kuzinze futhi kulungele kakhulu Amazwe amaningi aseqalile ukusebenzisa lokho akufundile ngesikhathi sobhadane lwe-COVID-19, kufaka phakathi ngokufakwa kwezinhlelo eziningi zokunciphisa ukuphazamiseka kwezinsizakalo ezintsha ekunikezelweni kwezinsizakalo zezempilo ezijwayelekile.

NgoMeyi 26, amazwe angamalungu avuma isinqumo sokuqinisa amakhono okuxilonga emazweni kanye nokwenza ngcono ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zokuxilonga. Isinqumo esibanzi siyavuma ukuthi izinsizakalo zokuxilonga zibalulekile ekuvimbeleni, ekuqapheni, ekuxilongweni, ekuphathweni kwamacala, ekuqapheni nasekwelapheni izifo ezithathelwanayo, ezingathathelwanayo, eziphuthumayo nezingavamile, ukulimala, nokukhubazeka. Ukuxilonga kuvumela ukuhlonza ngokunembile izifo, ngakho-ke ukuqala ngesikhathi esifanele ukwelashwa okulungile ukuze kube nemiphumela engcono yezempilo. Isinqumo sicubungula lonke uhla lwezindlela zokuxilonga, ngakho-ke kufaka phakathi ukuhlolwa kwe-in vitro, isibonelo, ukuhlolwa okusheshayo kanye nokuphendula kwe-polymerase chain reaction (PCR) kanye nokuxilongwa okungekho in vitro, isibonelo, imishini yokuthwebula izithombe noma yokulinganisa umfutho wegazi. Ihlanganisa izenzo zocwaningo nentuthuko, ukukhiqiza (kufaka phakathi ukukhiqizwa kwasendaweni nokudluliswa kobuchwepheshe), ukulawula, ukukhetha nokuthenga, ukuqwashisa, ukukhuthaza kanye nokubhekana nezingqinamba zokufinyelela ngokujwayelekile.

Umphakathi wamazwe omhlaba kumele usebenzise wonke la mathuluzi ukuze ufinyelele Izinjongo Zentuthuko Eqhubekayo ekupheleni kwaleli shumi leminyaka. UFatih Birol, uMqondisi Omkhulu we-International Energy Agency "Amandla avuselelekayo anezindleko ezincintisanayo aphinde abonise ukuqina okuphawulekayo, kodwa abantu abampofu kakhulu emhlabeni basengakwazi ukuzuza ngokugcwele kuwo. Ukuze sifeze i-SDG7 ngaphandle kokuyekethisa ezinhlosweni zesimo sezulu, kumele senze ushintsho oluhlelekile endleleni ukubambisana kwamazwe omhlaba okusebenza ngayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zezimali zamazwe omhlaba ziqondise ukugeleza kwezezimali ngendlela enobulungiswa emhlabeni wonke ukusekela ukusetshenziswa kwamandla avuselelekayo kanye nentuthuko yengqalasizinda ehlobene. " UFrancesco La Camera, uMqondisi-Jikelele we-International Renewable Energy Agency "Naphezu kokuthuthuka ekufezeni izinhloso zamandla avuselelekayo maphakathi ne-Agenda 2030, i-Goal 7 ibonakala inzima ukuyifinyelela kunango-2015 futhi kudingeka ukuthi kwenziwe izinyathelo ezinkulu uma sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukufinyelela kumandla anentengo ephansi, athembekile, ahlala njalo futhi anamuhla kuwo wonke umuntu ngo-2030.

Kusukela ngoMashi 2023, eminyakeni engaphezu kwemithathu ngemuva kokuthi i-WHO imemezele i-COVID-19 njengeSimo Esiphuthumayo Sezempilo Yomphakathi Esikhathazayo Emhlabeni Wonke (i-PHEIC), ama-69.7% wabantu bomhlaba wonke bathole okungenani umthamo owodwa womuthi wokugoma i-COVID-19. Ngokuphawulekayo, lesi sibalo sisahlala ngaphansi kuka-30% emazweni anemali ephansi (LICs). Lolu hlelo luhlose ukufaka isandla ekufinyeleleni ngokulinganayo emithini yokugoma ye-mRNA ngokwandisa ukusatshalaliswa kwamandla okukhiqiza okusimeme ku-LMICs, ukuthuthukisa ukusebenzisana kwesifunda nokwezingxenye, nokuthuthukisa nokunika amandla abasebenzi bendawo ngokuqeqeshwa okuhambisana nokwesekwa kochwepheshe. Yini eyingqayizivele kumodeli ye-MRNA Technology Transfer yinqubo yamazwe amaningi evumela ukwabelana ngobuchwepheshe kubamukeli abaningi ukuze ngokukhiqiza kwasendaweni nasezifundeni labo abaswele bangafinyelelwa ngokushesha. UDkt Phaahla, uNgqongqoshe Wezempilo eNingizimu Afrika, uthe: "Lokho esikubonayo lapha namuhla, yisikhathi emlandweni, uhlelo oluhlose ukunika amandla ama-LMICs ngenethiwekhi yokubambisana yomhlaba wonke.

Imithamo yokuvikela eyengeziwe yemithi yokugoma esekelwe ku-index virus iyaqhubeka nokunikeza amazinga aphezulu okuvikela ezifweni ezinzima nasekufeni okubangelwa yizo zonke izinhlobo ze-SARS-CoV-2, kufaka phakathi izizukulwane zesizukulwane se-Omicron yanamuhla. Ukuvikelwa ezifweni ezinzima nasekungenweni izifo okubangelwa yimithi yokugoma esekelwe ku-index virus kanye nemithi yokugoma ye-bivalent mRNA equkethe i-BA.1- noma i-BA.4/5 kuyancipha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Kodwa-ke, ukuvikelwa ezifweni ezinzima kugcinwa isikhathi eside kunokuvikelwa ezifweni ezibangelwa izimpawu. Uma kuqhathaniswa nemithi yokugoma esekelwe ku-index virus, imithamo yokuvikela eyengeziwe ye-BA.1- noma i-BA.4/5 equkethe imithi yokugoma ye-bivalent mRNA ingakhuphula kancane ukusebenza komuthi wokugoma ngokumelene nezifo ezibangelwa izimpawu, kuyilapho inani elincane lezifundo ezihlola imiphumela enzima libonisa izilinganiso ezifanayo zokusebenza komuthi wokugoma. Zombili imithi yokugoma ye-BA.1- ne-BA.4/5 equkethe imithi yokugoma ye-bivalent mRNA zithuthukisa ubukhulu futhi ziveze ububanzi obukhulu bezimpendulo zokuzivikela ezihambisanayo ezihambisanayo ze-SARS-CoV-2 lapho zisetshenziswa njengomthamo wokuvikela, uma kuqhathaniswa nemithi yokugoma esekelwe ku-index virus.

I-European Commission kanye ne-WHO baqala uhlelo olubalulekile lwezempilo lwedijithali ukuze kuqiniswe ukuphepha kwezempilo emhlabeni jikelele. I-World Health Organization (WHO) kanye ne-European Commission namuhla bamemezele ukuqaliswa kobambiswano olubalulekile lwezempilo lwedijithali. NgoJuni 2023, i-WHO izosebenzisa uhlelo lwe-European Union (EU) lokuqinisekisa i-COVID-19 yedijithali ukuze kusungulwe uhlelo lomhlaba wonke oluzosiza ukwenza lula ukuhamba komhlaba wonke futhi luvikele izakhamizi emhlabeni wonke ezinsongweni zezempilo eziqhubekayo nezesikhathi esizayo, kufaka phakathi izifo eziwubhubhane. Lokhu kuyisisekelo sokuqala se-WHO Global Digital Health Certification Network (GDHCN) esizokwakha uhla olubanzi lwemikhiqizo yedijithali ukuletha impilo engcono kubo bonke. "Ngokwakha inethiwekhi yokuqinisekisa yedijithali ephumelela kakhulu ye-EU, i-WHO ihlose ukunikeza wonke amazwe angamalungu e-WHO ukufinyelela kuthuluzi lezempilo yedijithali lomthombo ovulekile, olususelwa ezimisweni zokulingana, ukusungula, ukuvuleleka nokuvikelwa kwedatha kanye nobumfihlo", kusho uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, uMqondisi-Jikelele we-WHO.

Ngo-1987 uMkhandlu Wezempilo Womhlaba wamashumi amane, ukhathazekile ngokuhweba ngenzuzo yezitho zomuntu, waqala ukulungiselela Imigomo Yokuqondisa Yokuqala ye-WHO ngokufakelwa, eyamukelwa yiMkhandlu ngo-1991 ngesinqumo se-WHA44.25. Le Migomo Yokuqondisa iye yathonya kakhulu amakhodi nemikhuba yobungcweti kanye nomthetho emhlabeni wonke cishe amashumi amabili eminyaka. Ngemuva kwenqubo yokubonisana eyathatha iminyaka eminingana, uMkhandlu Wezempilo Womhlaba wamashumi ayisithupha nantathu wamukela isinqumo se-WHA63.22 ngo-21 Meyi 2010, esivuma Imigomo Yokuqondisa ye-WHO evuselelwe futhi ekhomba izindawo zokuthuthuka ukwenza ngcono imikhuba yokunikela nokufakelwa. Isimemezelo Sabasebenzi base-Istanbul sokunikela nokufakelwa kusuka kuzo zonke izifunda, ngokusebenzisa izinhlangano nezikhungo zabo eziningi, bayasamukela Isimemezelo se-Istanbul mayelana nokushushumbiswa kwezitho kanye nokuvakasha kokufakelwa okwenziwe ngaphansi kobuholi be-Transplantation Society kanye ne-International Society of Nephrology ngoMeyi 2008.

UDkt Aylward ubelokhu ehola i-WHO's Transformation Agenda kanye nomsebenzi weNhlangano ku-Access to COVID-19 Tools Accelerator (ACT-A) Hub. Endimeni yakhe entsha, uDkt Aylward uzohola i-ajenda yeNhlangano yokuguqula ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo njengokuvikelwa kwezempilo komphakathi, kanye nokuqondisa umsebenzi we-WHO ezinhlelweni zezempilo, ukugonywa kanye nempilo yabesifazane nezingane. UDkt Aylward unesiqu sobudokotela kanye nesiqu se-master's kwezempilo yomphakathi. UDkt Hanan Balkhy uzoqhubeka njengoMsizi woMqondisi-Jikelele we-Antimicrobial Resistance. UDkt Balkhy unikeza ubuholi bezobuchwepheshe nezombusazwe ukunqanda umthwalo wezempilo nezomnotho wokumelana nemithi, kufaka phakathi ngokubambisana kwemikhakha eminingi ne-Food and Agriculture Organization, i-World Organization for Animal Health, kanye ne-United Nations Environment Programme. Ngaphambi kokujoyina i-WHO, uDkt Balkhy wayengumqondisi ophethe we-Infection Prevention and Control eSaudi Arabia's Ministry of National Guard.

Ukumelana namagciwane (AMR) kuma-antibiotic asetshenziselwa ukwelapha izifo ezithathelwana ngocansi, ikakhulukazi i-gonorrhea, kukhuphuke ngokushesha eminyakeni yamuva futhi kunciphise imiphumela yokwelashwa okuphumelelayo. Imiphumela evela ku-Gonococcal AMR Surveillance Programme (GASP) yamanje ikhombisa ukuthambekela kwamazinga aphezulu okumelana ne-quinolone, ukwanda kokumelana ne-azithromycin kanye nokumelana okuvelayo kwama-cephalosporins anesibhedlela esibanzi. Ukuvela kokuncipha kokuthambekela kwe-gonorrhea kuma-cephalosporins anesibhedlela esibanzi, kanye namazinga aphezulu asunguliwe okumelana nama-penicillin, ama-sulphonamides, ama-tetracyclines, ama-quinolones nama-macrolides kwenza i-gonorrhea ibe yinto engamelana nemithi eminingi. I-AMR yezinye izifo ezithathelwanayo, yize ingavamile kangako, nayo ikhona, okwenza ukuvimbela nokwelashwa okusheshayo kubalulekile. Ukuze kwelashwe ngokwanele izifo ezithathelwanayo kubalulekile ukuthatha imithi efanele yokulwa namagciwane, ngomthamo ofanele nobude besikhathi se-STI ethile ukuqinisekisa ukwelashwa okwanele noma ukwelashwa, nokuvimbela ukuthuthukiswa kokumelana namagciwane.

Ezimweni zezinhlelo zezempilo eziqinile, sishayela umthelela wezempilo yomphakathi ekuvikelweni kwezempilo kubo bonke ngokuxoxisana ngenqubomgomo yezinhlelo zesikhathi esizayo kanye nokwesekwa kwamasu okuthuthukisa ukusebenza. Lo msebenzi usekelwa ngokuqondiswa okujwayelekile nezivumelwano; idatha, ucwaningo kanye nokwenza izinto ezintsha; kanye nobuholi emikhakheni yezombusazwe, ukukhuthaza, ukulingana ngokobulili, ukulingana kwezempilo kanye namalungelo abantu, isenzo semikhakha eminingi, kanye nezimali. I-Agenda ka-2030 ye-SDGs Umsebenzi we-WHO uhambisana nenhloso 3.8 ye-Sustainable Development Goals (SDG), egxile ekufezeni ukuvikelwa kwezempilo jikelele, kufaka phakathi ukuvikelwa kwengozi yezezimali, ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zokunakekelwa kwezempilo ezisezingeni eliphakeme kanye nokufinyelela emithini nemithi yokugoma ebalulekile ephephile, esebenzayo, esezingeni eliphezulu futhi engabizi kuwo wonke umuntu. Emhlabeni jikelele, inqubekela phambili ekuvikelweni kwezempilo jikelele iyinselelo. Inqubekela phambili ekuvikelweni kwezinsizakalo imile ngenkathi isilinganiso sabantu ababhekene nezindleko ezinkulu zezempilo ngaphandle kwepokethi sikhula njalo.

Ngo-2021, amazwe angu-139 anengeniso eliphakeme noma eliphakathi nendawo ayehlangabezane nale nhloso, kodwa amazwe angu-56 ngeke afinyelele le nhloso ye-ENAP ngo-2030 uma kungenziwanga eminye imizamo. Uma izimo ziqhubeka njengamanje, izingane eziyizigidi ezingu-15,9 zizofa zizalwa zifile; cishe ingxenye yazo (izigidi ezingu-7,7, 48%) izofika e-Afrika eseningizimu yeSahara. Izimbangela: Ngokunakekelwa kwezempilo okusezingeni eliphezulu ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa nokubeletha, iningi lezingane ezifile lingavinjelwa. Izimbangela eziyinhloko zokuzalwa zifile zihlanganisa izinkinga ezihlobene nokukhulelwa nokubeletha, ukukhulelwa isikhathi eside, izifo ezithathelwanayo ezifana nomalaleveva, isifo sofuba kanye ne-HIV, izimo zomama ikakhulukazi umfutho wegazi ophakeme, kanye nesifo sikashukela, kanye nokunciphisa ukukhula kwengane (lapho ingane engakazalwa ingakwazi ukufinyelela amandla ayo okukhula futhi ngenxa yalokho incane kunalokho okufanele ibe yikho). Ukungajwayelekile okuzalwa nakho kubangela ngaphansi kuka-10% wezingane ezifile ezibikwe ezweni lonke emazweni anengeniso ephezulu futhi isilinganiso esiqondile ezindaweni ezinengeniso ephansi asaziwa ngenxa yemikhawulo ekuxilongweni.

Ukuvimbela nokuphendula udlame olubhekiswe ezinganeni kudinga ukuthi imizamo ixazulule ngokuhlelekile izingozi nezici zokuvikela kuwo wonke amazinga amane ahlobene nobungozi (umuntu, ubudlelwano, umphakathi, umphakathi). Isinqumo soMkhandlu Wezempilo Womhlaba wonke sangoMeyi 2016 sasekela uhlelo lokuqala lwe-WHO Global Plan of Action lokuqinisa indima yohlelo lwezempilo ngaphakathi kokuphendula kwezwe okuhlanganisa imikhakha eminingi ukubhekana nodlame olubhekiswe kubantu, ikakhulukazi kwabesifazane namantombazane, kanye nezingane. A Ngokusho kwalolu hlelo, i-WHO ngokubambisana namazwe angamalungu nabanye abalingani, izibophezele: Ukuqapha ubukhulu bomhlaba wonke kanye nezici zodlame olubhekiswe ezinganeni nokusekela imizamo yezwe yokubhala nokulinganisa lolu dlame. Ukugcina uhlelo lolwazi lwe-elekthronikhi olufingqa idatha yesayensi ngomthwalo, izimbangela zobungozi kanye nemiphumela yodlame olubhekiswe ezinganeni, kanye nobufakazi bokuthi lungavinjelwa.

Lesi simemezelo, esakhiwe ngenqubo ehlanganisa wonke umuntu futhi esiqondiswa yi-SIDS, sigcizelela ukuthi izifo ezingalapheki nezimo zempilo yengqondo azikwazi ukubhekwana nazo ngendlela efanele ngaphandle kokubhekana nenkinga yesimo sezulu. "Isinyathelo esinesibindi esimweni sethu sezulu, impilo enhle, nenhlalakahle sithembele ekulungiseni nasekuhleleni kabusha ukuxhaswa ngezimali emhlabeni wonke ukuze kuvulwe izigidigidi zokutshalwa kwezimali, ngenkathi kwenziwa kube lula ukuthi amazwe asathuthuka akhokhe izikweletu zawo", kusho uNdunankulu waseBarbados uMia Amor Mottley. "Ukuxhaswa ngezimali zokuzivumelanisa nokuguquka kwesimo sezulu emazweni asathuthuka kuyisihluthulelo, kanye nezifo ezingathathelwanayo kanye nezimo zempilo yengqondo. "Izinselelo ezibhekene namazwe amancane asathuthuka zihlangene futhi zinezici eziningi. Ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu, ukonakala kwemvelo, ukungalingani kwezenhlalo nezomnotho, kanye nezici zezimali zezempilo kwenza izinkinga zezifo ezingathathelwanayo nezimo zempilo zibe nzima nakakhulu", kusho uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, uMqondisi-Jikelele we-WHO.

Alikho izwe elihlala lingathintwa yile nkinga, futhi i-WHO ithole imibiko yemithi yezokwelapha esezingeni eliphansi noma engamanga, imithi yokugoma kanye nokuxilongwa kwe-in vitro kusuka kuzo zonke izifunda zomhlaba. Imithi ejwayelekile kanye nemithi emisha ingakhohliswa, kusukela emikhiqizweni ebiza kakhulu yomdlavuza kuya emikhiqizweni engabizi kakhulu yokwelashwa kobuhlungu. Amazwe angamalungu e-WHO avumelene ngecebo elibanzi lomhlaba wonke eligxile ekuvimbeleni, ekutholeni nasekuphenduleni ukuze kufinyelelwe ekutholeni imikhiqizo yezokwelapha esezingeni eliphakeme, ephephile, esebenzayo futhi esezingeni eliphakeme. Umthelela: Imikhiqizo yezokwelapha esezingeni eliphansi futhi engamanga idala izinkinga eziningi kumuntu ngamunye othatha umuthi kanye nasemindenini, emphakathini omkhulu, ohlelweni lokunakekelwa kwezempilo kanye nokuhlinzekwa. Lapho imithi ingasebenzi ngendlela okufanele isebenze ngayo, ingahluleka ukwelapha noma ukuvimbela isifo, ifake isandla ekumelaneni nemithi elwa namagciwane, ichithe izinsiza eziyigugu futhi iholele ekulahlekelweni ukwethenjwa kwemithi kanye nokungathembani kwabahlinzeki bezempilo.

UProfesa Petro Terblanche, uMqondisi Omkhulu we-Afrigen uthe: "Iqembu lonke le-Afrigen lijabule kakhulu ukufinyelela kulesi sigaba esibalulekile ngokuqedwa kwesikhulumi sobuchwepheshe be-mRNA. Lesi sikhulumi sitholakala ngaphakathi kwesikhungo sokuthuthukisa nokukhiqiza umuthi wokugoma we-mRNA lapho umuthi wokugoma we-mRNA Hub Covid 19 i-AfriVac 2121 okwamanje isesigabeni sokukhula. Ezinyangeni eziyi-18 ezedlule, i-Afrigen ibhekane noshintsho olumangalisayo ngokusekelwa kwenethiwekhi yabalingani nabafundisi abanikwe amandla yilolu Hlelo. Sikhulise ikhono lethu namandla ethu okuhlangabezana nezindinganiso eziphakeme kakhulu zokuthuthukiswa komuthi wokugoma we-mRNA, sifeza inhloso yokwakha amandla aqhubekayo kuma-LMICs ukukhiqiza imithi yokugoma ye-mRNA. " I-Afrigen isungule ngempumelelo inqubo yokukhiqiza umuthi wokugoma we-COVID-19 ngesilinganiso selabhorethri futhi okwamanje ikhulisa leyo nqubo ezingeni elifanele lokukhiqiza amaqoqo omuthi wokugoma ukuze asetshenziswe ekuhlolweni komtholampilo kweSigaba I / II kuya kumazinga we-GMP.

Ukuzalwa kwengane efile: Ingane efa ngemuva kwamasonto angama-28 okukhulelwa, kodwa ngaphambi noma ngesikhathi sokubeletha, ihlukaniswa njengengane efile. Cishe kunezingane eziyizigidi ezi-2 ezizalwa zifile unyaka ngamunye - eyodwa njalo ngemizuzwana engu-16. Ngaphezu kuka-40% wazo zonke izingane ezizalwa zifile zenzeka ngesikhathi sokubeletha - ukulahlekelwa okungagwemeka ngokuthuthukisa ikhwalithi nokunakekelwa okuhloniphekile ngesikhathi sokubeletha okubandakanya ukuqapha okujwayelekile nokufinyelela ngesikhathi ekunakekelweni kwezokubeletha lapho kudingeka khona. Ukubona ingane efile ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa noma sokubeletha kuyinhlekelele engabhekwanga ngokwanele kuma-ajenda omhlaba, izinqubomgomo kanye nezinhlelo ezixhaswe ngemali. Kukhona izindleko ezingokwengqondo, ikakhulukazi kwabesifazane nemindeni yabo, njengokucindezeleka komama, imiphumela yezezimali kanye nemiphumela yezomnotho, kanye nokucwaswa nokungavumelekile. Ngo-2014, i-World Health Assembly yagunyaza i-Every Newborn Action Plan (ENAP), okubandakanya umgomo womhlaba wonke wezingane ezingu-12 noma ngaphansi ezizalwa esikhathini sesithathu (ngasekupheleni) ngezingane ezingu-1 000 ezizalwayo ezweni ngalinye ngo-2030.

Kodwa-ke, izilinganiso ze-IRENA zibonisa ukuthi ukugeleza kwezimali zomphakathi zamazwe omhlaba ukusekela amandla ahlanzekile emazweni anemali ephansi naphakathi kuye kwehla kusukela ngaphambi kobhubhane lwe-COVID-19 futhi imali ilinganiselwe enanini elincane lamazwe. Ukuhlangabezana nezinhloso ze-SDG 7 nokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bayazuza ngokugcwele ekuzuzeni kwezenhlalo nezomnotho ekushintsheni kwamandla avuselelekayo, kuyadingeka ukuthi kuguqulwe ngokwakhiwa kwezimali zomphakathi zamazwe omhlaba futhi kuchazwe amathuba amasha okuvula utshalomali. Umbiko futhi uthola ukuthi ukwanda kwesikweletu nokwenyuka kwamanani kagesi kuyawenza abe mubi umbono wokufinyelela kubo bonke abantu ekuphekeni okuhlanzekile kanye nogesi. Izibikezelo zamanje zilinganisela ukuthi abantu abayizigidi eziyi-1.9 bazobe bengenakho ukupheka okuhlanzekile kanye nokungafinyeleli kukagesi e-2030 uma singathathi izinyathelo ezengeziwe futhi siqhubeke nemizamo yamanje. Lezi zikhala zizoba nomthelela omubi empilweni yabantu bethu abasengozini kakhulu futhi zisheshise ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu.

Eminyakeni eyishumi edlule kuye kwaba nokwanda kokusebenza komphakathi ekuvimbeleni ukubeletha ngaphambi kwesikhathi nokuzalwa okushonile, okuqhutshwa yinethiwekhi yabazali, ochwepheshe bezempilo, izifundiswa, umphakathi kanye nabanye. Emhlabeni wonke, amaqembu emindeni ethintekile yokubeletha ngaphambi kwesikhathi abe phambili ekukhuthazeni ukufinyelela ekunakekelweni okungcono nasekushintsheni kwenqubomgomo nokusekela eminye imindeni. Okuholela eMhlanganweni Wamazwe Ngamazwe Wezempilo Yomama Nezinsana, eKapa, eNingizimu Afrika kusukela ngo-8 kuya ku-11 Meyi, i-WHO, i-UNICEF, i-UNFPA ne-PMNCH zicela lezi zenzo ezilandelayo zokuthuthukisa ukunakekelwa kwabesifazane nezinsana nokunciphisa izingozi zokubeletha ngaphambi kwesikhathi: Ukutshala imali okwandisiwe: Ukuhlanganisa izinsiza zamazwe omhlaba nezasekhaya ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yomama nezinsana, ukuqinisekisa ukunakekelwa okusezingeni eliphezulu lapho kudingeka khona. Ukuqaliswa okusheshayo: Ukuhlangabezana nemigomo yezwe yentuthuko ngokusebenzisa izinqubomgomo zikazwelonke ezimiselwe ukunakekelwa komama nezinsana.

Umgomo uhlanganisa ukufinyelela kagesi kanye nokupheka okuhlanzekile kuwo wonke umuntu, ukuphinda kabili amazinga omlando wokuthuthuka kokusebenza kahle, nokwandisa kakhulu isabelo samandla avuselelekayo kumxube wamandla womhlaba. Ukufeza lo mgomo kuzoba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni nasenhlalakahleni yabantu, kusize ukubavikela ezingozini zemvelo nezenhlalo ezifana nokungcoliswa komoya, nokwandisa ukufinyelela ekunakekelweni kwezempilo okuyisisekelo kanye nezinsizakalo. Uhlelo lwango-2023 lwe-Tracking SDG 7: Umbiko Wokuthuthuka Kwamandla luxwayisa ukuthi imizamo yamanje ayanele ukufeza i-SDG 7 ngesikhathi. Kube khona intuthuko ethile ezintweni ezithile ze-SDG 7 - ngokwesibonelo, izinga elikhulayo lokusebenzisa amandla avuselelekayo emkhakheni wamandla - kodwa intuthuko ayanele ukufinyelela imigomo ebekwe kuma-SDG. Inkinga yamandla emhlabeni wonke kulindeleke ukuthi ikhuthaze ukusetshenziswa kwamandla avuselelekayo futhi ithuthukise ukusebenza kahle kwamandla ngezinqubomgomo eziningana zikahulumeni ezikhomba ekwandeni kokutshalwa kwezimali.

Izwe ngalinye linendlela ehlukile yokufeza i-UHC futhi linqume ukuthi yini okufanele ihlanganiswe ngokuya ngezidingo zabantu balo kanye nemithombo etholakalayo. Ukutshala imali ku-PHC kuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke lezo zidingo ziyabonwa, zibekwe phambili futhi zibhekwane nazo ngendlela ehlanganisiwe; ukuthi kunabasebenzi bezempilo abaqinile nabahlomele; nokuthi yonke imikhakha yomphakathi inikela ekubhekaneni nezici zemvelo nezenhlalo nezomnotho ezithinta impilo nenhlalakahle, kufaka phakathi ukulungiselela, ukuphendula nokululama ezimweni eziphuthumayo. Impendulo ye-WHO: Njengesisekelo se-UHC, i-WHO incoma ukuqondiswa kabusha kwezinhlelo zezempilo kusetshenziswa indlela yokunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo (PHC). Ukufeza i-UHC kuyinto ebaluleke kakhulu ye-WHO, ngenhloso yokuthi abantu abayizigidi eziyinkulungwane bathole ukunakekelwa kwezempilo jikelele ngo-2025. Emazweni anezinhlelo zezempilo ezibucayi, sigxila ekusizeni kwezobuchwepheshe ukwakha izikhungo zikazwelonke nokulethwa kwezinsizakalo ukuze kugcwaliswe izikhala ezibalulekile ezimweni eziphuthumayo.

Lona unyaka wesine womkhosi wamafilimu futhi umncintiswano wawunamandla, njengoba amafilimu angu-93 abhalwe ohlwini ahlanganisa izinkinga ezisukela ekukhathazekeni nasekucindezelekeni kuya emiphumeleni yokuguquka kwesimo sezulu empilweni, kanye nezinselelo zezempilo zabantu abakhubazekile. Amafilimu ahlulelwe yiphaneli labachwepheshe abavelele, abaculi kanye nezishoshovu, kubandakanya nabalingisi abadumile, uSharon Stone no-Alfonso Herrera, umqambi womdanso, uSherrie Silver, isishoshovu sesimo sezulu, uSophia Kianni kanye nomuntu wezindaba, u-Adelle Onyango. Bajoyina izikhulu eziphezulu zeZizwe Ezihlangene kanye nabasebenzi be-WHO. "Umkhosi wefilimu we-Health for All uletha ubuso bomuntu emsebenzini wesayensi we-WHO", kusho uMqondisi-Jikelele we-WHO, uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. "Ukulalela amazwi abantu abathintwa yizinkinga zezempilo kuyindlela enamandla yokuqwashisa nokuthuthukisa ukuqonda kwethu okuhlangenwe nakho kwabantu futhi lokhu kungasisiza ukuthi siqhubekele phambili empilweni yabo bonke".

Iziqhingi ezincane zivumelana ngohlelo oluqinile lokulwa nezifo ezingezona ezithathelwanayo kanye nempilo yengqondo Namuhla, kwethulwa iSimemezelo saseBridgetown sika-2023 ngezifo ezingezona ezithathelwanayo kanye nempilo yengqondo, ukubhekana nezinye zezifo ezibulala kakhulu emhlabeni ezizweni ezincane ezisathuthuka (SIDS), ezisengozini enkulu. Isimemezelo siwumphumela oyinhloko weNgqungquthela yoNgqongqoshe beSIDS ngezifo ezingezona ezithathelwanayo kanye nempilo yengqondo, eqhutshwa kusukela ngomhlaka-14 kuya ku-16 Juni, ehlanganiswa yi-World Health Organization (WHO), i-Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) kanye noHulumeni waseBarbados. I-SIDS ithinteka kakhulu yizifo ezingezona ezithathelwanayo - ezibangela u-74% wabo bonke abafayo emhlabeni wonke - ngenxa yokuncika kwazo ekudleni okungenisiwe, amathonya ezentengiselwano kanye nenkinga yesimo sezulu. Umbiko omusha we-WHO ubonisa ukuthi amazwe angu-8 kwangu-15 anengozi engaphezu kuka-30% yokufa ngaphambi kwesikhathi ngenxa yezifo zenhliziyo, umdlavuza, isifo sikashukela, noma isifo sokuphefumula esingamahlalakhona yi-SIDS.

Lokhu kuphakeme kunokuthuthuka okungu-1.2% kusukela emashumini eminyaka adlule. Kodwa-ke, izinga lokuthuthuka kwamandla kagesi liye lancipha eminyakeni yamuva futhi lehla laya ku-0.6% ngo-2020. Lokhu kwenza kube unyaka omubi kakhulu wokuthuthuka kwamandla kagesi selokhu kwaqala inkinga yezimali yomhlaba wonke, yize ngokuyinhloko kungenxa yemikhawulo ehlobene nobhubhane, okungakhombisa ukubuyela emuva kwesikhashana kuphela. Ukuthuthuka konyaka kuze kube ngu-2030 kufanele manje kube ngama-3.4% ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nomgomo we-SDG 7.3. Ukugeleza kwezezimali zomphakathi emhlabeni wonke okusekela amandla ahlanzekile emazweni asathuthuka kuma-US $ 10.8 billion ngo-2021, okungaphansi kuka-35% kunesilinganiso sika-20102019 futhi cishe kungama-40% kuphela esiqongweni sika-2017 sika-US $ 26.4 billion. Ngo-2021, amazwe ayi-19 athola u-80% wezibophezelo. Umbiko uzokwethulwa kubaphathi abaphezulu emcimbini okhethekile wokwethulwa ngoJulayi 11, 2023 e-High-Level Political Forum (HLPF) mayelana nentuthuko eqhubekayo, ngaphambi kwengqungquthela yesibili ye-SDG ngoSepthemba 2023 eNew York.

Imiphumela yocwaningo olusha ikhombisa ukuthi izinhlelo zezempilo seziqala ukululama kulolu bhubhane Ngemuva kweminyaka emithathu yalolu bhubhane lwe-COVID-19, izinhlelo zezempilo emazweni seziqale ukukhombisa izimpawu zokuqala ezinkulu zokululama kohlelo lwezempilo, ngokusho kombiko wesikhashana we-WHO mayelana "nomjikelezo wesine wocwaningo lomhlaba wonke mayelana nokuqhubeka kwezinsizakalo zezempilo ezibalulekile ngesikhathi sobhubhane lwe-COVID-19: Novemba 2022-Januwari 2023". Ngasekuqaleni kuka-2023, amazwe abike ukuthi abhekana nokwehla kokuphazamiseka ekunikezelweni kwezinsizakalo zezempilo ezijwayelekile, kodwa agcizelele isidingo sokutshala imali ekululameni nasekuqineni kwekusasa. Phakathi kwamazwe ayi-139 aphendule emjikelezweni wesine wocwaningo lwe-WHO, amazwe abike ukuthi abhekana nokwehla kokuphazamiseka cishe kwengxenye eyodwa kwezinsizakalo ngokwesilinganiso kusuka ku-56% ngoJulayi-Septhemba 2020 kuya ku-23% ngoNovemba 2022-Januwari 2023.

I-WHO, amazwe angamalungu, kanye nabalingani basebenza ngokubambisana ukukhomba nokusebenzisa izenzo eziza kuqala zokuqinisa ukulungela kwezwe, kwesifunda, kanye nokwehlabathi jikelele ngobhubhane kanye nezinsongo zezifo ezithathelwanayo ezivelayo. Siyaqaphela indima yemiphakathi nayo yonke imikhakha, kanye nesidingo somfutho ohambisanayo futhi oqhubekayo wokuqeda umjikelezo wokwethuka nokunganakwa okuvame kakhulu ekulungiseleleni ubhubhane nasekuphenduleni. Sikhumbula izifundo ezivela ezifweni ezedlule nezifo eziwumshayabhuqe, ikakhulukazi lezo ezibangelwa amagciwane okuphefumula. Lezi zinto eziphilayo zibe futhi zizoqhubeka nokubeka usongo olukhulu emhlabeni wonke olunamandla okubangela ukugula okukhulu nokufa, ukugcwalisa izinhlelo zezempilo, ukuphazamisa umnotho womhlaba, kanye nokwandisa ukungalingani, okukhona ekufinyeleleni kokubili amathuluzi okuvimbela ubhubhane nokunakekelwa kwezempilo kwabo bonke abantu. Lokhu kuyi-Call to Action ukusheshisa ukulungela ubhubhane kanye nezinsongo ezivelayo emhlabeni jikelele.

Indlela yokudla ihluka kakhulu emazweni anengcebo efanayo; ayihambelani nezidingo zezokwelapha, njengoba kuboniswe inani elilinganisiwe lezinsuku abantu abahlushwa ngazo ubuhlungu noma ukuphefumula kanzima kubantu abanesifo esingalapheki. Le mininingwane iyavumelana naleyo yeKhomishini yeLancet ka-2018 echaze ukuntuleka kokutholakala kwemithi yokudambisa izinhlungu 'njengenye yezinto ezimbi kakhulu, ezingalungile emhlabeni jikelele' kanye ne-10% yamazwe acebile kakhulu ane-90% yemithi ye-morphine ehlukanisiwe. "Ukushiya abantu behlupheka lapho imithi esebenzayo itholakala ukuphathwa kobuhlungu, ikakhulukazi esimweni sokunakekelwa kokuphela kwempilo, kufanele kube yimbangela yokukhathazeka okukhulu kwabenzi benqubomgomo", kusho uDkt Yukiko Nakatani, uMsizi kaMqondisi-Jikelele we-WHO wezokwelapha nemikhiqizo yezempilo. "Kumele sikhuthaze ngokushesha ukufinyelela okuphephile nokufika ngesikhathi kwe-morphine kulabo abadinga ukwelashwa ngokusebenzisa inqubomgomo elinganiselayo, yonke indawo".

Lezi zimali zisekela ukusebenza kwe-Hub eNingizimu Afrika kanye nabalingani benethiwekhi emhlabeni jikelele. Sikholelwa ngokuqinile ekubalulekeni kokwakha amakhono ezingeni lendawo nelesifunda, kusho uMnu Martin Seychell, iSekela likaMqondisi Omkhulu weKhomishini yaseYurophu. "I-EC isivele inikele ngezigidi ezingama-€40 ekusungulweni kwe-Hub yokudluliswa kobuchwepheshe be-mRNA futhi isanda kusayina esinye isibonelelo ne-EIB esingu-€15,5 million ukwenza lula ukwanda kwamandla okukhiqiza imithi yokugoma. Lokhu kuyingxenye yokutshalwa kwezimali okuphelele ngaphansi kwe-EU Global Gateway strategy, lapho kuthuthukiswe khona ngaphezu kwe-€1 Billion ngaphansi kwe-Team Europe Initiative on Manufacturing health products. Manje sekubaluleke kakhulu ukubhekana nezinkinga ezingaba khona zokulawula kanye nokufunwa, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi akukhiqizwa kuphela imithi yokugoma esezingeni eliphakeme kuzo zonke izifunda zomhlaba, kodwa futhi nokufinyelela okusheshayo nokulinganayo kuleyo mithi yokugoma. "

Ukusetshenziswa kwe-biomass yendabuko kusho nokuthi amakhaya achitha amahora afinyelela kwangu-40 ngesonto eqoqa izinkuni zomlilo futhi epheka, okuvimbela abesifazane ekufuneni umsebenzi noma ekubambeni iqhaza ezinhlanganweni zokuthatha izinqumo zendawo kanye nezingane ukuya esikoleni. Ngokwezibalo ze-WHO zango-2019, ukufa ngaphambi kwesikhathi kwezigidi ezingama-3.2 minyaka yonke kwakubangelwa ukungcoliswa komoya emakhaya okwenziwa ngokusebenzisa uphethiloli nobuchwepheshe bokupheka obungcolisayo. Ukusetshenziswa kukagesi ovuselelekayo ekusetshenzisweni komhlaba wonke kukhule kusuka ku-26.3% ngo-2019 kuya ku-28.2% ngo-2020, ukwanda okukhulu konyaka owodwa kusukela ekuqaleni kokulandelela inqubekela phambili ye-SDGs. Imizamo yokwandisa isabelo samandla avuselelekayo ekushiseni nasekuthuthweni, okumelela ngaphezu kwezingxenye ezintathu kwezine zokusetshenziswa kwamandla emhlabeni, ihlala ingafinyeleli emigomweni yesimo sezulu esingu-1.5oC. Amandla kagesi - isilinganiso sokuthi umnotho womhlaba usebenzisa amandla amangaki ngedola le-GDP - sathuthuka ngo-1.8% ngonyaka kusuka ngo-2010 kuya ku-2020.

Bonke abahambi kumele balungiselele izingozi ezahlukahlukene zempilo abangase babhekane nazo ezindaweni abangazijwayele ngaphambi, ngesikhathi nangemva kokuhamba. Abantu abahlela ukuhamba kufanele bafune izeluleko ngezingozi ezingaba khona ezindaweni abazikhethile futhi baqonde indlela engcono kakhulu yokuvikela impilo yabo nokunciphisa ubungozi bokuthola izifo. Ukuhlela kusengaphambili, izinyathelo zokuvimbela ezifanele kanye nezinyathelo zokuqapha zingavikela impilo yabahambi, futhi zinciphise ubungozi bengozi nokuthola izifo. Nakuba umsebenzi wezokwelapha kanye nomkhakha wezokuvakasha kunganikeza usizo oluningi kanye nezeluleko ezinengqondo, kusewumthwalo womhambi ukufuna ulwazi, ukuqonda ubungozi obuhilelekile kanye nokuthatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo zokuvikela impilo yabo ngenkathi behamba. Ubungozi: Lapho kunqunywa ubungozi bezempilo bokuhamba kwamanye amazwe, abahambi kanye nochwepheshe bezempilo kufanele bacabangele lezi zinto ezilandelayo ezibalulekile:

Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo ezimbili ezithole umklomelo ka-2023 ziholwa ngabesifazane. Abanqobile emiklomelweni ka-2023 yiSasakawa Health PrizeAbanqobile ka-2023: I-Nick Simons Institute yaseNepal, noProfesa Vichai Tienthavorn waseThailand I-Nick Simons Institute yinhlangano engekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni ehlose ukuthuthukisa ukunakekelwa kwezempilo ezindaweni zasemakhaya eNepal. Ngokusebenzisana eduze noMnyango Wezempilo kanye Nezabasebenzi baseNepal, i-Institute iqeqeshe ochwepheshe bezokwelapha abangama-7000 (njengababelethisi nabasizi bezokwelapha) ezindaweni zasemakhaya, manje abanikeza izinsizakalo ezidingeka kakhulu emiphakathini yasendaweni lapho kungekho khona inani elanele lodokotela abavamile kanye nochwepheshe. I-Institute inikeze imishini ebalulekile futhi yanikeza abasebenzi bezempilo abengeziwe ukunciphisa ukuntuleka kochwepheshe bezokwelapha ezibhedlela ezingama-44, futhi yasekela ukwakhiwa kohlelo lokusebenza lwezinsizakalo ezingcono ezindaweni ezingaphezu kwezingu-100 zasemakhaya.

Ngo-2019 kuphela, abantu abangu-92 622 bathola ukwelashwa ngokuhlinzwa nge-trachoma esezingeni eliphakeme kanti abayizigidi ezingama-95.2 belashwa ngemithi elwa namagciwane. Naphezu kwale mpumelelo, lesi sifo sihlala siyinkinga enkulu yezempilo yomphakathi, kulinganiselwa ukuthi kuncishiswa imali eyizigidi eziyizinkulungwane eziyi-8 zamaRandi ngonyaka ngenxa yokungaboni nokungaboni kahle. Izimpawu: Ukutheleleka kuhlotshaniswa nezinguquko zokuvuvukala kwe-conjunctiva eyaziwa ngokuthi i- "active trachoma". Isimiso somzimba somuntu sokuzivikela singasusa isifo esisodwa sokutheleleka, kodwa emiphakathini enesifo, ukubuyiselwa kwaleli gciwane kwenzeka kaningi. Ngemuva kweminyaka yezigameko eziphindaphindiwe ze-trachoma esebenzayo, ingaphakathi le-eyelid lingaba nezibazi ezinzima (i-trachomatous conjunctival scarring) kangangokuthi liguquke libheke ngaphakathi futhi libangele ukuthi izinwele zingqongqo zingqongqo (trachomatous trichiasis), okuholela ebuhlungwini obungapheli nokungabekezelelani kokukhanya; lokhu kanye nezinye izinguquko zamehlo kungaholela ekubeni ne-conjunctiva.

Izifo ezingezona ezithathelwanayo ezifana nesifo senhliziyo, unhlangothi, i-asthma, umdlavuza, isifo sikashukela nokucindezeleka; kanye nodlame nokulimala, kubandakanya ukulimala emgwaqeni. Impendulo ye-WHO: Naphezu kwezinselelo zabo, amadolobha angakha amathuba okuthuthukisa impilo, imvelo ehlanzekile kanye nokulwa nesimo sezulu. Izinqubomgomo ezinamandla zasemadolobheni kufanele zibeke phambili ezempilo, njengoba kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zokuphila ezinhle zasemadolobheni, ukwakha abasebenzi abakhiqizayo, ukudala imiphakathi enamandla futhi enempilo, ukuvumela ukuhamba, ukukhuthaza ukuxhumana komphakathi kanye nokuvikela abantu abasengozini. Indlela ye-WHO yezempilo yasemadolobheni igxile ekuthuthukiseni ikhwalithi yomoya, amanzi kanye nokuthuthwa kwendle, kanye nezinye izinto ezinquma imvelo; ukuhlela okuhle kwasemadolobheni; izindawo ezinempilo futhi ezingenaboya; ukuhamba okuphephile nokunempilo; ukuvimbela udlame nokulimala; ukukhuthaza izinhlelo zokudla okunempilo nokudla; ukuphathwa kwemvelo kwezifo ezithathelwanayo; kanye nokulungela izimo eziphuthumayo.

Nge-cysticercosis, isikhathi sokufukamela siyahlukahluka, futhi abantu abathelelekile bangahlala bengenazo izimpawu iminyaka. Kwezinye izifunda ezithintekile, abantu abathelelekile bangathola ama-nodules abonakalayo noma abonakalayo (i-nodule encane eqinile noma i-node eqinile engatholakala ngokuthinta) ngaphansi kwesikhumba. I-Neurocysticercosis ihlotshaniswa nezimpawu nezimpawu ezahlukahlukene ngokuya ngenani, ubukhulu, isigaba kanye nendawo yezinguquko ze-pathological kanye nokusabela komzimba womuntu kanye ne-genotype ye-parasite, kepha futhi ingaba ne-asymptomatic ngokomtholampilo. Izimpawu zingabandakanya ubuhlungu obungapheli bekhanda, ubumpumputhe, ukuquleka (i-epilepsy uma iphindaphindwa), i-hydrocephalus, i-meningitis, i-dementia kanye nezimpawu ezibangelwa ukulimala okuhlala izikhala zesistimu yezinzwa ephakathi. Ukwelashwa: Ukwelashwa kwe-taeniasis nge-Taenia solium kubalulekile ukuvimbela i-neurocysticercosis futhi njengethuluzi lokusiza ekulawuleni noma ukumisa umjikelezo wokudluliswa kwe-parasite.

Le protocol, esebenza kuzo zonke izilungiselelo zemithombo, isiza ukuvala igebe lokulingana kwezempilo ekunakekelweni komama nezingane. Ngokubambisana nohulumeni kazwelonke wasePhilippines kanye namazwe ayi-17 e-WHO Western Pacific Region, udlale indima ebalulekile ekwandiseni umkhankaso we-First Embrace for Early Essential Newborn Care - iqoqo lezindlela ezilula ezinconywe yi-WHO futhi ezingabizi kakhulu. U-Highness Sheikh Sabah Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah Prize for Research in Health Care for the Elderly and in Health Promotion 2023 award laureates: I-National Center for Chronic and Noncommunicable Disease Control and Prevention evela eChina; kanye noDkt Abla Mehio Sibai waseLebanon I-National Center for Chronic and Noncommunicable Disease Control and Prevention, eyingxenye ye-Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention (China CDC), isingathe umnyango ogxile empilweni yabantu abadala kusukela ngo-2013.

I-WHO izoqhubeka nokuthuthukisa nokusabalalisa imihlahlandlela yezifo ezithile njengoba kudingeka. Ukuqaliswa kwalolu hlelo kwenzeka ngosuku lokugcina lwemihlangano nabantu abangaphezu kuka-120 abamele amazwe angamalungu, abalingani, kanye noNobhala we-WHO, ukuchaza indlela eya phambili ye-PRET, kufaka phakathi ukuthuthukiswa komgwaqo wokusebenza womhlaba wonke wokulungela ubhubhane lwezifo zokuphefumula. Imodyuli yokuqala ye-PRET Initiative igxile ezintweni ezibangela izifo zokuphefumula, kufaka phakathi umkhuhlane, ama-coronaviruses, kanye negciwane lokuphefumula elihambisanayo. Ngenxa yobhubhane oluqhubekayo lwe-COVID-19 kanye nosongo olungaba khona lomkhuhlane wezinyoni, le modyuli izovumela amazwe ukuthi abukeze ngokucophelela, ahlole, futhi avuselele imizamo yawo yokuhlela ubhubhane lokuphefumula ukuqinisekisa ukuthi banamandla okusebenza namakhono. Inqubo iyaqhubeka ukukhomba iqembu elilandelayo lezifo ezibangela izifo, njengama-arboviruses, ezizobhekwana nazo ngaphansi kwalesi sinyathelo.

Ngaphandle kwethalente lakhe elivelele lokucula, uFleming ubelokhu engummeli oshisekayo wocwaningo lapho ubuciko nezempilo kuhlangana khona. Izethulo zakhe emhlabeni wonke nososayensi nabasebenza kwezokwelapha, indima yakhe ehamba phambili ezinhlelweni ezinkulu, kanye nokuxhumana kwakhe ne-WHO kukhombisa ukuzibophezela kwakhe ekusebenziseni amandla aguqulayo ezobuciko emphakathini ongcono. "Ngijabule kakhulu ukuthi i-ejensi yezempilo yomhlaba ephambili ibona umthelela onamandla wezobuciko empilweni, futhi ngizizwa ngihlonipheke kakhulu ukuthi nginikwe ukwabelana ngalo mlayezo", kusho uFleming. "Nsuku zonke, intuthuko kwezesayensi yezinzwa nocwaningo lomtholampilo yembula okuningi ngezinzuzo zokwelashwa kwezobuciko, okuhlangenwe nakho, kanye nemfundo, nemiphumela enhlalakahleni yonke impilo yomuntu. Kodwa-ke, sisanda kuqala ukuqaphela amandla amangalisayo alo msebenzi, futhi ngibheke phambili ekwandiseni ukuqwashisa nokufinyelela njenge-WHO Goodwill Ambassador.

Ngemva kokukhuthaza ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekunakekelweni kwezibhedlela iminyaka engaphezu kwengu-20, uDkt Jorge Francisco Meneses wasungula amakomiti asekelwe emphakathini agxile ekuphepheni nasekwanelisekeni kweziguli, imindeni yazo kanye nomphakathi. Ngenxa yomthelela omuhle womsebenzi wakhe ekuthuthukiseni ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa kweziguli, imodeli yokunakekelwa okuhle nokugxile ezigulini ayiyile yakhuliswa ezingeni likazwelonke. Namuhla, njengomphathi kazwelonke wezibhedlela zaseGuatemala, usungule uhlelo lokuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yezinsizakalo zeziguli zezibhedlela nemindeni yazo. UDkt Meneses usanda kuhlanganisa iphrojekthi yokuhlola entsha eGuatemala South Health Area ukwakha inethiwekhi yokuqala ehlanganisiwe yezinsizakalo zezempilo, egxile kakhulu emiphakathini engakhonzwa kahle. Umsebenzi wakhe uholele ekwamukelweni kwesu likazwelonke lwezinsizakalo zezempilo ezihlanganisiwe, eyokuqala eMelika Ephakathi.

Le Ngqungquthela yoNgqongqoshe iza ngesikhathi esiyingqayizivele futhi izoba yisihluthulelo sokukhulisa izwi nezidingo ze-SIDS, ukuletha izifo ezingalapheki kanye nempilo yengqondo phambili ohlwini lwethu lwezinto eziza kuqala, "kusho uDkt Jarbas Barbosa, uMqondisi we-PAHO, kanye noMqondisi Wesifunda we-WHO eMelika.
