"Ukuze sakhe kulo mkhuba, kufanele sithathe isinyathelo manje. I-PAHO isilungele ukusekela ukuqaliswa okusheshayo kokungenelela esifundeni sethu, kufaka phakathi ukubandakanya ukunakekelwa kwalezi zimo ezinsizakalweni zezempilo eziyinhloko kanye nokusebenzisa izinto ezintsha ezifana namathuluzi ezempilo edijithali. Amazwe e-SIDS anerekhodi lokushayela ukuthatha izinqumo zomhlaba wonke; izivumelwano zawo zePort of Spain ne-SAMOA zivule indlela yesimemezelo sokuqala sezombusazwe se-UN mayelana ne-NCDs ngo-2018. Ingqungquthela kanye neSimemezelo kuzokwazisa futhi kubumbe imihlangano ephezulu ye-UN General Assembly ezayo mayelana nokuhlanganiswa kwezempilo yomhlaba wonke ngoSepthemba 2023 kanye ne-NCDs ngo-2025.

Ubhadane lwe-COVID-19 nezinye izimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo zikhombisile ukuthi amazwe kudingeka akulungele ukubhekana nezinsongo zezifo ezithathelwanayo, anezinhlelo zokulungiselela ezilungiselelwe futhi anokuxhumana nokubambisana okungcono neminye imikhakha efana nezolimo. "Ukulungiselela, ukuvimbela, kanye nemisebenzi yokuphendula akumele kube yisifundazwe somkhakha wezempilo kuphela", kusho uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, uMqondisi-Jikelele we-WHO. "Njengoba izimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo zinomthelela emikhakheni eminingi, kanjalo nemizamo yethu yokulungiselela nokuphendula kufanele ihlanganise imikhakha, imikhakha kanye namagciwane. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi ukubandakanyeka komphakathi kanye nokulingana kube yisikhungo semizamo yethu, ikakhulukazi kulabo bantu abacindezelwe futhi abasengozini enkulu. "I-PRET iyintuthuko endleleni i-WHO elungiselela ngayo ubhadane ngokusebenzisa ilensi yokudluliswa, kunokugxila ezifweni ezithile.

Ngaphambi kokujoyina i-Wellcome ngo-2013 uDkt Farrar wachitha iminyaka engu-17 njengoMqondisi we-Clinical Research Unit eSibhedlela Sezifo Ezishisayo eVietnam lapho izithakazelo zakhe zocwaningo zazisempilweni yomhlaba wonke ngokugxila ezifweni ezithathelwanayo ezivelayo. UDkt Farrar ungumcwaningi wezokwelapha onesiqu sezokwelapha kanye ne-PhD. UDkt Ailan Li uzoba nguMsizi woMqondisi-Jikelele we-Universal Health Coverage, Healthier Populations kusukela ngomhlaka-8 Meyi 2023. Kulesi sikhundla uDkt Li uzobheka imizamo yeNhlangano yokukhuthaza impilo engcono nenhlalakahle ngokungenelela okuhlobene nezimbangela zezempilo, ezenhlalo nezomnotho, kufaka phakathi ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu, ukulawulwa kukagwayi, ukuphepha kwamakhemikhali, ukuphepha emigwaqweni, izinhlelo zokudla kanye nokudla, umsebenzi womzimba, ukungcola komoya nemisebe, ngendlela ye-One Health. UDkt Li ubelokhu esebenza njengoMmeleli we-WHO eMbusweni waseCambodia kusukela ngomhlaka-15 Julayi 2019.

Ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane kunemiphumela emikhulu esheshayo neyesikhathi eside. Ngaphandle kokufa, ukulimala ngokomzimba nokukhubazeka, udlame lungaholela ekucindezelekeni okuphazamisa ukuthuthukiswa kobuchopho futhi kulimaze amasosha omzimba. Lokhu kuhlotshaniswa nokubambezeleka kokuthuthukiswa kwengqondo, ukusebenza kabi esikoleni nokuyeka isikole, izinkinga zempilo yengqondo, ukuzama ukuzibulala, ukwanda kokuziphatha okuyingozi empilweni, ukuhlukunyezwa kabusha kanye nokwenziwa kobudlova. Izindaba ezinhle ziwukuthi ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane kungavinjelwa ngokungenelela okusekela abazali nabanakekeli, ukukhuthaza izindinganiso namagugu okungabi nodlame, ukuhlinzeka ngemfundo namakhono okuphila, ukuqinisa imali yemindeni nokuvikeleka kwezomnotho, ukunikeza izinsizakalo zokuphendula nezokusekela ezisezingeni eliphakeme, ukudala nokugcina izindawo eziphephile zezingane, nokusebenzisa nokuphoqelela imithetho yokulwa nokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane. I-WHO, ngokubambisana nabalingani abaningana:

Isibonelo, imisebenzi yokunakekelwa kwezempilo eluhlaza ingadala izinzuzo zezempilo zeziguli nezisebenzi ngenkathi futhi igcina amandla, inciphisa ubungozi besimo sezulu futhi idala ukonga izindleko zesikhathi eside. I-World Health Organization izibophezele ekuphishekeleni intuthuko eqhubekayo kuyo yonke imisebenzi yayo yokusiza ukuvikela abantu bakusasa ezingozini zezempilo ezikhulayo zanamuhla. Umthelela: Amasu amaningi entuthuko eqhubekayo anganikeza ukunqoba okukhulu kwezempilo, isimo sezulu kanye nemvelo, futhi izinzuzo zingabonakala cishe ngokushesha. Isibonelo, izinhloso eziningi zezempilo nentuthuko zingafinyelelwa ngasikhathi sinye ngokubhekana nokungcola komoya, okubangela ukufa okungapheli kwabantu abayizigidi eziyi-7 minyaka yonke. Ukungcola okungcolisayo kufaka phakathi izinto ezingcolisa isimo sezulu ezinamandla ezinesikhathi esifushane (SLCPs) ikakhulukazi ikhabhoni emnyama, i-ozone kanye ne-methane, eziyingozi kakhulu empilweni kodwa ezinesikhathi esifushane sokuphila emkhathini.

"Ukubambisana komhlaba wonke ekuqapheni izifo ezibangela izifo kuye kwaba yinto ebalulekile njengoba umhlaba wonke ulwa ne-COVID-19 ndawonye", kusho uDkt Rajiv J. Shah, uMongameli weRockefeller Foundation. "I-IPSN isebenzisa lokhu okuhlangenwe nakho ngokwakha ipulatifomu eqinile yabalingani kuyo yonke imikhakha kanye nemingcele ukuze babelane ngolwazi, amathuluzi, kanye nemikhuba ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuvimbela nokuphendula ubhubhane kuyinto entsha futhi iqinile esikhathini esizayo. Naphezu kokukhuphuka kwakamuva kwamandla e-genomics emazweni ngenxa yobhubhane lwe-COVID-19, abaningi baswele izinhlelo ezisebenzayo zokuqoqa nokuhlaziya amasampula noma ukusebenzisa leyo datha ukuqhuba ukuthatha izinqumo kwezempilo yomphakathi. Akukho ukwabelana okwanele kwedatha, imikhuba, kanye nezinto ezintsha zokwakha isakhiwo esiqinile sokuqapha impilo yomhlaba. Izabelomali ezikhuphuke kakhulu ngesikhathi sobhubhane, ezivumela ukwakhiwa okusheshayo kwamakhono, manje ziyancishiswa, ngisho nasemazweni acebile kakhulu.

Leliqhinga libeka umbono ocacile: ngo-2030, wonke umuntu ofinyelela noma ohlinzeka ngokunakekelwa kwezempilo uphephile ezifweni ezihambisana nakho. Izinhloso zalo ezintathu eziyinhloko yilezi: ukuvimbela ukutheleleka ekunakekelweni kwezempilo; ukuthatha izinyathelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo ze-IPC zikhona futhi ziyasetshenziswa; nokuxhumanisa imisebenzi ye-IPC nezinye izindawo kanye nemikhakha. Leliqhinga ligxile kunoma yisiphi isimo lapho ukunakekelwa kwezempilo kunikezwa khona, kulo lonke uhlelo lwezempilo; kusekelwe esimisweni sokunakekelwa okuhlanzekile nokuphephile njengengxenye ebalulekile yelungelo lempilo, eliqhutshwa ngokulingana, futhi okufanele liqinisekise ukuziphendulela nokusimama. Isu lomhlaba wonke le-IPC lizohlanganiswa, futhi lisetshenziswe ngokuhambisana, nohlelo lokusebenza lomhlaba wonke oluhambisana nokubheka, oluzokwakhiwa ngo-20232024. Idokhumenti ehlobene ne-EB152/9 - Uhlaka lwecebo lomhlaba wonke lokuvimbela nokulawula ukutheleleka, Umbiko wesifinyezo esiphezulu soMqondisi-Jikelele

I-Big Tobacco - kanye nabo bonke abakhiqizi bemikhiqizo kagwayi - ilwela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izingozi zemikhiqizo yabo zifihliwe, kodwa nathi siyalwa: Ngo-2003, amazwe angamalungu e-WHO amukela ngazwi linye i-WHO Framework Convention on Tobacco Control (i-WHO FCTC), okuwukuphela kwesivumelwano sezempilo yomphakathi ngaphansi kokuqondiswa kwe-WHO. Isebenza kusukela ngo-2005, njengamanje inamaqembu angu-181. Ukusiza amazwe ukuba asebenzise i-WHO FCTC, i-WHO yethule i-MPOWER, iphakethe lezinyathelo zobuchwepheshe nezinsiza, ngalinye elihambisana okungenani nesimiso esisodwa se-WHO FCTC. I-MPOWER yakha ikhono lamazwe lokusebenzisa izinyathelo eziyisithupha zokunciphisa ukufunwa kwemikhiqizo kagwayi: ukuqapha ukusetshenziswa kukagwayi nezinqubomgomo zokuvimbela, ukuvikela abantu ekusebenziseni ugwayi, ukunikeza usizo lokuyeka ukusebenzisa ugwayi, ukuxwayisa ngezingozi zikagwayi, ukuphoqelela ukuvinjelwa kokukhangisa ngogwayi, ukukhuthaza nokuxhasa kanye nokwenyusa izintela zikagwayi.

I-WHO yethula isinyathelo esisha sokuthuthukisa ukulungela ubhubhane Ukuze isize amazwe alungiselele kangcono ubhubhane oluzayo, i-WHO yethule isinyathelo esisha namuhla esinikeza isiqondiso ekuhleleni okuhlanganisiwe kokuphendula kunoma yiziphi izifo ezibangela izifo zokuphefumula ezifana nomkhuhlane noma ama-coronavirus. I-New Preparedness and Resilience for Emerging Threats Initiative, noma i-PRET, ifaka amathuluzi nezindlela zakamuva zokufunda okwabelwana ngazo kanye nezenzo ezihlangene ezisungulwe ngesikhathi sobhubhane lwe-COVID-19 nezinye izimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo zomphakathi. Ngalesi sinyathelo, i-WHO izosebenzisa indlela yokudlulisela indlela yokuqondisa amazwe ekuhleleni ubhubhane, njengoba kunikezwe amandla amaningi namakhono ajwayelekile phakathi kwamaqembu ezifo ezibangela izifo. I-PRET iphendula ucingo lokuqondisa kwezobuchwepheshe nokusekelwa kokukhuthaza nokuqinisa ukulungela nokuphendula okuhlanganisiwe, njengoba kuchazwe ezinqumweni ze-World Health Assembly.

UProfesa Piot naye wadlala indima ekutholakaleni kwegciwane le-Ebola, nasekuvimbeleni ukuqubuka kokuqala okwaziwayo, ebambe iqhaza ekuphenyweni kwezifo. Ube ngusihlalo wezinhlelo eziningi ezisezingeni eliphezulu, wasebenza ezikhundleni eziningi zokweluleka ezisezingeni eliphezulu, kufaka phakathi i-COVID-19, futhi wathola imiklomelo eminingi. UProfesa Piot unguMeluleki Okhethekile kaMongameli we-EC, uProfesa Wezempilo Yomhlaba kanye noMqondisi wangaphambili weLondon School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine. "Kulesi sikhathi sezimo eziphuthumayo eziningi, izinkinga zezempilo, kanye nezingxabano, siyaqaphela ukuthi ubuholi kwezempilo yomphakathi nesayensi bubaluleke kakhulu kunanini ngaphambili ukuqhubekisela phambili impilo yomhlaba. "Umqondisi-Jikelele we-WHO, uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, uthe: "Ngesikhathi sezimo eziphuthumayo eziningi, izinkinga zezempilo, kanye nezingxabano, siyaqaphela ukuthi ubuholi kwezempilo yomphakathi nesayensi bubaluleke kakhulu kunanini ngaphambili ukuqhubekisela phambili impilo yomhlaba.

Okwamanje amahhashi angaphezu kwezigidi ezintathu omhlaba emazweni angaphezu kuka-120 asetshenziselwa ukutshala ugwayi obulalayo, ngisho nasemazweni lapho abantu bebulawa indlala khona. Umbiko omusha we-WHO, othi "Khulisa ukudla, hhayi ugwayi", ugcizelela ububi bokutshala ugwayi kanye nezinzuzo zokushintshela ezitshalweni zokudla ezizinzile kubalimi, imiphakathi, umnotho, imvelo, kanye nomhlaba wonke. Umbiko uphinde uveze imboni kagwayi ngokubopha abalimi emjikelezweni omubi wesikweletu, ukukhulisa ukutshala ugwayi ngokugcizelela izinzuzo zayo zezomnotho kanye nokukhuthaza amaqembu okulima. Ukulima ugwayi kubangela izifo kubalimi ngokwabo futhi kulinganiselwa ukuthi bangaphezu kwesigidi abasebenza emapulazini kagwayi, belahlekelwa ithuba labo lemfundo. "Ugwayi awusona nje usongo olukhulu ekungavikeleki kokudla, kodwa empilweni jikelele, kubandakanya nempilo yabalimi bakagwayi.

Sithanda ukuchaza izigaba ezintathu eziyinhloko zezinto ezifeziwe: Okokuqala, ucwaningo olusezingeni eliphezulu olwenziwe yi-HRP lube nomthelela obonakalayo kunqubomgomo yezempilo yomphakathi, amazinga, kanye nemikhuba emhlabeni wonke ekubhekaneni nezidingo eziguqukayo zabantu abahlukahlukene. Okwesibili, i-HRP, ikakhulukazi nge-HRP Alliance, iqinise izikhungo zocwaningo endaweni nasemhlabeni jikelele, futhi, yenza abacwaningi abaningi bakwazi ukuthola amakhono ocwaningo aqinisekisa ukuthi ucwaningo lwe-SRHR olusezingeni eliphezulu lungaqhubeka, futhi lube lukhulu, esikhathini esizayo. Okwesithathu, ezweni eligcwele izinkinga, izingxabano kanye nokwanda kokumelana nokulingana ngokobulili, i-HRP yenze lula ukulondolozwa kwamalungelo ayisisekelo abesifazane namantombazane kanye nabantu abasengozini. I-HRP ihlala iyithuluzi eliyinhloko ngaphakathi kohlelo lweZizwe Ezihlangene locwaningo lokuzala kwabantu futhi iyaqhubeka nokuba ngumholi ovelele kwezempilo yezocansi nokuzala emhlabeni jikelele.

UDkt Jérôme Salomon uzoba nguMsizi woMqondisi-Jikelele we-Universal Health Coverage, Izifo Ezithathelwanayo Nezingathathelwanayo kusukela ngomhlaka-17 Ephreli 2023. Kulesi sikhundla uDkt Salomon uzobheka iphothifoliyo ebanzi yezinhlelo zobuchwepheshe ezihlanganisa i-HIV, i-viral hepatitis, izifo ezithathelwana ngocansi, isifo sofuba, umalaleveva, izifo ezishisayo ezinganakwa, impilo yengqondo, ukuphazamiseka kokusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa, kanye nezifo ezingathathelwanayo ezifana nesifo senhliziyo, isifo sikashukela, izifo zokuphefumula ezingapheli kanye nomdlavuza. UDkt Salomon ubesebenza njengoMqondisi-Jikelele Wezempilo eMnyangweni Wezempilo Nokuvimbela eFrance. Wayeyilungu leBhodi Ebusayo ye-WHO ngaphambi kokuqokwa kwakhe futhi unolwazi oluningi ekuphathweni kwezinhlelo zezempilo, izifo ezithathelwanayo kanye nempilo yomphakathi yamazwe omhlaba. UDkt Salomon uphethe iziqu zobudokotela, iziqu ze-master's kwezempilo yomphakathi kanye ne-PhD kwe-epidemiology.

Imikhiqizo yezokwelapha esezingeni eliphansi neyakhelwe phansi Okubukezwe: Abantu abangafika ezigidini eziyizinkulungwane ezimbili emhlabeni wonke abakwazi ukuthola imithi edingekayo, imithi yokugoma, imishini yezokwelapha kubandakanya ukuxilongwa kwe-in vitro, neminye imikhiqizo yezempilo, okudala isikhala esivame ukugcwaliswa yimikhiqizo esezingeni eliphansi neyakhelwe phansi. Le nkinga iyakhula njengoba amaketanga okuhlinzeka emhlabeni wonke eba yinkimbinkimbi ngokwengeziwe, okusho ukuthi imikhiqizo ekhiqizwa ezweni elilodwa ingahle ifakwe ezweni lesibili futhi isatshalaliswe ngaphesheya kwemingcele ukuze ithengiswe noma ithengiselwe abathengi ezweni lesithathu. Ukukhula kwe-e-commerce nakho kunomthelela kulo mkhuba ngokwenza kube lula ukuthenga imithi online, kaningi kusuka emithonjeni engagunyaziwe. I-WHO ikhombe le nkinga njengenye yezinselelo zezempilo eziphuthumayo kule minyaka eyishumi ezayo ngenxa yokuthi imithi engaphezu kweyodwa kweyishumi emazweni anemali ephansi naphakathi kulinganiselwa ukuthi ingaphansi kwezinga eliphansi noma ingeyamanga.

"Kumele sivikele isizukulwane esilandelayo ngokwenza okuthile manje. Ukutshala imali ezixazululweni ezihlanzekile nezivuselelekayo ukusekela ukufinyelela kwamandla emhlabeni wonke kuyindlela esingenza ngayo ushintsho lwangempela. Ubuchwepheshe bokupheka obuhlanzekile emakhaya kanye nogesi onokwethenjelwa ezikhungweni zokunakekelwa kwezempilo kungadlala indima ebalulekile ekuvikeleni impilo yabantu bethu abasengozini enkulu. " UDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, uMqondisi-Jikelele we-WHO, i-World Health Organization Mayelana nombiko Lo mbiko ushicilelwe yizinhlangano ezigcina i-SDG 7, i-International Energy Agency (IEA), i-International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA), i-United Nations Statistics Division (UNSD), iBhange Lomhlaba, kanye ne-World Health Organization (WHO) futhi ihlose ukuhlinzeka umphakathi wamazwe omhlaba ngedeshibhodi yomhlaba wonke yokubhalisa inqubekela phambili ekufinyeleleni kwamandla, ukusebenza kahle kwamandla, amandla avuselelekayo kanye nokubambisana kwamazwe omhlaba ukuqhubekisela phambili i-SDG 7.

Ngokusebenzisa i-International Trachoma Initiative, i-azithromycin elwa namagciwane inikelwa yi-Pfizer ezinhlelweni zokuqeda ezisebenzisa isu le-SAFE. IBenin ihlanganise izindlela zokuqeda i-trachoma nalezo ezisetshenziswe ngokumelene nezinye izifo ezishisayo ezinganakiwe (i-NTDs), ngaphansi kwesambulela soHlelo Lukazwelonke Lwezifo Ezithathelwanayo. I-Trachoma iyi-NTD yesithathu ezosuswa eBenin, ngemuva kwe-dracunculiasis (ngo-2009) kanye ne-gambiense human African trypanosomiasis (ngo-2021). IMali yenze ucwaningo lomthelela lwe-trachoma kanye nokuqapha futhi yaqala ukungenelela ukufeza imigomo yokuqeda, naphezu kwezinselelo zokuphepha ezifundeni ezisenyakatho yezwe kanye nezinxushunxushu zezenhlalo nezombusazwe eminyakeni yamuva. I-Trachoma iyi-NTD yokuqala ezosuswa eMali, ngakho-ke manje ijoyina iqembu lomhlaba wonke lamazwe angama-47 aqede okungenani i-NTD eyodwa.

Ukuzinakekela ngokwakho: Ukuzinakekela ngokwakho yikhono labantu, imindeni kanye nemiphakathi lokuthuthukisa impilo, ukuvimbela izifo, ukugcina impilo, nokubhekana nokugula nokukhubazeka ngokusekelwa noma ngaphandle kosizo lwabasebenzi bezempilo. Okwamanje abantu abayizigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezi-3.6 - isigamu somhlaba wonke - abanakho ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zezempilo ezibalulekile. I-WHO incoma ukuzinakekela ngokwakho kuwo wonke amazwe kanye nezimo zezomnotho, njengendlela ebalulekile yokufinyelela ekunakekelweni kwezempilo komphakathi, ukukhuthaza impilo, ukugcina umhlaba uphephile, nokusiza ababuthakathaka. Ukuzinakekela ngokwakho kuyiqiniso elisekelwe ebufakazini, amathuluzi ekhwalithi asekela ukuzinakekela.

Ama-NCD ̶ usongo olukhulayo empilweni yezizukulwane ezizayoNaphezu kwentuthuko yezempilo jikelele, isabelo sokufa okubangelwa minyaka yonke ama-NCD sikhule ngokuqhubekayo futhi manje sibiza cishe izingxenye ezintathu kwezine zabo bonke abantu abafa unyaka ngamunye. Uma lo mkhuba uqhubeka, ama-NCD kulindeleke ukuthi abe ngu-86% wabantu abangu-90 million abafa minyaka yonke maphakathi nekhulu leminyaka; ngenxa yalokho, izigidi ezingama-77 zalaba zizoba ngenxa yama-NCD ̶ ukwanda okucishe kube ngu-90% ngamanani aphelele kusukela ngo-2019 kuya ku-2021 ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nomgomo we-SDG. Ngokufanayo, ukwehla okuphelele kwezinga lokuhlaselwa yi-TB kusukela ngo-2015 kuya ku-2021 bekungokwenye yezindlela eziyisihlanu zokufinyelela umgomo we-2025 we-End TB Strategy ye-WHO.

I-WHO ihalalisela iBenin neMali ngokuqeda i-trachoma njengenkinga yezempilo yomphakathi. I-WHO iqinisekise ukuthi iBenin neMali ziqede i-trachoma njengenkinga yezempilo yomphakathi, okwenza kube amazwe wesihlanu nowesithupha esifundeni sase-Afrika se-WHO ukufeza leli phuzu elibalulekile. Amazwe abikele i-WHO ngokuqeda i-trachoma ngaphambilini yiGhana (ngoJuni 2018), iGambia (ngo-Ephreli 2021), iTogo (ngoMeyi 2022) neMalawi (ngoSepthemba 2022). "I-WHO ihalalisela iziphathimandla zezempilo zaseBenin naseMali kanye nenethiwekhi yazo yabalingani bomhlaba wonke nabendawo ngalezi zinyathelo ezibalulekile", kusho uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, uMqondisi-Jikelele we-WHO. "Ngemuva kokuphumelela kweBenin neMali, i-trachoma isalokhu iyinkinga emazweni angu-23 esifundeni sase-Afrika se-WHO, okusisondeza eduze nomgomo wokuqeda i-trachoma obekwe ebalazweni lomgwaqo wezifo ezishisayo ezinganakiwe 2021-2030".

Umhlangano wabalingani wabuye waba sekupheleni kwenqubo enkulu yokubuyekezwa kokusebenza ngaphakathi koMnyango We-WHO Wokulawulwa Kwezifo Ezishisayo Ezishiyiwe. Ezinyangeni ezine ezedlule, i-WHO ibilokhu ilalela iminikelo nobufakazi obuvela kubo bonke abalingani bayo kanye nabathintekayo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi yona ngokwayo ifaka phakathi amagugu okuziphendulela, ukungafihli lutho kanye nokulingana okukhuthazayo nokufunayo. Lawo magugu ahlanganisa nokuqinisekisa ukuthi ama-NTD abekwa kabusha ekwakhiweni kwezempilo yomhlaba. Abahlanganyeli bomhlangano bamukele ukugcizelelwa kwezindima ezibalulekile umphakathi we-NTD ongazidlala futhi kufanele uzidlale ekufakeni isandla ezinseleleni ezibanzi ezifana ne-Universal Health Coverage, i-One Health kanye nosongo olukhulayo lokuguquka kwesimo sezulu emhlabeni jikelele. Abahambeli ababekhona mathupha nabo bakwazile ukujabulela umbukiso ozinikele ezifweni ezishisayo ezinganakwa ehhovisi elikhulu le-WHO.

Kamuva wasiza ekwakheni enye yezindlela zokuqala zokwelapha ngempumelelo igciwane kanye nokusetshenziswa kwemithi yokugoma yokuhlolwa kwegciwane le-Ebola. Usebenze ngokungakhathali ukwakha amandla esayensi eDemocratic Republic of Congo, wamisa izikhungo eziningi zocwaningo ezweni, futhi wadlala izindima ezibalulekile ne-WHO ekulweni nezifo ezithathelwanayo. UProfesa Piot waseBelgium uqashelwa ngobuholi bakhe obungavamile ekuphenduleni ubhubhane lwe-HIV / AIDS kanye nezinye izinselelo ezinkulu zezempilo zomhlaba. Udlale indima ebalulekile ekuqaliseni izinhlelo ezinkulu zezempilo zomhlaba ezifana ne-UNAIDS, i-Global Fund, nezinye ezithuthukise imiphumela yezempilo emhlabeni jikelele. Ngaphansi kobuholi bakhe, i-UNAIDS yaba ngummeli oyinhloko wezenzo zomhlaba wonke zokulwa ne-AIDS, futhi yahola ukuguqulwa kwe-UN ngokuhlanganisa izinhlangano eziyi-10 ezihlukene ze-UN.

Ukufinyelela kukagesi nokupheka okuhlanzekile kusabonisa ukungalingani okukhulu kwezifunda futhi kufanele kube yinto okufanele kugxilwe kuyo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi akekho umuntu oshiywe ngemuva. Ukutshalwa kwezimali kudinga ukufinyelela emazweni angathuthuki kakhulu nase-Afrika eseningizimu yeSahara ukuqinisekisa inqubekela phambili elinganayo kuSimo 7. UStefan Schweinfest, i-United Nations Statistics Division "Naphezu kokwehla kwesivinini sokufakwa kukagesi emhlabeni wonke muva nje, inani labantu abangenawo ugesi cishe liye lancipha ngesigamu kule minyaka eyishumi edlule, lisuka ezigidini eziyi-1.1 ngo-2010 laya ezigidini ezingama-675 ngo-2021. Noma kunjalo, kufanele kwenziwe imizamo nezinyathelo ezengeziwe ngokuphuthumayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abampofu kakhulu nabangafinyeleleki kakhulu abashiywa ngemuva. Ukuze kufinyelelwe ukufinyelela kwabantu bonke ngo-2030, umphakathi wentuthuko kufanele ukhulise utshalomali lwamandla ahlanzekile nokusekelwa kwenqubomgomo. " UGuangzhe Chen, iPhini likaMongameli weZingxenye Zomhlaba Wonke, iBhange Lomhlaba

Lo mklomelo uhlonipha impumelelo yabo empilweni yomphakathi. UProfesa Muyembe-Tamfum waseDemocratic Republic of Congo (DRC) uhlonishwa ngokusungula kwakhe, ubuholi kanye neminikelo yakhe emisha ekuphatheni nasekwelapheni izifo ezifana nesifo segciwane le-Ebola. Udlale indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni imiphumela yezempilo eDemocratic Republic of Congo, esifundeni sase-Afrika, nasemphakathini womhlaba. UProfesa Muyembe-Tamfum unguMqondisi-Jikelele we-DRC's National Institute of Biomedical Research eKinshasa, uProfesa ophelele we-Microbiology e-University of Kinshasa Medical School kanye nomongameli wokuqala we-Congolese Academy of Science. UProfesa Muyembe-Tamfum wayeyingxenye yethimba elathola i-Zaire ebolavirus ngesikhathi sokuqala kokuqubuka okurekhodiwe ngo-1976, esifundazweni sase-Equateur, e-Central DRC.

Imikhiqizo emisha yezempilo yedijithali esathuthukiswa ihlose ukusiza abantu kuyo yonke indawo ukuthi bathole izinsizakalo zezempilo ezisezingeni eliphezulu ngokushesha nangempumelelo. Ngokusekelwe ku-EU Global Health Strategy kanye ne-WHO Global Strategy on digital health, lesi sinyathelo silandela isivumelwano sango-30 Novemba 2022 phakathi kukaKhomishani uKyriakides noDkt Tedros sokuthuthukisa ukubambisana kwamasu ezindabeni zezempilo zomhlaba. Lokhu kuqhubeka nokugqugquzela uhlelo oluqinile lwe-multilateral olune-WHO njengengqikithi yalo, olunikwe amandla yi-EU enamandla. "Lobu budlelwano buyisinyathelo esibalulekile sohlelo lokusebenza lwedijithali lwe-EU Global Health Strategy. Ngokusebenzisa imikhuba emihle yaseYurophu sifaka isandla ezindinganisweni zezempilo zedijithali kanye nokusebenzisana emhlabeni jikelele ukuze kuzuze labo abaswele kakhulu. Futhi kuyisibonelo esinamandla sokuthi ukuvumelanisa phakathi kwe-EU ne-WHO kungaletha impilo engcono kubo bonke, e-EU nasemhlabeni jikelele.

Isinqumo esisha sokusheshisa imizamo yokuthuthukisa izakhi ezincane zokudla Izithunywa zamukela isinqumo sokusheshisa imizamo yokuvimbela ukuntuleka kwezakhi ezincane zokudla ngokuthuthukisa ukudla okuphephile futhi okusebenzayo. Ukuntuleka kwesimo samavithamini namaminerali, ikakhulukazi i-folate, insimbi, uvithamini A, ne-zinc, kuthinta u-50% wabo bonke abantwana abaneminyaka yobudala engaphambi kwesikole kanye no-67% wabo bonke abesifazane abaneminyaka yokuzala emhlabeni jikelele. Ukuntuleka kwezakhi ezincane zokudla kungaba nemiphumela emibi, kufaka phakathi i-spina bifida nezinye iziphambeko zethubhu yezinzwa. Ukuthuthukiswa kokudla okukhulu kuyingxenye yesixazululo. Ngokungeza amavithamini namaminerali abalulekile ekudleni okuyisisekelo kanye nezithako, njengokhukhamba nofulawa lukakolweni, irayisi, uwoyela wokupheka nosawoti ngokuhambisana nemikhuba yokudla kanye nokuntuleka, amazwe angalungisa futhi aqhubeke nokuvimbela ukuntuleka kwezakhi ezincane zokudla okubonisiwe.

Ngaphezu komthelela omubi kagwayi empilweni, izindleko zomnotho eziphelele zokubhema (kusuka ezindlekweni zezempilo kanye nokulahleka komkhiqizo ndawonye) kulinganiselwa ukuthi zizungeze ama-US $ 1.4 trillion ngonyaka, okulingana no-1.8% womkhiqizo wasekhaya wonyaka (GDP). Cishe u-40% walezi zindleko wenzeka emazweni asathuthuka, okugcizelela umthwalo omkhulu la mazwe abhekene nawo. Izintela zikagwayi zisetshenziswa ngokwengxenye ukulwa nalomphumela futhi zibhekwa njengendlela engcono kakhulu yokunqanda ukusetshenziswa kukagwayi, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwentsha kanye nabantu abahola kancane. Ukwanda kwentela okwandisa amanani kagwayi ngo-10% kunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kukagwayi cishe ngo-4% emazweni anengeniso ephezulu futhi cishe ngo-5% emazweni anengeniso ephansi naphakathi. Impendulo ye-WHO: Ubukhulu bale nhlekelele yabantu nezomnotho buyashaqisa, kodwa futhi buyagwemeka.

Emazwini akhe okuvala, uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, uMqondisi-Jikelele we-WHO, waphawula ukuthi "ukwanda kweminikelo ebaliwe kanye nomjikelezo wokutshalwa kwezimali kuyingqophamlando futhi kuyisenzakalo esikhulu". Wakhuluma ngonyaka ozayo, ngezinhlangano ezisezingeni eliphezulu ezibhekene nokuhlinzekwa kwezempilo komphakathi, isifo sofuba kanye nokulungela nokuphendula ubhubhane eMhlanganweni Jikelele we-UN kulo nyaka. Wakhomba ezingxoxweni eziqhubekayo zesivumelwano sobhubhane kanye nezichibiyelo eMithethweni Yezempilo Yomhlaba Wonke njengamathuba angakaze abonwe "ezizukulwaneni" okufunda ngawo amaphutha obhubhane lwe-COVID-19 nokuqinisekisa ukuthi awaphindwanga. Abameli babenethuba lokuzwa kusuka kubasebenzi bangaphambili be-WHO uGwen Carnelley, owagubha iminyaka eyi-100 kulo nyaka, owaqala ukusebenza ne-WHO ngo-1949, ngonyaka owodwa nje ngemuva kokusungulwa kwe-WHO eminyakeni engama-75 edlule. Ividiyo yokuvalwa koMhlangano Womhlaba Wonke Wezempilo wama-76.

Izehlakalo zomlilo wasendle ziya ngokuya ziba zimbi kakhulu ngokuya ngamahektare ashisiwe, isikhathi nobukhulu, futhi zingaphazamisa ezokuthutha, ezokuxhumana, ukunikezwa kwamanzi, kanye nezinsizakalo zamandla negesi. Umthelela: Imililo yasendle evutha eduze nezindawo ezinabantu ingaba nomthelela omkhulu emvelweni, impahla, imfuyo kanye nokufa nokugula kwabantu kuye ngosayizi, isivinini nokusondela emlilweni, nokuthi ngabe abantu banesixwayiso esithuthukisiwe sokuhoxa. Intuthu yomlilo wasendle iyinhlanganisela yezinto ezingcolisa umoya lapho izinhlayiya (PM) ziyisongo esikhulu empilweni yomphakathi. I-PM2.5 evela entuthu yomlilo yasendle ihlotshaniswa nokufa ngaphambi kwesikhathi kubantu abajwayelekile, futhi ingadala futhi ibhebhethekise izifo zamaphaphu, inhliziyo, ubuchopho / uhlelo lwezinzwa, isikhumba, amathumbu, izinso, amehlo, ikhala nesibindi. Kubuye kuboniswe ukuthi kuholela ekuphazamisekeni kwengqondo nokulahleka kwememori.

Ngaphambi kwalesi sikhundla, uDkt Li wasebenza njengoMqondisi Wezimo Eziphuthumayo Wesifunda woHlelo Lwezimo Eziphuthumayo Lwezempilo lwe-WHO eHhovisi Lesifunda le-WHO eNtshonalanga yePacific. UDkt Li uneziqu zobudokotela kanye neziqu kwezesayensi yezenhlalakahle yezempilo. UDkt Yukiko Nakatani uzoba nguMsizi Womqondisi-Jikelele Wokufinyelela Kumithi Nemikhiqizo Yezempilo kusukela ngomhlaka-2 Meyi 2023. Kulesi sikhundla uDkt Nakatani uzobheka ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwezindinganiso nezinqubomgomo ze-WHO ukuqinisekisa ukufinyelela okulinganayo emithini esezingeni eliphakeme, imithi yokugoma kanye nokuxilongwa kwayo yonke imiphakathi yonke indawo, kufaka phakathi ukuvimbela nokuphendula izifo eziwumshayabhuqe. UDkt Nakatani ubesebenza njengoMqondisi WeCandelo Lokulawulwa Komdlavuza Nezifo loMnyango Wezempilo, Wezabasebenzi Nezempilo waseJapan futhi njengoMeluleki Wezobuchwepheshe kuNgqongqoshe Wezwe weQembu Lokugoma I-COVID-19 eJapan.

Ababhali banxusa umphakathi wamazwe omhlaba kanye nabenzi benqubomgomo ukuba bavikele impumelelo etholwe ekufezeni i-SDG 7, ukuqhubekisela phambili izinguquko zesakhiwo, kanye nokugcina ukugxila kwamasu emazweni asengozini adinga ukwesekwa kakhulu. "Inkinga yamandla ebangelwe ukuhlasela kweRussia e-Ukraine iyaqhubeka nokuba nomthelela omkhulu kubantu emhlabeni wonke. Amanani aphezulu kagesi ashaye kanzima abantu abasengozini kakhulu, ikakhulukazi labo abasemnothweni osathuthuka. Ngenkathi ukuguqulwa kwamandla ahlanzekile kuhamba ngokushesha kunalokho abaningi abakucabangayo, kusekhona umsebenzi omningi odingekayo ukuletha ukufinyelela okuzinzile, okuphephile nokungabizi kumasevisi kagesi wesimanje yizigidigidi zabantu abaphila ngaphandle kwawo.

Njengegunya eliqondisayo nelihlanganisa umsebenzi wezempilo wamazwe omhlaba, akekho umlingani ongcono kune-WHO ukuqhubekisela phambili umsebenzi esiwuqale e-EU nokuthuthukisa izixazululo zezempilo zedijithali zomhlaba wonke, "kusho uStella Kyriakides, uKhomishani Wezempilo Nokuphepha Kokudla. Lokhu kubambisana kuzobandakanya ukusebenzisana eduze ekuthuthukiseni, ekuphatheni nasekusebenziseni uhlelo lwe-WHO GDHCN, okuzuzisa ubuchwepheshe obuningi beKhomishini yaseYurophu emkhakheni. Isinyathelo sokuqala ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izitifiketi zamanje zedijithali ze-EU ziyaqhubeka nokusebenza ngempumelelo. Ngamazwe angama-80 nezindawo ezixhunywe ku-EU Digital COVID-19 Certificate, i-EU isibeke indinganiso yomhlaba wonke. Isitifiketi se-EU asibanga nje ithuluzi elibalulekile ekulweni kwethu nalolu bhubhane, kodwa futhi senze lula ukuhamba nokuvakasha kwamazwe omhlaba.

Ukubambisana endaweni kuyisihluthulelo senqubekela phambili emhlabeni wonke maqondana nama-SDG ahlobene nezempilo Umbiko omusha wenqubekela phambili ukhishwa ngokuhlanganyela namuhla yizinhlangano eziyi-13 ezisayine i-Global Action Plan for Healthy Lives and Well-being for All (SDG3 GAP). Umbiko onesihloko esithi "Yini esebenzayo? Yini engasebenzanga? Yini elandelayo?" ubonisa iminyaka emine yomsebenzi ohlanganyelwe yizinhlangano ezinkulu zamazwe ngamazwe ezichaza ukuthi yini esebenzayo nokuthi yini engasebenzanga ekuqiniseni ukubambisana nokusekelwa ukusheshisa inqubekela phambili yezwe maqondana nezinhloso zentuthuko ezinzile (SDGs). Lo nyaka uphawula ingxenye yomgwaqo eya kuma-SDG, kodwa umhlaba usalele emuva ukufinyelela imigomo yomhlaba. Kusukela yethulwa ngo-2019, i-SDG3 GAP ivumele ukwakhiwa kwezakhiwo ezintsha zokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlangano ezisayinile ezindaweni ezibalulekile ezifana nokuxhaswa okuzinzile nokunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo phakathi kokunye.

Abantu abanezidingo zezokwelapha "bashiywe ngemuva ebuhlungwini" kuveza umbiko omusha I-World Health Organization (WHO) ishicilele umbiko omusha mayelana nokutholakala kwe-morphine ukuze isetshenziswe kwezokwelapha, echaza ukuthi ukusatshalaliswa komhlaba wonke kwe-morphine, njengomuthi obalulekile wokwelapha ubuhlungu, akulinganayo futhi akuhlangabezani nesidingo sezokwelapha. Umbiko, onesihloko esithi "Left behind in pain", ugcizelela izinkinga zokutholakala kwalo muthi obalulekile futhi unikeza izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa ukufinyelela okuphephile ngokusebenzisa inqubomgomo elinganiselayo. Naphezu kokuthi i-morphine iyimithi esebenzayo futhi engabizi kakhulu yokudambisa ubuhlungu obukhulu, efakwe ohlwini kusukela ngo-1977 ohlwini lokuqala lwe-WHO Model list of Essential Medicines, umehluko ekufinyeleleni emazweni ahlukahlukene mkhulu kakhulu. Kukhona umehluko ophindwe izikhathi ezingu-5 kuya kwezingu-63 ekusetshenzisweni okulinganiselwe kwe-morphine phakathi kwamazwe anengeniso ephezulu namazwe anengeniso ephansi.

Izici ezihlobene nobudala bomama kanye nokubhema nazo zingandisa ingozi yesifo somama nokuzalwa kwengane efile. Ukuzalwa kwengane efile kungavinjelwa ngokuhlela umndeni ukugwema ukukhulelwa okungafunwa, impilo enhle nokudla ngaphambi nangesikhathi sokukhulelwa, ukunakekelwa kwekhwalithi nokuhloniphekile ngaphambi kokubeletha kanye nokubeletha okubandakanya abasebenzi bezempilo abanamakhono afanele kanye nababelethisi. Ukwelashwa kwesifo sofuba ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa nakho kungavimbela ukuzalwa kwengane efile okulinganiselwa ku-200 000, ngenkathi ukuqapha ukushaya kwenhliziyo kwengane kanye nokuqapha ukubeletha kanye nokungenelela okusheshayo lapho kudingeka kubalulekile ekuvimbeleni ukuzalwa kwengane efile okungu-832 000 kanye nokunciphisa ukufa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa. Ukuzalwa kwengane efile kuhlobene kakhulu nezimbangela zempilo nezenhlalo nezomnotho. Ukuvimbela nokunakekelwa okuphendulayo kudinga ukuhlanganiswa kulo lonke uhlelo lokunakekelwa kwezempilo komama, nangaphezulu.

U-Nelson Mandela Award for Health Promotion 2023 award laureate: uDkt Mariam Athbi Al Jalahma waseBahrain Ngaphezu kokuba yiChief Executive Officer yeNational Health Regulatory Authority yaseBahrain, uDkt Mariam Athbi Al Jalahma ubambe izikhundla ezahlukahlukene zobuholi kuhulumeni nasezikhungweni zemfundo ezweni lakhe. UDkt Al Jalahma ubambe iqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni amasu nezinhlelo eziningi zikazwelonke nezesifunda emkhakheni wezokunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo, impilo yezingane nentsha, izifo ezingamahlalakhona kanye ne-antismoking. Endimeni yakhe yamanje, uDkt Al Jalahma uhole izinhlelo ezinkulu eziphumelelayo, njengohlelo lokugunyazwa kwezikhungo zezempilo kuzwelonke, ukuguqulwa kwedijithali kweNational Health Regulatory Authority, kanye nezinhlelo eziningana eziholela ekwandeni kokusebenza kahle nokwenza kahle emkhakheni wezempilo.

Umbiko obalulekile ubonisa indlela yokuguqula umnotho ukuze unikeze impilo kubo bonke. Embikweni wokuqala walolu hlobo, uMkhandlu we-WHO wezomnotho wezempilo yabo bonke uveze indlela entsha enesibindi yokuguqula umnotho ukuze unikeze lokho okubalulekile - impilo kubo bonke. UMkhandlu, owasungulwa nguMqondisi-Jikelele we-WHO uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus ngoNovemba 2020 ekuphenduleni ubhadane lwe-COVID-19, futhi owawuholwa nguProfesa Mariana Mazzucato, uchithe le minyaka emibili edlule ecabanga kabusha ngomnotho ngombono wezempilo kubo bonke, futhi egqugquzela ngamandla isimiso sokuthi impilo yabantu neyomhlaba kufanele ibe semqoka endleleni esakha ngayo izinhlelo zethu zenhlalo, ezempilo nezomnotho. UMkhandlu uveze indaba entsha enesibindi esekelwe ekuhlakanipheni okusha kwezomnotho ukuze uguqule umnotho ukuze unikeze impilo kubo bonke ngezihloko ezine ezihlobene:

(1) izifundo zokubuka ezishicilelwe zokubheka izilinganiso zokusebenza okuphelele nokuhlobene komuthi wokugoma we-BA.1- noma i-BA.4/5 equkethe imithi yokugoma ye-mRNA ye-bivalent esetshenziswa njengomthamo wokuvuselela ngokumelene nezimpawu nezifo ezinzima; (2) idatha esekelwe elabhorethri ngobukhulu nobubanzi bezimpendulo zokuzivikela ezihambisanayo ngokumelene nezinhlobo zangaphambilini nezisakazekayo ze-SARS-CoV-2 ezibangelwa imithi yokugoma ye-mRNA equkethe i-BA.1- noma i-BA.4/5, uma kuqhathaniswa nemithi yokugoma esekelwe kwi-index virus, esetshenziswa njengomthamo wokuvuselela; futhi (3) izifundo ezisekelwe elabhorethri kanye nedatha yokubuka mayelana nezimpendulo zememori yokuzivikela ukubheka umthelela wokuchayeka okuphindaphindiwe kwe-antigen ekuvikeleni nasekuvikeleni okubangelwa umuthi wokugoma. Leliqhinga lihlose ukusekela amazwe angamalungu ekuthuthukiseni izinqubomgomo ezisebenzayo nasekusebenziseni izinhlelo zokusebenza ezizoqinisa indima edlalwa imithi yendabuko ekugcineni abantu bephilile. Ukubhekana nezinselelo, ukuphendula izidingo ezikhonjwe amazwe angamalungu nokwakha emsebenzini owenziwe ngaphansi kwesu lemithi yendabuko ye-WHO: 2002-2005, isu elibuyekeziwe lesikhathi sika-2014-2023 linikeza ukunakwa okwengeziwe kunelokuqala ekubekeni phambili izinsizakalo nezinhlelo zezempilo, kufaka phakathi imikhiqizo, imikhuba kanye nabasebenzi bezokwelapha bendabuko;

Kule nqubo efanayo, i-Afrigen izoqhubeka nokwenza ukuqeqeshwa nokudluliswa kobuchwepheshe kubalingani benethiwekhi. Abaxhasi badlala indima ebalulekile ekusekeleni uhlelo ngemali ephelele kuze kube manje eyi-US $ 117 million kanti iFrance ingeyokuqala ukuxhasa umsebenzi wokudluliswa kobuchwepheshe be-mRNA. Ababekhona emhlanganweni kwakungabameleli beKhomishini yaseYurophu, iBelgium, iJalimane, kanye neNorway, iCanada, i-African Union, iNingizimu Afrika, kanye ne-ELMA Foundation. UCaroline Delany, uMqondisi-Jikelele we-GlobalAffairs Canada eNingizimu naseMpumalanga Afrika uthe: "ICanada iqinisekisa ukweseka kwayo okuqhubekayo koHlelo Lokudluliswa Kobuchwepheshe be-mRNA futhi siyajabula ukumemezela umnikelo owengeziwe wamaRandi ayizigidi eziyi-15 eCanada emhlanganweni wanamuhla. Lokhu kuletha umnikelo ophelele weCanada kuHlelo kuze kufike kumaRandi ayizigidi ezingama-45 eCanada.

Kudingeka isinyathelo esiphuthumayo sokubhekana nenqubekela phambili emile ezinhlosweni zentuthuko ezinzile ezihlobene nezempilo I-WHO ikhipha umbiko wayo wonyaka we-2023 we-World Health Statistics onezibalo ezintsha ngomthelela wobhubhane lwe-COVID-19 kanye nezibalo zakamuva zenqubekela phambili ezinhlosweni zentuthuko ezinzile ezihlobene nezempilo (SDGs). Umbiko onemininingwane efinyelela ku-2022 ugcizelela ukumiswa kwenqubekela phambili yezempilo ezinkomba ezibalulekile zezempilo eminyakeni yamuva uma kuqhathaniswa nokuthambekela okubonwe phakathi kuka-2000-2015. Iphinde isixwayise ngosongo olukhulayo lwezifo ezingezona ezithathelwanayo (NCDs) kanye nokuguquka kwesimo sezulu, futhi icela ukusabela okuhlanganisiwe nokuqinisiwe. Izindleko ze-COVID-19 ezimpilweni ezilahlekile kanye nenqubekela phambili yezempilo Ibhuku lezibalo ezibuyekeziwe ngomthelela walolu bhubhane empilweni yomhlaba, okufaka isandla ekwehleni okuqhubekayo kwenqubekela phambili kwe-SDGs.

Imiklomelo yeminikelo evelele kwezempilo yomphakathi enikezwe ngesikhathi soMhlangano Wezempilo Womhlaba wamashumi ayisikhombisa nesithupha Ngesikhathi somcimbi othinta inhliziyo eMhlanganweni Wezempilo Womhlaba wamashumi ayisikhombisa nesithupha eGeneva, imiklomelo yanikezwa abantu nezikhungo ezivela emhlabeni wonke ngeminikelo yabo evelele kwezempilo yomphakathi. "Imiklomelo yezempilo yomphakathi ka-2023 nemiklomelo igubha abantu abenze umnikelo obalulekile empilweni yomhlaba, futhi umsebenzi wabo udlulele ngalé kwesimemo somsebenzi ojwayelekile", kusho uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, uMqondisi-Jikelele we-WHO. "Ngesikhathi lapho umhlaba ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi, ngamunye uyisikhuthazo nesikhumbuzo senqubekela phambili engenziwa ukuthuthukisa impilo nenhlalakahle yabo bonke. "Isimemo sokuqokwa kwabazongenela umklomelo ngamunye sithunyelwa minyaka yonke ngemuva kokuvalwa kwe-World Health Assembly.

Ngibonga i-WHO ngokuvula indlela yocwaningo olusha nokunikeza ipulatifomu yabo yomhlaba wonke yokusabalalisa izwi nokwenza ucwaningo mayelana nokuxhumana kwezobuciko nezempilo. "Ngibheke phambili kuwo wonke amathuba okwenza umsebenzi obalulekile ezweni lakithi eNingizimu Afrika nasemhlabeni wonke ukuze kube nekusasa elingcono nelinempilo", kusho uYende. Ukuqokwa kukaFleming noYende kugcizelela ukuxhumana okujulile phakathi kwezobuciko nezempilo. Ukuzibandakanya emisebenzini yokudala, efana nomculo, ubuciko, nomdanso, kunomthelela omuhle empilweni yomzimba, yengqondo, inhlalakahle yomphakathi kanye nekhwalithi yempilo jikelele. Ngokusebenzisa izindima zabo njengezithunywa ze-Goodwill, uFleming noYende bazothuthukisa ukuhlanganiswa kwezobuciko ezinhlelweni zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, bakhuthaze ukufinyelela ekwelapheni kwezobuciko, futhi bagqugquzele ukubaluleka kokuveza ubuciko ekuthuthukiseni imiphumela yezempilo emhlabeni jikelele.

Izincazelo: I-WHO ibilokhu isebenza emkhakheni wezempilo yezocansi kusukela okungenani ngo-1974, lapho izingxoxo zekomiti lochwepheshe zaphumela ekushicilelweni kombiko wezobuchwepheshe onesihloko esithi "Imfundo nokwelashwa ngokocansi lomuntu" (WHO, 1975). Kusukela ngo-2000, i-Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) kanye ne-WHO babiza izingqungquthela eziningi zochwepheshe ukuze babuyekeze amagama futhi bakhombe izinketho zohlelo. Umphumela wale mihlangano kwaba Ukubonisana Kwezobuchwepheshe ngo-2002, lapho kwakhiwa khona izincazelo zokusebenza zamagama asemqoka ahlobene nempilo yezocansi ngezansi. Ubulili: Ubulili bubhekisela ezimfanelweni zebhayoloji ezichaza abantu njengabesifazane noma abesilisa. Ngenkathi lezi zinhlobo zezimfanelo zebhayoloji zingahambisani, njengoba kunabantu abanazo zombili, bavame ukuhlukanisa abantu njengabesilisa nabesifazane.

I-World Health Assembly yamashumi ayisikhombisa nesithupha  ̈Ukubuyekezwa kwansuku zonke: 27 Meyi 2023 Isu lokuqala lomhlaba wonke lokuvimbela nokulawula ukuthelelekaI-World Health Assembly ivumile namuhla ngecebo lokuqala lomhlaba wonke lokuvimbela nokulawula ukutheleleka (i-IPC), elisekelwe emizamweni ecishe ibe amashumi amabili eminyaka eholwa yi-WHO kanye nabalingani. Leli cebo linikeza amazwe angamalungu izinkomba zamasu zokunciphisa kakhulu ubungozi obuqhubekayo bokutheleleka okuhlobene nokunakekelwa kwezempilo (ama-HAI), kufaka phakathi lawo abonisa ukumelana nemithi elwa namagciwane. Ama-HAI aphakathi kwemicimbi emibi evame kakhulu eyenzeka kumongo wokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zezempilo. Ubhadane lwe-COVID-19 kanye nokuqubuka kwezifo ezinkulu zakamuva ezifana nesifo segciwane le-Ebola, isifo sokuphefumula saseMpumalanga Ephakathi kanye nesifo segciwane saseSudan kuye kwaveza ngokucacile izikhala ezikhona ezinhlelweni ze-IPC kuwo wonke amazwe.

I-Tetanus eyenzeka ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa noma kungakapheli amasonto ayi-6 ukuphela kokukhulelwa ibizwa nge-maternal tetanus, kuyilapho i-tetanus eyenzeka phakathi nezinsuku zokuqala ezingama-28 zokuphila ibizwa nge-neonatal tetanus. Lesi sifo sihlala siyinkinga ebalulekile yezempilo yomphakathi ezingxenyeni eziningi zomhlaba, kepha ikakhulukazi emazweni noma ezifundeni ezihola kancane, lapho ukumbozwa komzimba ngokumelene nezifo kuncane futhi imikhuba yokuzalwa engahlanzekile ivamile. Izimpawu nezimpawu ze-tetanus zivela noma nini kusuka ezinsukwini ezi-3 kuye kwezi-21 ngemuva kokuthi amagciwane e-tetanus angene emzimbeni ngesilonda. Izimpawu nezimpawu ze-tetanus zivela noma nini kusuka ezinsukwini ezi-3 kuye kwezi-21 ngemuva kokuthi amagciwane e-tetanus angene emzimbeni ngesilonda.

Ukuqokwa kwabaholi abakhulu okwenziwe ukuze kuqhutshwe ukuqondiswa kwe-WHO kanye nezinhlelo zayo I-World Health Organization (WHO) iqoke abantu abahlanu abasha abaphezulu eqenjini labaholi bayo eGeneva. Ukuqokwa okusha kulandela ukuqokwa kabusha kukaDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus esikhathini sakhe sesibili seminyaka emihlanu njengoMqondisi-Jikelele. Ithimba labaholi jikelele liye lahlanganiswa ukuze lihambisane nezinto eziza kuqala eNhlanganweni eminyakeni emihlanu ezayo futhi lizosebenzisana eduze noMqondisi-Jikelele ukuqhubekisela phambili lezi zinto eziza kuqala kanye nohlelo lwe-WHO lokuguqulwa okuhlosiwe. Ukuze kusheshiswe inqubekela phambili ekuqalisweni koHlelo Lomsebenzi Jikelele lwe-WHO lwe-13 (GPW13), kanye nokufezeka kwezinhloso zalo "ezibhiliyoni ezintathu" kanye nezinhloso zentuthuko ezihambisana nezempilo, umsebenzi we-WHO eminyakeni emihlanu ezayo ugxile ezintweni ezinhlanu eziza kuqala:

UMkhandlu Wezempilo Womhlaba Wamashumi Ayisikhombisa Nesithupha uzogxila ekusindiseni izimpilo, ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo bonke njengoba i-WHO igubha iminyaka engama-75 Njengoba umhlaba ubhekene nezimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo nezobuntu, uMkhandlu Wezempilo Womhlaba Wamashumi Ayisikhombisa Nesithupha uzogxila ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo bonke. Iseshini yalo nyaka yoMkhandlu Wezempilo Womhlaba izocacisa ikusasa eliseduze nelisikhathi eside le-WHO, kusukela ngesabelomali sohlelo lweminyaka emibili ezayo, izinqumo ezibalulekile mayelana nokuxhaswa ngezimali okusimeme kweNhlangano kanye nezinguquko ezenziwe ukuthuthukisa izinqubo nokuziphendulela kwe-WHO. Izithunywa zizophinde zicabange ngendima ebalulekile i-WHO enayo ekwakhiweni kwezimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo zomhlaba. Isizinda salezi zindaba yisikhumbuzo senhlangano seminyaka engama-75, kanye nezici ezivelele zempumelelo yayo ehlanganyelwe yezempilo yomhlaba wonke selokhu kwasungulwa i-WHO ngo-1948.

Kodwa-ke, ubhubhane luye lwabeka izinkomba eziningi ezihlobene nempilo ngaphandle kwendlela efanele futhi lwafaka isandla ekungalingani ekutholakaleni kokunakekelwa kwezempilo okusezingeni eliphezulu, ukugonywa okujwayelekile nokuvikelwa kwezezimali. Ngenxa yalokho, ukuthuthuka kwezifo zikamalaleveva nesifo sofuba kuye kwaguqulwa, futhi abantu abambalwa bayelashwa ngezifo ezingalapheki zasezindaweni ezishisayo (NTDs). "I-World Health Statistics iyisibuyekezo saminyaka yonke se-WHO ngesimo sempilo yomhlaba. Umbiko uthumela umyalezo onamandla ngosongo lwezifo ezingezona ezithathelwanayo, ezithatha inani elikhulu futhi elandayo ezimpilweni, ezindlekweni zokuphila, ezinhlelweni zezempilo, emiphakathini, kwezomnotho nasemiphakathini", kusho uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, uMqondisi-Jikelele we-WHO. "Umbiko ucela ukwanda okukhulu kokutshalwa kwezimali kwezempilo nezinhlelo zezempilo ukuze kubuyiselwe endleleni eya ezinhlosweni zentuthuko ezinzile".

ukweseka amazwe ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zikazwelonke noma zesifunda zokuqapha izimpilo zabantu ngamakhemikhali akhathazayo.Idokhumenti ehlobene: A76/A/CONF./2 - Umthelela wamakhemikhali, imfucuza kanye nokungcola empilweni yabantu Umsebenzi we-WHO ngokuphepha kwamakhemikhali kanye nempilo Ukufeza inhlalakahle: uhlaka lomhlaba wonkeAmazwe angamalungu avumile ukwamukela "Uhlaka lomhlaba wonke lokuhlanganisa inhlalakahle empilweni yomphakathi kusetshenziswa indlela yokukhuthaza impilo", oluzama ukuvumela bonke abantu ukuba bachume futhi bafeze amandla abo aphelele ngokomzimba nangokwengqondo impilo yabo yonke impilo kanye ngezizukulwane. Uhlaka lomhlaba wonke luncoma izinkomba eziyisithupha eziyinhloko zamasu ezigxile ku: ukumbozwa kwezempilo jikelele, umnotho onokulingana, ukuvikela iplanethi, izinhlelo zokuvikela umphakathi, izinhlelo zedijithali ukuvumela impilo, nokulinganisa nokuqapha inhlalakahle.

Ubulili: Impilo yezocansi ayikwazi ukuchazwa, ukuqondwa noma ukwenziwa isebenze ngaphandle kokucatshangelwa kabanzi ngobulili, okuyisisekelo sokuziphatha okubalulekile nemiphumela ehlobene nempilo yezocansi. Incazelo esebenzayo yobulili ithi: "... isici esiyinhloko sokuba ngumuntu impilo yonke ihlanganisa ubulili, ubunikazi nobudlelwano bobulili, ukuthambekela kwezocansi, ukuthambekela kwezocansi, injabulo, ukusondelana nokuzala. Ubulili buhlanganiswa futhi buvezwe ngemicabango, amaphupho, izifiso, izinkolelo, izimo zengqondo, amagugu, ukuziphatha, imikhuba, izindima kanye nobudlelwano. Nakuba ubulili bungabandakanya zonke lezi zici, akuzona zonke ezihlanganiswa noma ezivezwa njalo. Ubulili buthonywa ukusebenzisana kwezici zebhayoloji, ezengqondo, ezenhlalo, ezomnotho, ezombusazwe, ezamasiko, ezomthetho, ezomlando, ezenkolo nezomoya. " (WHO, 2006a)

"I-Argentina inentshisekelo enkulu ekwakheni ikhono lezwe lethu kanye nekhono lamanye amazwe", kusho uJosefina Campos, uMqondisi weNational Genomics and Bioinformatics Center e-ANLIS Malbrán, e-Argentina. "Izifo azihloniphi imingcele: usongo lwezifo ezweni elilodwa luwusongo nakwabanye. Sibheke phambili ekusebenzisaneni namalungu e-IPSN ukufeza umgomo wethu ofanayo wokuvimbela izifo nokusindisa izimpilo. I-IPSN izobhekana nalezi zinselelo ngenethiwekhi yomhlaba wonke, ixhumanisa izindawo kanye namanethiwekhi aqondene nezifo, ukwakha uhlelo lokusebenzisana lokuthola kangcono, ukuvimbela nokuphendula izinsongo zezifo. Amalungu azosebenza ndawonye emaqenjini azinikele agxile ezinseleleni ezithile, asekelwa ngezimali nge-IPSN ukuze kukhuliswe imibono namaphrojekthi kwezokwelapha.

Izincomo eziyinhloko zihlanganisa: Sidinga ukwazisa nokulinganisa izinto ezibaluleke ngempela - ukuchuma kwabantu nokwezwe - kunokuphishekela ukukhula komnotho nokwandisa i-GDP kungakhathalekile imiphumela. Ukuze kuzuzwe impilo yabo bonke, ohulumeni kumele bacabange kabusha ngokubaluleka futhi bahlele kabusha futhi baqondise kabusha umnotho ngokusekelwe enhlalakahleni yomphakathi neyezwe, beqondiswa amamethrikhi amasha. Kudingeka ukuguqulwa okuyisisekelo kwezinhlelo zikazwelonke nezamazwe ngamazwe zokuxhasa ngezimali ezempilo, ukuze ukusetshenziswa kwezimali kwezempilo kubhekwe njengokutshalwa kwezimali kwesikhathi eside. Ukuletha Impilo Yabo Bonke kuzodinga kokubili imali eningi, kanye nokuxhaswa kwezimali okusezingeni eliphakeme. Ukuqamba kudinga ubuhlakani obuhlangene - akukaze kube yisithelo senkampani eyodwa noma i-ejensi kahulumeni. Kodwa ngaphandle kokuthi ukuqamba kulawulwe ukuze kuzuze wonke umuntu, abantu abaningi bahlala bengafinyeleli ezinzuzweni zayo.

Ukutheleleka okunamandla kakhulu kungadala ukuvaleka kwamathumbu okufanele kwelashwe ngokuhlinzwa. I-S. stercoralis ingadala ukugula kwesikhumba nokugula kwesisu futhi yaziwa nangokuthi ihlotshaniswa nokungondleki okungapheli ezinganeni. Esimweni sokuncipha kokuzivikela komzimba, ipharasiti ingadala i-hyperinfection / dissemination syndrome ebulalayo ngaso sonke isikhathi uma ingelashwa ngokushesha nangendlela efanele futhi ivame ukubulala ngisho nangokwelashwa. Ngo-2001, izihambeli eMhlanganweni Wezempilo Womhlaba wonke zavumelana ngazwi linye nesinqumo (WHA54.19) esikhuthaza amazwe anezifo ezivamile ukuba aqale ukubhekana ngokungathi sína nezimpethu, ikakhulukazi i-schistosomiasis kanye ne-helminths ethathelwa umhlabathi. Isu lokulawula izifo ezithathelwana ngumhlabathi ukulawula ukugula ngokwelashwa ngezikhathi ezithile kwabantu abasengozini abahlala ezindaweni ezivamile.

Amaphothifoliyo wamalungu akhona eqembu labaholi abasezindlunkulu: UDkt Samira Asma uzoqhubeka njengoMsizi woMqondisi-Jikelele weDatha, i-Analytics kanye ne-Delivery for Impact. UDkt Asma uqondisa iphothifoliyo eqinisekisa ukuthi idatha yezempilo inokwethenjelwa futhi iyatholakala, futhi isetshenziselwa ukuthuthukisa imiphumela yezempilo emhlabeni wonke, kufaka phakathi ukulandelela nokusheshisa inqubekela phambili ekufinyeleleni imigomo eyizigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezintathu kanye neZinjongo Zentuthuko Ezinzile ezihlobene nezempilo. Ngaphambi kokujoyina i-WHO ngo-2018, uDkt Asma ubambe izikhundla zobuholi e-U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) iminyaka engaphezu kwamashumi amabili. Uphethe iziqu zobudokotela ekuhlinzweni kwamazinyo kanye nesiqu se-master kwezempilo yomphakathi. UDkt Bruce Aylward uqokwe njengoMsizi woMqondisi-Jikelele we-Universal Health Coverage, iLife Course Division kusukela ngomhlaka-4 Meyi 2023.

Abaculi abadumile uRenée Fleming noPretty Yende abaqokwe njengabamemezeli be-WHO be-Humanitarian Arts and Health WHO iyajabula ukumemezela ukuqokwa kwabaculi abadumile emhlabeni wonke uRenée Fleming noPretty Yende njengabamemezeli be-Humanitarian Arts and Health. Lesi simemezelo esihlonishwayo senziwe njengengxenye yokugubha iminyaka engama-75 ye-WHO ngesikhathi se-76th World Health Assembly ngomhlaka-22 Meyi 2023. URenée Fleming, ongomunye wabaculi abadume kakhulu besikhathi sethu, noPretty Yende, i-soprano engavamile eyaziwa ngemisebenzi yakhe ekhazimulayo, bakhethelwe impumelelo yabo yobuciko nokukhuthaza imiphumela yezempilo ethuthukisiwe ngezindlela zokudala. Ngomhlaka-8 Ephreli 2023, uFleming no-Yende badlalela ikhonsathi ekhethekile enesihloko esithi Healing Arts, enikelwe kumnyaka wama-75 we-WHO eGeneva, eSwitzerland.

Ukuvuselelwa; imithi yendabuko, nomsebenzi we-WHO ekuphenduleni inqwaba yezimo eziphuthumayo ngenkathi isebenza namazwe angamalungu ukuze ilungele kangcono ukubhekana nezimo ezintsha. Ngaphambilini ngalolo suku, izithunywa eKomitini A zavuma ukuphawula uhlelo lokuhola oluya ku-Global Health and Peace Initiative (kanye noshintsho oluncane egameni kusuka ku- "Global Health for Peace Initiative"), futhi bacela ukuthi uMqondisi-Jikelele abike ngenqubekela phambili ekuqiniseni uhlelo lokuhola. Emhlanganweni, njengesinyathelo sokugcina sokuvuma umhlangano, izithunywa zamukela izinqumo nezinqumo zamakomiti amabili, futhi zamukela imibiko yazo. Lokhu kufaka ukuvunywa kwesabelomali sika-2024-25, kanye nokwenyuka okungu-20% kweminikelo ehlolwe. Abaholi bekomiti nabamele izifunda ezimbili bakhulume ukuqaphela umsebenzi nokuqhubekela phambili kwalo Mhlangano.

I-IPSN ibona umhlaba lapho wonke amazwe enokufinyelela okulinganayo emandleni aqhubekayo okuhlela nokuhlaziya ama-genomic njengengxenye yohlelo lwawo lokuqapha impilo yomphakathi. Ihlose ukudala inethiwekhi yomhlaba wonke yokusekela ababambiqhaza bokuqapha ama-genomic okukhulisa nokusheshisa umsebenzi wamalungu ayo ukuthuthukisa ukufinyelela nokulingana. I-IPSN iqukethe izinhlangano ezintathu eziyinhloko zokusebenza ezihlanganisa amaqembu ahlukene abathintekayo, asekelwa yiSekrethariya e-WHO Pandemic Hub. Abalingani basebenzisana kuma-Communities of Practice (COPs) ukuxazulula izinselelo ezifanayo, ngenhloso yokwandisa ukuvumelanisa nokwenza izinto ezintsha ku-genomics ye-pathogen. Ku-Country Scale-Up Accelerator (CSUA), abathintekayo basebenza ndawonye ukuqondanisa imizamo nokwenza ukushintshana kwe-South-South ukukhulisa ukwakhiwa kwamakhono ezwe.

I-Universal Health Coverage iyilungelo elibaluleke kakhulu, ilungelo lomuntu wonke emhlabeni jikelele. "Kunikezwe nemiklomelo emine ekhethekile ngefilimu eyenziwe ngabafundi, ifilimu ekhuluma ngokuguquka kwesimo sezulu nempilo, ifilimu ekhuluma ngempilo yezocansi nokuzala namalungelo kanye nefilimu emfushane kakhulu. Isihloko sempilo yengqondo sivezwe kakhulu kumafilimu anqobile alo nyaka, kufaka phakathi ifilimu emfushane enamandla futhi ethinta inhliziyo evela eSweden ekhuluma ngokukhathazeka nokucindezeleka. Ifilimu, ebekwe kumculo othinta inhliziyo, iveza uchungechunge lwabalingisi abaveza izigaba ezahlukahlukene zokukhathazeka nokuthi kungazibonakalisa kanjani. Umyalezo jikelele wawuthi awuwedwa ekubhekaneni nemicabango emibi nokuthi kulungile ukuvuma imizwa enjalo. Enye ifilimu ewinile, evela eBangladesh, iveza umfana omncane owavezwa ngumthofu ovela efektri yendawo.

Ngemuva kwesikhathi esingekho zimpawu sezinsuku eziyi-1 kuya kweziyi-20 kuze kufike ku-15% weziguli zihlangabezana nesigaba sesibili sesifo esibonakala ngomkhuhlane ovame ukudlula ku-40 °C kanye nezimpawu zokubandakanyeka kwesistimu yezinzwa emaphakathi, njenge-meningitis (isib. umkhuhlane, ikhanda, nentamo eqinile), i-encephalitis (isib. ukozela, ukudideka, nokuphazamiseka kwemizwa), i-myelitis noma i-radiculitis. I-encephalitis ekhula phakathi kwalesi sigaba sesibili ingaholela ekukhubazekeni, imiphumela ehlala njalo noma ukufa. Cishe i-1% yamacala anezifo zezinzwa angase afe; amanani aphezulu okufa abikwe kusuka kufedereshini yaseRussia, okungahle kuhlobene nohlobo oluhlukile lwegciwane. Ubukhulu besifo buyanda ngeminyaka yesiguli, kepha ukufa kuye kwabikwa kuwo wonke amaqembu eminyaka. Akukho ukwelashwa okukhethekile kwe-tick-borne encephalitis.

Amazwe angamalungu anxuswa ukuba aqinise ukusetshenziswa kwamasu akhona e-WHO okubandakanya ukusetshenziswa kwe-WHO Chemicals Roadmap echaza izindima ezibalulekile zomkhakha wezempilo ekusebenziseni i-Strategic Approach to International Chemicals Management. Isinqumo siphinde sikhuthaze oNgqongqoshe bezempilo ukuthi bahlanganyele emizamweni yokulungiselela iziphakamiso zephaneli yenqubomgomo yesayensi phakathi kukahulumeni kanye nezingxoxo zesivumelwano sokuqeda ukungcoliswa kwepulasitiki. Isinqumo sicele uMqondisi-Jikelele ukuthi athathe izinyathelo eziningana, kufaka phakathi: ukushicilela umbiko ngemithelela yezempilo yamakhemikhali, imfucuza kanye nokungcola ngombono we- "One Health"; ukuvuselela idokhumenti ka-2012 ngesimo seSayensi yamakhemikhali aphazamisa i-Endocrine ngokuhlanganyela ne-United Nations Environment Programme; futhi

Izinqubomgomo zezokuthutha kanye nokutshalwa kwezimali okukhuthaza ezokuthutha zomphakathi ezihlanzekile, kanye nokuhamba ngezinyawo nokuhamba ngebhayisikili, kungaba nomthelela omkhulu kwikhwalithi yomoya. Lokhu kunganciphisa izingozi eziningi zezempilo ngasikhathi sinye, kufaka phakathi isifo sohlangothi, isifo senhliziyo, isifo samaphaphu kanye nomdlavuza othile. Kunganciphisa futhi ukufa okulinganiselwa ezigidini eziyi-1.25 minyaka yonke ngenxa yokulimala emgwaqweni, ngenkathi kuthuthukiswa ukufinyelela kwezinsizakalo zezempilo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinabantu abaningi. Izinqubomgomo zokuthuthukiswa okusimeme zinganciphisa ukukhishwa kwegesi ngokucabangela izinto ezinjengokwakhiwa kwezakhiwo nokusetshenziswa komhlaba, ukukhethwa kwezinto zokwakha, izici zokwakha kanye nokungenisa umoya namandla. Impendulo ye-WHO: Umsebenzi we-WHO uqondiswa yiZinhloso Zokuthuthukiswa Okusimeme, ikakhulukazi iGoli 3: "Ukuqinisekisa izimpilo ezinempilo nokukhuthaza inhlalakahle yabo bonke babo bonke ubudala".

Izidingo ezivimbela ngokungafanele zingavimbela ukufinyelela kweziguli ngoba zivimbela ukugeleza kokunikezwa noma zenze ukunikezwa nokunikezwa kube nzima kochwepheshe bezokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi ukukhathazeka ngemiphumela eyingozi engaba khona yama-opioid kuyiqiniso, njengamandla awo okuholela ekuphazamisekeni kokusetshenziswa kwe-opioid. Ngenxa yalesi sizathu, ukunakekela okuthile mayelana nokulimala okungenzeka kokusetshenziswa kwe-opioid (isib. ukusetshenziswa ebuhlungwini obungapheli obungeyona eyomdlavuza) kubalulekile empilweni yomphakathi uma ukusetshenziswa kwayo kunolwazi futhi kuhambisana nezingozi. Ukukhathazeka okunjalo akufanele kunciphise izinzuzo zokusetshenziswa kwe-opioid lapho kuboniswa khona ngokomtholampilo nalapho kusetshenziswa ngokuphepha ngabasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe. Amathuba okusebenzaUmbiko wethula isethi ehambisanayo yezindawo zokusebenza ezihlose ukuthuthukisa ukufinyelela okuphephile ku-morphine.

I-WHO neRiphabhulikhi yaseKorea basayine isivumelwano esiyingqophamlando sokukhulisa amandla okukhiqiza ama-biomanufacturing I-WHO neRiphabhulikhi yaseKorea basayine iMemorandum of Understanding yokusungula isikhungo sokuqeqesha emhlabeni wonke ekukhiqizeni ama-biomanufacturing. Lesi sikhungo sokuqeqesha emhlabeni wonke sizosebenzela wonke amazwe anengeniso ephansi naphakathi (LMICs) ukukhiqiza ama-biologicals, njengemithi yokugoma, i-insulin, ama-monoclonal antibodies, nemithi yomdlavuza. Ubhadane lwe-COVID-19 lugcizelele isidingo sokwandisa ukukhiqizwa kwendawo nesifunda kwemithi yokugoma neminye imikhiqizo yezempilo ebalulekile kuma-LMICs ukuqinisekisa ukufinyelela okulinganayo. Ukunikeza amazwe ulwazi lokukhiqiza ngokushesha imithi yokugoma ye-mRNA, i-WHO, ngokubambisana nabalingani, yasungula uhlelo lwe-mRNA Technology Transfer, ngokwethulwa ngokusemthethweni kwesikhungo seHub eNingizimu Afrika ngo-Ephreli 2023.

Ngokuvamile kusetshenziswa ezilimini eziningi, igama elithi ucansi livame ukusetshenziselwa ukuchaza "umsebenzi wezocansi", kodwa ngezinhloso zobuchwepheshe kumongo wezingxoxo zocansi nempilo yezocansi, incazelo engenhla iyathandwa. Impilo yezocansi Ngokwencazelo esebenzayo yamanje, impilo yezocansi yile: "...isimo senhlalakahle yomzimba, engokomzwelo, engokwengqondo neyenhlalo maqondana nobulili; akuyona nje ukungabikho kwezifo, ukungasebenzi kahle noma ukukhubazeka. Impilo yezocansi idinga indlela enhle nenenhlonipho ngobulili nobudlelwano bobulili, kanye nethuba lokuba nokuhlangenwe nakho kobulili okujabulisayo nokuphephile, ngaphandle kokuphoqelelwa, ukubandlululwa nodlame. Ukuze impilo yezocansi ifinyelelwe futhi igcinwe, amalungelo ezocansi abo bonke abantu kufanele ahlonishwe, avikelwe futhi agcwaliswe. " (WHO, 2006a)

Ukuthuthukisa nokusabalalisa imibhalo yokuqondisa yezobuchwepheshe esekelwe ebufakazini, izindinganiso kanye namazinga okuvimbela nokuphendula udlame olubhekiswe ezinganeni. Ukushicilela njalo imibiko yesimo somhlaba wonke ngemizamo yamazwe yokubhekana nodlame olubhekiswe ezinganeni ngokusebenzisa izinqubomgomo zikazwelonke nezinhlelo zokusebenza, imithetho, izinhlelo zokuvimbela kanye nezinsizakalo zokuphendula. Ukusekela amazwe kanye nabalingani ekusebenziseni amasu okuvimbela nokuphendula asekelwe ebufakazini, njengalawo afakwe ku-INSPIRE: Amasu ayisikhombisa okuqeda udlame olubhekiswe ezinganeni. Ukusebenzisana nezinhlangano zomhlaba wonke kanye nezinhlangano ukunciphisa nokuqeda udlame olubhekiswe ezinganeni emhlabeni jikelele, ngokusebenzisa imizamo efana ne-Global Partnership to End Violence against Children, i-Global Partnership to End Violence against Children,

Kubantu, ukuchayeka kakhulu emisebeni ye-UV kungabangela umdlavuza wesikhumba, i-cataract nokulimala kwesimiso somzimba sokuzivikela. Ukuvimbela: Ukwanda kwenani lamacala omdlavuza wesikhumba emashumini eminyaka adlule kuhlobene kakhulu nokuchayeka kakhulu elangeni lapho wenza imisebenzi yangaphandle kanye nemithombo yokukhanya kwe-UV efana nezibani zelanga nemibhede yokuvikela. Ukuchayeka ngokweqile futhi kuyimbangela eyinhloko yemiphumela eyingozi emehlweni nasohlelweni lokuzivikela. Ukuthatha izinyathelo ezimbalwa ezilula zokuqapha kunganciphisa kakhulu ingozi yalezi zimo zempilo: Nciphisa isikhathi sokushisa kwelanga kusukela ngo-10 ekuseni kuya ku-4 ntambama, ikakhulukazi ngezinsuku lapho inkomba ye-UV iphezulu lapho kufanele ube ngaphandle, zama ukuthola umthunzi futhi ugqoke izingubo zokuzivikela, kufaka phakathi isigqoko esivikela ikhanda lakho, ubuso nentamo.

I-schistosomiasis ithinta cishe abantu abayizigidi ezingama-240 emhlabeni wonke, futhi abantu abangaphezu kwezigidi ezingama-700 bahlala ezindaweni ezinabantu abaningi. Lesi sifo sivame kakhulu ezindaweni ezishisayo nezingaphansi kwezindawo ezishisayo, emiphakathini empofu engenamanzi okuphuza nokuhlanzeka okwanele. I-schistosomiasis ye-urogenital ibangelwa yi-Schistosoma haematobium kanye ne-schistosomiasis yamathumbu nganoma iyiphi yezinto eziphilayo i-S. guineensis, i-S. intercalatum, i-S. mansoni, i-S. japonicum, ne-S. mekongi. Izigidi eziningana zabantu emhlabeni wonke zihlushwa ukugula okunzima ngenxa ye-schistosomiasis. Isu le-WHO lokusebenzisa izidakamizwa ze-anthelminthic manje lenza kube nokwenzeka ukulawula i-schistosomiasis emiphakathini empofu nehlukanisiwe, ngokuhlangana nokungenelela ngokumelene ne-lymphatic filariasis, onchocerciasis kanye ne-helminthiasis edluliselwa enhlabathini.

Naphezu kokuncishiswa kokuchayeka ezingozini eziningi zempilo - njengokusebenzisa ugwayi, ukuphuza utshwala, ubudlova, amanzi angaphephile nokukhucululwa kwendle, kanye nokuncipha kwezingane - intuthuko ibinganele futhi ukuchayeka kwezinye izingozi ezinjengokungcola komoya kusalokhu kuphezulu. Ngokushaqisayo, ukwanda kokukhuluphala kuyanda ngaphandle kwezimpawu ezisheshayo zokuguquka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufinyelela okwandisiwe kwezinsizakalo zezempilo ezibalulekile kuye kwehla uma kuqhathaniswa nokuzuza kwangaphambi kuka-2015, kuhlangene nokungabi khona kwentuthuko ebalulekile ekunciphiseni ubunzima bezezimali ngenxa yezindleko zokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Lokhu kunciphisa kakhulu ikhono lethu lokufeza i-Universal Health Coverage ngo-2030. "Ubhadane lwe-COVID-19 luyisikhumbuzo esibalulekile sokuthi intuthuko ayiqondile futhi ayiqinisekisiwe", kuxwayisa uDkt Samira Asma, uMsizi kaMqondisi-Jikelele we-WHO weDatha, Ukuhlaziywa kanye Nokulethwa Kwethonya.

I-Institute iphinde yenze imisebenzi yocwaningo nokukhuthaza ukwakha imibono nokuthonya izinqubomgomo ezithinta abasebenzi bezempilo basemaphandleni eNepal. UProfesa Vichai Tienthavorn unguMongameli we-Praboromarajchanok Institute eMnyangweni Wezempilo Yomphakathi waseThailand. Enye yezinhlelo zikazwelonke aziholile yinqubomgomo entsha yokukhuthaza ezempilo ukusiza ukubhekana ne-thalassemia, nomsebenzi wakhe oholele ekwamukelweni kwenqubomgomo esebenzayo kazwelonke yokuvimbela nokulawula i-thalassemia. Futhi waklama ithuluzi lokuxhumana elisebenzayo nendlela yokuhlola ukusiza izakhamizi ukuthi zivumelanise nokuziphatha kwazo ukuze zivimbele futhi zilawule isifo sikashukela nomfutho wegazi. Ngenxa yalo msebenzi, kwamukelwa inqubomgomo kazwelonke enomthelela omuhle kakhulu emthwalweni wesifo ezweni.

Ukwelashwa kungenziwa ngesisekelo somuntu ngamunye, noma njenge-Mass Drug Administration kuye ngezimo zendawo nezindlela zokulawula ezisetshenziswayo.I-Taeniasis ingelashwa kusetshenziswa ama-anthelmintics (Praziquantel, Niclosamide, Albendazole).Ku-neurocysticercosis, njengoba ukubhujiswa kwama-cysts kungaholela ekuphenduleni kokuvuvukala, ukwelashwa okukhethekile kwesifo esisebenzayo kuyadingeka futhi kungafaka izifundo ezinde ngemithamo ephezulu ye-anthelmintic, kanye nokwelashwa okusekelayo ngama-corticosteroids kanye / noma imithi elwa nesifo, futhi mhlawumbe ukuhlinzwa. Umthamo nobude besikhathi sokwelashwa kungahluka kakhulu futhi kuncike kakhulu enanini, ubukhulu, indawo kanye nesigaba sokuthuthuka kwama-cysts, i-edema yabo evuvukayo ezungezile, ubukhali nobukhulu bezimpawu noma izimpawu zomtholampilo.

Igciwane le-T-lymphotropic virus type 1 (HTLV-1) Ngokuvamile elingenazimpawu, uhlobo olungapheli lwe-HTLV-1 lungadala isifo esibi, okubandakanya i-leukemia / lymphoma ye-T-cell yabantu abadala (ATL) kanye nesimo esiqhubekayo sesistimu yezinzwa esaziwa ngokuthi i-HTLV-1-associated myelopathy noma i-tropical spastic paraparesis (HAM / TSP). Ukwelashwa: Ukwelashwa okusebenzayo okwamanje kuyatholakala kuma-STI amaningana. Izifo ezintathu ze-STI zebhaktheriya (i-chlamydia, i-gonorrhoea ne-syphilis) kanye ne-STI eyodwa yezinambuzane (i-trichomoniasis) ngokuvamile iyelapheka ngezindlela ezikhona, eziphumelelayo zomthamo owodwa noma eziningi zama-antibiotic. Kuma-STI egciwane (i-HIV, i-HSV ne-HTLV-1), imithi esebenza kahle etholakalayo yimithi elwa namagciwane noma imithi elwa nomdlavuza (kwimeko ye-HTLV-1), engakwazi ukulungisa inkambo yezifo, yize ingakwazi ukwelapha lezi zifo ezintathu.

Esikhaleni sokulawulwa kwama-vector, kunemikhiqizo emisha engu-28 emgqeni we-R & D. Amathuluzi ahlolwayo afaka, isibonelo, izinhlobo ezintsha zamanetha aphathwe ngama-insecticide, ama-baits aqondisiwe aheha omiyane, ama-repellents wesikhala, ama-lure ayingozi ezindlini (ama-tubes ama-ave) kanye nobunjiniyela bezakhi zofuzo bezinambuzane. Abacwaningi babeka phambili ukuthuthukiswa kwezindlela zokwelashwa ezingezona ze-ACT emkhakheni wemithi elwa nomalaleveva ngenxa yokuvela nokusabalala kokumelana ne-artemisinin okuyingxenye. Ukuthuthukiswa kwemithi yesizukulwane esilandelayo, njenge- "triple ACTs," esebenzisa inhlanganisela ye-artemisinin nezidakamizwa ezimbili ezihlangene, kuyaqhubeka ukunciphisa ubungozi bokumelana nezidakamizwa.
