Izindaba ezibalulekile Kulindeleke izingxoxo nezinqumo ezibalulekile mayelana nalokhu: Ukubuyekezwa komsebenzi we-WHO ezimweni eziphuthumayo zezempilo, kubandakanya neMithetho Yezempilo Yomhlaba Wonke kanye nokuqinisa ukulungela kwe-WHO kanye nokuphendula ezimweni eziphuthumayo zezempilo; Amasu kanye nezenzo zomhlaba wonke ezindaweni ezinjengempilo yabesifazane, izingane kanye nentsha, ukuvuselelwa, ukunakekelwa kwezempilo jikelele kanye nokunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo, imithi yendabuko, ukuvimbela nokulawula izifo, imithi engekho ezingeni elifanele kanye nemithi engamanga, impilo yababaleki kanye nabafuduki, izifo ezingezona ezithathelwanayo, impilo yengqondo, izinqumo zomphakathi, ukudla okunomsoco kanye nokukhubazeka; Ukuvunywa kweBhajethi yoHlelo lwe-WHO ka-2024-2025, kufaka phakathi isinqumo sokwandisa iminikelo ehlolwe kanye nezinye izindaba ezivela eqenjini elisebenzayo le-Working Group on Sustainable Financing.

I-mRNA Technology Transfer Programme idlulela esigabeni esilandelayo sokuthuthuka kwayo Ukuvulwa kwesikhungo se-mRNA technology Hub e-Afrigen, eNingizimu Afrika. Abalingani bahlangana eKapa ukuxoxa ngesigaba esilandelayo sokuthuthukiswa komuthi wokugoma we-mRNA kanye nokwabelana ngolwazi. Abahlanganyeli bamazwe omhlaba abangaphezu kuka-200 abasebenza nohlelo lwe-mRNA Technology Transfer Programme bahlangana eKapa kuleli sonto emhlanganweni wabo wokuqala ubuso nobuso. Bexhunyaniswe nguMqondisi-Jikelele we-World Health Organization (WHO), uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus noDkt Joe Phaahla, uNgqongqoshe Wezempilo noNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezimboni, uMnu Ebrahim Patel waseNingizimu Afrika kanye nezikhulu ezisezingeni eliphezulu ezivela emazweni abaxhasayo, lo mhlangano oyingqayizivele ubukeze inqubekela phambili selokhu i-WHO ne-Medicines Patent Pool (MPP) baqala ngoJuni 2021.

Ngiyajabula ukuthi i-WHO izokwakha phezu kwezimiso zokulondolozwa kobumfihlo kanye nobuchwepheshe obusezingeni eliphezulu besitifiketi se-EU ukudala ithuluzi lomhlaba wonke lokulwa nezifo eziwumshayabhuqe esikhathini esizayo", kusho uThierry Breton, uKhomishani Wezimakethe Zangaphakathi. Uhlelo lwe-WHO lomhlaba wonke olwakha phezu kwefa le-EU Olunye lwezinto ezibalulekile emsebenzini we-European Union wokulwa nobhubhane lwe-COVID-19 kube yizitifiketi ze-COVID-19 ezidijithali. Ukuze kube lula ukuhamba ngokukhululekile ngaphakathi kwemingcele yayo, i-EU isheshe yasungula izitifiketi ze-COVID-19 ezisebenzisanayo (ezibizwa ngokuthi yi-EU Digital COVID-19 Certificate noma i-EU DCC). Ngokusekelwe kubuchwepheshe obuvulekile kanye namazinga, ivumele nokuxhumeka kwamazwe angaphandle kwe-EU akhipha izitifiketi ngokuya ngezimfuneko ze-EU DCC, okwenza kube yisixazululo esisetshenziswa kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele.

Izifo ezithathelwana ngocansi ezihlanganisa i-HIV, i-herpes simplex virus (HSV), i-viral hepatitis B, i-human papillomavirus (HPV) kanye ne-human T-lymphotropic virus type 1 (HTLV-1) azinazo izindlela zokwelashwa noma zinezindlela ezilinganiselwe zokwelashwa. Imithi yokugoma i-hepatitis B iyatholakala ukuvimbela ukutheleleka okungaholela kumdlavuza wesibindi kanye ne-HPV ukuvimbela umdlavuza wesibeletho. I-HIV, i-HSV ne-HTLV-1 yizifo ezithathelwana ngocansi ezihlala isikhathi eside: i-HIV ne-HSV kunezindlela zokwelashwa ezingacindezela igciwane, kodwa okwamanje azikho izindlela zokwelapha noma yiziphi zalezi zifo ezithathelwana ngocansi. Amakhondomu asetshenziswe ngendlela efanele futhi ngokuqhubekayo ayizindlela eziphumelelayo zokuvikela izifo ezithathelwana ngocansi ne-HIV. Ukuhlolwa nokuxilongwa kusenesikhathi kwabantu abane-STIs kanye nabalingani babo bobulili kunikeza ithuba elihle kakhulu lokwelashwa okuphumelelayo nokuvimbela izinkinga nokudluliselwa okwengeziwe.

Udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane Ukubhekisisa: Udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane - ikakhulukazi udlame olubhekiswe kubalingani abasondelene kanye nodlame lwezocansi - luyinkinga enkulu yezempilo yomphakathi neyomtholampilo kanye nokwephulwa kwamalungelo abantu abesifazane. Lusekelwe futhi lugcine ukungalingani ngokobulili. Emhlabeni jikelele owesifazane oyedwa kwabathathu ubhekana nodlame lomzimba kanye / noma lwezocansi empilweni yakhe, ikakhulukazi ngumlingani osondelene naye. Lokhu kuyisikhumbuzo esicacile sobukhulu bokungalingani ngokobulili kanye nokucwaswa kwabesifazane. IZizwe Ezihlangene zichaza udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane ngokuthi "noma yisiphi isenzo sodlame olususelwa ebulilini oluholela, noma olungaholela, ekulimaleni ngokomzimba, ngokocansi, noma ngokwengqondo noma ukuhlupheka kwabesifazane, kufaka phakathi izinsongo zalezo zenzo, ukuphoqelelwa noma ukuncishwa inkululeko ngokuzikhethela, noma ngabe kwenzeka emphakathini noma empilweni yangasese.

Cishe u-20% wokuzibulala emhlabeni wonke kwakungenxa yokuzibulala ngemithi yokubulala izinambuzane. Nakuba ukuhlobana phakathi kokuzibulala nezimo zempilo yengqondo (ikakhulukazi, ukucindezeleka nokuphazamiseka kokusebenzisa utshwala) nokuzama ukuzibulala kwangaphambilini kusungulwe kahle emazweni anemali ephezulu, ukuzibulala okuningi kwenzeka ngokuzenzekelayo ngezikhathi zobunzima. Ezinye izimbangela zobungozi bokuzibulala zihlanganisa ukulahlekelwa, isizungu, ukubandlululwa, ukuhlukana kobudlelwano, izinkinga zezezimali, ubuhlungu obungapheli nokugula, udlame, ukuhlukunyezwa, kanye nezingxabano noma ezinye izimo eziphuthumayo zobuntu. Ukuzibulala nokuzama ukuzibulala kunomthelela omkhulu emindenini, kubangane, kozakwabo, emiphakathini nasemiphakathini.

Ukubuka konke ngemililo yasendle: Imililo yasendle iyanda emhlabeni wonke ngobuningi, ubukhulu nobude besikhathi, okwandisa isidingo sokuqonda imiphumela yempilo yokuchayeka emlilweni wasendle. Ubungozi bemililo yasendle bukhula ezimweni ezomile kakhulu, njengesomiso, amagagasi okushisa kanye nemimoya enamandla. Intuthu yomlilo yasendle iyinhlanganisela yezinto ezingcolisa umoya eziyingozi, njenge-PM2.5, i-NO2, i-ozone, ama-hydrocarbon anuka kamnandi, noma i-lead. Ngaphezu kokungcolisa umoya ngezinto ezingcolisa umoya ezinobuthi, imililo yasendle nayo inethonya elifanayo esimweni sezulu ngokukhulula inani elikhulu le-carbon dioxide namanye amagesi abamba ukushisa emkhathini. Ngokushintsha kwesimo sezulu okuholela emazingeni okushisa afudumele nezimo ezomile kanye nokwanda kokuhlala emadolobheni ezindaweni zasemakhaya, inkathi yomlilo iqala ngokushesha futhi iphele kamuva.

Ukuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo Ukubuka konke: Ukuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo yigama elibanzi lokuchaza izinqubomgomo, amaphrojekthi kanye nokutshalwa kwezimali okunikeza izinzuzo namuhla ngaphandle kokudela impilo yemvelo, yezenhlalo kanye neyomuntu siqu esikhathini esizayo. Lezi zinqubomgomo zivame ukuchazwa njengeziluhlaza ngoba zigxile ekunciphiseni umthelela wentuthuko emvelweni. Kodwa-ke, izinzuzo zokuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo nazo ziyabonakala kulo lonke uhlangothi lwezempilo yabantu kanye nenhlalakahle, kufaka phakathi ukuncishiswa kokungcola kanye nezifo ezihlobene nemvelo, imiphumela yezempilo ethuthukisiwe kanye nokwehla kwengcindezi. Njengoba izinsongo zokuguquka kwesimo sezulu ziba zibaluleke kakhulu, amasu okuphumelela okunciphisa, ukuthuthukisa impilo kanye nokonga izindleko anikeza uhla lwezinzuzo kubathintekayo abahlukahlukene.

Amazwe ayi-10 anezinga eliphakeme kakhulu lokukhuluphala emhlabeni wonke yi-SIDS yonke ePacific, lapho abantu abadala abangaphezu kuka-45% bephila nokukhuluphala. Izimo zempilo yengqondo zivamile emazweni e-SIDS, ezithinta abantu abalinganiselwa ku-15.2% wabantu baseCaribbean kanye no-11.2% wabantu basePacific. Abantu abanezimo zempilo yengqondo babhekene nengozi enkulu yokufa ngaphambi kwesikhathi, kufaka phakathi ngenxa yezimo zempilo ezingaphathwa kahle kanye nokuzibulala. I-Stigma, ukushoda kwabasebenzi abakhethekile kanye nomthelela wokushintsha kwesimo sezulu kunomthelela esimweni esiyinselele e-SIDS esidinga ukunakwa ngokushesha. Isimemezelo saseBridgetown sika-2023 sichaza izinyathelo ezinesibindi zokubhekana nobubanzi bezinkinga zenhlalo, ezemvelo, ezomnotho nezentengiselwano eziholela kuma-NCD kanye nezimo zempilo yengqondo.

Umsebenzi we-WHO wokuvimbela nokulawula ukutheleleka Isinqumo esingokomlando sivula indlela yokuqinisa ukuvuselelwa kwezinhlelo zezempiloNamuhla uMkhandlu Wezempilo Womhlaba wonke uvumile isinqumo esiyingqophamlando sokuqinisa ukuvuselelwa kwezinhlelo zezempilo. Izinsizakalo zokuvuselelwa zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukujabulela amalungelo abantu kubandakanya nezinga eliphakeme kakhulu elingafinyeleleka lezempilo yomzimba nengqondo. Iphinde ikhuthaze impilo yezocansi neyokuzala, futhi ibone ilungelo lokusebenza nelungelo lemfundo. Lesi sinqumo esiyingqophamlando sihlose ukubhekana nezinselelo ekuvuseleleni njengesidingo: ukwandisa ukuqwashisa ngokuvuselelwa lapho kusungulwa izinto eziza kuqala kwezempilo kanye nama-ajenda ocwaningo, ukwaba izinsiza, ukukhuthaza ukubambisana nokuvumela ukudluliswa kobuchwepheshe;

Lokhu kuzolandela izinto eziza kuqala ezikhonjwe ngeziphakamiso eziyishumi zokuqinisa ukwakheka komhlaba wonke kokulungela, ukuphendula, kanye nokuqina kwezimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo (i-HEPR). I-PRET Initiative iqala inkathi entsha yokulungela ubhubhane futhi imelela ukuguquka kwemisebenzi eyinhloko ye-WHO ukusekela wonke amazwe angamalungu ekuqiniseni ukulungela, ukuvimbela, kanye namakhono okuphendula ezimweni eziphuthumayo zezempilo. Isinyathelo singasebenza futhi ekusebenziseni izinhloso nemibandela ye-Pandemic Accord, okwamanje okuxoxwa ngayo ngamazwe angamalungu e-WHO. Ngemuva kokufaka imibono nezingxoxo phakathi kwabahlanganyeli bomhlangano, i-WHO imema abathintekayo kulolu bizo lomhlaba wonke lokuthatha izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa ukulungela ubhubhane lwezifo zokuphefumula.

Lokhu kungaba nomthelela omubi kwezenhlalo nezomnotho, kube nomthelela ekulahlekelweni komkhiqizo kanye nokwengeza izindleko ohlelweni lwezempilo lomuntu ngamunye nolwezwe. Kungenzeka kakhulu ukuthi bafinyelele ezigulini ezimweni lapho kunokufinyelela okulinganiselwe emikhiqizweni yezokwelapha esezingeni eliphezulu nephephile, ukuphathwa kabi kanye namandla obuchwepheshe abuthakathaka. Nakuba le nkinga ithinta wonke amazwe, amazwe lapho kunezinhlelo zokulawula ezibuthakathaka noma ezingekho, anesibopho esikhulu semikhiqizo yezokwelapha engekho ezingeni elifanele futhi engamanga. Ezweni eliya ngokuya lihlanganiswa, alikho izwe elinemithombo eyanele namandla okubhekana nalolu daba ngokwahlukana. Ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo nezinqubo zomhlaba wonke ezifana ne-WHO Global Surveillance and Monitoring System kanye ne-WHO Member State Mechanism,

Kusukela kwaqala lolu bhubhane, i-WHO yasebenzisana nazo zonke izifunda ze-WHO ukuchaza imihlahlandlela jikelele yezitifiketi ezinjalo. Ukusiza ukuqinisa ukulungela kwezempilo emhlabeni wonke ngokubhekana nezinsongo zezempilo ezikhulayo, i-WHO isungula inethiwekhi yezitifiketi zezempilo yedijithali yomhlaba wonke eyakhelwe phezu kwezisekelo eziqinile zohlaka lwe-EU DCC, izimiso kanye nobuchwepheshe obuvulekile. Ngokubambisana nalokhu, i-WHO izokwenza lula le nqubo emhlabeni jikelele ngaphansi kwesakhiwo sayo ngenhloso yokuvumela umhlaba ukuthi uzuze ekuhlanganeni kwezitifiketi zedijithali. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukubeka amazinga nokuqinisekisa amasiginesha edijithali ukuvimbela ukukhwabanisa. Ngokwenza kanjalo, i-WHO ngeke ibe nokufinyelela kunoma iyiphi idatha yomuntu siqu eyisisekelo, ezoqhubeka nokuba yindawo ekhethekile yohulumeni.

"Sinezinsiza zokunciphisa umalaleveva, iphakethe lokungenelela elihlanganisa ukulawulwa kwezifo ezithathelwanayo, imithi yokuvimbela, ukuhlolwa kanye nokwelashwa", kusho uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, uMqondisi-Jikelele we-WHO. "Lokhu kuhlangene nomuthi wokugomela umalaleveva ophephile futhi osebenzayo, ongagcina izimpilo zamashumi ezinkulungwane zezingane unyaka ngamunye. Ngokutshalwa kwezimali okuqhubekayo kanye nemizamo eyandisiwe yokufinyelela kulabo abasengozini enkulu, ukuqedwa komalaleveva emazweni amaningi kufinyeleleka. "Usuku Lomhlaba Lomalaleveva 2023 lugujwa ngaphansi kwesihloko esithi "Isikhathi sokuletha umalaleveva ongu-zero: utshale imali, yenza izinto ezintsha, sebenzisa". Ngaphakathi kwalesi sihloko, i-WHO igqugquzela ukusetshenziswa ngempumelelo kwamathuluzi namasu atholakalayo okuvimbela, ukuxilonga nokwelapha umalaleveva, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abalahliwe.

Iyasebenza, iphephile, futhi ayibizi kakhulu. Noma kungavela ukutheleleka kabusha ngemuva kokwelashwa, ingozi yokuthola isifo esibi iyancipha futhi ibuye ibuyele emuva lapho ukwelashwa kuqalwa futhi kuphindwa ebuntwaneni. Ukulawulwa kwe-schistosomiasis kwenziwe ngempumelelo eminyakeni engama-40 edlule emazweni amaningana, kufaka phakathi iBrazil, iCambodia, iChina, i-Egypt, iMauritius, i-Islamic Republic of Iran, i-Oman, iJordani, iSaudi Arabia, iMorocco, iTunisia, njll. EBurundi, eBurkina Faso, eGhana, eNiger, eRwanda, eSierra Leone, e-United Republic of Tanzania, naseYemen, kwenzeke ukuthi ukwelashwa kwe-schistosomiasis kukhuliswe ezingeni likazwelonke futhi kube nomthelela kulesi sifo eminyakeni embalwa. Ukuhlolwa kwesimo sokudluliswa kuyadingeka emazweni amaningana.

I-WHO inxusa ukuthi kusetshenziswe kakhulu amathuluzi anconywayo okulwa nomalaleveva Ngokugubha uSuku Lomhlaba Lomalaleveva, i-World Health Organization (WHO) ikhipha isimemo sokuthi kusetshenziswe kakhulu izindlela ezintsha nezikhona zokusindisa izimpilo ezibangelwa umalaleveva. Cishe izingane eziyizigidi eziyi-1.5 ezisengozini enkulu yokugula nokufa ngenxa yomalaleveva eGhana, eKenya naseMalawi manje sezithole umthamo wazo wokuqala womuthi wokugomela umalaleveva, i-RTS,S/AS01 (RTS,S), ngenxa yohlelo oluqhubekayo lokuhlola oluhlelwe yi-WHO. Ukuhlolwa komuthi wokugomela umalaleveva, okwethulwe ngo-2019, kukhulisa ukulingana ekufinyeleleni ekuvimbeleni umalaleveva kwabasengozini enkulu futhi kusindisa izimpilo. Uma kusetshenziswa kabanzi, i-WHO ilinganisela ukuthi imithi yokugomela umalaleveva ingasindisa izimpilo zamashumi ezinkulungwane zezingane unyaka ngamunye.

Njalo ngonyaka uSuku Lomhlaba Wonke Lokungabhemi luhlonipha labo abenza umehluko ekulawuleni ugwayi. Kulo nyaka omunye wabanikezwe umklomelo, uNksz Sprina Robi Chacha, umlimi wesifazane waseKenya, uqashelwa hhayi nje ngokushintsha ukutshala ugwayi ukuya ekutshaleni ubhontshisi onamaprotheni amaningi, kodwa futhi nokuqeqesha amakhulu abanye abalimi ukuthi bangakwenza kanjani lokhu ukudala umphakathi onempilo. Amaqembu angu-182 e-WHO Framework Convention on Tobacco Control azibophezele ekutheni "...akhuthaze ezinye izindlela ezizuzisayo kwezomnotho zabasebenzi nabakhiqizi bakagwayi". Indlela ebalulekile amazwe angagcwalisa ngayo lesi sibopho ukuyeka ukuxhasa ukutshala ugwayi nokusekela izitshalo ezinempilo. Ngokukhetha ukutshala ukudla esikhundleni sikagwayi, sibeka phambili impilo, silondoloze imvelo, futhi sandise ukuphepha kokudla.

Umbiko uphawula ukuthi ingane eyodwa kuphela kweziyishumi ezizalwe ngaphambi kwesikhathi (<28 amasonto) ephila emazweni anemali ephansi, uma kuqhathaniswa nezingane ezingaphezu kweziyisishiyagalolunye kweziyishumi emazweni anemali ephezulu. Ukungalingani okuhlobene nohlanga, ubuzwe, imali engenayo, kanye nokufinyelela ekunakekelweni kwekhwalithi kunquma amathuba okuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi, ukufa, kanye nokukhubazeka, ngisho nasemazweni anemali ephezulu. INingizimu ye-Asia kanye ne-Afrika eseningizimu yeSahara inamazinga aphezulu kakhulu okuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi, futhi izingane ezizalwe ngaphambi kwesikhathi kulezi zifunda zibhekene nengozi ephezulu yokufa. Ngokubambisana, lezi zifunda ezimbili zimelela ngaphezu kuka-65% wokuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi emhlabeni jikelele. Umbiko uphinde ugcizelele ukuthi imiphumela yezingxabano, ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu kanye nomonakalo wezemvelo, i-COVID-19, kanye nokwenyuka kwezindleko zokuphila kuyandisa ubungozi kwabesifazane nezingane yonke indawo.

Ngo-1996, eMhlanganweni Wezempilo Womhlaba wama-49, amazwe angamalungu anquma ukuthi leli qoqo libhujiswe ngoJuni 1999, futhi livumele kuphela amasampula amancane ukuthi agcinwe ngezinhloso zocwaningo kumalabhorethri amabili agcinwe ngokuphepha - elinye lise-United States elinye liseRussian Federation. Ukugcinwa kwesikhashana kwamasheya akhona egciwane le-variola kusetshenziselwa ucwaningo olwengeziwe olubalulekile, olubhekwa yiKomidi Lokweluleka Lokucwaninga Ngegciwane le-variola. Leli qembu lihlangana minyaka yonke. I-World Health Organization (WHO) Smallpox Secretariat esekelwe eNhloko-dolobha ye-WHO iqondisa yonke imisebenzi ehlobene nokuqedwa kwegciwane le-variola kanye nangemva kokuqedwa kwayo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuqapha ucwaningo oluvunyelwe ngegciwane le-variola eliphilayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe izindlela zokulwa nalo njengomuthi wokugoma kanye nemithi elwa namagciwane.

Kusukela ngenkathi yokuqothulwa, kuye kwasungulwa imithi yokugoma ephephile kanye nokwelashwa okukhethekile kwe-smallpox kanye nezifo ezihlobene nayo njenge-monkeypox. UNobhala futhi unesibopho sokulungela izimo eziphuthumayo futhi uphatha isitoko esiphuthumayo somuthi wokugoma i-smallpox esimweni esingalindelekile sokuthi lesi sifo siphinde sivele. UNobhala uphatha ukuhlolwa kokuphepha kwezinto eziphilayo kanye nokuphepha kwezinto eziphilayo kwezinqolobane zegciwane le-variola ezigunyaziwe njengoba kugunyazwe yi-World Health Assembly, futhi uqinisekisa ukubika minyaka yonke ezinhlakeni ezilawulayo ze-WHO. UNobhala we-Smallpox Secretariat usekela i-WHO Archives ekulondolozeni umlando womhlaba wonke we-smallpox futhi ubhale izifundo ezifundwe ngempumelelo yokuqothulwa kwe-smallpox. Ukusebenza kuyo yonke imikhakha nokuqinisekisa ukuvumelana kwezinqubomgomo ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene kuyisihluthulelo sokwakha izindawo ezisekelayo nezivumelayo zezempilo, okuqinisekisa ukuthi ukucatshangelwa kwezempilo nokulingana kuhlanganiswa kuyo yonke inqubo yokuhlela, ukutshalwa kwezimali kanye nezinqumo zenqubomgomo ezingeni lendawo. Ukusiza amazwe angamalungu ukubhekana nalezi zinto ezibalulekile ezingenhla, i-WHO isebenza ukuqinisa isisekelo sobufakazi ukusiza abenzi bezinqubomgomo ukuthi benze izinqumo ezinolwazi lapho bebhekana nezingozi zezempilo. Inikeza amathuluzi nesiqondiso sokuthi yini esebenzayo, futhi isekela ukuqapha izinkomba ezibalulekile ezihlobene nezempilo. I-WHO ihola futhi ibandakanyeka ekuthuthukiseni ukushintshana kwamadolobha kanye nokusiza ukuthuthukisa izinhlaka zezikhungo nezinqubomgomo zokuphathwa kahle kwamadolobha ngenxa yezempilo nenhlalakahle emadolobheni.

Ukuqinisa ikhono lezwe lezinhlelo zezempilo kanye nabahlinzeki ukuvimbela nokuphendula odlameni olubhekiswe kwabesifazane. Ukukhuthaza ubuholi ezinhlelweni zezempilo nokwakha intando yezepolitiki yokubhekana nodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane ngokukhuthaza kanye nokubambisana. Uhlelo Lomsebenzi Jikelele Lwe-WHO lwesi-13 (GPW) lubandakanya udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane njengengxenye yomnikelo walo kuSinqumo Sokuthuthukiswa Okuqhubekayo (SDG) 5 mayelana nokulingana ngokobulili kanye nokuhlomisa abesifazane (ikakhulukazi, i-SDG 5.2 ngokuqedwa kodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane namantombazane) eMhlanganweni Wezempilo Womhlaba ngoMeyi 2016, amazwe angamalungu avumelana nohlelo lokusebenza lomhlaba wonke lokuqinisa indima yezinhlelo zezempilo ekubhekaneni nodlame phakathi kwabantu, ikakhulukazi olubhekiswe kwabesifazane namantombazane kanye nezingane.

Kodwa-ke, iningi labantu abayizigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezi-4.2 abahlala emadolobheni bahlushwa izindlu nezokuthutha ezinganele, ukuhlanzeka okungalungile nokuphathwa kwemfucuza, kanye nekhwalithi yomoya ehluleka imihlahlandlela ye-WHO. Ezinye izinhlobo zokungcola, njengomsindo, ukungcoliswa kwamanzi nomhlabathi, okubizwa ngokuthi iziqhingi ezishisayo zasemadolobheni, kanye nokuntuleka kwendawo yokuhamba, ukuhamba ngebhayisikili nokuphila okusebenzayo kuhlangana okwenza amadolobha abe yizikhungo zomqedazwe wesifo esingadluliseki futhi abe yizimbangela zokushintsha kwesimo sezulu. I-WHO Repository on Urban Health Impact: Cishe i-40% yokukhula kwamadolobha kusezindaweni ezisemaphandleni ezingenamanzi aphephile nokuhlanzeka, kanti i-91% yabantu ezindaweni zasemadolobheni iphefumula umoya ongcolile. Uma kukhulunywa ngokudla okunempilo, ukwanda kwamadolobha kwandisa ibanga elisuka epulazini liye efekethini, okushayela ukufunwa kokudla okungahlanzekile, okucutshunguliwe.

UDkt Balkhy uneziqu zobudokotela ezikhethekile ezifweni ezithathelwanayo zezingane. UDkt Catharina Boehme uzoba nguMsizi woMqondisi-Jikelele, Wezobudlelwano Bangaphandle kanye noHulumeni kusukela ngomhlaka-4 Meyi 2023. Kulesi sikhundla uDkt Boehme uzohola ukuzibandakanya kwamasu e-WHO ezindaweni zokuphatha, ukuqoqwa kwemithombo kanye nobudlelwano bomlingani. Iphothifoliyo yakhe izofaka izinqubo ezibalulekile zamazwe angamalungu, njengokuxoxisana kwabo ngesivumelwano sobhubhane, ukuguqulwa kokuphathwa kwe-WHO kanye nokuqaliswa kwezincomo zokuxhaswa okusimeme. UDkt Boehme ubelokhu esebenza njengoMqondisi-Jikelele we-Chef de Cabinet ngesikhathi lapho ehola khona umbono wamasu wobuholi, eqinisekisa ukuqondanisa kuyo yonke iNhlangano kanye namazwe angamalungu kanye nabalingani.

Ujoyine i-WHO ngo-2021, ngemuva kokuba yiChief Executive Officer ye-FIND, umfelandawonye wamazwe omhlaba wokuxilonga. UDkt Boehme unesiqu sezokwelapha kanye namadiploma kwezempilo yomphakathi kanye nokuphathwa. UDkt Chikwe Ihekweazu uzoqhubeka njengoMsizi woMqondisi-Jikelele weSigaba Sezobunhloli Bezimo Eziphuthumayo Zempilo Nezinhlelo Zokuqapha ohlelweni lwe-Emergencies Programme. Njengengxenye yephothifoliyo yakhe, uDkt Ihekweazu uhola i-WHO Hub ye-Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence, ehlanganisa abalingani ukubhekana nobungozi besikhathi esizayo besifo kanye nobhubhane ngokufinyelela okungcono kwedatha, amandla wokuhlaziya, namathuluzi wokwenza izinqumo. Ngaphambi kokujoyina i-WHO, uDkt Ihekweazu wayengumqondisi-Jikelele wokuqala we-Nigeria Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), kusukela ngo-2016 kuya ku-2021.

Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukunakekelwa ngenhlonipho nokusekela uma kwenzeka kufa. Ukulalela okuhlangenwe nakho namazwi abesifazane nemiphakathi yabo kubalulekile ukusiza ukubhekana nezinkinga zokucwaswa okuhlobene nokuzalwa okushonile. Impendulo ye-WHO: Kudingeka kwenziwe okwengeziwe ukuhlanganisa ukuvimbela ukuzalwa okushonile ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo zomhlaba wonke nezikazwelonke zokunakekelwa kwezempilo okuphezulu kwabesifazane, intsha, nezingane. Ngokusebenzisa i-Global Strategy for Women's, Children's and Adolescents Health 2016-2030 kanye nokusebenzisa izincomo ze-Every Newborn Action Plan (2014), i-WHO isebenza ukuqeda ukuzalwa okushonile okungavinjelwa, njengengxenye yemizamo yokuthuthukisa impilo yomama, usana, ingane nentsha. Iningi lokuzalwa okushonile alitholi isitifiketi sokuzalwa futhi alibhalisiwe.

Lezi zihlanganisa ukuqaliswa kwezinhlelo ezincane zesifunda noma zombuso zokuthuthukisa ukufinyelela kwe-morphine yokusetshenziswa kwezokwelapha ngephakethe lezinsizakalo nemikhiqizo ebalulekile yokunakekelwa okudambisa okuhlelwe ngokuya nge-WHO Model List of Essential Medicines kanye ne-WHO Essential Package of Palliative Care. Zihlanganisa nokwenza ngcono ukuphathwa, ukwenza lula izinqubo zokuthengwa nokunikezwa ukuze kubhekwane nanoma yikuphi ukungasebenzi kahle, ukuthuthukisa izinsiza ezinjengemali ezinzile, ukuthuthukisa amakhono afanele abasebenzi bezempilo, nokukhulisa ukuqwashisa ngezinzuzo kanye nokulimala okungenzeka kokusetshenziswa kwe-opioid. Impumelelo yalezi zenzo izoncika ekubambisaneni nasekusebenzisaneni phakathi kwabo bonke ababambe iqhaza kuzwelonke, esifundeni nasemhlabeni jikelele.

Ngenkathi amaqanda e-tapeworm ethathelana nezimbuzi, amaqanda e-T. solium nawo angathathelana nabantu uma edliwa ngumuntu (ngendlela yendle-umlomo, noma ngokudla ukudla noma amanzi angcolile). Ukudla amaqanda e-tapeworm kubangela ukutheleleka nge-parasite ye-larva ezicutshini ezifana nemisipha, isikhumba, amehlo kanye nesimiso sezinzwa esiyinhloko (i-cysticercosis yomuntu), ngemiphumela engaba yingozi empilweni. Lapho ama-cysts eba khona ebuchosheni, isimo sibizwa ngokuthi i-neurocysticercosis. Izimpawu: I-Taeniasis ivame ukubonakala ngezimpawu ezincane nezingacacile ezihambisana nokutheleleka kwamathumbu (ubuhlungu besisu, isicanucanu, isifo sohudo, njll.). Lezi zimpawu zingaqhubeka kuze kube yilapho i-tapeworm ifa ngemuva kokwelashwa, kungenjalo ingaphila iminyaka.

Amalungelo ezocansi: Kunokuvumelana okwandayo kokuthi impilo yezocansi ayinakutholakala futhi igcinwe ngaphandle kokuhlonipha nokuvikela amalungelo athile abantu. Incazelo esebenzayo yamalungelo ezocansi enikezwe ngezansi iwumnikelo engxoxweni eqhubekayo yamalungelo abantu ahlobene nempilo yezocansi. Ukusetshenziswa kwamalungelo abantu akhona kwezocansi nempilo yezocansi kuyizimfanelo zamalungelo ezocansi. Amalungelo ezocansi avikela wonke amalungelo abantu okufeza nokuveza ubulili babo futhi bajabulele impilo yezocansi, ngokucabangela amalungelo abanye ngaphakathi kohlaka lokuvikelwa ekubandlululweni. " (WHO, 2006a, updated 2010) "Ukufezeka kwempilo yezocansi kuhlobene nezinga lapho amalungelo abantu ehlonishwa, evikelwa futhi egcwaliswa khona.

UDkt Ryan uneziqu zobudokotela kanye neziqu ze-master kwezempilo yomphakathi. UMnuz Raul Thomas uzoqhubeka njengoMsizi woMqondisi-Jikelele Wezokusebenza Kwebhizinisi. UMnuz Thomas unesibopho esiphelele semisebenzi yebhizinisi le-WHO, kufaka phakathi isabelomali, ezezimali, izinsiza zabantu, ukuphathwa, ukuhlolwa, ukuphathwa kwengozi, ukuphendula kanye nokulandela umthetho, kanye nokuphathwa jikelele. Unesibopho sokusebenzisa izinhlelo eziningi ngaphansi kwe-ajenda yokuguqulwa kweNhlangano kanye nokwakha indawo yokusebenza enenhlonipho, ehlanganisa wonke umuntu. Phakathi neminyaka yakhe engama-20 esebenza ne-WHO, uMnuz Thomas usebenze ezifundeni zase-Afrika, eMelika, eMpumalanga yeMedithera naseNtshonalanga yePacific, kanye ne-International Agency for Research on Cancer (IARC).

"Lezi yizimpumelelo ezihlaba umxhwele zezempilo yomphakathi", kusho uDkt Ibrahima Socé Fall, uMqondisi we-WHO Global NTD Programme. "I-Benin ne-Mali zibonisa ukuthi intando yezombusazwe enamandla, ukuhlanganiswa kwemikhakha ehlukene, ukuqapha kanye nokuzibandakanya komphakathi kungasebenza kanjani ngokubambisana ukuze kuqedwe lesi sifo. Intuthuko ebalulekile yenziwe ekulweni ne-trachoma eminyakeni embalwa edlule. Inani labantu abadinga ukwelashwa ngama-antibiotic ngenxa ye-trachoma esifundeni sase-Afrika se-WHO lehle ngezigidi ezingama-84, lisuka ezigidini eziyi-189 ngo-2014 laya ezigidini eziyi-105 ngoJuni 2022. Qaphela umhleli: I-trachoma ihlala iyinkinga yezempilo yomphakathi emazweni angama-41 (kusukela ngoJuni 2022) enabantu abalinganiselwa ezigidini eziyi-125 abahlala ezindaweni ezidinga ukungenelela ngokumelene nalesi sifo.

ukuzibandakanya kakhulu nomphakathi wesakhamuzi; nokusebenzisana namazwe angamalungu ukuqinisa izikhuthazo zokubambisana ngokusebenzisa ubuholi bezepolitiki, ukuqondiswa kokuphatha kanye nokuxhaswa ngezimali ukusekela ukubambisana. Imiphumela esemqoka yombiko izofaka izingxoxo ze-United Nations General Assembly SDG Summit elandelayo kanye ne-Meeting High-Level on Universal Health Coverage ngoSepthemba 2023. Izinyanga eziholela kulezi zenzakalo ezibalulekile zinikeza ithuba lokugqugquzela ngokuhlanganyela ngamazwe angamalungu kanye nezinhlangano zamazwe amaningi ukukhomba izindlela zokusebenzisa izincomo nokulungiselela indawo yokusebenzisa ngokugcwele ukubambisana okunamandla nokusheshisa inqubekela phambili ekufinyeleleni kuma-SDG ahlobene nezempilo engxenyeni yesibili yesikhathi se-SDG. Isaziso kumhleli:

Udlame lomlingani oseduze lubhekisela ekuziphatheni komlingani oseduze noma owayengumlingani okubangela ukulimala ngokomzimba, ngokocansi noma ngokwengqondo, kufaka phakathi ukuhlukunyezwa ngokomzimba, ukuphoqelelwa ngokocansi, ukuhlukunyezwa ngokwengqondo nokuziphatha okulawulayo. Udlame lwezocansi "yisiphi isenzo socansi, ukuzama ukuthola isenzo socansi, noma esinye isenzo esibhekiswe ebulilini bomuntu ngokusebenzisa ukuphoqelelwa, yinoma yimuphi umuntu kungakhathalekile ubudlelwano bakhe nesisulu, kunoma iyiphi indawo. Kufaka phakathi ukudlwengula, okuchazwa njengokungeniswa ngokomzimba noma ngokunye okuphoqelelwe kwesitho sangasese noma i-anus ngesitho sangasese, enye ingxenye yomzimba noma into. Umthelela: Udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane luyinkinga yomhlaba wonke yobubhubhane. Kubangela ukulimala okukhulu, ukulimala kwezimpilo zabesifazane nezingane zabo.

Isinqumo esiyingqophamlando sokuqinisa impilo yabantu bomdabu emhlabeni wonke I-World Health Assembly namuhla ivume isinqumo esingakaze sibonwe ngaphambili mayelana nempilo yabantu bomdabu, esicela uMqondisi-Jikelele ukuthi athuthukise uhlelo lokusebenza lomhlaba wonke lwezempilo yabantu bomdabu futhi alethule ku-World Health Assembly yama-79 ngo-2026. Abantu bomdabu, yize bemele amaqembu ahlukahlukene abantu nemiphakathi, ngokuvamile banesikhathi sokuphila esiphansi kakhulu kunabantu abangewona abomdabu. Futhi banesibalo esiphakeme sezifo eziningi nezimo zempilo ezingezinhle, kufaka phakathi isifo sikashukela, ukufa komama nezinsana kanye nokungondleki.

Emhlabeni jikelele, iBenin neMali zihlanganyela namanye amazwe angu-15 aqinisekiswe yi-WHO ngokuqeda i-trachoma njengenkinga yezempilo yomphakathi. Lawa yiCambodia, iChina, iGambia, iGhana, i-Islamic Republic of Iran, iLao People's Democratic Republic, iMalawi, iMexico, iMorocco, iMyanmar, iNepal, i-Oman, iSaudi Arabia, iTogo neVanuatu. Ukuqedwa kwe-trachoma kusetshenziswa isu le-WHO le-SAFE Kokubili iBenin neMali basebenzise isu le-SAFE elinconywe yi-WHO lokuqeda i-trachoma ngokusekelwa yi-WHO kanye nabalingani. Isu le-SAFE liqukethe ukuhlinzwa ukwelapha izinkinga ze-trachoma zakamuva; ama-antibiotic ukuqeda ukutheleleka; ukuhlanzeka kobuso; kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwemvelo, ikakhulukazi ukuthuthukisa ukufinyelela emanzini nasekuhlanzekeni, ukunciphisa ukudluliselwa.

Kuyimbangela ehamba phambili yomhlaba wonke yokufa kwezingane okuhlobene nokucwila. Eminyakeni eyishumi edlule, abantu abayizigidi ezi-2.5 bafa ngokucwila, futhi ngaphezu kuka-90% walokho kwenzeka emazweni anemali ephansi naphakathi. Ngokumenywa kwe-United Nations (UN) General Assembly, i-WHO izoxhumanisa izenzo ngaphakathi kohlelo lwe-UN mayelana nokuvimbela ukucwila futhi yenze lula ukugcinwa koSuku Lomhlaba Lokuvimbela Ukucwila ngoJulayi 25 unyaka ngamunye. I-WHO izophinde isungule i-Global Alliance for Drowning Prevention nezinhlangano zohlelo lwe-UN, abalingani bezentuthuko bamazwe omhlaba nezinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni. Ukuze uqonde kangcono umthwalo wangempela nomthelela wokucwila, isinqumo sicela i-WHO ukuthi ilungiselele umbiko wesimo somhlaba wonke mayelana nokuvimbela ukucwila.

Ukuze uvikeleke impilo yakho yonke, i-WHO incoma ukuthi umuntu athole imithamo engu-6 (3 eyinhloko kanye nemithamo emithathu yokuvuselela) ye-TTCV. Uchungechunge lokuqala lwemithamo emithathu kufanele luqale kusukela emavikini ayisithupha ubudala, kanti imithamo elandelayo inikezwe ngesikhathi esiphakathi kwamasonto amane. Imithamo emithathu yokuvuselela kufanele inikezwe phakathi konyaka wesibili wokuphila (izinyanga ezingu-12 kuya kwezingu-23), eminyakeni engu-4 kuya kwengu-7, naseminyakeni engu-9 kuya kwengu-15. Ngokufanelekile, kufanele kube okungenani neminyaka emine phakathi kwemithamo yokuvuselela. Kunezinhlobo eziningi zemithi yokugoma esetshenziselwa ukuvikela i-tetanus: imithi yokugoma i-diphtheria ne-tetanus (DT) imithi yokugoma i-diphtheria, i-tetanus, ne-pertussis (i-whooping cough) (DTaP) imithi yokugoma i-tetanus ne-diphtheria (Td) imithi yokugoma i-tetanus, i-diphtheria, ne-pertussis (i-whooping cough) (DTaP) imithi yokugoma i-tetanus ne-diphtheria (Td) imithi yokugoma i-tetanus, i-diphtheria, ne-pertussis (i-whooping cough) (DTaP).

Izici zobungozi bezemvelo zokudluliselwa kwe-trachoma zifaka phakathi inhlanzeko embi, imizi egcwele ngokweqile, ukufinyelela okunganele emanzini noma ukusetshenziswa kwezindawo ezifanele zokuhlanzeka. Ngo-1996, i-WHO yethule i-WHO Alliance for the Global Elimination of Trachoma ngonyaka ka-2020 (GET2020). Ngabanye abalingani ku-Alliance, i-WHO isekela ukuqaliswa kwezwe kwamasu we-SAFE nokuqiniswa kwamandla kazwelonke ngokuhlola ubhubhane, ukuqapha, ukuqapha, ukuhlola iphrojekthi kanye nokuqoqwa kwemithombo okufaka isandla ekuqedeni i-trachoma njengenkinga yezempilo yomphakathi. I-road map, evunywe yi-World Health Assembly ngo-2020 ngesinqumo sayo 73(33), ibeka u-2030 njengosuku olusha lokugcina lokuqeda umhlaba wonke.

"Ngaphandle kwemithombo yabo elinganiselwe kanye nemikhawulo yendawo, lezi zizwe zikhombise ukuqina okuphawulekayo lapho zibhekene nobunzima. Ngokubambisana, kufanele sakhe indlela esekwe ekulinganeni, ukuqina, kanye nokusimama. Kumele siqinise izinhlelo zezempilo, sithuthukise izindlela zokuvimbela kanye nokutholwa kusenesikhathi, futhi sibeke phambili ukuhlanganiswa kwezinsizakalo ze-NCD nezempilo yengqondo ekunakekelweni kwezempilo okuyisisekelo. "UMqondisi-Jikelele uphinde wathembisa ukuthi i-WHO izosebenzela ukuqoqa izinsiza zezimali ukuthuthukisa izikhungo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo ezinokumelana nesimo sezulu, ezizinzile kwezemvelo e-SIDS. I-WHO izophinde iqhubeke nokukhuthaza ukuxhaswa ngezimali "kokulahleka nokulimala" kokutshalwa kwezimali kokuzivumelanisa nokuguquka kwesimo sezulu emazweni anemali ephansi.

Ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokubika ukuzalwa nokufa kwezinsana kuyindaba yamalungelo abantu futhi kuyisidingo sokunciphisa ukuzalwa okufile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kunesidingo sokuqinisa izinhlelo zolwazi lwezempilo ezijwayelekile ukuze kubanjwe ngokunembile futhi kubikwe ukuzalwa okufile ukuze kulandelwe futhi kuthuthukiswe ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa. I-WHO inikeza amathuluzi okusiza amazwe ukuthi athuthukise idatha yawo kokubili ukuzalwa okufile nokufa kwezinsana. I-WHO futhi inesiqondiso sokusiza amazwe ukuthi abuyekeze futhi aphenye ukufa komuntu ngamunye ukuze akwazi ukuncoma nokusebenzisa izixazululo zokuvimbela ukuzalwa okufile esikhathini esizayo kanye nohlelo olujwayelekile lokuhlukanisa ukufa kwezinsana (ICD-PM). I-WHO ne-UNICEF basekela isimemo sokusebenza ngokuhlanganyela ukuqeda ukuzalwa okufile okungagwemeka ngokuthi:

Ukuchayeka ekubhemeni kukagwayi nakho kuye kwahlotshaniswa nemiphumela emibi yezempilo, okubangela ukufa kwabantu abayizigidi eziyi-1.2 minyaka yonke. Cishe ingxenye yazo zonke izingane iphefumula umoya ongcoliswe intuthu kagwayi futhi izingane ezingama-65 000 zifa minyaka yonke ngenxa yezifo ezihlobene nokubhema. Ukubhema ngenkathi ukhulelwe kungaholela ezimweni eziningana zezempilo zempilo yezingane. Imikhiqizo kagwayi efudumele (HTPs) iqukethe ugwayi futhi iveza abasebenzisi ukukhishwa okunobuthi, okuningi okubangela umdlavuza futhi okulimazayo empilweni. Izinhlelo zokulethwa kwe-nicotine nge-elekthronikhi (ENDS) nezinhlelo zokulethwa kwe-elekthronikhi ezingenayo i-nicotine (ENNDS), ezaziwa kakhulu njenge-e-cigarettes, aziqukethe ugwayi futhi zingaba noma zingabi ne-nicotine, kepha ziyingozi empilweni futhi ngokungangabazeki.

Isakhiwo sokuqala sohlelo lwe-WHO lomhlaba wonke siqala ukusebenza ngoJuni 2023 futhi sihlose ukuthuthukiswa kancane kancane ezinyangeni ezizayo. I-COVID-19 igcizelele indima ebalulekile edlalwa yi-genomics ye-pathogen ekuphenduleni izinsongo zobhubhane. I-Genomics ilele enhliziyweni yokulungela nokuphendula ubhubhane olusebenzayo nobhubhane, kanye nengxenye yokuqapha okuqhubekayo kohlu olukhulu lwezifo, kusukela ezifweni ezidluliselwa ngokudla kanye nomkhuhlane kuya esifubeni kanye ne-HIV. Ukuzinakekela okutholakalayo, okufinyeleleka, okungabizi, okwamukelekayo nekhwalithi enhle kuyizinto ezisemqoka zokukhuthaza nokuvikela ilungelo labantu lempilo. Ukuzinakekela kungathuthukisa ukusebenza kahle kokulethwa kwezinsizakalo zezempilo, ukufinyelela kanye nokumbozwa. Lokhu kudinga imithetho nezinqubomgomo ezisekelayo, ukuxhaswa kwezempilo, imikhiqizo esezingeni eliphakeme kanye nokungenelela okulawulwayo, kanye nemfundo ekhuthaza ukubamba iqhaza kwabantu ngabanye, kanye nobumfihlo nokugcinwa kwemfihlo. Ukucatshangelwa kwamalungelo abantu kusiza ukunciphisa udlame, ukuphoqelelwa, ukucwaswa kanye nokucwaswa ngokuthuthukisa ukusetshenziswa komuntu ngamunye kwelungelo lakhe lempilo, ulwazi, kanye nokwenza izinqumo ngokuzimela.

I-Latent syphilis ayinazo izimpawu noma izimpawu zomtholampilo futhi ukwelashwa kwehlukile esigabeni sokuqala. Ngemuva kweminyaka noma amashumi eminyaka ngaphandle kokwelashwa, izifo zezinzwa nezenhliziyo phakathi kwezinye zingenzeka. Ukwelashwa: Ukuxilongwa kwe-syphilis kususelwa emlandweni womuntu, ukuhlolwa komzimba, ukuhlolwa kwelabhorethri futhi kwesinye isikhathi i-radiology, njengoba izimpawu zingavamile noma zingabonakali. Ukukhomba ukutheleleka okungenazimpawu ngokuhlolwa kwelabhorethri kanye nokwelashwa kwamacala amahle kuzovimbela ukudluliselwa okwengeziwe kanye nemiphumela emibi yokukhulelwa, kufaka phakathi i-syphilis yemvelo. Ukuhlolwa kwelabhorethri kwe-syphilis kufaka phakathi ukutholwa okuqondile kwe-T. pallidum noma izindlela ezingaqondile ezifana ne-serology.

I-Sepsis Overview: I-Sepsis yisimo esisongela impilo esivela lapho ukusabela komzimba ekungenweni yisifo kubangela ukulimala kwezicubu nezitho zomzimba. Ngokuvamile kuyindlela yokugcina evamile yokufa kwezifo eziningi ezithathelwanayo emhlabeni jikelele. Kuhilela ukungasebenzi kahle kwezitho ezibangelwa ukusabela okungalawulwa komzimba ekungenweni yisifo futhi uma kungabonwa kusenesikhathi futhi kulawulwe ngokushesha, kungaholela ekushayweni yisifo se-septic shock, ukwehluleka kwezitho eziningi nokufa. Nakuba kunzima ukuthola isilinganiso esiqondile somthwalo womhlaba wonke we-sepsis, incwadi yesayensi yakamuva ibike ukuthi i-sepsis ithinta abantu abalinganiselwa ezigidini ezingama-49 futhi ibangela ukufa kwezigidi eziyi-11 emhlabeni wonke unyaka ngamunye.

Ukufinyelela kwamandla okuyisisekelo kuyabambezeleka phakathi kwamathuba avuselelekayo, umbiko omusha ukhombisa igebe lokufinyelela kwamandla emhlabeni wonke liyaqhubeka: abantu abayizigidi ezingama-675 abangenawo ugesi, abantu abayizigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezi-2.3 abathembele kumafutha wokupheka ayingozi Umbiko omusha we-International Energy Agency (IEA), i-International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA), i-United Nations Statistics Division (UNSD), iBhange Lomhlaba, kanye ne-World Health Organization (WHO), ekhishwe namuhla, uthola ukuthi umhlaba awusekho endleleni yokufeza iSifiso Sokuthuthuka Okusimeme (SDG) 7 ngamandla ngo-2030. Lo nyaka uphawula isigaba esiphakathi sokufeza i-SDGs ngo-2030. I-SDG 7 ukuqinisekisa ukufinyelela kumandla angabizi, athembekile, aqhubekayo futhi anamuhla.

Ku-neonatal tetanus, izimpawu zihlanganisa ukuqina kwemisipha, okuvame ukubangelwa ukungakwazi kwengane esanda kuzalwa ukuncela noma ukuncelisa ibele, nokukhala ngokweqile. I-tetanus itholakala ngesisekelo sezimpawu zomtholampilo futhi ayidingi ukuqinisekiswa kwelabhorethri. I-tetanus idinga ukwelashwa esikhungweni sezokwelapha, ngokuvamile esibhedlela sokudlulisela. Abantu abalulama ku-tetanus abanawo amasosha omzimba angokwemvelo futhi bangangenwa futhi ngakho-ke badinga ukugonywa. Ukuvimbela: I-tetanus ingavinjelwa ngokugonywa ngemithi yokugoma i-tetanus-toxoid (TTCV), efakwe ezinhlelweni zokugoma ezijwayelekile emhlabeni wonke futhi enikezwa ngesikhathi sokuxhumana nokunakekelwa kwangaphambi kokubeletha.

I-WHO yethula inethiwekhi yomhlaba wonke yokuthola nokuvimbela izinsongo zezifo ezithathelwanayo I-WHO kanye nabalingani bayo baqala inethiwekhi yomhlaba wonke yokusiza ukuvikela abantu ezinsongweni zezifo ezithathelwanayo ngamandla e-pathogen genomics. I-International Pathogen Surveillance Network (IPSN) izonikeza ipulatifomu yokuxhuma amazwe nezifunda, ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuqoqa nokuhlaziya amasampula, ukusebenzisa le datha ukushayela ukuthatha izinqumo kwezempilo yomphakathi, nokwabelana ngalolo lwazi kabanzi. I-Pathogen genomics ihlaziya ikhodi yofuzo yamagciwane, amabhaktheriya nezinye izinto ezibangela izifo ukuze ziqonde ukuthi zithathelwana kangakanani, zibulala kangakanani, nokuthi zisakazeka kanjani.

I-Tick-borne encephalitis Overview: I-Tick-borne encephalitis (TBE) iyimbangela ebalulekile yokutheleleka ngegciwane lesimiso sezinzwa esiphakathi emazweni aseMpumalanga, eMpumalanga, eNyakatho naseNtshonalanga Yurophu, naseNyakatho yeChina, eMongolia, naseRussian Federation. Igciwane le-Tick-borne encephalitis liyilungu lomndeni weFlaviviridae. Cishe amacala angu-10 000 kuya kwangu-12 000 omtholampilo we-tick-borne encephalitis abikwa minyaka yonke, kodwa lesi sibalo kukholakala ukuthi siphansi kakhulu kunenani langempela lamacala omtholampilo. Iningi lokutheleleka ngegciwane libangelwa amagundane anegciwane, avame ukuhlala aqinile esikhumbeni izinsuku eziningi.

Kudingeka uhlelo olusha lwezobuchwepheshe kwezempilo olubeka phambili inhlalakahle yomphakathi. Njengoba ubhadane lwe-COVID-19 lukwenze kwacaca, ikhwalithi namandla kahulumeni kubalulekile. Ohulumeni abaphumelelayo akubona abancane kunabo bonke, kodwa yilabo abaklanywe kahle futhi abanemithombo efanele, kokubili ngokwezezimali nangokwabantu babo kanye nengqalasizinda. Ukutshala kabusha amandla kahulumeni kubalulekile ekufezeni i-Health for All. Umbiko uphinde unikeze iziphakamiso zokuthi yini engenziwa ngokoqobo ukuze kwenziwe izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze kuqondiswe kabusha izinyathelo zenani lezomnotho, ukuxhaswa kwezempilo, ukusungula kanye nokwakha amandla omkhakha womphakathi ekusebenzeleni impilo yabo bonke.

Ukuhlela ndawonye i-Global Action Plan 2025-2030. Kulindeleke ukuthi kube nabahlanganyeli abangaphezu kuka-300 emhlanganweni, kungaba mathupha noma nge-inthanethi. Bazobandakanya abamele umphakathi we-NTD womhlaba wonke, abavela emazweni nakubanikeli kuya kubalingani bokusebenza kanye nabachwepheshe, kusukela emfundweni kuya ezinhlanganweni zeziguli nakuzo zonke ezinye izinhlangano nezikhungo ezibandakanyeka ekulweni ne-NTDs. Umbukiso wezifo ezishisayo ezinganakwa uzokwenzeka e-mezzanine yesakhiwo se-B, ngenhla nje kwe-cafeteria. Isethi yamapaneli ensimbi izokhombisa izimo ezingama-20 ezihlanganiswe ngaphansi kwesambulela se-NTD futhi inikeze imininingwane ngezenzo ezisetshenzisiwe ukubhekana nomthwalo wazo.

Izifo eziwumshayabhuqe nezinhlekelele zokusiza abantu Ezimweni lapho izinhlelo zezempilo ezikhona zicindezelekile, kuvame ukuba nesidingo esingakaze sibonwe kubantu nasemiphakathini sokuphatha impilo yabo. Kudingeka ngokushesha amasu amasha adlula ukusabela okujwayelekile komkhakha wezempilo njengoba: abantu abayizigidi ezingama-274 njengamanje badinga usizo nokuvikelwa kwabantu futhi ukuqubuka kwezifo kuyisongo esiqhubekayo emhlabeni wonke okungenani abantu abayizigidi ezingama-400 emhlabeni wonke abakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zezempilo ezibaluleke kakhulu. Umuntu oyedwa kwabahlanu emhlabeni wonke manje uphila ezinkingeni zokusiza abantu, lapho izinhlelo zezempilo zibhekene nenselele yokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezibalulekile.

Wahola i-WHO Global Burden of Disease Study eLebanon (2000) futhi wenza ucwaningo lokuqala lukazwelonke ngezifo ezingezona ezithathelwanayo kanye nezici zobungozi, ukwazisa ukukhuthaza, ukwenza izinqubomgomo kanye nokuhlela izinhlelo zokukhuthaza impilo. Ekwakha phezu kwempumelelo yakhe eminingi, uDkt Sibai usungule i- "National Strategy for Older Persons" eLebanon (2020-2030). UDkt Sibai futhi wasungula i-Arab Ageing Network kanye ne-Centre for Studies on Aging ukudala ukuxhumana phakathi kocwaningo nenqubomgomo emazingeni kazwelonke, wesifunda kanye nawomhlaba. Isifo sofuba: Isifo sofuba yisifo esithathelwana ngocansi esibangelwa yi-Treponema pallidum esibangela ukugula nokufa okukhulu, futhi singelapheka. Isifo sofuba sidluliselwa ngokuthintana ngokocansi nezilonda ezithathelwanayo, ngokumpontshelwa igazi noma ngowesifazane okhulelwe kumntwana wakhe. Ukudluliselwa kwesifo sofuba kusuka kumama kuya enganeni ngokuvamile kuyingozi kumntwana okhulelwe ezimweni ezingatholakalanga noma ezingalashwa ngokushesha ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa. Isifo sofuba somama, uma singelashwa, siphathwa sekwephuzile noma singelashwa nge-penicillin, kuholela emiphumeleni emibi yokubeletha (ABOs) elinganiselwa ku-50-80% wamacala, kuye ngesigaba sesifo sofuba.

Uma ingelashwa, lesi simo siholela ekwakhekeni kwezinto ezingabonakali, okuholela ekuphazamisekeni kokubona noma ukungaboni. Iminyaka okwenzeka ngayo lokhu incike ezintweni eziningana ezibandakanya ukuqina kokudluliselwa kwendawo. Emiphakathini enezifo eziningi, kungenzeka ebuntwaneni, yize ukuqala kokuphazamiseka kokubona phakathi kweminyaka engama-30 nengama-40 kuyinto ejwayelekile. Abesifazane baye baphuphuthekiswa izikhathi ezine kaningi kunamadoda, mhlawumbe ngenxa yokuxhumana kaningi nezingane ezithintekile. Abantu abahlala emiphakathini empofu kakhulu futhi ekude kakhulu e-Afrika, e-Asia, e-Australia, eMpumalanga Ephakathi, eMelika Ephakathi naseziQhingini zasePacific basengozini.

UProfesa Leo Yee Sin, uMqondisi Omkhulu weNational Centre for Infectious Diseases; eSingapore; uDkt Mario Moreira, uMongameli, Fiocruz, eBrazil; noDkt Josefina Campos, uMqondisi weNational Genomics and Bioinformatics Center e-ANLIS Malbrán, e-Argentina. Umcimbi uzokwenzeka ngendlela ye-hybrid, enikeza ithuba lokuthi amalungu e-IPSN kanye nezithameli ezibanzi zihlanganyele ne-IPSN nemisebenzi yayo. Mayelana ne-IPSNI-IPSN iyinethiwekhi entsha yomhlaba wonke yabalingisi be-genomic pathogen, ebanjwe yi-WHO Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence, ukusheshisa inqubekela phambili ekusetshenzisweni kwe-genomics pathogen nokwenza ngcono ukuthatha izinqumo kwezempilo yomphakathi.

Lawa ma-ABO avame ukuba mabi futhi ahlanganisa ukuzalwa okushonile (okuvame kakhulu), ukufa kwezinsana, ukuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi, isisindo esiphansi sokuzalwa, nezinsana ezitheleleke ngokwemvelo. I-Syphilis ingavinjelwa ngemikhuba yobulili ephephile okubandakanya ukusetshenziswa kwamakhondomu ngendlela efanele futhi engaguquguquki. Abantu abaningi abane-syphilis abanazo izimpawu noma banezimpawu ezincane kuphela ezingabonakali. Ukukhomba ukutheleleka ngokuhlolwa kwelabhorethri kanye nokwelashwa kwamacala atholakele kuzovimbela ukudluliselwa okwengeziwe kanye nemiphumela emibi yokukhulelwa okubandakanya i-syphilis yokuzalwa. Ukuhlolwa kungenziwa kusetshenziswa izivivinyo ezisheshayo ezinganikeza imiphumela engaphansi kwemizuzu engama-20, okuvumela ukwelashwa okusheshayo.

Phakathi kuka-2020-2021, i-COVID-19 yabangela ukulahleka kweminyaka yokuphila eyizigidi ezingama-336.8 emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kulingana nesilinganiso seminyaka engama-22 yokuphila okulahlekile ngokufa ngokweqile, okusheshisa ngokungazelelwe nangokudabukisayo izimpilo zezigidi zabantu. Kusukela ngo-2000, sabona ukuthuthuka okuphawulekayo empilweni yomama nengane ngenxa yokwehla kwezinga lokufa ngesithathu nengxenye, ngokulandelana. Izinga lezifo ezithathelwanayo ezifana ne-HIV, isifo sofuba (i-TB) kanye nomalaleveva nalo lancipha, kanye nokwehla kwengozi yokufa ngaphambi kwesikhathi ngenxa yezifo ezingamahlalakhona kanye nokulimala. Ngokubambisana, lokhu kwafaka isandla ekwandeni kokulindelwe kwempilo emhlabeni wonke kusuka eminyakeni engama-67 ngo-2000 kuya eminyakeni engama-73 ngo-2019.

Ukwelashwa: Amakhambi okubulala izinyoka ayindlela ephumelelayo yokuvimbela noma ukuguqula imiphumela eminingi eyingozi yokulunywa yinyoka futhi afakwe ohlwini lwe-WHO lwemithi ebalulekile. Ukutholakala nokufinyeleleka kwala makhambi, kanye nokuqwashisa ngezindlela zokuvimbela eziyinhloko phakathi kwemiphakathi nabasebenzi bezempilo, kuyindlela engcono kakhulu yokunciphisa imiphumela emibi nokufa okubangelwa ukulunywa yinyoka. Ngemva kokulunywa yinyoka okusolwa ukuthi inobuthi, landela lezi zinyathelo: Hambela kude ngokushesha nendawo lapho kulunywe khona. Susa noma yini eqinile ezungeze ingxenye yomzimba elunywe ukuze ugweme ukulimala uma kwenzeka ukuvuvukala.

Ithimba labaholi eliyinhloko, elihlanganisa inani elilinganayo labesifazane nabesilisa, lizosebenza ngokubambisana namahhovisi esifunda nawamazwe e-WHO. Amalungu amasha eqembu labaholi eliyinhloko: uDkt Jeremy Farrar uzoba nguSosayensi Oyinhloko we-WHO kusukela ngomhlaka-8 Meyi 2023. Ukuqokwa kukaDkt Farrar kumenyezelwe ngaphambilini ngoDisemba 2022. Kulesi sikhundla uDkt Farrar uzobheka uMnyango Wezesayensi, ahlanganise ochwepheshe abahle kakhulu namanethiwekhi kwezesayensi nokwenza izinto ezintsha emhlabeni wonke ukuze aqondise, athuthukise futhi alethe izinqubomgomo nezinsizakalo zezempilo ezisezingeni eliphakeme kubantu abazidinga kakhulu. Ngaphambi kokujoyina i-WHO uDkt Farrar wayengumqondisi we-Wellcome Trust.

Imizamo yokuvimbela ukuzibulala idinga ukuhlanganiswa nokubambisana phakathi kwemikhakha eminingi, kufaka phakathi ezempilo, ezemfundo, ezemisebenzi, ezolimo, ezamabhizinisi, ezobulungiswa, ezomthetho, ezokuvikela, ezombusazwe kanye nabezindaba. Ukuvimbela ukuzibulala ngokuvamile akubhekwana nakho ngokwanele ngenxa yokucwaswa kanye nokuntuleka kokuqwashisa ukuthi ukuzibulala kuyinkinga enkulu yezempilo yomphakathi. Imiphakathi nayo idlala indima ebalulekile ekuvimbeleni ukuzibulala. I-WHO response: Isidingo sokuthatha izinyathelo zokuvimbela ukuzibulala sesibonwe futhi sabekwa phambili emazingeni aphezulu.

UDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, uMqondisi-Jikelele we-WHO, uthe, "I-WHO iyaziqhenya ngokuba noRenée Fleming noPretty Yende njengabamemezeli be-Goodwill Ambassadors for Arts and Health. Ithalente labo elingenakuqhathaniswa, ukuzinikela kwezobuciko, nokuzibophezela ekuthuthukiseni impilo nenhlalakahle kubenza babe ngabamemezeli abahle kakhulu bale nhloso ebalulekile. Ukuzibandakanya kwabo kuzokhuthaza abantu, imiphakathi kanye nabenzi bezinqubomgomo ukuba babone futhi basebenzise amandla aguqulayo ezobuciko ekufuneni impilo engcono yabo bonke. "UFleming uletha ubuchwepheshe obuningi endimeni yakhe entsha. Uthakazelise izethameli emhlabeni wonke ngezwi lakhe elikhanyayo le-soprano nobuciko obuphoqayo.

ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amazwe ahlomele kangcono ukubhekana nokwanda okungazelelwe kwezidingo zokuvuselelwa okubandakanya ubuchwepheshe bokusiza ngenxa yezimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo; ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abasemazingeni aphansi nabasengozini banokufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zokuvuselelwa ezifikelelekayo, ezisezingeni elifanele nezifanele kubandakanya nobuchwepheshe bokusiza; ukugwema izindleko eziphezulu ezingaphandle kwepokethi zabantu ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zokuvuselelwa kanye nobuchwepheshe bokusiza obungadala ubunzima bezezimali; nokubhekana nezinga lamanje elinganele labasebenzi bokuvuselelwa ukuze bakhonze izidingo zabantu. Isinqumo sibala uhla lwezenzo okumele zithathwe yiNobhala we-WHO njengokuthi:

UDkt Ihekweazu uneziqu zobudokotela, ekhethekile njengesazi sezifo ezithathelwanayo, kanye neziqu ze-master's kwezempilo yomphakathi. UDkt Michael Ryan uzoqhubeka njengoMqondisi Omkhulu we-WHO's Health Emergencies Programme. UDkt Ryan ubelokhu ephatha izimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo ku-WHO eminyakeni engama-25 edlule futhi muva nje uhola ukusabela okuphuthumayo kwe-WHO kubhubhane lwe-COVID-19. Uhola ukusabela kwe-WHO ekuqubukeni kwezifo, izinkinga zokusiza abantu kanye nezinye izimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo. UDkt Ryan uyilungu elisungula i-Global Outbreak Alert and Response Network (GOARN), eye yasiza ekuphenduleni amakhulu eziqubuko zezifo emhlabeni jikelele.

Eminyakeni yamuva, izinsiza zamazwe ngamazwe zamalungelo abantu bezilokhu zisetshenziswa kakhulu ukusekela nokuthuthukisa izimangalo zomthetho zabantu ngabanye kanye nemiphakathi yonke ukuze ohulumeni bezwe baqinisekise ukuhlonishwa, ukuvikelwa nokugcwaliseka kwamalungelo abo ezempilo yezocansi nokuzala (Cook et al., 2003). Izincazelo zokusebenza kanye nohlaka lwezinhlelo ezivezwe lapha zisekelwe kumalungelo abantu amukelwa emhlabeni wonke futhi zinikeza indlela esekelwe kumalungelo okuhlela kwezempilo yezocansi. Izakhi eziyinhloko zomqondo wezempilo yezocansi zibhalwe ngezansi. Izakhi eziyinhloko zomqondo wezempilo yezocansi Uma zibhekwa ngokuphelele nangendlela enhle:

Emphakathini, i-sepsis ivame ukuvela njengokuwohloka komtholampilo kwezifo ezivamile nezingavinjelwa. I-sepsis futhi ivame ukuvela ngenxa yezifo ezitholakala ezikhungweni zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, okungenye yezenzakalo ezingathandeki ezivame kakhulu ngesikhathi sokunakekelwa futhi ezithinta amakhulu ezigidi zeziguli emhlabeni wonke unyaka nonyaka. Uma i-sepsis iqala ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa, ngesikhathi sokubeletha noma ngemuva kokubeletha, noma ngemuva kokukhipha isisu, ibizwa ngokuthi i-sepsis kamama. I-sepsis ezinganeni ezisanda kuzalwa ibizwa ngokuthi i-neonatal sepsis. Naphezu kokuthi ingavinjelwa kakhulu, i-sepsis kamama nezingane ezisanda kuzalwa iyaqhubeka nokuba yimbangela enkulu yokufa kwabesifazane abakhulelwe nezingane ezisanda kuzalwa.

Sebenzisa ukhilimu wokuvikela ilanga onamandla okungenani angu-15 SPF (okungcono kube ngaphezulu) bese uphinde uwusebenzise njalo ngemva kwamahora amabili. Gwema izibani zelanga nezindawo zokuthambisa, njengoba zaziwa ngokulimaza isikhumba namehlo. Ukuchayeka kwezingane emisebeni ye-UV kufanele kuncishiswe ngokucophelela ngoba zisesimweni sokukhula okusheshayo futhi ngenxa yalokho zithambekele kakhulu ezinsongweni zemvelo kunabantu abadala. Imisebenzi eminingi ebalulekile efana nesimiso somzimba sokuzivikela ayithuthuki ngokugcwele lapho zizalwa, futhi izindawo ezingaphephile zingaphazamisa ukukhula kwazo okujwayelekile. Impendulo ye-WHO: I-WHO isebenza namazwe angamalungu kanye nabalingani bayo ukuze kwandiswe ukuqonda komphakathi ngemiphumela yokuchayeka ngokweqile emisebeni ye-ultraviolet.

I-Trachoma itholakala kakhulu ezindaweni ezihlwempu kakhulu nezasemakhaya e-Afrika, e-Central nase-South America, e-Asia, e-Western Pacific nase-Middle East. I-WHO African Region ithinteka kakhulu yi-trachoma ngabantu abayizigidi eziyi-105 abahlala ezindaweni ezisengozini, okumelela u-84% womthwalo we-trachoma emhlabeni jikelele. I-Trachoma iyimbangela ehamba phambili yokutheleleka kokungaboni emhlabeni jikelele. Lesi sifo sibangelwa ukutheleleka ngebhaktheriya i-Chlamydia trachomatis. Ukutheleleka kudluliselwa kusuka kumuntu kuya kumuntu ngeminwe engcolile, ama-fomites kanye nezimpukane ezithintene nokukhishwa kwamehlo noma ikhala lomuntu onegciwane.

Ukuhamba kanye nempilo Okubalulekile: Ukuhamba kwamanye amazwe kungaletha izingozi ezahlukahlukene empilweni, kuya ngezici zomuntu ohambayo kanye nohambo. Abahambi bangahlangabezana nezinguquko ezingazelelwe futhi ezibalulekile ekuphakameni, umswakama, amagciwane, kanye nokushisa, okungaholela empilweni embi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izingozi ezinkulu zempilo zingavela ezindaweni lapho indawo yokuhlala ingeyekhwalithi, inhlanzeko kanye nokukhucululwa kwendle kunganele, izinsizakalo zezokwelapha azithuthukisiwe kahle futhi amanzi ahlanzekile awatholakali. Ukuhamba kwamanye amazwe kuyanda, njengoba izigidi zabantu zihamba ngezinhloso zomsebenzi, ezenhlalo, ezokungcebeleka nezokusiza abantu unyaka nonyaka.

Ekugcineni, kungadala ubuhlungu obukhulu bomzimba noma ukungakhululeki, okwenza kube lula ukudida umkhuhlane noma ukudla okunobuthi. Ezinganeni, i-sepsis ingavela ngokuphefumula okusheshayo kakhulu, ukuquleka, isikhumba esiphuzi, ukucobeka noma ubunzima bokuvuka noma ukuzwa ukubanda okungajwayelekile. Ezinganeni ezingaphansi kweminyaka engu-5, kungadala ubunzima bokudla, ukuhlanza okuphindaphindiwe noma ukuntuleka kokuchama. Ukusola i-sepsis nokwenza ngokushesha kubalulekile ekuboneni nasekuxilongweni kusenesikhathi. Ukwelashwa: Ukukhonjwa kwezimpawu kusenesikhathi nokusungulwa kwesikhathi esifanele kokuphathwa okufanele kuyizinto ezibalulekile ekunciphiseni ubungozi nomthelela we-sepsis.

"UPretty Yende uhlabe umxhwele izethameli ngezwi lakhe elihle kakhulu nokusebenza kwakhe okumangalisayo. Njengomculi we-soprano onokuqonda okujulile kwamandla omculo, ukhombise ukuzibophezela kwakhe ekusebenziseni ithalente lakhe ukuthuthukisa umphakathi. Uthando lukaYende lokwabelana ngezici zokwelapha zomculo nokuzinikela kwakhe ezindabeni zenhlalo kuhambisana ngokuphelele ne-ajenda ye-WHO's Arts and Health. UYende uthe, "Ngijabule kakhulu ukuqokwa njenge-WHO Goodwill Ambassador for Arts and Health. Ngithemba ukusiza ukusungula isisekelo sokuphenya okuqhubekayo kwezobuciko okuyisithako esiyisisekelo ekuthuthukiseni impilo yethu yomzimba, yengqondo neyenhlalo.

Nakuba ezinye izifunda zithinteka kakhulu, ukubeletha ngaphambi kwesikhathi kusongela intuthuko yezempilo kuwo wonke amazwe. Ukutshala imali eningi ekunakekelweni kwezinsana ezisanda kuzalwa kungasindisa izigidi zemindeni ebuhlungwini. Kudingeka futhi umsebenzi omningi wokuvimbela ukubeletha ngaphambi kwesikhathi, okuzophinde kuthuthukise intuthuko ekunciphiseni ukuzalwa kwezinsana nokufa komama. Ngokubambisana lezi zindlela ezimbili zokuvimbela nokunakekela ngaphambi kwesikhathi zizokhiqiza abantu abanempilo kanye nemiphakathi ukuze kufezwe intuthuko kwezomnotho nezenhlalo. Isizukulwane sethu esilandelayo sincike kithi sonke ukuthi sisebenze manje - utshalomali lungase lungabi luncane kodwa imbuyiselo yalolu tshalomali izoba nkulu kuwo wonke amazwe. "

Abantu bangase futhi babhekane nezinkinga zokopha ezingaholela ekupheleni kwegazi noma ukwehluleka kwezinso okungenakuguqulwa. Ukubhujiswa okukhulu kwezicubu zendawo nakho kungenzeka, okungaholela ekukhubazekeni okungapheli ngisho nasekunqunyweni kwemilenze. Izingane zisengozini enkulu yemiphumela emibi ngenxa yobunzima bomzimba obuphansi kunabantu abadala. Iningi lokufa nemiphumela emibi yokulunywa yinyoka kungavinjelwa ngokuphelele ngokwenza amakhambi anempilo futhi asebenzayo atholakale kabanzi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinobungozi obukhulu. Amakhambi anempilo enyoka ayindlela kuphela ephumelelayo yokuvimbela noma ukuguqula iningi lemiphumela enobuthi yokulunywa yinyoka.

I-helminthiases edluliselwa ngumhlabathi Uhlolojikelele: Izifo ezidluliselwa ngumhlabathi (STH) ziphakathi kwezifo ezivame kakhulu emhlabeni wonke futhi zithinta imiphakathi empofu kakhulu futhi ehlwempu kakhulu.Zidluliselwa ngamaqanda akhona emathunjini omuntu okubangela ukungcoliswa kwenhlabathi ezindaweni lapho ukuhlanzeka kungathandeki khona.Izinhlobo eziyinhloko ezithinta abantu yizimpethu ezizungezile (Ascaris lumbricoides), i-whipworm (Trichuris trichiura) kanye ne-hookworms (Necator americanus kanye ne-Ancylostoma duodenale).Izimpethu zesisu zikhiqiza uhla olubanzi lwezimpawu ezibandakanya ukubonakaliswa kwamathumbu (isifo sohudo, ubuhlungu besisu), ukungaphatheki kahle jikelele kanye nobuthakathaka.

Inkinga eqhubekayo evimbela ukufinyelela ekwelashweni okuphephile, okusebenzayo kwezibulala-zinambuzane ezindaweni eziningi, futhi ikakhulukazi e-Afrika eseningizimu yeSahara, ingenye yezinto ezibangela ukuthambekela kokufuna usizo ngemithi yendabuko. Izimpawu: Ukulunywa noma ukufafazwa ubuthi bezinyoka ezinobuthi kungabangela izimo eziphuthumayo zezokwelapha ezibucayi. Ukufakwa ubuthi ngezinhlobo ezahlukene zezinyoka kungabangela izimpawu ezahlukahlukene, ezinye ezibucayi kunezinye. Lokhu kwenza ukulungiswa kwezibulala-zinambuzane ezifanele kube yinkinga eqhubekayo. Ukufakwa ubuthi kungabangela ukukhubazeka okunzima okungavimbela ukuphefumula, okwenza ukunakekelwa kwezokwelapha okusheshayo kubaluleke kakhulu.

Ukukhethwa kungenziwa ngabaphathi bezempilo kazwelonke bezwe eliyilungu le-WHO kanye nanoma yimuphi umuntu owake wathola imiklomelo. Emhlanganweni wawo wama-152 ngoJanuwari 2023, iBhodi Eliphethe likhethe abawinile bemiklomelo ka-2023, ngesisekelo seziphakamiso ezenziwe amaqembu okukhetha azinikele ngomklomelo ngamunye. Abawinile abayisikhombisa bakhethwe ukugubha indima yabo eyingqayizivele kanye nomnikelo wabo kwezempilo yomphakathi emazweni abo nasemhlabeni jikelele. Abawinile abahlanu bangabantu ngabanye, futhi abathathu kubo ngabesifazane.

Izinhlelo zokuvimbela ukuhlukunyezwa ezikoleni, ezemfundo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa amakhono okuphila nawomphakathi; izindlela zokwelapha abantu abasengozini enkulu, kanye nezindlela zomphakathi nezenhlalo ezifana nokunciphisa ukufinyelela nokusetshenziswa kabi kotshwala nezibhamu, izindawo ezibucayi kanye namaphoyisa agxile ezinkingeni, ukuthuthukiswa kwamadolobha, kanye nokunciphisa ubuphofu. I-WHO kanye nabalingani bayo banciphisa udlame lwentsha ngezinhlelo ezisiza ekuboneni, ekulinganiseni nasekuphenduleni le nkinga, lezi zihlanganisa: ukuthuthukisa iphakethe lezinhlelo zokuvimbela udlame ezikoleni; ukuqaphela ubukhulu bodlame lwentsha kanye nesidingo sokuvimbela;

Kodwa-ke, idatha etholakalayo ikhombisa ukuthi abantu abayizigidi ezi-4.5 kuya kwezi-5.4 balunywa yizinyoka minyaka yonke. Kulokhu, abantu abayizigidi eziyi-1.8 kuya kwezi-2.7 baba nezifo zomtholampilo kanti abangu-81 000 kuya ku-138 000 babulawa yizinkinga. Amaqembu asengozini enkulu afaka phakathi abasebenzi bezolimo basemaphandleni, abelusi, abadobi, abazingeli, izingane ezisebenzayo, abantu abahlala ezindlini ezakhiwe kabi nalabo abanokufinyelela okulinganiselwe emfundweni nasekunakekelweni kwezempilo. Ukugula nokufa kwenzeka kaningi kubantu abasha futhi izingane zihlupheka kakhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abesifazane babhekana nezingqinamba ezandayo zokufinyelela ekunakekelweni kwezokwelapha kwamanye amasiko futhi abesifazane abakhulelwe basengozini enkulu.

Lokhu kwelashwa kuzoholela ekwelapheni okuphelele kumacala angama-95% kodwa iziguli kufanele ziphinde zihlolwe ngemuva kwamasonto ama-4 zithole imithi elwa namagciwane. Ukubuyekezwa kwemibhalo yomlando kusukela ngawo-1950 kukhombisa ukuthi amazwe nezindawo ezingaphezu kuka-90 zazigcwele i-yaws. Amazwe nezindawo eziyi-14 kuphela kwezingu-90 zinemibiko yakamuva nge-yaws esekelwe ohlelweni lokuqapha olujwayelekile; kodwa-ke, lezi zibalo zingase zibe yisibonakaliso sokuthi lesi sifo sikhona futhi hhayi ubukhulu baso. IGhana, iPapua New Guinea kanye neSolomon Islands zibika amacala angaphezu kuka-10 000 ngonyaka. I-Ecuador neNdiya zibonakala ziphazamise ukudluliselwa.

UMkhandlu ucele ukuthi kwenziwe uhlelo lokusebenza ngokubonisana nabantu bomdabu; ukuthi i-WHO inikeze ukwesekwa kumazwe angamalungu, uma kuceliwe, ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yabantu bomdabu; nokuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwempilo yabantu bomdabu kufakwe ekuthuthukisweni koHlelo Lomsebenzi Jikelele Lwe-WHO Lweshumi Nane. Esinqumweni esifanayo, uMkhandlu Wezempilo unxuse amazwe angamalungu ukuthi, phakathi kweminye imisebenzi, athuthukise ulwazi ngesimo sezempilo sabantu bomdabu, ngemvume yabo yamahhala, yangaphambilini futhi enolwazi; athuthukise, axhase futhi asebenzise izinhlelo zezempilo zikazwelonke, amasu noma ezinye izinyathelo zabantu bomdabu;

UDkt Nakatani uneziqu zobudokotela kanye ne-PhD kwezempilo yomphakathi. UDkt Razia Pendse uzoba yiChef de Cabinet kusukela ngomhlaka-4 Meyi 2023. Kulesi sikhundla uDkt Pendse uzohola iHhovisi loMqondisi-Jikelele, asize ukuqhuba izinto eziza kuqala kanye nezinhlelo zenhlangano, futhi uzoqinisekisa ukuqondanisa ngaphakathi kwethimba lobuholi be-WHO kanye kuwo wonke amazinga amathathu e-WHO. UDkt Pendse ubesebenza njengoMqondisi Wezempilo Yabantu Abanempilo Kakhulu Nezifo Ezingathathelwanayo eHhovisi Lase-WHO Lesifunda saseNingizimu-mpumalanga ye-Asia futhi ngaphambilini wayengummeli we-WHO eSri Lanka. UDkt Pendse uneziqu zobudokotela kanye neziqu ze-master kwezempilo yomphakathi.

Ukukhuthaza ukuheha, ukuqeqesha, ukuqasha kanye nokugcina abantu bomdabu njengabasebenzi bezempilo ngokucabangela ulwazi nemikhuba yendabuko. Idokhumenti ehlobene: A76/A/CONF./1 - Impilo yabantu bomdabu Isinqumo sokuqala sokusheshisa izinyathelo zokuvimbela ukucwilaIzithunywa eMhlanganweni Wezempilo Womhlaba wamashumi ayisikhombisa nesithupha zavumelana ngesinqumo sokusheshisa izinyathelo zokuvimbela ukucwila emhlabeni jikelele. Isinqumo sicela amazwe angamalungu ukuthi ahlole isimo sawo sokucwila kuzwelonke futhi athuthukise futhi asebenzise izinhlelo zokuvimbela ukucwila ezinamasiko amaningi. Ukucwila kubangela ukufa kwabantu abangu-236 000 minyaka yonke.

ukushicilela umbiko oyisisekelo ngasekupheleni kuka-2026 onolwazi mayelana nekhono lamazwe angamalungu lokuphendula izidingo zokuvuselelwa; ukuthuthukisa imigomo nezinkomba zokuhlanganiswa ngempumelelo kwezinsizakalo zokuvuselelwa ngo-2030; ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza ezifanele zinikezwa i-WHO ukusekela amazwe angamalungu ekusebenziseni umhlahlandlela wezobuchwepheshe nezinsiza; nokusekela amazwe angamalungu ekuhlanganiseni ukuvuselelwa kanye nobuchwepheshe bokusiza ohlelweni lwawo lokulungela nokusabela ezimweni eziphuthumayo. UNobhala we-WHO uzobika ngenqubekela phambili ekusetshenzisweni kwalesi sinqumo kuMkhandlu Wezempilo ngo-2026, 2028 no-2030.

Ukugqugquzela ukunakekelwa kwezempilo komhlaba wonke ngokuhlanganisa izinsizakalo ze-T&CM ekunikezelweni kwezinsizakalo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo kanye nokunakekelwa kwezempilo komuntu siqu. Impendulo ye-WHO: Umbiko we-WHO womhlaba wonke ngemithi yendabuko neyokwengeza 2019 wenzelwe ukubhekana nokuntuleka kwedatha ethembekile, ethembekile futhi esemthethweni evela kuMazwe angamalungu emkhakheni we-T&CM. Lo mbiko ubukeza inqubekela phambili yomhlaba wonke ku-T&CM emashumini amabili eminyaka adlule futhi usekelwe eminikelweni evela ku-179 Amazwe angamalungu e-WHO. Inikeza imininingwane ebalulekile kubenzi bezinqubomgomo, ochwepheshe bezempilo kanye nomphakathi ukuze basebenzise umnikelo ongaba khona we-T&CM empilweni nasenhlalakahleni.

Ukubukeza impilo yezocansi: Impilo yezocansi ibalulekile empilweni jikelele nenhlalakahle yabantu ngabanye, imibhangqwana nemindeni, kanye nasekuthuthukisweni kwezenhlalo nezomnotho kwemiphakathi namazwe. Impilo yezocansi, uma ibhekwa ngendlela eqinisekile, idinga indlela enhle nenenhlonipho ngobulili nobudlelwano bobulili, kanye nethuba lokuba nokuhlangenwe nakho kobulili okujabulisayo nokuphephile, ngaphandle kokucindezelwa, ukubandlululwa nodlame. Ikhono lamadoda nabesifazane lokuthola impilo yezocansi nenhlalakahle lincike ekutheni: bathole ulwazi olunzulu, olusezingeni elifanele mayelana nobulili nobulili;

Izimpawu: I-Sepsis iyisimo esiphuthumayo sezokwelapha futhi sidinga ukunakekelwa ngokushesha ukuvimbela izinkinga ezengeziwe noma ukufa.Kungaveza izimpawu nezimpawu ezahlukahlukene zesixwayiso ngezikhathi ezithile, ezinye zazo ezingadala ukungaziwa kahle nezinye izimo.Ukutheleleka kwe-septic kungadala umkhuhlane, kepha futhi kungadala izinga lokushisa eliphansi lomzimba, imilenze ebandayo nokuthuthumela.Kungaba nobunzima bokuphefumula noma ukuphefumula okusheshayo, kanye nokushaya kwenhliziyo okwandisiwe, noma ngokuphambene nokushaya kwenhliziyo okunciphile nomfutho wegazi ophansi.Kungadala ukukhishwa komchamo okuphansi, kanye nesikhumba esinombala oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, esinamabala noma esiphaphathekile ngokungajwayelekile, kanye nesimo sengqondo esiguqukile.

Isifo sofuba sidluliselwa kusuka kumuntu kuya kumuntu ngamaconsi athathelwanayo ngesikhathi sokuxhumana eduze nabantu abanegciwane abanezimpawu zesifo, noma kwezinye izimo ngezingubo zokugqoka nezingubo zokulala ezingcolile. Inenkathi yokufukamela yezinsuku ezingu-7 kuya kwezingu-17 ngemuva kokuchayeka futhi iba nethonya kuphela uma umkhuhlane uqala. Abantu bahlala bethathelwanayo kuze kube yilapho izicubu zokugcina ziwela. Isifo sofuba sasibulala kuze kufike ku-30% wamacala. Ikhadi lokwazisa le-WHO ngesifo sofuba: Isikhathi sokususa sinqunywe yimpikiswano ende futhi eyinkimbinkimbi egxile ekubhujisweni kwemithombo yokugcina esele yegciwane le-variola.

Izimiso Eziqondisayo zifuna ukunakekelwa okuhle kakhulu kwabanikeli nabamukeli. Ukuqapha okusobala kweziphathimandla zezempilo ngemisebenzi yokunikela nokufakelwa nakho kubalulekile ukukhulisa ukwethenjwa komphakathi ohlelweni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, isinqumo sokuba ngumnikeli ngokuvamile sisekelwe ekuqondeni ukuthi umnikelo ekutholakaleni kwemithombo yokufakelwa ungase ngelinye ilanga uzuzise izidingo zezempilo zomndeni womnikeli. Uma sikulungele ukuthola ukufakelwa, uma sidinga okunye, khona-ke kufanele sikulungele ukunikeza izimiso zokuziphatha: IziMiso Eziqondisayo ze-WHO zokufakelwa kwamangqamuzana, izicubu nezitho zomuntu

Kunezinyathelo ezimbili eziyinhloko zokuvimbela i-sepsis: Ukuvimbela ukudluliselwa kwamagciwane nokutheleleka Ukuvimbela ukutheleleka okuguqukela ku-sepsis Ngaphakathi emphakathini, ukuvimbela i-sepsis kusizwa ngokusebenzisa izindlela zokuhlanzeka eziphumelelayo, ukuthuthukisa ukuhlanzeka kanye nekhwalithi yamanzi nokutholakala, ukuhlinzeka ngokufinyelela emithini yokugoma, ikakhulukazi kulabo abasengozini enkulu, kanye nokudla okufanele, kufaka phakathi ukuncelisa izingane ezisanda kuzalwa. Ukuvimbela ezikhungweni zokunakekelwa kwezempilo kuncike ezinhlelweni zokuvimbela nokulawula ukutheleleka (IPC), izindlela zokuhlanzeka eziphumelelayo, kanye nemishini ehlanzekile, esebenza kahle.

Ukubeletha ngaphambi kwesikhathi manje sekuyimbangela ehamba phambili yokufa kwezingane, okubangela ukufa kwezingane ezingaphezu kweyodwa kwezinhlanu ngaphambi kokuba zifinyelele eminyakeni emihlanu. Abasindile ngaphambi kwesikhathi bangabhekana nemiphumela yempilo yempilo yabo yonke, kanye namathuba okukhubazeka nokubambezeleka kokukhula. Izikhala zokusinda ngokwezifunda, imali engenayo, uhlanga Umbiko osanda kwenziwa ngo-2012 ngale ndaba unikeza umbono ophelele ngokwanda kokubeletha ngaphambi kwesikhathi kanye nomthelela wako omkhulu kwabesifazane, imindeni, imiphakathi kanye nezomnotho. Ngokuvamile, lapho izingane zizalwa khona kunquma ukuthi ziyasinda yini.

I-WHO inxusa ohulumeni ukuba bayeke ukuxhasa izitshalo zikagwayi ezisongela impilo Ngosuku Lomhlaba Wonke Lokungabikho Kokubhema, i-WHO inxusa ohulumeni ukuba bayeke ukuxhasa ukulima ugwayi futhi basekele izitshalo ezizinzile ezingondla izigidi. "Ugwayi uyimbangela yokufa kwezigidi ezingu-8 ngonyaka, nokho ohulumeni emhlabeni wonke basebenzisa izigidi zokuxhasa amapulazi kagwayi", kusho uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, uMqondisi-Jikelele we-WHO. "Ngokukhetha ukutshala ukudla esikhundleni sikagwayi, sibeka impilo phambili, silondoloze imvelo, futhi siqinise ukuphepha kokudla kwabo bonke". Abantu abangaphezu kwezigidi ezingu-300 emhlabeni wonke babhekene nokuntuleka kokudla okuphuthumayo.

Isibonelo, ukungcoliswa komoya kulinganiselwa ukuthi kunomthelela ekuzalweni kwezingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka engu-6 minyaka yonke. Cishe ingane eyodwa kweziyishumi ezizalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi izalwa emazweni ayishumi abuthakathaka kakhulu athintwe yizinhlekelele zokusiza abantu, ngokusho kokuhlaziywa okusha kulo mbiko. Izingozi zempilo kamama, njengokukhulelwa kwentsha kanye ne-pre-eclampsia, zihlobene kakhulu nokuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Lokhu kugcizelela isidingo sokuqinisekisa ukufinyelela kwezinsizakalo zezempilo yezocansi nezokuzala, kufaka phakathi ukuhlela umndeni okusebenzayo, nokunakekelwa kwekhwalithi ephezulu ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa kanye nesikhathi sokuzalwa. I-Agenda yesenzo: utshalomali olwengeziwe lwamazwe kanye nokuzibandakanya okuholwa ngabazali

Kunezinhlobo ezi-3 zemijikelezo yokudluliswa: I-Sylvatic (noma i-jungle) yellow fever isakazeka lapho izinkawu zilunywa omiyane basendle abadlulisela igciwane kwezinye izinkawu nakubantu. I-Intermediate yellow fever isakazeka lapho omiyane abangabomndeni basendlini bethelela kokubili izinkawu nabantu. Lolu uhlobo oluvame kakhulu lokuqubuka e-Afrika. I-yellow fever yasemadolobheni ingadala izifo ezinkulu lapho abantu abathelelekile bethula igciwane ezindaweni ezinabantu abaningi kakhulu kanye nenani elikhulu lezinyosi futhi lapho abantu benokuzivikela okuncane. Ngezikhathi ezithile, abahambi abathelelekile bathumele amacala emazweni angenawo umkhuhlane ophuzi.

Labo abangenwe yilesi sifo kodwa abangaguli (okwamanje) abakwazi ukusidlulisela kwabanye. Abantu abangenwe yileli gciwane le-TB banengozi engu-5 kuya ku-10% yokugula yi-TB. Labo abanamasosha omzimba abuthakathaka, njengabantu abaphila ne-HIV, abangondlekile noma abanesifo sikashukela, noma abantu abasebenzisa ugwayi, banengozi enkulu yokugula. Izimpawu: Izimpawu ezivamile zesifo se-TB zihlanganisa: Ukukhwehlela isikhathi eside, ubuhlungu esifubeni, ubuthakathaka noma ukukhathala, ukwehla kwesisindo, umkhuhlane, ukujuluka ebusuku. Ngokuvamile, lezi zimpawu ziyoba mnene izinyanga eziningi, ngaleyo ndlela ziholele ekubambezelweni kokufuna ukunakekelwa futhi zikhulise ingozi yokusabalalisa lesi sifo kwabanye.

Ubumpofu, izimo eziphansi zezenhlalo nezomnotho kanye nokuhlanzeka komuntu siqu okungalungile kwenza kube lula ukusabalala kwe-yaws. Nakuba kunamacala angaphezu kuka-80 000 e-yaws unyaka ngamunye, ochwepheshe bakholelwa ukuthi lesi sifo singalawulwa futhi ekugcineni siqedwe ngenxa yezizathu eziningana. Okokuqala, senzeka kuphela kubantu, hhayi ezilwaneni, okwenza ukulawula kube lula kakhulu. I-Tetanus Overview: I-Tetanus yisifo esiyingozi esitholakala ngokuchayeka kuma-spores ebhaktheriya, i-Clostridium tetani, ehlala enhlabathini, amathe, uthuli nomquba. Amabhaktheriya angangena emzimbeni ngokulimala okujulile, amanxeba noma ukushiswa okuthinta uhlelo lwezinzwa. Ukutheleleka kuholela ekunciphiseni kwemisipha ebuhlungu, ikakhulukazi imisipha yomhlathi nentamo, futhi kuvame ukubizwa ngokuthi yi-lockjaw. Abantu bayo yonke iminyaka bangathola i-tetanus kodwa lesi sifo sivame kakhulu futhi sinzima ezinganeni ezisanda kuzalwa nakomama bazo lapho umama engavikelekile ku-tetanus ngomuthi wokugoma, i-tetanus toxoid.

Kubuye kulimaze impilo yezomnotho neyenhlalo yemindeni yabo, imiphakathi kanye namazwe. Nakuba abanye besifazane besengozini enkulu kunabanye, udlame lungenzeka kunoma yimuphi owesifazane, kunoma yiliphi izwe - kungakhathalekile isiko, inkolo noma isimo sezomnotho. Ukungalingani ngokobulili okubandakanya izindinganiso ezilimazayo zobulili kuyizimbangela eziyinhloko zodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane. Udlame lungathinta kabi impilo yabesifazane ngokomzimba, ngokwengqondo, ngokocansi nangokuzala. Kuhlotshaniswa nengozi eyengeziwe yokulimala, ukucindezeleka, ukuphazamiseka kokukhathazeka, ukukhulelwa okungahleliwe, izifo ezithathelwana ngocansi, i-HIV nezinye izinkinga eziningi zempilo.

Ukukhanya kwe-Ultraviolet Overview: Ukukhanya kwe-Ultraviolet (UV) kuhlanganisa ububanzi bamaza angu-100400 nm, okuyisilinganiso esiphakeme nobude bamaza obuphansi kunokukhanya okubonakalayo.Ukukhanya kwe-UV kuvela ngokwemvelo elangeni, kepha futhi kungadalwa yimithombo yokufakelwa esetshenziswa embonini, kwezentengiselwano nakwezokungcebeleka.Isifunda se-UV sihlanganisa ububanzi bamaza angu-100-400 nm futhi sihlukaniswe ngamabhande amathathu: i-UVA (315-400 nm) i-UVB (280-315 nm) i-UVC (100-280 nm). Njengoba ukukhanya kwelanga kudlula emkhathini, konke ukukhanya kwe-UVC kanye cishe ne-90% ye-UVB kufakwa yi-ozone, umhwamuko wamanzi, i-oxygen kanye ne-carbon dioxide.

Ezimweni ezingavamile, ukutheleleka kungabangelwa ukudla ubisi olungaphekiwe oluvela ezimbuzini, ezimvwini noma ezinkomeni ezinegciwane. Abantu bangathintana namagciwane ngesikhathi benza imisebenzi yangaphandle ezindaweni ezinamahlathi kuze kufike endaweni ephakeme ngamamitha angaba ngu-2000. Akukho ukudluliselwa okuqondile komuntu nomuntu. Izimpawu: Izifo eziningi azibonisi zimpawu. Uma kunesifo somtholampilo, isikhathi sokufukamela se-encephalitis ethwalwa ngamagciwane sihlala izinsuku ezingama-2-28 (ngokuvamile izinsuku eziyi-7-14) futhi kulandelwa izinsuku eziyi-1-8 zezimpawu ezivamile ezibandayo, njengokukhathala, ikhanda kanye nokungaphatheki kahle, ngokuvamile kuhlangene nomkhuhlane ongu-≥38 °C.

Kodwa-ke, kusekusheshe kakhulu ukunikeza impendulo ecacile ngomthelela wesikhathi eside wokusetshenziswa kwe-HTP kanye / noma i-e-cigarette. Umthelela: Kulinganiselwa ukuthi abantu abayizigidi eziyizinkulungwane eziyi-1.3 emhlabeni wonke basebenzisa imikhiqizo kagwayi, i-80% yabo isezindaweni ezinengeniso ephansi naphakathi. Ukusetshenziswa kukagwayi kunomthelela ebuphofini ngokudlulisa imali esetshenziswa emakhaya kusuka ezidingweni eziyisisekelo, njengokudla nendawo yokuhlala, kuya kutshwala. Lokhu kuziphatha kokusebenzisa imali kunzima ukukunqanda ngoba ugwayi ulutha kakhulu. Futhi kubangela ukufa ngaphambi kwesikhathi nokukhubazeka kwabantu abadala abaneminyaka yokukhiqiza emakhaya ngaleyo ndlela kuholele ekunciphiseni imali engenayo yasekhaya kanye nokwenyuka kwezindleko zokunakekelwa kwezempilo.

Ukulungela okuphumelelayo kuncike ekuhleleni okuqinile nasekusebenzeni okuhlanganisiwe. Ukuzibophezela ngokuhlanganyela ezenzweni ezilandelayo kuzobona inqubekela phambili etholwe ngoDisemba 2025 njengoba kuzochazwa ohlelweni lokuqapha lokulungela nokumelana nezinsongo ezivelayo (PRET): Hlela kabusha izinhlelo zokulungela eziqinisekisa izenzo eziza kuqala futhi ezicabangele izifundo ezivela ezenzakalweni ezedlule. Ukuqaphela ubungozi obubangelwa amagciwane okuphefumula, ukuhlela ubhubhane lwamagciwane okuphefumula ngokusekelwe ezihlokweni ezikhonjwe ku-PRET Module #1: Ukuhlela ubhubhane lwamagciwane okuphefumula kuyinto ebaluleke kakhulu

Ukubhekelelwa kwezempilo jikelele Okubanzi: Ukubhekelelwa kwezempilo jikelele (UHC) kusho ukuthi bonke abantu banokufinyelela kuzo zonke izinsizakalo zezempilo ezisezingeni eliphezulu abazidingayo, lapho futhi lapho bezidinga khona, ngaphandle kobunzima bezezimali. Ihlanganisa lonke uhlangothi lwezinsizakalo zezempilo ezibalulekile, kusukela ekuthuthukiseni impilo kuya ekuvimbeleni, ekwelapheni, ekuvuseleleni nasekunakekeleni okudambisa. Ukuze kufezwe lesi sithembiso, amazwe adinga ukuba nezinhlelo zezempilo eziqinile, ezisebenza kahle futhi ezilinganayo ezisekelwe emiphakathini abayisebenzelayo. Ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo (PHC) kuyindlela ephumelela kakhulu futhi engabizi kakhulu yokufika lapho.

Imisebe ye-UVA ayithinteki kangako umkhathi. Ngakho-ke, imisebe ye-UV efinyelela ebusweni bomhlaba iqukethe kakhulu i-UVA enengxenye encane ye-UVB. Inani lemisebe ye-UV evela elangeni elishaya ebusweni bomhlaba lincike ezintweni eziningana, kufaka phakathi ukuphakama kwelanga esibhakabhakeni, ububanzi, ukumbozwa kwamafu, ukuphakama, ubukhulu besendlalelo se-ozone nokubonakaliswa komhlaba. Ukuncishiswa kwesendlalelo se-ozone ngenxa yokungcola okwenziwe ngumuntu kwandisa inani le-UVA ne-UVB elifinyelela ebusweni. Lokhu kungathinta impilo yabantu, izilwane, izinto zasolwandle kanye nezitshalo.

Ukuthuthukiswa kwamadolobha kungenye yezindlela ezihamba phambili zomhlaba wonke zekhulu lama-21 ezinomthelela omkhulu empilweni. Abantu abangaphezu kuka-55% emhlabeni bahlala ezindaweni ezisemadolobheni - isilinganiso okulindeleke ukuthi sikhuphuke sibe ngu-68% ngo-2050. Njengoba ukukhula kwamadolobha okuzayo kuzokwenzeka emazweni asathuthuka, umhlaba namuhla unethuba eliyingqayizivele lokuqondisa ukuthuthukiswa kwamadolobha nezinye izitayela ezinkulu zentuthuko yasemadolobheni ngendlela evikela futhi ithuthukise impilo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi ngoba impilo nenhlalakahle yezakhamizi mhlawumbe iyimpahla ebaluleke kakhulu yedolobha.
