Kasancewa wani ɓangare na Shirin Gaggawa na Lafiya na WHO, WHO Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence (WHO Pandemic Hub), yana sauƙaƙe haɗin gwiwar duniya na abokan haɗin gwiwa daga sassa da yawa waɗanda ke tallafawa ƙasashe da masu ruwa da tsaki don magance haɗarin annoba da annoba a nan gaba tare da ingantaccen damar samun bayanai, ingantattun ƙwarewar nazari, da ingantattun kayan aiki da fahimta don yanke shawara. Tare da tallafi daga Gwamnatin Tarayyar Jamus, an kafa WHO Pandemic Hub a watan Satumbar 2021 a Berlin, don mayar da martani ga cutar COVID-19, wanda ya nuna rauni a duniya a yadda ƙasashe ke ganowa, sa ido da sarrafa barazanar lafiyar jama'a. WHO Pandemic Hub yana aiki tare da ƙasashe membobin kungiyar da ofisoshin yanki da na ƙasa na WHO don ƙarfafa ƙarfin musayar bayanan su da kuma ba abokan hulɗa daga ko'ina cikin duniya damar yin aiki tare da haɗin gwiwa don ƙirƙirar kayan aiki don tattara da nazarin bayanai don sa ido da gaggawa. Tare da kasancewa a cikin ƙasashe sama da 150, ofisoshin yanki shida, da hedkwatarsa ta Geneva, WHO's reach yana ba mu damar magance annoba, annoba da haɗarin lafiyar jama'a tare da gaggawa da himma a duk faɗin duniya. Ta hanyar haɗa ayyukan gida, na yanki, da na duniya, WHO Pandemic Hub yana haɓaka yanayin haɗin gwiwa ga masu kirkire-kirkire, masana kimiyya da masana daga kowane fanni, yana ba mu damar amfani da haɓaka fasaha da kuma kafa ayyukanmu a cikin bukatun masu ruwa da tsaki a duniya.

A ƙarshen 2022, yawancin ƙasashe sun ba da rahoton alamun ɓangare na dawo da sabis, gami da sabis don jima'i, haifuwa, uwa, jariri, yara da matasa; abinci mai gina jiki; rigakafi; cututtukan da ke yaduwa (ciki har da zazzabin cizon sauro, HIV, TB, da sauran cututtukan da ake ɗauka ta hanyar jima'i); cututtukan da ba a lura da su ba; cututtukan da ba a iya yaduwa ba; kula da cututtukan ƙwaƙwalwa, jijiyoyin jiki da amfani da kwayoyi; kula da tsofaffi; da kuma kulawa ta gargajiya da / ko ƙarin kulawa. Yawan ƙasashe da ke ba da rahoton katsewa ga tsarin samar da kayayyaki na ƙasa ya ragu daga kusan rabin (29 na ƙasashe 59 da suka amsa) zuwa kusan kashi ɗaya cikin huɗu (18 na ƙasashe 66 da suka amsa) a cikin shekarar da ta gabata. Duk da alamun farfadowa, katsewar sabis na ci gaba a duk ƙasashe a duk yankuna da matakan samun kuɗi, kuma a yawancin wuraren bayar da sabis da wuraren bincike. Kasashe kuma suna magance ƙaruwar jinkirin sabis - galibi a cikin sabis don bincike, ganewar asali da maganin cututtukan da ba a iya yaduwa ba - wanda zai iya haifar da mummunan sakamako na rashin lafiya kamar yadda mutane ke jinkirta samun damar kulawa a kan lokaci. Maido da isasshen sabis na kiwon lafiya yana da mahimmanci saboda katsewa - gami da sabis don inganta kiwon lafiya, rigakafin cututtuka, ganewar asali, magani, gyarawa da kuma rage - na iya samun mummunan sakamako na rashin lafiya a matakin jama'a da na mutum fiye da cutar kanta, musamman a tsakanin mutane masu rauni.

Waɗannan sun haɗa da aiwatar da hanyoyin maganin nesa, inganta kulawa ta gida ko ayyukan kula da kai, hanyoyin ƙarfafa wadatar ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya, iyawa da hanyoyin tallafi, sabbin abubuwa a cikin sayen da isar da magunguna da kayayyaki, ƙarin sadarwa na yau da kullun na al'umma, da haɗin gwiwa tare da masu samar da kamfanoni masu zaman kansu. Kashi uku cikin huɗu na ƙasashe sun ba da rahoton ƙarin rarraba kuɗi don dawo da tsarin tsawon lokaci, juriya da shiri. Kasashe sun nuna buƙatar tallafin WHO don magance sauran ƙalubalen da ke cikin yanayin COVID-19 da bayan haka, galibi suna da alaƙa da ƙarfafa ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya, gina ƙarfin sa ido na sabis na kiwon lafiya, tsara samfuran kulawa na farko - masu mai da hankali, gudanarwa, manufofi da tsare-tsare da tsare-tsaren kuɗi. Lura ga editoci: A zagaye na huɗu na binciken bugun jini na duniya na WHO, an gayyaci ƙasashe 222, yankuna da yankuna don amsa daidaitaccen binciken yanar gizo tsakanin Nuwamba 2022 da Janairu 2023. Binciken na huɗu ya biyo bayan binciken WHO na 2020 da 2021 na baya: Zagaye na 1 (Mayu-Satumba 2020), Zagaye na 2 (Janairu-Maris 2021), da Zagaye na 3 (Nuwamba-Disamba 2021) wanda ya nuna yadda annobar ke shafar ci gaba da mahimman ayyukan kiwon lafiya da yadda ƙasashe ke ɗaukar mataki.

Hadaddiyar Daular Larabawa ta mai da hankali ne musamman kan samar da tallafi ga kungiyoyin da suka fi fama da matsalar a Sudan, musamman marasa lafiya, yara, tsofaffi, da mata wadanda ke cikin hadari daga rikicin da ke gudana - kuma wadannan jirage na agaji za su magance matsalolin da suka fi dacewa a fannin kiwon lafiya da samar da abinci. Darajojin jin kai na Hadaddiyar Daular Larabawa sun nuna cewa ta tabbatar da cewa ta ci gaba da sadarwa ga duniya game da jajircewarta wajen karfafa zaman lafiya, tsaro da kwanciyar hankali, ba kawai a yankin ba, har ma a duk duniya, yayin da take tare da abokan huldarta da al'ummar kasa, kasar na ci gaba da taimakawa mutanen Sudan a lokutan rikici. Kayayyakin kiwon lafiya sun hada da isassun kayan aikin jinya, kayan aikin tiyata na gaggawa, da magunguna masu mahimmanci don kaiwa kai tsaye ga mutane 165,000 da ke cikin matsananciyar bukatar taimakon jin kai. Cibiyoyin kiwon lafiya a duk fadin kasar sun ba da rahoton cewa sun rasa kayan kiwon lafiya na asali kuma ba za a iya samun shagunan likitanci na kasa ba saboda yanayin tsaro. Daga cikin sauran tallafi, WHO tana tura masu ba da agajin gaggawa guda biyu da ke tafiya tare da jigilar kaya don tabbatar da cewa an rarraba wadannan kayayyaki nan da nan ga manyan cibiyoyin kiwon lafiya 13 don tallafawa ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya da kuma ba da kulawa ga wadanda ke cikin bukata.

Yanzu, maimakon a ga lafiyar kowa a matsayin mai hidimar ci gaban tattalin arziki, muna da taswirar hanya don tsara ayyukan tattalin arziki ta hanyar da za ta ba mu damar cimma burin ganin dukkan mutane suna da damar samun muhimman ayyukan kiwon lafiya cikin sauri tare da kyakkyawan sakamako, "in ji Dokta Tedros. "A cikin shekaru biyu da suka gabata, Majalisar WHO kan Tattalin Arzikin Kiwon Lafiya ga Kowa ta yi aiki don tsara sabon labarin tattalin arziki - wanda zai canza kudade don kiwon lafiya daga kashe kuɗi zuwa saka hannun jari, "in ji Shugaban Majalisar, Farfesa Mariana Mazzucato. "Mun bincika canje-canjen da ake buƙata - gami da tsarin haƙƙin mallaka, haɗin gwiwar jama'a da masu zaman kansu, da kasafin kuɗi - don tsara tattalin arzikin da ke ba da Kiwon Lafiya ga Kowa. A cikin rahotonmu na ƙarshe, muna kira ga sabuwar manufar tattalin arziki wacce ba game da gyaran kasuwa ba amma game da ingantaccen haɗin gwiwa da haɗin gwiwa don tsara kasuwanni waɗanda ke ba da fifiko ga lafiyar ɗan adam da duniya. "An ƙaddamar da rahoton a yau tare da Majalisar Lafiya ta Duniya ta 76, rahoton, mai taken Kiwon Lafiya ga Kowa: Canza tattalin arziki don isar da abin da ke da mahimmanci (https://www.who.int/groups/who-council-on-the-economics-of-health-for-all), yana ba da sabon tsarin da aka gina akan ginshiƙai huɗu da ke sama, tare da takamaiman shawarwari a ƙarƙashin kowannensu - daga aikin Majalisar na baya.

Shirin INTERSUN haɗin gwiwa ne tsakanin WHO, Shirin Muhalli na Majalisar Dinkin Duniya, Hukumar Kula da Yanayi ta Duniya, Hukumar Kula da Binciken Ciwon daji ta Duniya da Hukumar Kula da Kariya ta Wutar Lantarki ta Duniya. Yana inganta da kimanta bincike kan tasirin lafiyar UV, da haɓaka martani mai dacewa ta hanyar jagorori, shawarwari da yada bayanai. Manufofin shirin sun haɗa da samar da shawarwari masu amfani da inganci game da tasirin lafiya da muhalli na haɗuwa da UV, don ƙarfafa ƙasashe su ɗauki mataki don rage haɗarin lafiyar da UV ke haifarwa da kuma samar da jagora ga hukumomin ƙasa game da shirye-shiryen wayar da kan jama'a game da hasken rana. Don wannan, shirin yana haɗin gwiwa tare da masana da hukumomin ƙwararru don aiwatar da mahimman ayyukan bincike, gano da ƙididdige haɗarin lafiya daga hasken UV, haɓaka tabbataccen hasashe game da sakamakon lafiya da muhalli na canje-canje a cikin haɗuwa da UV tare da lalacewar ozone na stratospheric, da haɓaka hanyoyin da suka dace don sa ido kan canjin tasirin lafiyar UV a tsawon lokaci. Shirin yana ba da kayan aiki da jagororin da suka shafi ƙididdigar UV, kariya daga rana ga yara, gadon rana na wucin gadi, yawon shakatawa da lafiyar aiki.

Wannan kokarin da sauran shirye-shiryen samar da kayayyaki na gida na baya-bayan nan na bukatar dabarun bunkasa ma'aikata don daukar ma'aikata, inganta kwarewarsu da kuma rike ma'aikatan da ke aiki a wadannan cibiyoyin, tare da kwarewa ta musamman da ake bukata a fannin samar da kwayoyin halitta. Don magance wannan gibin, WHO da Jamhuriyar Koriya sun shiga cikin hadin gwiwa na tsawon shekara guda kuma yanzu suna tsara alkawurran su na kafa cibiyar horarwa ta duniya a fannin samar da kwayoyin halitta. "Muna farin cikin sanya hannu kan wannan yarjejeniyar fahimtar juna don daukaka kawancenmu zuwa mataki na gaba da kuma hada kai wajen samar da tsarin horo mai zurfi. Muna fatan wannan cibiyar horarwa ta duniya za ta taimaka wajen gina kwararrun ma'aikata da kuma tabbatar da ingancin kayayyakin kiwon lafiya a duniya", in ji Dokta Yukiko Nakatani, Mataimakin Darakta Janar na WHO, Samun Magunguna da Kayayyakin Kiwon Lafiya. Gwamnatin Jamhuriyar Koriya tana ba da manyan cibiyoyin horarwa na kasa da shirye-shirye da suka shafi dukkanin fannin samar da kwayoyin halitta kuma tana fadada ayyukanta don karbar karin ma'aikata daga wasu kasashe tare da gina Cibiyar Ilimin Kwayoyin Halitta ta Duniya da za a kaddamar a shekarar 2025.

Majalisar ta kafa MSM a shekarar 2012 don magance kayayyakin kiwon lafiya marasa inganci da na jabu daga mahangar kiwon lafiyar jama'a kuma ta hanyar gaskiya da kuma hada kai. Manufar MSM ita ce kare lafiyar jama'a da inganta samun kayayyakin kiwon lafiya masu araha, masu aminci, masu inganci da inganci. Bayan lura da abubuwan da suka faru kwanan nan na gurbataccen magunguna da aka samu a kasuwanni daban-daban da kuma mutuwar da za a iya kaucewa, kasashe membobin sun jaddada goyon bayan da ake bukata don inganta karfin su na hana, ganowa da kuma mayar da martani ga kayayyakin kiwon lafiya marasa inganci da na jabu ta hanyar samun damar amfani da fasahohin da suka dace, gami da wuraren gwaji na dakin gwaje-gwaje, tare da inganta kulawa kan kasuwanni marasa tsari da tallace-tallace, da kuma sayar da kayayyakin kiwon lafiya ta yanar gizo. Kasashe membobin sun yi kira da a rungumi da aiwatar da fasahohin bin diddigin don kula da kasuwa da sa ido, da kuma bukatar hadin gwiwa ta hanyar da ta dace ta abokan hulda na gida da na duniya kamar tilasta bin doka da hukumomin kwastam. An karfafa kasashe membobin da su daidaita da yarjejeniyoyin da ke da nufin inganta dokoki da sanya takunkumi mai tsauri ga cinikin da ba daidai ba a cikin kayayyakin kiwon lafiya marasa inganci da na jabu.

Rahoton taron Kungiyar Bayar da Shawarwari ta WHO kan Sinadarin rigakafin COVID-19 (TAG-CO-VAC) wanda aka gudanar a ranar 16-17 ga Maris 2023 A watan Yunin 2022, TAG-CO-VAC ta wallafa wata sanarwa ta wucin gadi da ke nuna cewa alluran rigakafin da ke tushen ƙwayar cuta na ci gaba da ba da babban matakin kariya daga cututtuka masu tsanani da duk nau'ikan SARS-CoV-2 na damuwa (VOCs) ke haifarwa, gami da Omicron. Koyaya, saboda nisan antigenic da rashin tabbas na ci gaba da juyin halittar ƙwayar cuta, TAG-CO-VAC ta yarda cewa mai yiwuwa ne ingancin alluran rigakafin da ke tushen ƙwayar cuta na ci gaba da raguwa a tsawon lokaci. Saboda haka, TAG-CO-VAC ta shawarci masana'antun allurar rigakafi da hukumomin da ke da iko da suyi la'akari da sabunta abun da ke cikin allurar rigakafin ta hanyar haɗa Omicron, kamar yadda nau'in SARS-CoV-2 ya fi bambanta har zuwa yanzu, don gudanarwa azaman ƙarin allurar rigakafi. Masana'antun allurar rigakafi da yawa sun haɓaka alluran rigakafin COVID-19 tare da sabunta abun da ke cikin allurar rigakafi; wannan ya haɗa da alluran mRNA masu nau'i biyu da ke ƙunshe da tsohuwar layin Omicron, ban da ƙwayar cuta ta index (watau index virus + BA.1 ko BA.4/5), waɗanda hukumomin da ke da iko suka ba da izini don amfani da gaggawa.

Taron Abokan Hulɗa na Shirin Cututtukan NTD na Duniya, 12-13 Yuni 2023 Wakilan al'ummar NTD na duniya za su taru a Geneva mako mai zuwa don halartar Taron Abokan Hulɗa na Shirin Cututtukan NTD na Duniya, wanda ke faruwa a zauren hedkwatar a ranar 12-13 Yuni 2023. Manufofin taron shine a sake nazarin ci gaban da aka samu a kan taswirar hanyar WHO don cututtukan NTD da aka yi watsi da su 2021-2030 da kuma samar da kyakkyawar fahimta game da ayyukan NTD na duniya daga hangen nesa na musamman da na tsaka-tsaki, da kuma shiga cikin tattaunawa mai zurfi game da hangen nesa don Shirin NTD guda ɗaya da ke isar da shirin NTD guda ɗaya. Yayin da WHO ta kira taron abokan hulɗa na NTD na duniya a 2007 da 2017, wannan taron na uku mai zuwa shine na farko tun lokacin da aka ƙaddamar da taswirar hanya a watan Janairun 2021. Taswirar NTD na cututtukan NTD na 2021-2030 tsari ne mai fa'ida wanda ke nuna manufofi, hanyoyin daidaitawa tare da Manufofin Ci Gaban Dorewa da sauran ajandun duniya da kuma kira ga sauye-sauye na dabarun NTD tare da manufar kawo ƙarshen annobar cututtukan NTD ta 2030.

Ma'aikatan kashe gobara da ma'aikatan ba da agajin gaggawa suma suna shan wahala sosai daga rauni, ƙonewa da shan hayaki, musamman a wurare masu yawa. Ana buƙatar ƙarin bincike na fannoni daban-daban don fahimtar tasirin lafiyar da ke ɓoye da na dogon lokaci na haɗarin wutar daji a kan mutanen da ke cikin haɗari (yara, tsofaffi, masu juna biyu, marasa lafiya na yau da kullun), musamman ga yankunan da ke fuskantar maimaitawa da kuma maimaitawa ga waɗannan abubuwan da ke faruwa na wutar daji. Amsar WHO: Za a iya rage girman farashin jiki da na ɗan adam daga gobarar daji idan an aiwatar da isassun matakan rigakafin gaggawa, shiri, amsawa da farfadowa a cikin hanyar da ta dace da kuma dacewa. Yin aiki tare da ƙasashe membobin, WHO na taimakawa wajen gina tsarin kiwon lafiya mai ƙarfi da mai himma wanda zai iya hango buƙatu da ƙalubale yayin gaggawa, don mu sami damar rage haɗari da amsawa yadda ya kamata lokacin da ake buƙata. WHO tana aiki tare da abokan hulɗa wajen shiryawa, rigakafi, ganowa, amsawa da farfadowa daga gaggawa da bala'i, gami da haɗarin muhalli, kamar aiwatar da tsarin gargadi na farko da bayar da shawarwari game da lafiya da ingancin iska;

Yana ba da shirye-shirye da ayyuka da yawa waɗanda ke haɓaka inganta lafiyar tsofaffi, tun daga ingantaccen fahimtar abubuwan da ke haifar da rashin lafiya da mutuwa ta hanyar sa ido na ƙasa don cututtukan da ba a iya yaduwa ba, bincike, rajistar mutuwa da bincike, zuwa shirye-shiryen da aka tsara don haɓaka ilimin kiwon lafiya da manufofin da ke da hujja. Ayyukan sun haɗa da kayan aiki na musamman ga tsofaffi, haɓaka ƙarfin ma'aikatan kulawa na farko 2000, makon tallafawa kiwon lafiya da aka keɓe ga tsofaffi, da kuma wani sabon shiri don inganta lafiyar hankali da fahimta na fiye da rabin miliyan tsofaffi a birane da yankunan karkara. Dr Abla Mehio Sibai Farfesa ce a fannin ilimin cututtuka da Dekan na Kwalejin Kimiyyar Kiwon Lafiya a Jami'ar Amurka ta Beirut a Lebanon. Ta ba da babbar gudummawa ga lafiyar tsofaffi a Lebanon da yankin, haɓaka cikakkiyar hanya don inganta tsufa mai kyau. Ta jagoranci sabon shiri na shigar da kusan tsofaffi 600 kowace shekara a Jami'ar Tsofaffi a Jami'ar Amurka ta Beirut, ban da horar da ƙwararrun likitocin kiwon lafiya.

Sanarwar bikin cika shekaru 50 na HRP: Sweden da United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland Don kama ruhun Kwamitin Manufofi da Hadin Kai (PCC) da ke bikin cika shekaru 50 na HRP da nasarorin da ya samu, Sweden da United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland sun karanta wannan sanarwa ta godiya da taya murna a taron HRP PCC karo na 36. Al'ummarmu ta ga ci gaba a fannin kimiyya da fasaha fiye da dukkan al'ummomin da suka gabata tare da shaida sauye-sauye da dama na ilimi, fasaha, kiwon lafiya da zamantakewa wanda juyin juya halin hana haihuwa ya jagoranta kuma ya biyo bayan ci gaba a fannin kiwon lafiya, kirkire-kirkire da kuma daidaito tsakanin maza da mata. Duk da haka, akwai kalubale masu yawa a fannin SRHR, kuma, ana iya cewa, wasu ci gaba sun sake yin tambaya a yau. Muna taya ma'aikatan HRP, abokan hulda da magoya baya murna kan nasarorin da suka samu har zuwa yau kuma mun amince da gagarumin ci gaban da aka samu a cikin rabin karni wajen samar da hujjojin da ke goyon bayan cikakkiyar dama da daidaito ga lafiyar jima'i da haihuwa.

An amince da kudurin farko kan kimiyyar halayya don inganta kiwon lafiya A yau Kasashen Membobin sun amince da kudurin kimiyyar halayya don inganta kiwon lafiya tare da kasashe membobin da ke nuna babban yarjejeniya game da buƙatar haɗa ka'idar kimiyyar halayya, hanyoyi da hanyoyin a cikin batutuwan kiwon lafiya da ayyukan kiwon lafiyar jama'a. Kudurin ya bukaci kasashe membobin da su amince da rawar da kimiyyar halayya ke takawa wajen cimma kyakkyawan sakamako na kiwon lafiya, don gano damar da za a ƙara amfani da ita, da kuma kafa ayyuka da rukunoni don samarwa da fassara shaidu don sanar da manufofi da shirye-shirye. Hakanan ya nemi Darakta Janar da ya haɗa da amfani da kimiyyar halayya a cikin ƙungiyar kuma ya ba da tallafi ga kasashe membobin ta hanyar haɓaka jagora da samar da taimakon fasaha. Kasashe membobin sun amince da nasarar da aka samu na Binciken Kimiyyar Halayya don Inganta Kiwon Lafiya wanda sakatariyar ke jagoranta, suna taya Malaysia murna, mai daukar nauyin kudurin, da sauran ƙasashe 19 da suka shiga a matsayin masu tallafawa, kuma sun gode wa Darakta Janar don rahoton.

A matsayin wani ɓangare na ƙoƙarin ƙarfafa tsarin duniya don shirye-shiryen gaggawa na kiwon lafiya, amsawa, da juriya UAE, WHO, da abokan hulɗa suna aiki hannu da hannu don isar da kayayyaki don isa ga mafi rauni a duniya a lokacin da suke da matukar buƙata. A nasa bangaren, Dr Ahmed Al-Mandhari, Daraktan Yankin WHO na Gabashin Bahar Rum, ya ce, "Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya na ci gaba da haɗin gwiwa tare da hukumomin kiwon lafiya na Sudan don isar da kayayyakin kiwon lafiya masu mahimmanci ta duk hanyoyin da ake da su. Saboda rikici, asibitoci, kantin magani da cibiyoyin kula da lafiya na farko sun yi tanadi na magunguna masu mahimmanci, masu ceton rai. Zuwan ƙarin tan 30 na kayan aikin rauni da tiyata na gaggawa da kuma magunguna masu mahimmanci zai ba WHO damar tallafawa manyan cibiyoyin kiwon lafiya 13 da sake kafa ayyukan kula da lafiya ga waɗanda suke buƙata. Cibiyar samar da kayayyaki ta duniya a Dubai tana taka muhimmiyar rawa wajen tabbatar da samar da kayayyakin kiwon lafiya ba tare da katsewa ba kuma muna godiya ga tallafin da Hadaddiyar Daular Larabawa ta bayar don sauƙaƙe jirginmu na farko na waɗannan kayayyakin da ake matukar buƙata.

Za a sake nazarin ci gaban da aka samu a shekarar da ta gabata, nasarorin da aka samu da kuma kalubalen da ake fuskanta tare da abubuwan da za a sa a gaba a nan gaba a fannonin da suka shafi aikin WHO: Tsarin Kiwon Lafiya na Duniya, Gaggawa, Inganta Kiwon Lafiya da Jin Dadi. WHA76 za ta yi taro a ranar 21-30 ga Mayu a Palais des Nations a Geneva. "Yayin da muke bikin cika shekaru 75 da kafa WHO, za mu iya yin alfahari da nasarorin da muka samu a baya, amma dole ne mu tuna da darussan da muka koya, yayin da muke sauyawa daga lokacin gaggawa na COVID-19, da kuma samar da makoma inda kowane mutum zai iya samun sabis na kiwon lafiya da suke bukata", in ji Darakta Janar Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. "Wannan yana nufin karfafa tsarin duniya don shirye-shiryen gaggawa na kiwon lafiya, amsawa da juriya, tallafawa kasashe a kan hanyar samun kiwon lafiya na duniya, da kuma gina WHO mai karfi, mai dorewa da kuma ba da lissafi. "Don fara WHA76 a ranar Lahadi 21 ga Mayu, bugu na huɗu na Walk the Talk: Health for All challenge zai fara a Place des Nations da karfe 8:30 na safe CEST (warm-up yana farawa da karfe 7:30 na safe CEST), don inganta lafiyar jiki da tunani da kuma bikin mahimmancin haɗin gwiwa a lokacin bikin cika shekaru 75 na WHO.

WHO tana da sauran tan 30 na kayayyaki don zazzabin cizon sauro da cututtukan da ba sa yaduwa kamar su ciwon sukari da hauhawar jini, yanayin da zai iya zama mai kisa idan ba a magance shi ba. Waɗannan da kusan buhunan jini 23,000 ana shirya su a cikin cibiyar samar da kayayyaki ta duniya ta WHO a cikin Birnin Jinƙai na Duniya, kuma WHO a halin yanzu tana bincika duk yiwuwar isar da waɗannan kayayyaki zuwa Sudan da wuri-wuri tare da haɗin gwiwar Ma'aikatar Lafiya ta Sudan. Dokta Michael Ryan, Babban Daraktan, na Shirin Gaggawa na Lafiya na WHO, ya ce, "Cibiyar Samun Kayayyaki ta Duniya ta WHO a UAE ta zama cibiyar amsa saurin samar da kayayyaki ga manyan al'amuran da suka faru a duniya. Taimaka wa sama da ƙasashe 140 a duk yankuna 6 na WHO, cibiyar tana ba da layin ceto ga ƙasashe membobin da ke fuskantar matsalolin kiwon lafiya sakamakon barkewar cututtuka, bala'o'i kamar ambaliyar ruwa da girgizar ƙasa, da kuma tasirin rikici kan tsarin kiwon lafiya. Tallafin da UAE ke bayarwa ya ba WHO damar kasancewa a sahun gaba na waɗannan martanin gaggawa na kiwon lafiya - isar da taimakon likita na musamman ga masu buƙata a duk inda ake buƙata.

Wadannan sun gaji bayan 'yan kwanaki saboda yawan wadanda suka ji rauni. Aikin tura jirgin ya zo ne a matsayin wani bangare na ci gaba da kokarin taimakon da UAE ke yi don tallafawa mutanen Sudan kuma yana nuna zurfin dangantakar da ke tsakaninta da Sudan, musamman dangane da halin da ake ciki yanzu da kasar ke fuskanta. Taimakon kuma wani ci gaba ne na hangen nesa na UAE na jin kai kuma yana jaddada dangantakar da ke tsakaninta da sauran kasashe bisa zumunci na mutane da kuma jajircewarta na taimaka wa wasu a lokutan bukata. Dr Reem bint Ebrahim Al Hashimy, Ministan Harkokin Kasuwanci na Duniya, ya ce UAE "ta ci gaba da aiki kafada da kafada da Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya don tabbatar da nasarar aiwatar da mahimman ayyukan dabaru don aika taimakon gaggawa da abinci don taimakawa magance rikicin na yanzu a Sudan. A daidai lokacin da ake kira ga dukkan bangarorin rikicin na yanzu don dakatar da tashin hankali nan da nan da kuma rage yanayin da ke haifar da wahala ga mutanen Sudan, UAE ta dage kan jajircewarta na samar da taimako da taimako ga kasashe a lokutan bukata.

Manufofin suna ba da shawara ga ayyuka da manufofi a duk faɗin Ƙungiyar, gami da jagororin kan gidaje, ci gaban birane, tsarin sufuri da isar da kiwon lafiya. Misali, Jagororin Gidaje da Lafiya na WHO, wanda aka fara bugawa a cikin 2018, ya nuna karuwar tasirin yanayin gidaje akan lafiyar ɗan adam dangane da haɓakar birane, canjin yanayi da canjin yawan jama'a. Jagororin suna ba wa ƙasashe membobin, abokan hulɗa da jama'a shawarwari bisa hujjoji masu dacewa da rashin isasshen sararin rayuwa (cunkoso), ƙananan zafin jiki da zafin jiki na cikin gida, haɗarin rauni a gida, da kuma samun damar gidaje ga mutanen da ke da nakasa. Shirin Kiwon Lafiyar Birane (UHI) shima yana mai da hankali kan hanyoyin da biranen za su ba da damar ingantacciyar lafiya ta hanyar haɓaka aiki mai tasiri kan gurɓataccen iska na birane da gurɓataccen yanayi na ɗan gajeren lokaci (SLCPs) - ceton rayuka ta hanyar haɗa lafiya, muhalli da ci gaba mai ɗorewa. WHO kuma tana haɗin gwiwa tare da Ƙungiyar Canjin Yanayi da Tsabtace Iska (CCAC) akan kamfen na Breathe Life, wanda ke da nufin rage gurɓataccen iska da rage mutuwar miliyan 7 a kowace shekara da yake haifarwa.

Ba da gudummawa: Ya kamata a samar da gudummawa daga mutanen da suka mutu don iyakar damar maganin su, guje wa, a duk lokacin da zai yiwu, haɗarin da ke tattare da masu ba da gudummawa masu rai, kamar yadda aka bayyana a cikin Ka'idar Jagora ta WHO 3. Akwai sanannen buƙata ga al'ummomi, da ƙwararrun likitocin kiwon lafiya, don samun ingantaccen ilimi game da ba da gudummawa da dasa kwayar halitta kuma wannan shine mabuɗin nasarar shirye-shiryen ba da gudummawa ga waɗanda suka mutu. Duk da haka, duk da yawan amfani da kayan da aka ba da gudummawa daga masu ba da gudummawa da suka mutu, gudummawar daga masu ba da gudummawa masu rai ya zama dole don wasu nau'ikan dasa kwayar halitta ko don biyan ƙarancin kayan da ake samu daga masu ba da gudummawa da suka mutu don biyan bukatun marasa lafiya. Don haka ana yin ba da gudummawa mai rai duk da cewa ya ƙunshi haɗari ga mai ba da gudummawa wanda ba zai iya zama mara mahimmanci ba. Kamar yadda sayen kayan ɗan adam don dasa kwayar halitta daga masu ba da gudummawa da suka mutu ko masu rai da kuma dasa kwayar halitta na gaba na iya haifar da haɗarin ɗabi'a da aminci ga mai karɓa da mai ba da gudummawa, hukumomin kiwon lafiya ya kamata su aiwatar da tsauraran matakai da kulawa mai kyau don kare su.

Da yake karbar shawarwarinsu daga manyan sauye-sauye guda uku da aka gabatar a cikin taswirar hanya - ƙarin mallakar ƙasa, auna tasirin ba tsari ba, da kuma sadaukar da kai ga ayyukan haɗin gwiwa da haɗin kai don ƙara inganci - tattaunawar ta kasance mai ma'ana, mai hangen nesa kuma cike da buƙatar daidaito na kiwon lafiya da adalci don magance NTDs. Irin wannan hanyar, taron ya ji, na iya kawo canjin da ake buƙata daga wasu al'ummomin da ke fama da talauci a duniya don cimma burin ci gaba mai ɗorewa na Majalisar Dinkin Duniya na 2030. A farkon irin wannan taron na duniya tun lokacin da aka kaddamar da taswirar hanya a watan Janairun 2021, wakilai sun ji daga Darakta Janar na WHO Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. Yayin maraba da mahalarta a farkon taron na kwana biyu, Dr Tedros ya ce, "Wannan taron yana nuna abin da WHO ke nufi - abokan tarayya suna haɗuwa don amfani da ƙarfin su don magance ƙalubalen kiwon lafiya na duniya wanda babu wanda zai iya magance shi shi kaɗai. "Kalubale mai fannoni da yawa kamar cututtukan wurare masu zafi da aka yi watsi da su yana ɗaukar tsari mai fannoni da yawa, kuma wannan shine abin da muke kawowa, tare".

Tare da wannan bayanin, masana kimiyya da jami'an kiwon lafiyar jama'a za su iya ganowa da bin diddigin cututtuka don hanawa da kuma mayar da martani ga barkewar cutar a matsayin wani ɓangare na tsarin sa ido kan cututtuka, da kuma samar da magunguna da alluran rigakafi. IPSN, tare da Sakatariyar da Cibiyar WHO ta shirya don Binciken Cututtuka da Annoba, ta haɗu da masana a duk duniya a kan gaba a fannin ilimin kwayoyin halitta da nazarin bayanai, daga gwamnatoci, gidauniyoyin agaji, ƙungiyoyi masu yawa, ƙungiyoyin jama'a, masana ilimi da kamfanoni masu zaman kansu. Duk suna da manufa ɗaya: don ganowa da mayar da martani ga barazanar cututtuka kafin su zama annoba da annoba, da kuma inganta sa ido kan cututtuka na yau da kullun. Manufar wannan sabuwar hanyar sadarwa tana da buri, amma kuma tana iya taka muhimmiyar rawa a cikin tsaron lafiya: don ba kowace ƙasa damar yin amfani da tsarin kwayoyin halittar cutar da nazarin bayanai a matsayin wani ɓangare na tsarin lafiyar jama'a, "in ji Darakta Janar na WHO Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. "Kamar yadda aka nuna mana a fili a lokacin annobar COVID-19, duniya ta fi ƙarfi lokacin da ta tsaya tare don yaƙi da barazanar lafiyar jama'a. "

Ci gaba yana raguwa ga lafiyar uwa da jariri, da kuma rigakafin haihuwar mace-mace, kuma yanzu an sake tura shi gaba ta hanyar mummunan haɗin COVID-19, canjin yanayi, faɗaɗa rikice-rikice da hauhawar farashin rayuwa. "Ta hanyar aiki tare a cikin haɗin gwiwa - gwamnatoci, masu ba da gudummawa, kamfanoni masu zaman kansu, ƙungiyoyin farar hula, iyaye, da ƙwararrun likitocin kiwon lafiya - za mu iya yin ƙararrawa game da wannan "mummunan gaggawa", kuma mu kawo ƙoƙarin rigakafin da kulawa kafin lokaci zuwa gaba na ƙoƙarin kiwon lafiya da ci gaban ƙasa, gina ƙarfin ɗan adam ta hanyar tallafawa iyalai, al'ummomi da tattalin arziki a ko'ina. "Gabriela da Jerome Foster, Las Vegas, Amurka: iyayen Jalen Foster, da waɗanda suka kafa Gidauniyar Kyautar Jalen "Gidauniyarmu an kafa ta ne bayan mutuwar ɗanmu, Jalen Foster, wanda ya mutu kafin lokaci a makonni 27 saboda ƙwayoyin cuta da ake kira group B streptococcus. Rashin ɗanmu ya kasance abin takaici, kuma babu tallafi a cikin al'umma kuma a lokacin ne muka yanke shawarar samar da wurin ta'aziyya da bege ga iyalai waɗanda suka rasa jariri.

A matsayin wani ɓangare na amincewa da Yarjejeniyar, SIDS ta sanya hannu don aiwatar da jerin ayyuka, wanda ya shafi fannoni kamar shigar da dukkan al'umma, hanzarta aiwatarwa, tabbatar da saka hannun jari, daidaitawa tsakanin gwamnatoci da lissafin ci gaba. Taron ya kuma nuna takamaiman alkawurran da SIDS ta yi game da NCDs da lafiyar kwakwalwa, gami da inganta samun damar kula da lafiyar kwakwalwa a cibiyoyin kulawa na farko, sabunta dokokin kula da taba sigari don rufe e-sigari da vaping, da rage yawan mutanen da ke shan gishiri da sukari. Waɗannan alkawurran sun dace da "mafi kyawun sayayya" na WHO - jerin ayyukan da ke da fa'ida, masu taimako don magance NCDs. Jerin mafi kyawun sayayya an sabunta shi kwanan nan a Majalisar Lafiya ta Duniya a watan Mayu don haɗawa da rigakafin mataki na biyu na zazzabin cizon sauro, magance cutar asma da cutar huhu mai tsawo da kuma magance cututtukan huhu da yawa.

Farfesa Tienthavorn ya kuma taka muhimmiyar rawa wajen magance kalubalen rashin daidaiton rarraba ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya, musamman a kan iyakoki da yankunan karkara na Thailand. Ya jagoranci kafa kawance da makarantun kauyuka don daukar daliban makarantar sakandare, horar da su da kuma taimaka musu su koma gida bayan sun kammala karatun likitanci da sauri. Gidauniyar Kiwon Lafiya ta Hadaddiyar Daular Larabawa (2023) mai lambar yabo: Dr Maria Asuncion Silvestre daga PhilippinesBugu da kari ga kasancewa sanannen likitan asibiti da mai bincike, Dr Maria Asuncion Silvestre mai kishin shayar da nono ne kuma wanda ya kafa Kalusugan ng Mag-Ina (Lafiyar Uwa da Yaro) - wata kungiya mai zaman kanta ta Philippines. Dr Silvestre ya yi amfani da kwarewarsa a matsayin mai aikin al'umma don gudanar da bincike da tsara tsari don taimakawa inganta lafiyar uwaye da jarirai. Tsarin farko da ta kirkira ya bayyana saitin ayyuka masu sauki da ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya za su yi wa uwa yayin haihuwa da jaririnta bayan haihuwa.

"Na yi farin cikin kasancewa a nan Cape Town tare da abokan huldarmu don tallafawa tsarin ci gaba don canja wurin fasahar mRNA don baiwa kasashe masu karamin karfi da matsakaicin karfi damar samun alluran rigakafi da sauran kayayyakin kiwon lafiya masu ceton rai", in ji Darakta Janar na WHO Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. "Ina matukar alfahari da nasarar da duk wadanda ke cikin wannan aikin suka samu; a cikin kasa da shekaru biyu mun nuna cewa idan muka yi aiki tare, za mu yi nasara tare. "Mahalarta taron sun hada da abokan huldarmu daga kasashe 15 a cikin Shirin, manyan masana, masana'antu, wakilan farar hula, da masu ba da tallafi. A yayin taron na kwana biyar, mahalarta za su raba ci gaba da tattauna mahimman abubuwan da ke ba da damar dorewar Shirin kamar batutuwan mallakar ilimi da bangarorin doka, da kuma kimiyyar fasahohin mRNA da mahimman aikace-aikace masu dacewa da LMICs a wasu yankunan cututtuka kamar HIV da tarin fuka. Cutar COVID-19 ta jaddada cewa akwai babban rashin daidaito a cikin samun kayayyakin kiwon lafiya, musamman alluran rigakafi.

Rage yawan kashe-kashen kai a kasashe wata alama ce a cikin Manufofin Ci Gaban Majalisar Dinkin Duniya (alamar kawai ga lafiyar kwakwalwa), Babban Shirin Ayyukan WHO da Shirin Ayyukan Lafiya na WHO na 2013-2030. Rahoton farko na WHO na kashe-kashen kai na duniya, Rigakafin kashe-kashen kai: larura ta duniya, wanda aka buga a shekarar 2014, yana da nufin kara wayar da kan jama'a game da mahimmancin lafiyar jama'a na kashe-kashen kai da yunƙurin kashe-kashen kai da kuma sanya rigakafin kashe-kashen kai a matsayin fifiko na kiwon lafiyar jama'a. Ana ƙarfafa gwamnatoci su aiwatar da shirin LIVE LIFE na WHO na ingantattun hanyoyin da aka tabbatar don rigakafin kashe-kashen kai, da haɓaka ko ƙarfafa cikakkun dabarun rigakafin kashe-kashen kai a cikin tsarin kiwon lafiyar jama'a. Jagoranci na ƙasa da haɗin kai kan rigakafin kashe-kashen kai suna ƙara tallafawa ta hanyar buga dabarun rigakafin kashe-kashen kai na ƙasa: ci gaba, misalai da alamomi. Gane cewa bayanai da ƙididdiga suna da mahimmanci don bayar da shawarwari da yanke shawara, WHO ta buga Kashe-kashen kai a duk duniya a cikin 2019: Kimanin Kiwon Lafiya na Duniya.

Taron Abokan Hulɗa na Shirin Cututtukan Zazzabi na Duniya na WHO ya ƙare tare da kira mai tayar da hankali don aiki a duk duniya Wakilai da wakilai sun bar Taron Abokan Hulɗa na Shirin Cututtukan Zazzabi na Duniya tare da kira mai tayar da hankali daga darektan sa Dr Ibrahima Socé Fall. Yayin da taron na ƙasashe da yawa, wanda wasu manyan abokan hulɗa 300 suka halarta, ya ƙare a Geneva a ranar Talata 13 ga Yuni, Dr Fall ya bukaci mahalarta su ɗauki saƙon cewa, "idan ba mu kalubalanci kanmu ba, ba za mu iya haɓaka da ingantawa ba". A cikin wani taron da aka gudanar don nazarin ci gaban da aka samu game da taswirar hanyar WHO don cututtukan zazzabi na 2021-2030 da kuma samar da kyakkyawar fahimta game da ayyukan NTD na duniya daga mahangar cututtuka da kuma mahangar duniya, abokan hulɗa, masu ba da gudummawa, abokan fasaha, cibiyoyi da wakilan ƙasashe sun ƙarfafa alƙawarin su na cimma burin da aka sa gaba: duniya ba tare da cututtukan zazzabi na 2030 ba. Babban jigon taron ya ta'allaka ne da hangen nesa na "Ƙungiya ɗaya da ke isar da shirin NTD na Duniya ɗaya".

Wakilai da mahalarta taron sun kwashe kwanaki biyu masu zuwa suna gano manyan gibin da kalubalen da ke tattare da cimma manyan manufofi da kalubalen gida, wadanda suka hada da tabbatar da cewa mutanen da cutar NTD ta shafa kai tsaye, da wadanda ke da alhakin gudanar da ayyukan magance cutar NTD, an nemi su kuma an amince da su, musamman ta fuskar sadarwa da kuma shiga tsakani da al'umma. Taron ya kuma lura da mahimmancin bunkasa al'ummomin aiki, don gina karfin aiki da amincewar ma'aikatan NTD na duniya. A cikin tattaunawa ta gaba, wakilai sun amince da ka'idoji da matakai na aiki don aiwatar da aiki zuwa ga burin da aka bayyana da kuma shirya tare don Tsarin Ayyukan Duniya na 20252030. Muhimman ayyuka da yanke shawara da suka fito daga taron sun hada da shawarwari don karfafawa da aiwatar da dandamali na hadin gwiwar kasa don tabbatar da hadin kai don tsara tsari da kuma sa ido da kimantawa, da kuma tabbatar da ingantaccen tsarin samar da kayayyaki a cikin tsarin kasa.

Kimanin jarirai miliyan 13.4 ne aka haifa kafin lokaci a shekarar 2020, tare da kusan miliyan 1 da suka mutu sakamakon rikitarwa kafin lokaci, a cewar wani sabon rahoto da hukumomin Majalisar Dinkin Duniya da abokan hulda suka fitar a yau. Wannan ya yi daidai da kusan 1 cikin jarirai 10 da aka haifa kafin lokaci (kafin makonni 37 na ciki) a duk duniya. Haihuwa da wuri: shekaru goma na aiki kan haihuwar da wuri, wanda Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya (WHO) da Asusun Yara na Majalisar Dinkin Duniya (UNICEF) suka samar tare da PMNCH - babbar kawancen duniya ga mata, yara, da matasa, yana ba da kashedi game da "gaggawa mai nutsuwa" na haihuwar da wuri, wanda ba a san shi ba a cikin girmansa da tsananinsa, wanda ke hana ci gaba wajen inganta lafiyar yara da rayuwarsu. Rahoton ya hada da sabbin kimantawa daga WHO da UNICEF, wanda aka shirya tare da Makarantar Lafiya da Magunguna ta London, kan yaduwar haihuwar da wuri. Gabaɗaya, ya gano cewa yawan haihuwar da wuri bai canza ba a kowane yanki a duniya a cikin shekaru goma da suka gabata, tare da jarirai miliyan 152 da suka haifu da wuri daga 2010 zuwa 2020.

Dalilan rashin daidaito Samun damar amfani da morphine don amfanin likita yana shafar abubuwa masu yawa masu hulɗa ciki har da masu ba da damar da suka shafi kyakkyawan shugabanci, amintacce / ingantaccen sayen kayayyaki da hanyoyin samarwa, wadatar albarkatu da ayyukan haɓaka iyawa, tare da shingayen da suka shafi dokoki da manufofi masu ƙuntatawa, rashin isasshen sabis, da halaye da fahimta mara kyau. Ganin yanayin ƙasashe daban-daban, masu ba da damar, shingayen da abubuwan fifiko don aiki sun bambanta; binciken masu ruwa da tsaki da aka gabatar a cikin wannan rahoton, tare da masu amsa daga ƙasashe membobin WHO 105, ya tabbatar da wannan bambancin. Misali, rashin daidaitaccen samar da morphine da sauran opioids masu ƙarfi a wuraren kiwon lafiya saboda iyakantaccen kuɗi an lura da shi a matsayin shinge a ƙasashe masu ƙarancin kuɗi da matsakaici idan aka kwatanta da ƙasashe masu kuɗi. Fiye da kashi ɗaya bisa uku na masu amsa a duk yankuna sun kuma lura da shingayen da suka samo asali daga dokoki da ƙa'idodi yayin da suka fahimci mahimmancin tsarin doka da ƙa'idodi don cimma samun dama mai aminci.

Ci gaba da rikice-rikice ya faru ne saboda dalilai na buƙata da na samarwa, gami da ƙarancin neman kula da lafiya a cikin al'ummomi da ƙarancin wadatar ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya da sauran albarkatun kiwon lafiya kamar asibitocin buɗewa ko wadatattun magunguna da kayayyaki. "Labari ne mai daɗi cewa tsarin kiwon lafiya a yawancin ƙasashe sun fara dawo da mahimman ayyukan kiwon lafiya ga miliyoyin mutanen da suka rasa su a lokacin annobar", in ji Dokta Rudi Eggers, Daraktan WHO na Ayyukan Kiwon Lafiya na Haɗin Kai. "Amma muna buƙatar tabbatar da cewa duk ƙasashe suna ci gaba da rufe wannan rata don dawo da ayyukan kiwon lafiya, da kuma amfani da darussan da aka koya don gina ƙarin tsarin kiwon lafiya da juriya don nan gaba".

Haɗa ayyukan COVID-19 cikin mahimman ayyukan kiwon lafiya A wani muhimmin mataki na dawo da tsarin da sauyawa, yawancin ƙasashe sun sami ci gaba wajen haɗa ayyukan COVID-19 cikin isar da sabis na kiwon lafiya na yau da kullun. Kimanin kashi 80-90% na ƙasashe sun haɗa da cikakken allurar rigakafin COVID-19, bincike da sabis na gudanarwa gami da sabis don yanayin bayan COVID-19 cikin isar da sabis na yau da kullun. Har yanzu, yawancin ƙasashe (80% na ƙasashe 83 da suka amsa) sun ba da rahoton aƙalla cikas ɗaya don haɓaka samun dama ga mahimman kayan aikin COVID-19 (misali COVID-19 diagnostics, therapeutics, alluran rigakafi da kayan kariya na mutum - PPE), tare da batutuwan ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya da rashin kuɗi suna wakiltar mafi yawan shinge. Ana buƙatar ƙarin tallafi don farfadowa, juriya da shiri Yawancin ƙasashe sun fara amfani da abin da suka koya yayin annobar COVID-19, gami da sanya wasu dabarun rage katsewar sabis na kirkire-kirkire cikin isar da sabis na yau da kullun.

A ranar 26 ga Mayu, kasashe mambobin sun amince da wani kuduri don karfafa karfin bincike a kasashe da kuma inganta samun dama ga ayyukan bincike. Wannan kuduri mai zurfi ya yarda cewa ayyukan bincike suna da mahimmanci ga rigakafi, sa ido, ganewar asali, kula da yanayin, sa ido da kuma magance cututtukan da ke yaduwa, wadanda ba sa yaduwa, cututtukan da ba a sani ba, raunuka, da nakasa. Bincike yana ba da damar gano cututtukan daidai, sabili da haka fara maganin da ya dace a kan lokaci don samun kyakkyawan sakamako na kiwon lafiya. Kudurin ya yi la'akari da dukkan nau'ikan "bincike", don haka ya hada da gwaje-gwajen dakin gwaje-gwaje na "in vitro" misali gwaje-gwajen bincike mai sauri da polymerase chain reaction (PCR) da kuma "ba in vitro" gwaje-gwaje misali na hoton hoto ko na'urar auna hawan jini. Ya shafi ayyukan bincike da ci gaba, masana'antu (ciki har da samar da gida da canja wurin fasaha), tsari, zabi da sayen kayayyaki, wayar da kan jama'a, bayar da shawarwari da magance shingayen samun dama gaba daya.

Dole ne al'ummar kasa da kasa su yi amfani da duk wadannan kayan aikin don cimma burin ci gaba mai dorewa nan da karshen wannan shekaru goma. Fatih Birol, Babban Daraktan Hukumar Kula da Makamashi ta Duniya "Makamashi mai sabuntawa mai tsada ya sake nuna juriya mai ban mamaki, amma har yanzu mafi talauci a duniya ba su da damar cin gajiyar shi. Don cimma SDG7 ba tare da yin sulhu da burin sauyin yanayi ba, dole ne mu kawo canji na tsarin yadda hadin gwiwar kasa da kasa ke aiki. Yana da mahimmanci cibiyoyin hada-hadar kudi na kasa da kasa su jagoranci kwararar kudi cikin adalci a duk duniya don tallafawa amfani da makamashi mai sabuntawa da ci gaban kayan aikin da ke da alaƙa. " Francesco La Camera, Babban Darakta, Hukumar Kula da Makamashi mai Sabuntawa ta Duniya "Duk da ci gaba zuwa burin makamashi mai dorewa a tsakiyar ajanda na 2030, burin 7 yana da wuya a cimma fiye da yadda yake a 2015 kuma ana buƙatar ƙara yin aiki idan muna son tabbatar da samun makamashi mai araha, abin dogaro, mai dorewa da na zamani ga kowa nan da 2030.

Ya zuwa watan Maris na 2023, fiye da shekaru uku bayan WHO ta ayyana COVID-19 a matsayin Gaggawa na Kiwon Lafiyar Jama'a na Damuwa ta Duniya (PHEIC), kashi 69.7% na yawan mutanen duniya sun sami aƙalla kashi ɗaya na allurar rigakafin COVID-19. Abin lura, wannan rabo har yanzu yana ƙasa da 30% a cikin ƙananan ƙasashe masu ƙarancin kuɗi (LICs). Wannan Shirin yana da nufin ba da gudummawa ga samun damar samun daidaito ga alluran rigakafin mRNA ta hanyar haɓaka rarraba ƙarfin masana'antu mai ɗorewa a cikin LMICs, haɓaka haɗin gwiwar yanki da na yanki, da haɓaka da ƙarfafa ma'aikata na gida ta hanyar horo da tallafin ƙwararru. Abin da ke na musamman a cikin tsarin Canja wurin Fasahar mRNA shine tsarin da yawa wanda ke ba da damar raba fasahohi ga masu karɓa da yawa don ta hanyar samar da ƙasa da yanki waɗanda masu buƙata za a iya isa da sauri. Dr Phaahla, Ministan Lafiya na Afirka ta Kudu, ya ce: "Abin da muke gani a nan yau, wani lokaci ne a tarihi, Shirin da ke da nufin ƙarfafa LMICs ta hanyar cibiyar haɗin gwiwar duniya.

Karin allurar rigakafin da aka yi amfani da su na allurar rigakafin da aka yi amfani da su na kwayar cutar index na ci gaba da ba da babban matakin kariya daga cututtuka masu tsanani da mutuwar da dukkan nau'ikan SARS-CoV-2 ke haifarwa, gami da zuriyar zamani na Omicron. Kariya daga cututtuka masu tsanani da kamuwa da cuta da allurar rigakafin da aka yi amfani da su na kwayar cutar index da allurar mRNA mai bivalent da ke dauke da BA.1- ko BA.4/5 ke haifarwa yana raguwa a tsawon lokaci. Koyaya, kariya daga cututtuka masu tsanani ana kiyaye ta fiye da kariya daga kamuwa da cuta. Kamar yadda aka kwatanta da allurar rigakafin da aka yi amfani da su na kwayar cutar index, allurar rigakafin da aka yi amfani da su na BA.1- ko BA.4/5 mai dauke da bivalent mRNA na iya ɗan ƙara tasirin allurar rigakafi a kan cututtukan alamomi, yayin da ƙananan ƙididdigar nazarin da ke tantance sakamako mai tsanani ke nuna irin wannan kimantawa game da tasirin allurar rigakafi. Dukansu allurar rigakafin da ke dauke da BA.1- da BA.4/5 suna haɓaka girma da haifar da faɗin amsawar garkuwar jiki ga bambance-bambancen SARS-CoV-2 lokacin da aka yi amfani da su azaman allurar ƙarin, idan aka kwatanta da allurar rigakafin da ke dauke da kwayar cutar index.

Hukumar Tarayyar Turai da WHO sun kaddamar da wani muhimmin shiri na kiwon lafiya na dijital don karfafa tsaron kiwon lafiya na duniya Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya (WHO) da Hukumar Tarayyar Turai sun sanar a yau da kaddamar da wata muhimmiyar kawance ta kiwon lafiya ta dijital. A watan Yunin 2023, WHO za ta yi amfani da tsarin Tarayyar Turai (EU) na takardar shaidar COVID-19 ta dijital don kafa tsarin duniya wanda zai taimaka wajen sauƙaƙe motsi na duniya da kare 'yan ƙasa a duk faɗin duniya daga barazanar kiwon lafiya da ke gudana da kuma nan gaba, gami da annoba. Wannan shine ginshiƙin farko na Cibiyar Takaddun Shaida ta Kiwon Lafiya ta Dijital ta Duniya (GDHCN) wanda zai haɓaka ɗimbin samfuran dijital don samar da ingantacciyar lafiya ga kowa. "Gina kan cibiyar sadarwar takaddun shaida ta dijital ta EU mai nasara sosai, WHO na da niyyar ba duk ƙasashe membobin WHO damar yin amfani da kayan aikin kiwon lafiya na dijital, wanda ya dogara da ƙa'idodin daidaito, kirkire-kirkire, nuna gaskiya da kariyar bayanai da sirri", in ji Dokta Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, Darakta Janar na WHO.

A shekarar 1987 taron lafiya na duniya na arba'in, da ya damu da cinikin riba a kan sassan jikin mutum, ya fara shirya ka'idojin jagorancin WHO na farko kan dasa sassan jiki, wanda taron ya amince da shi a shekarar 1991 a cikin kudurin WHA44.25. Wadannan ka'idojin jagoranci sun yi tasiri sosai ga ka'idojin sana'a da ayyuka da kuma dokoki a duk duniya a cikin kusan shekaru ashirin. Bayan wani tsarin tuntuba da ya dauki shekaru da dama, taron lafiya na duniya na sittin da uku ya amince da kudurin WHA63.22 a ranar 21 ga Mayu 2010, yana amincewa da sabunta ka'idojin jagorancin WHO da kuma gano wuraren ci gaba don inganta bayarwa da aikin dasa sassan jiki. Yarjejeniyar Istanbul ta kwararru na bayarwa da dasa sassan jiki daga dukkan yankuna, ta hanyar yawancin kungiyoyinsu da cibiyoyinsu, suna amincewa da Yarjejeniyar Istanbul kan fataucin sassan jiki da yawon shakatawa na dasa sassan jiki wanda aka kirkira a karkashin jagorancin kungiyar Transplantation Society da kungiyar International Society of Nephrology a watan Mayu 2008.

Dokta Aylward ya jagoranci Shirin Canji na WHO da kuma aikin Kungiyar kan Cibiyar Access to COVID-19 Tools Accelerator (ACT-A). A cikin sabon aikinsa, Dokta Aylward zai jagoranci ajandar Kungiyar don sauya tsarin kula da lafiya na farko a matsayin cibiyar kula da lafiyar duniya, tare da kula da aikin WHO kan tsarin kiwon lafiya, rigakafi da kiwon lafiyar haihuwa, uwa da yaro. Dokta Aylward yana da digiri na likitanci da digiri na biyu a fannin kiwon lafiyar jama'a. Dokta Hanan Balkhy zai ci gaba a matsayin Mataimakin Darakta Janar na Rigakafin Rigakafin Kwayoyin cuta. Dokta Balkhy yana ba da jagoranci na fasaha da siyasa don dakile nauyin kiwon lafiya da tattalin arziki na juriya ga magunguna, gami da haɗin gwiwar bangarori da yawa tare da Hukumar Abinci da Noma, Hukumar Kula da Lafiyar Dabbobi ta Duniya, da Hukumar Kula da Muhalli ta Majalisar Dinkin Duniya. Kafin shiga WHO, Dokta Balkhy ya kasance Babban Daraktan Rigakafin Cututtuka da Kula da Cututtuka a Ma'aikatar Tsaron Kasa ta Saudiyya.

Rashin maganin rigakafi (AMR) ga magungunan rigakafin da ake amfani da su don magance STIs, musamman gonorrhoea, ya karu cikin sauri a cikin 'yan shekarun nan kuma ya rage sakamakon magani mai nasara. Sakamakon daga Gonococcal AMR Surveillance Programme (GASP) na yanzu yana nuna yanayin yawan ƙarfin quinolone, ƙaruwar azithromycin da fitowar juriya na faɗaɗɗen-spectrum cephalosporins. Fitowar raguwar saukin kamuwa da gonorrhoea ga faɗaɗɗen-spectrum cephalosporins, tare da kafa matakan juriya na manyan matakan penicillins, sulphonamides, tetracyclines, quinolones da macrolides suna sa gonorrhoea ta zama kwayar cuta mai juriya da magunguna. AMR don sauran STIs, kodayake ba a gama ba, shima ya wanzu, yana sanya rigakafi da saurin magani mai mahimmanci. Don magance STIs yadda ya kamata yana da mahimmanci a ɗauki magungunan rigakafin da suka dace, tare da daidaitaccen adadin da tsawon lokaci don takamaiman STI don tabbatar da isasshen magani ko warkarwa, da kuma hana ci gaban juriya na rigakafi.

A cikin tsarin kiwon lafiya mai ƙarfi, muna haifar da tasirin kiwon lafiyar jama'a zuwa ga kula da lafiyar kowa ta hanyar tattaunawar manufofi don tsarin nan gaba da tallafi na dabarun inganta aiki. Wannan aikin yana tallafawa da jagororin ƙa'ida da yarjejeniyoyi; bayanai, bincike da kirkire-kirkire; da jagoranci a fagen diflomasiyya, bayar da shawarwari, daidaito tsakanin mata da maza, daidaito na kiwon lafiya da haƙƙin ɗan adam, ayyukan da yawa, da kuma kuɗi. 2030 Agenda for SDGs Ayyukan WHO sun dace da manufar 3.8 na Manufofin Ci Gaban Dorewa (SDG), wanda ke mai da hankali kan cimma cikakkiyar kiwon lafiya, gami da kariya daga haɗarin kuɗi, samun ingantattun ayyukan kiwon lafiya da samun ingantattun magunguna da alluran rigakafi ga kowa. A duniya, ci gaba zuwa ga kula da kiwon lafiya na duniya ƙalubale ne. Ci gaba a cikin kula da sabis ya tsaya yayin da rabon yawan jama'a da ke fuskantar mummunan kashe kuɗin kiwon lafiya yana ƙaruwa koyaushe.

A cikin 2021, ƙasashe 139 galibi masu samun kuɗi mai yawa da masu matsakaicin kuɗi sun cika wannan burin, amma ƙasashe 56 ba za su cika burin ENAP ba a cikin 2030 idan ba a ƙara ƙoƙari ba. Idan aka ci gaba da yanayin yanzu, jarirai miliyan 15.9 za su mutu; kusan rabin waɗannan (miliyan 7.7, 48%) za su faru ne a yankin Saharar Afirka. Dalilai: Tare da ingantaccen kiwon lafiya a duk lokacin daukar ciki da haihuwa, yawancin mutuwar jarirai ana iya hana su. Manyan abubuwan da ke haifar da mutuwar jarirai sun haɗa da rikitarwa da ke tattare da ciki da haihuwa, tsawon lokacin ciki, cututtukan uwa kamar zazzabin cizon sauro, syphilis da HIV, yanayin uwa musamman hauhawar jini, da ciwon sukari, da ƙuntatawar ci gaban jariri (lokacin da jaririn da ba a haifa ba ba zai iya cimma damar ci gabansa ba saboda haka ya fi ƙanƙanta). Rashin daidaituwa na haihuwa yana da alhakin ƙasa da 10% na mutuwar jarirai da aka ruwaito a ƙasashe masu samun kuɗi mai yawa kuma ba a san ainihin rabo a cikin ƙananan ƙasashe ba saboda iyakokin bincike.

Ana iya hana cin zarafin yara. Rigakafin da kuma mayar da martani ga cin zarafin yara na bukatar kokarin magance hadari da abubuwan kariya a dukkan matakai hudu da ke da alaka da juna na hadari (mutum, dangantaka, al'umma, al'umma). Mayu 2016 Majalisar Dinkin Duniya ta amince da shirin WHO na farko na duniya game da karfafa rawar da tsarin kiwon lafiya ke takawa a cikin matakan da suka shafi al'umma don magance cin zarafin mutane, musamman ma mata da 'yan mata, da kuma yara. A Bisa ga wannan shirin, WHO tare da hadin gwiwar kasashe mambobin kungiyar da sauran abokan hulda, sun himmatu ga: Kula da girman duniya da halayen cin zarafin yara da kuma tallafawa kokarin da ake yi a kasashe don rubuta da kuma auna irin wannan cin zarafin. Kula da tsarin bayanai na lantarki wanda ke taƙaita bayanan kimiyya game da nauyin, abubuwan haɗari da sakamakon cin zarafin yara, da kuma shaidar da za a iya hana ta.

An samar da sanarwar ne ta hanyar wani tsari na hada kai wanda SIDS ke jagoranta, sanarwar ta nuna cewa ba za a iya magance cututtukan da ba su da lafiya da kuma yanayin lafiyar kwakwalwa ba tare da amsa matsalar canjin yanayi ba. "Ayyukan jaruntaka don yanayin mu, lafiya mai kyau, da walwala sun dogara ne da gyara da sake tsara kudaden duniya don buɗe biliyoyin saka hannun jari, yayin da ake rage azabtarwa ga ƙasashe masu tasowa don biyan bashin su", in ji Mai Girma Mia Amor Mottley, Firayim Ministan Barbados. "Kudade don daidaitawa da rage sauyin yanayi a cikin ƙasashe masu rauni ma suna da mahimmanci, tare da cututtukan da ba a iya yaduwa da lafiyar kwakwalwa. "Kalubalen da ƙananan ƙasashe masu tasowa ke fuskanta suna da alaƙa da juna kuma suna da fannoni da yawa. Canjin yanayi, lalacewar muhalli, rashin daidaito na zamantakewa da tattalin arziki, da kuma yanayin kasuwanci na lafiya suna ƙara nauyin cututtukan da ba a iya yaduwa da yanayin lafiyar kwakwalwa, "in ji Dokta Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, Darakta Janar na WHO.

Babu wata ƙasa da ta tsaya ba tare da wannan batun ba, kuma WHO ta karɓi rahotannin ƙananan magungunan likita ko na ƙarya, alluran rigakafi da binciken in vitro daga dukkan yankuna na duniya. Duk magungunan gama gari da na kirkire-kirkire ana iya yin karya, tun daga samfuran da suka yi tsada sosai don cutar kansa zuwa samfuran da ba su da tsada sosai don maganin ciwo. Ƙasashen membobin WHO sun amince da cikakkiyar dabarun duniya da aka mai da hankali kan rigakafi, ganowa da amsawa don matsawa zuwa samun ƙarin inganci, lafiya, inganci da ingantattun kayayyakin kiwon lafiya. Tasiri: Kayayyakin kiwon lafiya marasa inganci da na ƙarya suna haifar da matsaloli da yawa ga mutum da ke shan magani da kuma ga iyalai, babbar al'umma, tsarin kiwon lafiya da sarkar samarwa. Lokacin da magunguna ba su yi aiki yadda ya kamata ba, suna iya kasa magance ko hana cuta, taimakawa ga juriya ga maganin ƙwayoyin cuta, ɓata albarkatu masu tamani da haifar da asarar amincewa da magunguna da rashin amincewa da masu ba da kiwon lafiya.

Farfesa Petro Terblanche, Babban Daraktan Afrigen ya ce: "Dukan ƙungiyar Afrigen suna farin cikin cimma wannan muhimmin mataki tare da kammala dandalin fasahar mRNA. Wannan dandalin yana cikin cibiyar ci gaba da samar da allurar rigakafin mRNA inda ƙungiyar rigakafin mRNA Hub Covid 19 AfriVac 2121 ke cikin matakin haɓaka a halin yanzu. A cikin watanni 18 da suka gabata, Afrigen ya sami canji mai ban mamaki tare da tallafin cibiyar haɗin gwiwa da masu ba da shawara wanda wannan Shirin ya ba da damar. Mun haɓaka ƙarfinmu da iyawarmu don saduwa da mafi girman ƙa'idodin ingancin haɓaka allurar rigakafin mRNA, muna aiki da manufar gina ƙarfin ci gaba a cikin LMICs don samar da alluran rigakafin mRNA. "Afrigen ya sami nasarar kafa tsarin samar da allurar rigakafin COVID-19 a sikelin dakin gwaje-gwaje kuma a halin yanzu yana haɓaka wannan tsari zuwa matakin da ya dace don samar da alluran rigakafin da za a yi amfani da su a gwajin asibiti na Mataki na I / II zuwa ƙa'idodin GMP.

Bayani game da mutuwar jariri: Jariri wanda ya mutu bayan makonni 28 na ciki, amma kafin ko lokacin haihuwa, an rarraba shi a matsayin mutuwar jariri. Akwai kusan mutuwar jariri miliyan 2 a kowace shekara - ɗaya a kowane dakika 16. Fiye da kashi 40% na duk mutuwar jariri yana faruwa yayin haihuwa - asarar da za a iya kauce mata da ingantaccen kulawa da girmamawa yayin haihuwa gami da sa ido na yau da kullun da samun damar gaggawa lokacin da ake buƙata. Fuskantar mutuwar jariri a lokacin ciki ko haihuwa bala'i ne wanda ba a magance shi sosai a cikin ajandar duniya ba, manufofi da shirye-shiryen da aka ba da kuɗi. Akwai farashin tunani, musamman ga mata da danginsu, kamar baƙin ciki na uwa, sakamakon kuɗi da tasirin tattalin arziki, da kuma zargi da haramci. A cikin 2014, Majalisar Lafiya ta Duniya ta amince da Tsarin Ayyukan Kowane Jariri (ENAP), wanda ya haɗa da burin duniya na mutuwar jariri 12 ko ƙasa da haka a kowane 1,000 haihuwa a kowace ƙasa nan da shekara ta 2030.

Koyaya, ƙididdigar IRENA ta nuna cewa kwararar kuɗin jama'a na ƙasa da ƙasa don tallafawa makamashi mai tsabta a ƙasashe masu ƙarancin kuɗi da matsakaici suna raguwa tun kafin annobar COVID-19 kuma tallafin yana iyakance ga ƙananan ƙasashe. Don cimma burin SDG 7 da kuma tabbatar da cewa mutane sun sami cikakkiyar fa'ida daga fa'idodin zamantakewar tattalin arziki na sauyawa zuwa makamashi mai ɗorewa, ya zama dole a sake fasalin tsarin kuɗin jama'a na ƙasa da ƙasa da kuma ayyana sabbin dama don buɗe saka hannun jari. Rahoton ya kuma gano cewa ƙaruwar bashi da hauhawar farashin makamashi suna ƙara tabarbarewar hangen nesa don samun damar cin abinci mai tsabta da wutar lantarki. Hasashe na yanzu sun kiyasta cewa mutane biliyan 1.9 ba za su sami abinci mai tsabta ba kuma miliyan 660 ba za su sami damar samun wutar lantarki ba a cikin 2030 idan ba mu ɗauki ƙarin mataki ba kuma mu ci gaba da ƙoƙarinmu na yanzu. Waɗannan gibin za su yi mummunan tasiri ga lafiyar mafi raunin al'ummominmu da hanzarta canjin yanayi.

Shekaru goma da suka gabata sun kuma ga ci gaban ayyukan al'umma kan hana haihuwa da mutuwar jarirai, wanda cibiyoyin iyaye, kwararrun likitoci, masana ilimi, kungiyoyin farar hula, da sauransu ke jagoranta. A duk faɗin duniya, ƙungiyoyi don iyalan da ke fama da haihuwa da wuri sun kasance a sahun gaba wajen ba da shawara don samun ingantaccen kulawa da sauya manufofi da tallafawa sauran iyalai. Zuwa taron kasa da kasa na lafiyar mata da jarirai, a Cape Town, Afirka ta Kudu daga 8-11 ga Mayu, WHO, UNICEF, UNFPA da PMNCH suna kira ga ayyuka masu zuwa don inganta kulawa ga mata da jarirai da rage haɗarin haihuwa da wuri: Ƙara saka hannun jari: Haɗa albarkatun ƙasa da na cikin gida don inganta lafiyar uwa da jariri, tabbatar da ingantaccen kulawa a lokacin da kuma inda ake buƙata. Hanzarta aiwatarwa: Cimma burin ƙasa don ci gaba ta hanyar aiwatar da manufofin ƙasa don kula da uwa da jariri.

Manufar ta hada da samun damar samun wutar lantarki ga kowa da kowa da kuma tsaftace abinci, ninka matakan ingantaccen aiki na tarihi, da kuma kara yawan amfani da makamashi mai sabuntawa a cikin hadadden makamashi na duniya. Cimma wannan burin zai yi tasiri sosai ga lafiyar mutane da jin daɗin rayuwa, yana taimakawa wajen kare su daga haɗarin muhalli da zamantakewa kamar gurɓatar iska, da kuma fadada damar samun kulawa da sabis na kiwon lafiya na farko. Buga 2023 na bin diddigin SDG 7: Rahoton Ci gaban Makamashi ya yi gargadin cewa ƙoƙarin da ake yi yanzu bai isa ba don cimma SDG 7 a kan lokaci. An sami wasu ci gaba kan takamaiman abubuwan da ke cikin ajandar SDG 7 - misali, ƙaruwar yawan amfani da makamashi mai sabuntawa a cikin sashen wutar lantarki - amma ci gaban bai isa ba don cimma burin da aka sa a cikin SDGs. Ana sa ran rikicin makamashi na duniya zai ƙarfafa aiwatar da makamashi mai sabuntawa da haɓaka ingancin makamashi tare da wasu manufofin gwamnati da ke nuna ƙaruwar saka hannun jari.

Kowace ƙasa tana da hanya daban don cimma UHC da yanke shawarar abin da za a rufe bisa ga bukatun jama'arsu da albarkatun da ke hannunsu. Zuba jari a cikin PHC yana tabbatar da cewa an gano duk waɗannan buƙatun, an ba da fifiko kuma an magance su ta hanyar haɗin kai; cewa akwai ƙwararrun ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya da ke da kayan aiki; kuma cewa dukkanin ɓangarorin al'umma suna ba da gudummawa don fuskantar abubuwan da suka shafi muhalli da zamantakewar tattalin arziki waɗanda ke shafar lafiya da walwala, gami da shirya, amsawa da murmurewa daga yanayin gaggawa. Amsar WHO: A matsayin tushe don UHC, WHO ta ba da shawarar sake daidaita tsarin kiwon lafiya ta amfani da tsarin kula da lafiya na farko (PHC). Samun UHC shine fifikon dabarun WHO, tare da burin ƙarin mutane biliyan 1 da ke cin gajiyar kula da lafiya ta duniya a cikin 2025. A cikin ƙasashe da ke da tsarin kiwon lafiya mai rauni, muna mai da hankali kan taimakon fasaha don gina cibiyoyin ƙasa da isar da sabis don cike manyan gibin da ke cikin yanayin gaggawa.

Wannan ita ce shekara ta huɗu ta bikin fim ɗin kuma gasar ba ta da ƙarfi, tare da wasu fina-finai 93 da aka zaɓa waɗanda suka shafi batutuwa da suka fara daga damuwa da baƙin ciki har zuwa tasirin canjin yanayi kan lafiya, da kuma ƙalubalen kiwon lafiya na mutanen da ke da nakasa. An tantance fina-finai ta hanyar kwamitin ƙwararrun masana, masu zane-zane da masu fafutuka, gami da sanannun 'yan wasan kwaikwayo, Sharon Stone da Alfonso Herrera, mai tsara rawa, Sherrie Silver, mai fafutukar sauyin yanayi, Sophia Kianni da kuma ɗan jarida, Adelle Onyango. Sun kasance tare da manyan jami'an Majalisar Dinkin Duniya da ma'aikatan WHO. "Bikin Fim na Kiwon Lafiya ga Kowa ya kawo fuskar ɗan adam ga aikin kimiyya na WHO", in ji Darakta Janar na WHO, Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. "Sauraron muryoyin mutanen da ke fama da matsalolin kiwon lafiya hanya ce mai ƙarfi don wayar da kan jama'a da haɓaka fahimtarmu game da abubuwan da mutane ke fuskanta kuma wannan na iya taimaka mana ci gaba zuwa kiwon lafiya ga kowa".

Ƙananan tsibirai sun amince da shirin ɗaukar mataki kan cututtukan da ba a iya yaduwa ba da kuma lafiyar kwakwalwa A yau, an ƙaddamar da Yarjejeniyar Bridgetown ta 2023 kan cututtukan da ba a iya yaduwa ba (NCDs) da lafiyar kwakwalwa, don magance wasu daga cikin cututtukan da suka fi kashe mutane a ƙananan tsibirai masu tasowa (SIDS), waɗanda ke cikin haɗari. Yarjejeniyar ita ce babbar sakamakon taron ministocin SIDS kan cututtukan da ba a iya yaduwa ba (NCDs) da lafiyar kwakwalwa, wanda ya gudana daga 14 zuwa 16 ga Yuni, wanda Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya (WHO), Hukumar Lafiya ta Pan American (PAHO) da Gwamnatin Barbados suka shirya. SIDS suna fama da cututtukan da ba a iya yaduwa ba - wanda ke haifar da kashi 74% na dukkan mutuwar a duniya - saboda dogaro da abincin da aka shigo da shi, tasirin kasuwanci da rikicin yanayi. Wani sabon rahoton WHO ya nuna cewa 8 daga cikin ƙasashe 15 da ke da haɗarin mutuwa da wuri daga cututtukan zuciya, ciwon daji, ciwon sukari, ko cututtukan numfashi na kullum sune SIDS.

Wannan ya fi ci gaban 1.2% daga shekarun da suka gabata. Koyaya, ƙimar haɓakar ƙarfin makamashi ta ragu a cikin 'yan shekarun nan kuma ta sauka zuwa 0.6% a cikin 2020. Wannan ya sa ya zama mafi munin shekara don haɓakar ƙarfin makamashi tun rikicin kuɗi na duniya, kodayake galibi saboda ƙuntatawa da ke da alaƙa da cutar, wanda zai iya nuna koma baya na ɗan lokaci. Ingantattun shekara-shekara har zuwa 2030 dole ne yanzu su kai kimanin 3.4% don saduwa da burin SDG 7.3. Tsarin kuɗin jama'a na duniya don tallafawa makamashi mai tsabta a cikin ƙasashe masu tasowa ya tsaya a kan dala biliyan 10.8 a cikin 2021, 35% ƙasa da matsakaicin 2010-2019 kuma kusan kawai kusan 40% na ƙimar 2017 na dala biliyan 26.4. A cikin 2021, ƙasashe 19 sun karɓi kashi 80% na alkawurran. Za a gabatar da rahoton ga manyan masu yanke shawara a wani taron ƙaddamarwa na musamman a ranar 11 ga Yuli 2023 a Babban Taron Siyasa (HLPF) kan Ci Gaban Dorewa, kafin taron SDG na biyu a watan Satumba 2023 a New York.

Sabbin sakamakon binciken sun nuna tsarin kiwon lafiya ya fara murmurewa daga annobar Bayan shekaru uku na annobar COVID-19, tsarin kiwon lafiya a kasashe ya fara nuna manyan alamun farko na murmurewar tsarin kiwon lafiya, a cewar rahoton na wucin gadi na WHO kan " zagaye na huɗu na binciken bugun jini na duniya kan ci gaba da ayyukan kiwon lafiya na yau da kullun yayin annobar COVID-19: Nuwamba 2022 zuwa Janairu 2023. " A farkon 2023, ƙasashe sun ba da rahoton fuskantar raguwar katsewa a cikin isar da sabis na yau da kullun na kiwon lafiya, amma sun nuna buƙatar saka hannun jari a cikin murmurewa da ƙarfin juriya don nan gaba. Daga cikin ƙasashe 139 da suka amsa zagaye na huɗu na binciken bugun jini na WHO, ƙasashe sun ba da rahoton ci gaba da katsewa a kusan kashi ɗaya cikin huɗu na sabis a matsakaita. A cikin ƙasashe 84 inda yiwuwar nazarin yanayin yake, yawan sabis ɗin da aka katse ya ragu a matsakaita daga 56% a watan Yuli-Satumba 2020 zuwa 23% a watan Nuwamba 2022-Janairu 2023.

WHO, Kasashe mambobi, da abokan hulɗa suna aiki tare don ganowa da aiwatar da ayyukan fifiko don ƙarfafa shirye-shiryen ƙasa, yanki, da na duniya don annoba da barazanar cututtukan da ke tasowa. Mun fahimci rawar al'ummomi da dukkanin bangarori, da kuma buƙatar daidaitawa da ci gaba don kawo ƙarshen zagayen tsoro da rashin kulawa wanda ya zama ruwan dare gama gari a cikin shirye-shiryen annoba da amsawa. Mun tuna da darussan da muka koya daga annoba da annoba da suka gabata, musamman waɗanda ke haifar da ƙwayoyin cuta na numfashi. Waɗannan ƙwayoyin cuta sun kasance kuma za su ci gaba da haifar da babbar barazana ta duniya tare da yuwuwar haifar da mummunan rashin lafiya da mutuwa, shawo kan tsarin kiwon lafiya, da rashin daidaituwa na tattalin arziƙin duniya, da kuma ƙara rashin daidaito, wanda ya wanzu a cikin samun kayan aikin hana annoba da kula da lafiya ga dukkan mutane. Wannan kira ne na Aiki don hanzarta shirye-shiryen annoba da barazanar da ke tasowa a duniya.

Tsarin amfani ya bambanta sosai tsakanin ƙasashe masu irin wannan wadata; bai dace da buƙatun likita ba, kamar yadda aka nuna ta ƙididdigar yawan kwanakin da mutane ke fama da ciwo ko wahala da matsanancin numfashi ga mutanen da ke fama da rashin lafiya mai tsanani. Wannan bayanan ya yi daidai da na Hukumar Lancet ta 2018 wanda ya bayyana rashin samun magungunan rage ciwo a matsayin "ɗaya daga cikin mafi munin, ɓoyayyen rashin adalci a cikin kiwon lafiyar duniya" tare da kashi 10% na ƙasashe masu arziki da ke da kashi 90% na magungunan da aka rarraba na morphine. "Barin mutane cikin ciwo lokacin da magunguna masu tasiri suke samuwa don magance ciwo, musamman a cikin yanayin kulawa da ƙarshen rayuwa, ya kamata ya zama babban abin damuwa ga masu tsara manufofi", in ji Dokta Yukiko Nakatani, Mataimakin Darakta Janar na WHO don Magunguna da Kayayyakin Kiwon Lafiya. "Dole ne mu gaggauta ba da shawara don samun damar samun maganin morphine mai aminci da dacewa ga waɗanda ke buƙatar magani ta hanyar daidaitaccen manufofi, a ko'ina. "

Waɗannan kuɗaɗen suna tallafawa gudanar da Hub a Afirka ta Kudu da kuma abokan haɗin gwiwa a duk faɗin duniya. Mun yi imani da mahimmancin haɓaka ƙarfin aiki a matakin gida da na yanki. "Mista Martin Seychell, Mataimakin Daraktan Gudanarwa na Hukumar Tarayyar Turai, ya ce. "EC ta riga ta ba da gudummawar Euro miliyan 40 don kafa Hub na canja wurin fasahar mRNA kuma kwanan nan ta sanya hannu kan wani tallafi tare da EIB na Euro miliyan 15,5 don sauƙaƙe faɗaɗa ƙarfin samar da alluran rigakafi. Wannan wani ɓangare ne na saka hannun jari gaba ɗaya a ƙarƙashin dabarun EU Global Gateway, inda aka tattara sama da Euro biliyan 1 a ƙarƙashin Team Europe Initiative on Manufacturing health products. Yanzu yana da mahimmanci a magance yiwuwar ƙuntatawa da buƙatun, don tabbatar da samar da alluran rigakafi mafi inganci a duk yankuna na duniya, har ma da saurin samun dama da daidaito ga waɗancan alluran rigakafin. "

Amfani da biomass na gargajiya kuma yana nufin gidaje suna kashe har zuwa awanni 40 a mako suna tattara itacen wuta da dafa abinci, wanda ya hana mata neman aiki ko shiga cikin hukumomin yanke shawara na gida da yara daga zuwa makaranta. Dangane da ƙididdigar WHO ta 2019, mutuwar da ba a tsammani ba miliyan 3.2 a kowace shekara ana iya danganta su da gurɓatar iska na gida da aka kirkira ta amfani da man fetur da fasahohin dafa abinci. Amfani da wutar lantarki mai sabuntawa a cikin amfani da duniya ya karu daga 26.3% a cikin 2019 zuwa 28.2% a cikin 2020, mafi girman ƙaruwa na shekara guda tun farkon bin diddigin ci gaban SDGs. Kokarin haɓaka rabon makamashi mai sabuntawa a cikin dumama da sufuri, wanda ke wakiltar fiye da kashi uku cikin huɗu na amfani da makamashi na duniya, ya ci gaba da ƙasa da manufa don cimma burin yanayi na 1.5oC. Ƙarfin makamashi - ma'aunin yawan makamashi da tattalin arzikin duniya ke amfani da shi a kowace dala ta GDP - ya inganta daga 2010 zuwa 2020 da 1.8% a kowace shekara.

Duk matafiya dole ne su shirya don nau'ikan haɗarin kiwon lafiya da za su iya fuskanta a cikin yanayin da ba su saba da su ba kafin, lokacin da kuma bayan sun yi tafiya. Mutanen da ke shirin tafiya ya kamata su nemi shawara game da haɗarin da ke tattare da wuraren da suka zaɓa kuma su fahimci yadda za su kare lafiyarsu da kuma rage haɗarin kamuwa da cuta. Shirya gaba, matakan rigakafin da suka dace da kuma taka tsantsan na iya kare lafiyar matafiya, da kuma rage haɗarin haɗari da kamuwa da cuta. Ko da yake aikin likita da masana'antar tafiye-tafiye na iya ba da taimako mai yawa da shawara mai kyau, ya kasance alhakin matafiyi ne ya nemi bayani, ya fahimci haɗarin da ke tattare da shi kuma ya ɗauki matakan da suka dace don kare lafiyarsu yayin tafiya. Haɗari: Lokacin tantance haɗarin lafiyar tafiye-tafiye na ƙasa da ƙasa, matafiya da ƙwararrun likitocin ya kamata suyi la'akari da waɗannan mahimman abubuwan masu zuwa:

Bugu da kari, cibiyoyin biyu da suka sami lambar yabo ta 2023 mata ne ke jagorantar su. Wadanda suka lashe kyaututtukan 2023 Sasakawa Health PrizeMasu lashe kyaututtukan 2023: Cibiyar Nick Simons daga Nepal, da Farfesa Vichai Tienthavorn daga Thailand Cibiyar Nick Simons kungiya ce mai zaman kanta da ke da burin inganta kiwon lafiya a yankunan karkara na Nepal. Yin aiki tare da Ma'aikatar Lafiya da Jama'a ta Nepal, Cibiyar ta horar da kwararrun likitoci 7000 (kamar ungozoma da mataimakan magunguna) a yankunan karkara, wadanda yanzu ke ba da sabis da ake buƙata ga al'ummomin yankin a cikin rashin isasshen likitoci da kwararru. Cibiyar ta samar da kayan aiki masu mahimmanci kuma ta samar da ƙarin ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya don rage rashin ƙwararrun likitoci a asibitoci 44, kuma ta goyi bayan tsara shirin aiki don ingantaccen sabis a asibitocin karkara sama da 100.

A shekarar 2019 kadai, mutane 92 622 sun sami maganin tiyata na cutar trachoma mai ci gaba kuma miliyan 95.2 an yi musu maganin rigakafi. Duk da wadannan nasarorin, cutar ta kasance babbar damuwa ga lafiyar jama'a, tare da asarar kimanin dalar Amurka biliyan 8 a kowace shekara a cikin yawan aiki saboda makanta da raunin gani. Alamomi: Kamuwa da cuta yana da alaƙa da canje-canje na kumburi a cikin conjunctiva da aka sani da "active trachoma". Tsarin garkuwar jiki na mutum na iya share wani yanayi na kamuwa da cuta, amma a cikin al'ummomin da ke fama da cutar, sake samun kwayar cutar yana faruwa akai-akai. Bayan shekaru da yawa na maimaita cututtukan trachoma mai aiki, cikin ido na iya zama mai tsananin rauni (trachomatous conjunctival scarring) wanda ya juya zuwa ciki kuma ya sa gashin ido ya shafa da kwayar ido (trachomatous trichiasis), wanda ke haifar da ciwo na yau da kullun da rashin jure haske; wannan da sauran canje-canje na ido na iya haifar da lalacewar cornea.

cututtukan da ba sa yaduwa kamar cututtukan zuciya, bugun jini, asma, ciwon daji, ciwon sukari da damuwa; da tashin hankali da rauni, gami da raunin zirga-zirgar ababen hawa. Amsar WHO: Duk da kalubalen da suke fuskanta, birane na iya samar da dama don ingantacciyar lafiya, tsabtace muhalli da kuma sauyin yanayi. Dole ne manufofin birane masu ƙarfi su ba da fifiko ga kiwon lafiya, saboda yana da mahimmanci don haɓaka rayuwar birane mai kyau, gina ma'aikata masu fa'ida, ƙirƙirar al'ummomi masu juriya da ƙarfi, ba da damar motsi, inganta hulɗar zamantakewa da kare mutane masu rauni. Hanyar WHO ga lafiyar birane tana mai da hankali kan ingantaccen iska, ruwa da tsaftacewa, da sauran abubuwan da ke haifar da muhalli; tsara birane masu lafiya; yanayin lafiya da rashin shan sigari; motsi mai aminci da lafiya; hana tashin hankali da rauni; inganta ingantattun tsarin abinci da abinci; kula da muhalli na cututtukan vector-borne; da shirye-shiryen birane don gaggawa.

Ga cysticercosis, lokacin da ake samun cutar yana da bambanci, kuma mutanen da suka kamu da cutar na iya kasancewa ba tare da alamun cutar ba har tsawon shekaru. A wasu yankuna da cutar ta fi yawa, mutanen da suka kamu da cutar na iya samun alamun cutar a bayyane ko a iya gani (ƙaramin kumburi mai ƙarfi ko kumburi wanda yake da ƙarfi wanda za'a iya gano shi ta hanyar taɓawa) a ƙarƙashin fata. Neurocysticercosis yana da alaƙa da alamomi da alamomi daban-daban dangane da adadi, girma, mataki da kuma wurin canje-canje na cutar da kuma amsar garkuwar jiki da kwayar cutar, amma kuma yana iya zama mara alamun cutar. Alamomin na iya haɗawa da ciwon kai na kullum, makanta, shanyewar jiki (cutar farfadiya idan suna maimaitawa), hydrocephalus, meningitis, rashin hankali da alamomin da raunuka ke haifarwa da ke mamaye sararin tsarin juyayi na tsakiya. Magani: Maganin taeniasis ta Taenia solium yana da mahimmanci don hana neurocysticercosis kuma a matsayin kayan aiki don taimakawa wajen sarrafawa ko dakatar da zagayen yaduwar kwayar cutar.
