WHO za ta ci gaba da haɓaka da yada jagororin kan takamaiman cututtuka kamar yadda ake buƙata. Ƙaddamar da shirin yana faruwa ne a ranar ƙarshe na tarurruka tare da mutane sama da 120 da ke wakiltar ƙasashe membobin, abokan hulɗa, da sakatariyar WHO, don ayyana hanyar ci gaba don PRET, gami da haɓaka taswirar aiwatar da duniya don shirye-shiryen annobar cutar numfashi. Module na farko na PRET Initiative yana mai da hankali kan cututtukan numfashi, gami da mura, ƙwayoyin cuta na coronavirus, da kwayar cutar numfashi. Gama yaduwar cutar COVID-19 da ke gudana da kuma yiwuwar barazanar murar tsuntsaye, wannan ɓangaren zai ba ƙasashe damar yin nazari mai mahimmanci, gwaji, da sabunta ƙoƙarin shirye-shiryen annobar numfashi don tabbatar da cewa suna da ƙarfin aiki da iyawa a wurin. Ana ci gaba da aiwatar da tsarin gano rukunin cututtukan na gaba, kamar su arboviruses, da za a magance su a ƙarƙashin wannan shirin.

Bayan gwaninta na murya mai ban mamaki, Fleming ta kasance mai kishin bincike a mahadar fasaha da kiwon lafiya. Gabatarwarta a duk duniya tare da masana kimiyya da masu aiki, rawar da take takawa a manyan manufofi, da alaƙar ta da WHO sun nuna jajircewarta don amfani da ikon canji na fasaha don inganta al'umma. "Ina farin ciki cewa babbar hukumar kiwon lafiya ta duniya tana fahimtar tasirin fasaha a cikin kiwon lafiya, kuma ina matukar alfahari da aka ba ni alhakin raba wannan sakon", in ji Fleming. "Kowace rana, ci gaba a cikin ilimin kwakwalwa da bincike na asibiti yana bayyana ƙarin game da fa'idodin maganin fasaha, gogewa, da ilimi, tare da tasiri ga jin daɗin rayuwar ɗan adam. Duk da haka, mun fara fahimtar damar ban mamaki na wannan aikin, kuma ina fatan fadada wayar da kai da samun dama a matsayin Jakadan Alheri na WHO.

Bayan ya inganta shigar al'umma cikin kulawar asibiti sama da shekaru 20, Dr Jorge Francisco Meneses ya kafa kwamitocin al'umma da ke mai da hankali kan aminci da gamsuwa na marasa lafiya, danginsu da al'umma. Ganin kyakkyawan tasirin aikinsa wajen inganta ingancin kulawar marasa lafiya, samfurin ɗabi'a da kulawa da marasa lafiya da ya tsara an kara girman shi a matakin ƙasa. A yau, a matsayin mai kula da ƙasa don asibitocin Guatemala, ya tsara wani shiri don inganta ingancin sabis ga marasa lafiyar asibiti da danginsu. Dr Meneses kwanan nan ya daidaita wani sabon aikin gwaji a Yankin Lafiya na Guatemala ta Kudu don gina cibiyar sadarwar farko ta ƙasa ta sabis na kiwon lafiya, tare da fifikon mayar da hankali kan al'ummomin da ba su da wadata. Aikinsa ya haifar da karɓar dabarun ƙasa na cibiyoyin sabis na kiwon lafiya, na farko a Amurka ta Tsakiya.

Wannan taron ministocin ya zo ne a wani lokaci na musamman kuma zai zama mabuɗin don ƙara murya da bukatun SIDS, kawo NCDs da lafiyar hankali a gaba a jerin abubuwan da muke fifiko, "in ji Dokta Jarbas Barbosa, Daraktan PAHO, da Daraktan Yankin WHO na Amurka. "Don gina kan wannan ci gaba, dole ne mu yi aiki yanzu. PAHO a shirye take don tallafawa hanzarta aiwatar da ayyukan a yankinmu, gami da haɗa kulawa da waɗannan yanayin cikin ayyukan kiwon lafiya na farko da kuma amfani da sabbin abubuwa kamar kayan aikin kiwon lafiya na dijital. Kasashen SIDS suna da tarihin jagorantar yanke shawara na duniya; yarjejeniyar Port of Spain da SAMOA sun share fagen farkon sanarwar siyasa ta Majalisar Dinkin Duniya game da NCDs a cikin 2018. Taron da Sanarwar za su ba da bayani da kuma tsara tarurrukan manyan tarurrukan Majalisar Dinkin Duniya masu zuwa game da kula da lafiyar duniya a watan Satumba 2023 da kuma NCDs a cikin 2025.

Cutar COVID-19 da sauran matsalolin kiwon lafiya sun nuna cewa kasashe suna bukatar su kasance a shirye don magance barazanar cututtukan da ke yaduwa, tare da shirye-shiryen shirye-shirye da aka tsara da kuma ingantaccen haɗin kai da haɗin gwiwa tare da sauran fannoni kamar noma. "Shirye-shiryen, rigakafi, da ayyukan amsawa ba za su zama al'amarin sashen kiwon lafiya kadai ba", in ji Dokta Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, Darakta Janar na WHO. "Kamar yadda matsalolin kiwon lafiya ke da tasiri a fannoni da yawa, haka ma shirye-shiryenmu da kokarinmu na amsawa ya shafi fannoni, fannoni da ƙwayoyin cuta. Yana da mahimmanci, kuma, cewa haɗin gwiwar al'umma da daidaito sune cibiyar kokarinmu, musamman ga waɗancan al'ummomin da ke gefe kuma mafi haɗari. PRET ci gaba ne a cikin tsarin WHO na shirye-shiryen annoba ta hanyar amfani da madubin watsawa, maimakon mai da hankali kan takamaiman cututtuka.

Kafin shiga Wellcome a shekarar 2013 Dr Farrar ya shafe shekaru 17 a matsayin Daraktan Sashin Binciken Asibiti a Asibitin Cututtukan Zazzabi a Vietnam inda bincikensa ya shafi lafiyar duniya tare da mai da hankali kan sabbin cututtukan da ke yaduwa. Dr Farrar likita ne mai bincike tare da digiri na likita da PhD. Dr Ailan Li zai zama Mataimakin Darakta Janar na Tsarin Kiwon Lafiya na Duniya, Jama'a masu Lafiya daga ranar 8 ga Mayu 2023. A wannan matsayin Dr Li zai kula da kokarin Kungiyar don inganta ingantacciyar lafiya da walwala ta hanyar ayyukan da suka shafi muhalli, zamantakewa, da yanayin tattalin arziki na lafiya, gami da canjin yanayi, sarrafa taba, amincin sinadarai, amincin hanya, tsarin abinci da abinci mai gina jiki, aikin motsa jiki, gurbataccen iska da radiation, ta hanyar tsarin Lafiya Daya. Dr Li ya kasance wakilin WHO a Masarautar Kambodiya tun daga ranar 15 ga Yuli 2019.

Cin zarafin yara yana da mummunar tasiri na gaggawa da na dogon lokaci. Baya ga mutuwa, rauni na jiki da nakasa, tashin hankali na iya haifar da damuwa wanda ke lalata ci gaban kwakwalwa da lalata tsarin juyayi da tsarin rigakafi. Wannan kuma yana da alaƙa da jinkirin ci gaban fahimi, rashin aikin makaranta da barin makaranta, matsalolin lafiyar hankali, ƙoƙarin kashe kansa, ƙaruwar halayen haɗari na kiwon lafiya, sake cin zarafi da aikata tashin hankali. Labari mai dadi shine cewa ana iya hana cin zarafin yara ta hanyar shiga tsakani wanda ke tallafawa iyaye da masu kulawa, inganta ƙa'idodi da ɗabi'un da ba na tashin hankali ba, samar da ilimi da horo na rayuwa, ƙarfafa kuɗin iyalai da tsaro na tattalin arziki, bayar da amsa mai inganci da sabis na tallafi, ƙirƙirar da kiyaye yanayi mai aminci ga yara, da aiwatar da dokoki game da cin zarafin yara. WHO, tare da haɗin gwiwar abokan hulɗa da yawa:

Misali, ayyukan kiwon lafiya masu tsabta na iya samar da fa'idodin lafiyar marasa lafiya da ma'aikata yayin da kuma adana makamashi, rage haɗarin yanayi da samar da tanadi na dogon lokaci. Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta himmatu wajen bin ci gaba mai dorewa a duk ayyukanta don taimakawa kare mutanen gobe daga haɗarin kiwon lafiya na yau da kullun. Tasiri: Yawancin dabarun ci gaba mai dorewa na iya ba da fa'idodi masu mahimmanci ga lafiya, yanayi da muhalli, kuma ana iya ganin fa'idodin kusan nan da nan. Misali, ana iya cimma burin kiwon lafiya da ci gaba da yawa a lokaci guda ta hanyar magance gurɓatar iska, wanda ke da alhakin kimanin mutuwar mutane miliyan 7 a kowace shekara. Gurbataccen hayaki ya haɗa da gurɓatattun abubuwa masu ƙarfi na ɗan gajeren lokaci (SLCPs) - musamman baƙin carbon, ozone da methane - waɗanda ke da haɗari ga lafiya amma suna da ɗan gajeren rayuwar sararin samaniya.

"Hadin gwiwar duniya a cikin sa ido kan kwayoyin cuta yana da mahimmanci yayin da duniya ke yaƙi da COVID-19 tare", in ji Dokta Rajiv J. Shah, Shugaban Gidauniyar Rockefeller. "IPSN ya gina kan wannan ƙwarewar ta hanyar ƙirƙirar ingantaccen dandamali ga abokan tarayya a duk faɗin sassa da iyakoki don raba ilimi, kayan aiki, da ayyuka don tabbatar da cewa rigakafin cutar da mayar da martani na zamani ne kuma mai ƙarfi a nan gaba. Duk da karuwar da aka samu kwanan nan a cikin ƙarfin kwayoyin halitta a cikin ƙasashe sakamakon annobar COVID-19, mutane da yawa har yanzu ba su da ingantattun tsarin tattarawa da nazarin samfuran ko amfani da waɗannan bayanan don jagorantar yanke shawara game da lafiyar jama'a. Babu isasshen raba bayanai, ayyuka, da sabbin abubuwa don gina ingantaccen tsarin sa ido kan lafiyar duniya. Kasafin kuɗi da ya tashi a lokacin annobar, yana ba da damar haɓaka iyawa cikin sauri, yanzu ana rage shi, har ma a cikin ƙasashe masu arziki.

Dabarar ta sanya hangen nesa a bayyane: nan da shekarar 2030, duk wanda ke samun ko samar da kiwon lafiya yana da aminci daga cututtukan da ke tattare da shi. Manufofinta guda uku sune: don hana kamuwa da cuta a cikin kiwon lafiya; yin aiki don tabbatar da shirye-shiryen IPC suna nan kuma ana aiwatar da su; da kuma daidaita ayyukan IPC tare da sauran yankuna da bangarori. Dabarar tana mai da hankali kan kowane wuri inda ake ba da kiwon lafiya, a duk faɗin tsarin kiwon lafiya; ya dogara ne akan ƙa'idar tsafta da aminci a matsayin muhimmin ɓangare na haƙƙin kiwon lafiya, wanda ke daidaita daidaito, kuma wanda ya kamata ya tabbatar da lissafi da dorewa. Dabarar IPC ta duniya za a cika ta, kuma za a yi amfani da ita tare, da shirin aiki na duniya da ke da alaƙa da tsarin sa ido, wanda za a haɓaka a cikin 2023-2024. Takaddar da ke da alaƙa EB152/9 - Daftarin dabarun duniya game da rigakafin kamuwa da cuta da sarrafawa, Rahoton taƙaitaccen rahoton Darakta-Janar

Big Tobacco - tare da duk masana'antun kayayyakin taba - suna gwagwarmaya don tabbatar da cewa an ɓoye haɗarin samfuran su, amma muna mayar da martani: A cikin 2003, ƙasashe membobin WHO sun amince da Yarjejeniyar WHO kan Kula da Tabar (WHO FCTC), yarjejeniyar kiwon lafiyar jama'a kawai a ƙarƙashin kulawar WHO. A cikin 2005, yana da ƙungiyoyi 181. Don taimakawa ƙasashe aiwatar da WHO FCTC, WHO ta gabatar da MPOWER, kunshin matakan fasaha da albarkatu, kowannensu ya dace da aƙalla tanadi ɗaya na WHO FCTC. MPOWER yana gina ƙarfin ƙasashe don aiwatar da matakan 6 don rage buƙatun kayayyakin taba: saka idanu kan amfani da taba da manufofin rigakafi, kare mutane daga amfani da taba, bayar da taimako don daina amfani da taba, gargadi game da haɗarin taba, tilasta haramcin tallan taba, tallatawa da tallafawa da kuma ƙara haraji kan taba.

WHO ta ƙaddamar da sabon shiri don inganta shirye-shiryen annoba Don taimakawa ƙasashe su shirya da kyau don annoba a nan gaba, WHO ta ƙaddamar da sabon shiri a yau wanda ke ba da jagora kan haɗaɗɗen shiri don amsa duk wata cuta mai saurin saurin numfashi kamar mura ko ƙwayoyin cuta na corona. Sabon Shirin Shirye-shiryen da Juriya don Barazanar da ke Farkawa, ko PRET, ya haɗa da sabbin kayan aiki da hanyoyin don ilmantarwa tare da haɗin gwiwa wanda aka kafa yayin annobar COVID-19 da sauran gaggawa na kiwon lafiyar jama'a na baya-bayan nan. Ta hanyar shirin, WHO za ta yi amfani da hanyar hanyar watsawa don jagorantar ƙasashe a cikin shirin annoba, la'akari da cewa ƙarfi da iyawa da yawa suna gama gari tsakanin rukunin ƙwayoyin cuta. PRET yana amsa kiran don jagorancin fasaha da tallafi don haɓakawa da ƙarfafa shiri da amsa haɗin kai, kamar yadda aka tsara a cikin ƙudurin Majalisar Lafiya ta Duniya.

Farfesa Piot ya kuma taka rawa a binciken farko na kwayar cutar Ebola, da kuma dakile barkewar cutar ta farko da aka sani, yana halartar binciken annoba. Ya jagoranci wasu manyan manufofi, ya yi aiki a matsayin mai ba da shawara mai girma, ciki har da COVID-19, kuma ya sami lambobin yabo da yawa. Farfesa Piot shi ne Mashawarci na Musamman ga Shugaban EC, Farfesa na Kiwon Lafiyar Duniya kuma tsohon Daraktan Makarantar Kiwon Lafiyar London & Tropical Medicine. "Wadannan fitattun mutane suna nuna sadaukarwa na rayuwa, ba da shawara ba tare da jinkiri ba, sadaukar da kai ga daidaito, da kuma sadaukar da kai ga bil'adama da lafiyar mutane", in ji Darakta Janar na WHO, Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. "A lokacin da ake fuskantar matsaloli da yawa, rikice-rikice, da rikice-rikice, mun fahimci cewa jagoranci a cikin kiwon lafiyar jama'a da kimiyya sun fi muhimmanci fiye da kowane lokaci don ci gaban kiwon lafiyar duniya.

A halin yanzu ana amfani da fiye da kadada miliyan 3 na ƙasa a cikin ƙasashe sama da 120 don shuka taba mai kisa, har ma a ƙasashen da mutane ke fama da yunwa. Wani sabon rahoton WHO, "Shuka abinci, ba taba ba", ya nuna illolin noman taba da fa'idodin sauyawa zuwa amfanin gona mai dorewa ga manoma, al'ummomi, tattalin arziki, muhalli, da duniya baki ɗaya. Rahoton ya kuma fallasa masana'antar taba don kama manoma a cikin mummunan yanayin bashi, yada noman taba ta hanyar wuce gona da iri game da fa'idodin tattalin arzikinta da kuma yin kira ta hanyar kungiyoyin gona. Noman taba yana haifar da cututtuka ga manoma da kansu kuma an kiyasta fiye da ma'aikata miliyan 1 suna aiki a gonakin taba, suna rasa damar su na ilimi. "Taba ba kawai babbar barazana ce ga rashin abinci ba, amma lafiyar gaba ɗaya, gami da lafiyar manoman taba.

Muna so mu zayyana manyan nau'ikan nasarori guda uku: Na farko, bincike mai inganci ta HRP yana da tasiri mai mahimmanci kan manufofin kiwon lafiyar jama'a, ka'idoji, da aiki a duk duniya don magance buƙatun da ke tasowa na yawan jama'a. Na biyu, HRP, musamman ta hanyar HRP Alliance, ya ƙarfafa cibiyoyin bincike a cikin gida da na duniya, kuma, ya ba da damar masu bincike da yawa su sami ƙwarewar bincike wanda ke tabbatar da cewa bincike mai inganci na SRHR na iya ci gaba, kuma hakika ya ƙaru, a nan gaba. Na uku, a cikin duniyar da ke fama da rikici, rikici da ƙaruwar juriya ga daidaito tsakanin mata da maza, HRP ya sauƙaƙe kiyaye haƙƙin mata da 'yan mata da ƙarancin ƙarfi. HRP ya kasance babban kayan aiki a cikin tsarin Majalisar Dinkin Duniya don bincike a cikin haifuwar ɗan adam kuma yana ci gaba da kasancewa jagora na musamman a cikin lafiyar jima'i da haihuwa ta duniya.

Dr Jérôme Salomon zai zama Mataimakin Darakta-Janar na Tsarin Kiwon Lafiya na Duniya, Cututtuka masu yaduwa da marasa yaduwa daga ranar 17 ga Afrilu 2023. A wannan matsayin Dr Salomon zai kula da babban fayil na shirye-shiryen fasaha da suka shafi HIV, cutar hepatitis, cututtukan da ake yadawa ta hanyar jima'i, tarin fuka, zazzabin cizon sauro, cututtukan da ba a kula da su ba, lafiyar kwakwalwa, cututtukan amfani da kwayoyi, da cututtukan da ba a yaduwa ba kamar cututtukan zuciya, ciwon sukari, cututtukan numfashi na kullum da ciwon daji. Dr Salomon ya kasance yana aiki a matsayin Darakta-Janar na Kiwon Lafiya a Ma'aikatar Kiwon Lafiya da Rigakafin Faransa. Ya kasance memba na Kwamitin Gudanarwa na WHO kafin nadin sa kuma yana da kwarewa sosai a cikin tsarin kiwon lafiya, cututtukan da ba a yaduwa da kuma lafiyar jama'a ta duniya. Dr Salomon yana da digiri na likita, digiri na biyu a fannin kiwon lafiyar jama'a da PhD a fannin ilimin cututtuka.

Kayan magani marasa inganci da na bogi Bayani: Har zuwa mutane biliyan biyu a duniya ba su da damar samun magunguna, alluran rigakafi, na'urorin kiwon lafiya ciki har da binciken in vitro, da sauran kayayyakin kiwon lafiya, wanda ke haifar da wani wuri wanda galibi ana cika shi da kayayyaki marasa inganci da na bogi. Wannan matsalar tana ƙaruwa yayin da hanyoyin samar da kayayyaki na duniya ke ƙara rikitarwa, ma'ana samfuran da aka ƙera a cikin ƙasa ɗaya ana iya shirya su a cikin ƙasa ta biyu kuma a rarraba su a ƙetaren iyakoki don tallatawa ko sayarwa ga masu amfani a cikin ƙasa ta uku. Ci gaban kasuwancin e-commerce shima yana ba da gudummawa ga wannan yanayin ta hanyar sauƙaƙa sayan magunguna akan layi, galibi daga hanyoyin da ba a ba da izini ba. WHO ta gano wannan batun ɗayan ƙalubalen kiwon lafiya na gaggawa na shekaru goma masu zuwa saboda an kiyasta fiye da ɗaya cikin goma na magunguna a ƙasashe masu ƙarancin kuɗi da matsakaici suna da ƙarancin inganci ko na bogi.

"Dole ne mu kare ƙarni na gaba ta hanyar yin aiki yanzu. Zuba jari a cikin tsabtace da sabuntawa don tallafawa samun damar samar da makamashi ga kowa da kowa shine yadda za mu iya kawo canji na gaske. Tsabtace fasahohin dafa abinci a gidaje da ingantaccen wutar lantarki a cibiyoyin kiwon lafiya na iya taka muhimmiyar rawa wajen kare lafiyar mutanenmu mafi rauni. " Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, Darakta Janar na WHO, Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya Game da rahoton Hukumar Kula da SDG 7, Hukumar Kula da Makamashi ta Duniya (IEA), Hukumar Kula da Makamashi ta Duniya (IRENA), Sashen Kididdiga na Majalisar Dinkin Duniya (UNSD), Bankin Duniya, da Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya (WHO) da nufin samar wa al'ummar duniya da dashboard na duniya don yin rajistar ci gaba kan samun makamashi, ingancin makamashi, makamashi mai sabuntawa da haɗin gwiwar duniya don ciyar da SDG 7 gaba.

Ta hanyar International Trachoma Initiative, maganin rigakafi azithromycin Pfizer ya bayar da gudummawa ga shirye-shiryen kawar da cutar da ke aiwatar da dabarun SAFE. Benin ta haɗa ayyukan kawar da cutar trachoma tare da waɗanda aka aiwatar da su kan sauran cututtukan wurare masu zafi da aka yi watsi da su (NTDs), a ƙarƙashin inuwar Shirin Kasa na Cututtukan da ke Yaduwa. Trachoma ita ce NTD ta uku da za a kawar da ita a Benin, bayan dracunculiasis (a 2009) da gambiense human African trypanosomiasis (a 2021). Mali ta gudanar da binciken tasirin trachoma da sa ido kuma ta ƙaddamar da ayyukan don cimma burin kawar da ita, duk da ƙalubalen tsaro a yankunan arewacin ƙasar da rikice-rikicen zamantakewar al'umma a cikin 'yan shekarun nan. Trachoma ita ce NTD ta farko da za a kawar da ita a Mali, wanda hakan ya sa yanzu ta shiga rukunin ƙasashe 47 na duniya waɗanda suka kawar da aƙalla NTD ɗaya.

NCDs ̶ barazanar kiwon lafiya mai ci gaba ga al'ummomi masu zuwaDuk da ci gaban kiwon lafiya gabaɗaya, yawan mutuwar da NCDs ke haifarwa a kowace shekara ya ci gaba da ƙaruwa kuma yanzu yana ɗaukar kusan kashi uku cikin huɗu na duk rayukan da aka rasa kowace shekara. Idan wannan yanayin ya ci gaba, ana hasashen NCDs za su ƙididdige kusan kashi 86% na mutuwar miliyan 90 na shekara-shekara a tsakiyar karni; sakamakon haka, miliyan 77 daga cikin waɗannan za su kasance saboda NCDs - kusan ƙaruwa da kashi 90% a cikin adadi na ƙarshe tun daga 2019 zuwa 2030 don cimma burin SDG. Hakanan, raguwar cutar tarin fuka daga 2015 zuwa 2021 ya kasance kashi ɗaya cikin biyar ne kawai na hanyar zuwa maƙasudin 2025 na dabarun kawo ƙarshen tarin fuka na WHO.

Hanyoyin kula da kai don kiwon lafiya Bayani: Kula da kai shine ikon mutane, iyalai da al'ummomi don inganta kiwon lafiya, hana cututtuka, kiyaye lafiya, da magance rashin lafiya da nakasa tare da ko ba tare da tallafin ma'aikacin kiwon lafiya ba.A halin yanzu mutane biliyan 3.6 - rabin duniya - ba su da damar yin amfani da mahimman ayyukan kiwon lafiya.WHO ta ba da shawarar yin amfani da hanyoyin kula da kai ga kowace ƙasa da yanayin tattalin arziki, a matsayin hanya mai mahimmanci don cimma cikakkiyar kiwon lafiya, inganta kiwon lafiya, kiyaye duniya lafiya, da kuma taimaka wa marasa ƙarfi.Hanyoyin kula da kai suna da hujja, ingantattun kayan aikin da ke tallafawa kula da kai.

Daga baya ya taimaka wajen tsara daya daga cikin ingantattun magunguna na farko kan kwayar cutar da kuma tura alluran rigakafin cutar Ebola na gwaji. Ya yi aiki ba tare da gajiyawa ba don gina karfin kimiyya na Jamhuriyar Demokradiyyar Kongo, kafa cibiyoyin bincike da yawa a kasar, kuma ya taka muhimmiyar rawa tare da WHO wajen yaki da cututtukan cututtuka. Farfesa Piot daga Belgium ana yaba masa saboda jagorancinsa na musamman wajen magance cutar HIV / AIDS da sauran manyan kalubalen kiwon lafiya na duniya. Ya taka muhimmiyar rawa wajen kaddamar da manyan ayyukan kiwon lafiya na duniya kamar UNAIDS, Asusun Duniya, da sauran su wadanda suka inganta sakamakon kiwon lafiya a duniya. A karkashin jagorancinsa, UNAIDS ya zama babban mai ba da shawara ga ayyukan duniya game da cutar AIDS, kuma ya jagoranci sake fasalin Majalisar Dinkin Duniya ta hanyar tattara kungiyoyi 10 daban-daban na Majalisar Dinkin Duniya.

WHO ta taya Benin da Mali murna kan kawar da cutar trachoma a matsayin matsalar lafiyar jama'a WHO ta tabbatar da Benin da Mali a matsayin wadanda suka kawar da cutar trachoma a matsayin matsalar lafiyar jama'a, wanda hakan ya sanya su zama kasashe na biyar da na shida a Yankin Afirka na WHO da suka cimma wannan muhimmin ci gaba. Kasashen da suka riga suka samu tabbacin WHO na kawar da cutar trachoma sune Ghana (Yuni 2018), Gambia (Afrilu 2021), Togo (Mayu 2022) da Malawi (Satumba 2022). "WHO ta taya hukumomin kiwon lafiya na Benin da Mali da kuma cibiyar haɗin gwiwar su na duniya da na gida murna saboda waɗannan nasarorin", in ji Dokta Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, Darakta Janar na WHO. "Bayan nasarar Benin da Mali, cutar trachoma ta kasance a cikin ƙasashe 23 a Yankin Afirka na WHO, wanda ke kawo mu mataki kusa da burin kawar da cutar trachoma da aka sa a cikin taswirar hanya don cututtukan wurare masu zafi 2021-2030. "

Taron Abokan hulɗa ya gudana ne a ƙarshen babban tsarin nazarin aiki a cikin Sashen Kula da Cututtukan da ba a kula da su ba na WHO. A cikin watanni huɗu da suka gabata, WHO ta saurari gudummawa da shaidar daga dukkan abokan hulɗarta da masu ruwa da tsaki, don tabbatar da cewa ita kanta ta ƙunshi ƙimar lissafi, nuna gaskiya da daidaito da take bi da kuma buƙata. Waɗannan ƙimar sun haɗa da tabbatar da cewa an sake sanya NTDs a cikin tsarin kiwon lafiyar duniya. Mahalarta taron sun yi maraba da jaddadawa kan mahimman ayyukan da al'ummar NTD za su iya kuma dole ne su taka rawa wajen ba da gudummawa ga ƙalubalen da suka fi girma kamar Universal Health Coverage, One Health da kuma ƙaruwar barazanar canjin yanayi na duniya. Wakilan da suka halarci taron da kansu sun sami damar jin daɗin baje kolin da aka keɓe ga cututtukan NTD a hedkwatar WHO.

Samun wutar lantarki da tsaftataccen abinci har yanzu suna nuna manyan bambance-bambance na yanki kuma ya kamata ya zama abin da za a mayar da hankali a kai don tabbatar da cewa ba a bar kowa a baya ba. Ana buƙatar saka hannun jari don isa ga ƙasashe marasa ci gaba da Afirka da ke kudu da hamadar Sahara don tabbatar da ci gaba mai daidaito zuwa Manufa ta 7. Stefan Schweinfest, Sashen Kididdiga na Majalisar Dinkin Duniya Duk da cewa an sami jinkiri a kwanan nan a saurin wutar lantarki na duniya, yawan mutanen da ba su da wutar lantarki kusan ya ragu da rabi a cikin shekaru goma da suka gabata, daga biliyan 1.1 a 2010 zuwa miliyan 675 a 2021. Duk da haka, dole ne a gaggauta aiwatar da ƙarin ƙoƙari da matakai don tabbatar da cewa ba a bar mutanen da suka fi talauci da wahalar isa ba. Don cimma damar gama gari a shekarar 2030, al'ummar ci gaba dole ne su haɓaka saka hannun jari na makamashi mai tsabta da tallafin siyasa. Guangzhe Chen, Mataimakin Shugaban Tsarin Gidaje, Bankin Duniya

Kyautar ta girmama nasarorin da suka samu a rayuwarsu a fannin kiwon lafiyar jama'a. Farfesa Muyembe-Tamfum daga Jamhuriyar Demokradiyyar Kongo (DRC) ana yaba masa ne saboda kirkirar sa, jagoranci da kuma gudummawar da ya bayar ga gudanarwa da maganin cututtuka irin su cutar Ebola. Ya taka muhimmiyar rawa wajen inganta sakamakon kiwon lafiya a Jamhuriyar Demokradiyyar Kongo, yankin Afirka, da kuma al'ummar duniya. Farfesa Muyembe-Tamfum shi ne Darakta Janar na Cibiyar Nazarin Kwayoyin Halitta ta DRC a Kinshasa, cikakken Farfesa na ilimin halittu a Jami'ar Kinshasa Medical School kuma shugaban farko na Kwalejin Kimiyya ta Kongo. Farfesa Muyembe-Tamfum yana cikin tawagar da ta gano kwayar cutar Ebola ta Zaire a lokacin barkewar cutar ta farko a shekarar 1976, a lardin Equateur, DRC ta Tsakiya.

"Sabbin kayayyakin kiwon lafiya na dijital da ake ci gaba da su na da nufin taimakawa mutane a ko'ina su sami ingantattun ayyukan kiwon lafiya cikin sauri da inganci". Dangane da Dabarun Kiwon Lafiyar Duniya na EU da Dabarun Duniya na WHO kan kiwon lafiya na dijital, shirin ya biyo bayan yarjejeniyar 30 ga Nuwamba 2022 tsakanin Kwamishina Kyriakides da Dr Tedros don haɓaka haɗin gwiwa kan batutuwan kiwon lafiya na duniya. Wannan ya ƙara ƙarfafa ingantaccen tsarin da ke da alaƙa da WHO a cikin jikinsa, wanda ke da ƙarfin EU mai ƙarfi. "Wannan haɗin gwiwa muhimmin mataki ne ga shirin aiki na dijital na Dabarun Kiwon Lafiyar Duniya na EU. Ta hanyar amfani da kyawawan ayyukan Turai muna ba da gudummawa ga ƙa'idodin kiwon lafiya na dijital da haɗin kai a duniya don amfanin waɗanda suka fi buƙata. Hakanan misali ne mai ƙarfi na yadda daidaitawa tsakanin EU da WHO na iya samar da ingantacciyar lafiya ga kowa, a cikin EU da kuma duniya.

Sabuwar ƙuduri don hanzarta ƙoƙarin kan ƙarfafa abinci mai gina jiki Wakilan sun amince da ƙuduri kan hanzarta ƙoƙarin hana ƙarancin abinci mai gina jiki ta hanyar ingantaccen abinci mai inganci. Rashin ƙarancin bitamin da ma'adanai, musamman na folate, baƙin ƙarfe, bitamin A, da zinc, yana shafar kashi 50% na duk yara masu shekarun makaranta da kashi 67% na duk mata masu haihuwa a duk duniya. Rashin ƙarancin abinci mai gina jiki na iya haifar da mummunan sakamako, gami da spina bifida da sauran lahani na jijiyoyin jiki. Babban ƙarfin abinci na iya zama wani ɓangare na mafita. Ta hanyar ƙara mahimman bitamin da ma'adanai ga manyan abinci da kayan ƙanshi, kamar alkama da masara, shinkafa, man girki da gishiri daidai da tsarin amfani da ƙasa da ƙarancin, ƙasashe na iya gyarawa da ƙarin hana ƙarancin abinci mai gina jiki da aka nuna.

Baya ga mummunan tasirin taba sigari a kan lafiya, jimillar kudin tattalin arzikin shan sigari (daga kashe kudaden kiwon lafiya da asarar yawan aiki tare) an kiyasta su kusan dalar Amurka tiriliyan 1.4 a kowace shekara, kwatankwacin girman 1.8% na yawan kayan cikin gida na shekara-shekara (GDP). Kusan kashi 40% na wannan kudin ya faru ne a kasashe masu tasowa, yana nuna babban nauyin da wadannan kasashe ke fama da shi. Ana amfani da harajin taba sigari a wani bangare don magance wannan tasirin kuma ana ganin shi ne hanya mafi inganci don dakile shan taba sigari, musamman a tsakanin matasa da masu karamin karfi. Karin haraji wanda ke kara farashin taba sigari da kashi 10% yana rage yawan shan taba sigari da kusan kashi 4% a kasashe masu kudin shiga da kuma kusan kashi 5% a kasashe masu karamin karfi da matsakaicin karfi. Amsar WHO: Girman wannan bala'in na mutum da na tattalin arziki abin mamaki ne, amma kuma ana iya hana shi.

Abubuwan da ke faruwa na wutar daji suna kara tsanantawa dangane da kadada da aka ƙone, tsawon lokaci da tsananin, kuma suna iya katse sufuri, sadarwa, samar da ruwa, da wutar lantarki da iskar gas. Tasiri: Wutar daji da ke ƙonewa kusa da wuraren da ake zaune na iya yin tasiri sosai ga muhalli, dukiya, dabbobi da mutuwar mutane da rashin lafiya dangane da girman, saurin da kuma kusanci da wutar, da kuma ko jama'a suna da gargadi mai zurfi don ƙaura. Hayakin wutar daji cakuda ne na gurɓataccen iska wanda ƙwayoyin cuta (PM) shine babban barazanar lafiyar jama'a. PM2.5 daga hayakin wutar daji yana da alaƙa da mutuwar da ta gabata a cikin jama'a gaba ɗaya, kuma yana iya haifar da kuma tsananta cututtukan huhu, zuciya, kwakwalwa / tsarin juyayi, fata, hanji, koda, idanu, hanci da hanta. Hakanan an nuna cewa yana haifar da raunin hankali da asarar ƙwaƙwalwa.

A cikin jawabinsa na rufewa, Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, Darakta Janar na WHO, ya lura cewa "ƙaruwar gudummawar da aka tantance da kuma zagayen saka hannun jari na tarihi ne kuma babban abin tarihi ne". Ya yi magana game da shekara mai zuwa, tare da manyan tarurruka kan kula da lafiyar jama'a, tarin fuka da shirye-shiryen annoba da mayar da martani a Babban Taron Majalisar Dinkin Duniya na wannan shekara. Ya nuna ci gaba da tattaunawa kan yarjejeniyar annoba da gyare-gyare ga Dokokin Kiwon Lafiya na Duniya a matsayin damar da ba a taɓa gani ba don koyo daga kuskuren cutar ta COVID-19 da kuma tabbatar da cewa ba a sake maimaita su ba. Wakilai sun kuma sami damar jin daga tsohon ma'aikacin WHO Gwen Carnelley, wanda ya cika shekaru 100 a wannan shekara, wanda ya fara aiki tare da WHO a 1949, shekara guda bayan da aka kafa WHO shekaru 75 da suka gabata. Bidiyo na Rufe Taron Lafiya na Duniya na 76.

Kafin wannan matsayin, Dr Li ya yi aiki a matsayin Daraktan Gaggawa na Yankin na Shirin Gaggawa na Lafiya na WHO a Ofishin Yankin WHO na Yammacin Pacific. Dr Li yana da digiri na likitanci da digiri a fannin kimiyyar zamantakewar lafiya. Dr Yukiko Nakatani zai zama Mataimakin Darakta-Janar don Samun Magunguna da Kayayyakin Kiwon Lafiya daga ranar 2 ga Mayu 2023. A wannan matsayin Dr Nakatani zai kula da ci gaba da aiwatar da ka'idoji da manufofin WHO don tabbatar da samun damar samun ingantattun magunguna, alluran rigakafi da bincike ga dukkan al'ummomi a ko'ina, gami da rigakafi da amsa annoba. Dr Nakatani ya kasance Daraktan Sashen Kula da Ciwon daji da Cututtuka na Ma'aikatar Lafiya ta Japan, Aiki da Jin Dadi kuma a matsayin Mashawarcin Fasaha ga Ministan Jiha don Aikin Rigakafin COVID-19 a Japan.

Marubutan sun bukaci al'ummar kasa da kasa da masu tsara manufofi da su kiyaye nasarorin da aka samu wajen cimma SDG 7, don ci gaba da sauye-sauyen tsarin, da kuma ci gaba da mayar da hankali kan kasashe masu rauni da ke bukatar tallafi mafi yawa. "Rikicin makamashi da aka haifar da mamayar Rasha a Ukraine ya ci gaba da yin tasiri sosai ga mutane a duk faɗin duniya. Babban farashin makamashi ya shafi mafi rauni sosai, musamman waɗanda ke cikin tattalin arziƙi masu tasowa. Yayin da sauyin makamashi mai tsabta ke tafiya da sauri fiye da yadda mutane da yawa ke tsammani, har yanzu akwai aiki mai yawa da ake buƙata don samar da ci gaba, amintacce da samun damar samun sabis na makamashi na zamani ga biliyoyin mutanen da ke rayuwa ba tare da shi ba. Nasarar sauye-sauyen makamashi ya dogara da ingantattun manufofi da ƙwarewar fasaha haɗe da babban ƙarfin saka hannun jari.

A matsayin hukumar gudanarwa da daidaitawa kan aikin kiwon lafiya na kasa da kasa, babu wani abokin tarayya da ya fi WHO inganta aikin da muka fara a EU da kuma kara bunkasa hanyoyin magance lafiyar dijital na duniya, "in ji Stella Kyriakides, Kwamishinan Lafiya da Tsaron Abinci. Wannan haɗin gwiwar zai haɗa da haɗin kai a cikin ci gaba, gudanarwa da aiwatar da tsarin GDHCN na WHO, yana amfana daga ƙwarewar fasaha na Hukumar Tarayyar Turai a fagen. Mataki na farko shi ne tabbatar da cewa takaddun shaida na dijital na EU na yanzu suna ci gaba da aiki yadda ya kamata. Tare da ƙasashe 80 da yankuna da ke da alaƙa da EU Digital COVID-19 Certificate, EU ta kafa mizanin duniya. Takaddun shaida na EU ba kawai ya kasance muhimmin kayan aiki ba a cikin yaƙinmu da annoba, amma kuma ya sauƙaƙe tafiye-tafiye da yawon shakatawa na duniya.

Haɗin kai a cikin gida shine mabuɗin ci gaba a duniya game da SDGs da suka shafi kiwon lafiya An fitar da sabon rahoton ci gaba tare a yau ta hanyar hukumomin 13 da suka sanya hannu kan Shirin Ayyukan Duniya don Rayuwa Mai Lafiya da Jin Daɗi ga Kowa (SDG3 GAP). Rahoton mai taken "Me ya yi aiki? Me bai yi aiki ba? Menene na gaba?" yana nuna shekaru huɗu na haɗin gwiwar manyan hukumomin ƙasashe da yawa da ke nuna abin da ya yi aiki da abin da bai yi aiki ba wajen ƙarfafa haɗin gwiwa da tallafi don hanzarta ci gaban ƙasa zuwa Manufofin Ci Gaban Dorewa (SDGs) da suka shafi kiwon lafiya. A wannan shekara alama ce ta rabin hanya zuwa SDGs, amma duniya tana baya don cimma burin duniya. Tun lokacin da aka ƙaddamar da shi a cikin 2019, SDG3 GAP ya ba da damar ƙirƙirar sabbin tsarin haɗin gwiwa tsakanin hukumomin da suka sanya hannu a cikin mahimman fannoni kamar kuɗi mai ɗorewa da kulawa da lafiya na farko da sauransu.

Mutanen da ke da bukatun kiwon lafiya suna "barin baya cikin ciwo" ya bayyana sabon rahoto Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya (WHO) ta wallafa wani sabon rahoto kan samun damar amfani da morphine don amfanin likita, wanda ke bayyana yadda rarraba morphine a duniya, a matsayin magani mai mahimmanci na ciwo, ba daidai ba ne kuma ba ya biyan bukatun likita. Rahoton, mai taken "Barin baya cikin ciwo", ya nuna matsalolin samun wannan magani mai mahimmanci kuma ya ba da shawarwari don inganta samun damar amfani da shi ta hanyar daidaitaccen manufofi. Duk da cewa morphine magani ne mai inganci kuma mai rahusa don rage ciwo mai tsanani, wanda aka lissafa tun 1977 a cikin bugu na farko na jerin magungunan WHO na Magunguna Masu Muhimmanci, bambancin samun dama a tsakanin ƙasashe ya yi tsanani. Akwai bambanci 5 zuwa 63 a cikin ƙididdigar matsakaicin amfani da morphine tsakanin ƙasashe masu samun kuɗi da ƙasashe masu ƙarancin kuɗi.

Abubuwan da suka danganci shekarun mahaifiyar da kuma yin shan sigari na iya kara hadarin kamuwa da cututtukan mahaifa da mutuwar jariri. Ana iya hana mutuwar jariri ta hanyar tsara iyali don kauce wa ciki da ba a so, lafiya mai kyau da abinci mai gina jiki kafin da lokacin daukar ciki, inganci da kulawa mai daraja kafin haihuwa da haihuwa gami da isassun ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya masu ƙwarewa gami da ungozoma. Maganin syphilis a lokacin daukar ciki na iya hana kimanin mutuwar jariri 200 000, yayin da sa ido kan bugun zuciya na jariri da sa ido kan haihuwa da saurin shiga tsakani lokacin da ake buƙata suna da mahimmanci don hana mutuwar jariri 832 000 a lokacin haihuwa da rage mutuwar jarirai. Mutuwar jariri tana da alaƙa da mummunan yanayin zamantakewa da tattalin arziki na kiwon lafiya. Dole ne a haɗa rigakafi da kulawa mai amsawa a duk faɗin tsarin kula da lafiyar mahaifa, da kuma bayan haka.

Wanda ya lashe lambar yabo ta Nelson Mandela don Inganta Kiwon Lafiya 2023: Dr Mariam Athbi Al Jalahma daga Bahrain Baya ga kasancewa Babban Jami'in Hukumar Kula da Kiwon Lafiya ta Kasa ta Bahrain, Dr Mariam Athbi Al Jalahma ta rike mukaman jagoranci daban-daban a cikin gwamnati da cibiyoyin ilimi a kasarta. Dr Al Jalahma ta taka muhimmiyar rawa wajen haɓaka dabaru da tsare-tsare da yawa na ƙasa da na yanki a fagen kiwon lafiya na farko, lafiyar yara da matasa, cututtuka na yau da kullun da maganin shan sigari. A cikin rawar da take takawa yanzu, Dr Al Jalahma ta jagoranci manyan ayyukan nasara, kamar tsarin amincewa da ƙasa don cibiyoyin kiwon lafiya, canjin dijital na Hukumar Kula da Kiwon Lafiya ta Kasa, da kuma ayyuka da yawa da ke haifar da haɓaka inganci da ƙwarewa a fannin kiwon lafiya.

Rahoton Landmark ya tsara hanyar da za a sake tsara tattalin arzikin don samar da kiwon lafiya ga kowa A cikin rahoton farko irin wannan, Majalisar WHO kan Tattalin Arzikin Kiwon Lafiya ga Kowa ta tsara wata sabuwar hanya mai karfin gwiwa don sake tsara tattalin arzikin don samar da abin da ke da muhimmanci - kiwon lafiya ga kowa. Majalisar, wacce Darakta Janar na WHO Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus ya kirkira a watan Nuwamba 2020 don mayar da martani ga annobar COVID-19, kuma Farfesa Mariana Mazzucato ke jagoranta, ta shafe shekaru biyu na ƙarshe tana sake tunani game da tattalin arzikin daga hangen nesa na kiwon lafiya ga kowa, kuma tana matsa lamba da ƙarfi kan ƙa'idar cewa lafiyar ɗan adam da na duniya dole ne su kasance a zuciyar yadda muke tsara tsarin zamantakewarmu, kiwon lafiya da tattalin arzikinmu. Majalisar ta gabatar da sabon labari mai ƙarfin gaske wanda ke da tushe a cikin sabon hikimar tattalin arziki don sake tsara tattalin arzikin don samar da kiwon lafiya ga kowa a cikin jigogi huɗu masu alaƙa:

Manufar dabarar ita ce tallafawa kasashe mambobin kungiyar wajen samar da manufofi masu inganci da aiwatar da tsare-tsaren ayyukan da za su karfafa rawar da magungunan gargajiya ke takawa wajen kiyaye lafiyar jama'a. Don magance kalubalen, amsa bukatun da kasashe mambobin kungiyar suka gano da kuma gina kan aikin da aka yi a karkashin dabarun magungunan gargajiya na WHO: 2002-2005, da kuma sabunta dabarun na 2014-2023 ya ba da hankali fiye da wanda ya gabace shi wajen fifita ayyukan kiwon lafiya da tsarin kiwon lafiya, gami da magungunan gargajiya da na kariya, ayyuka da masu aikatawa. Manufofin dabarun sune: Don gina tushen ilimi don gudanar da T&CM ta hanyar manufofin kasa masu dacewa; Don karfafa tabbatar da inganci, aminci, amfani da inganci na T&CM ta hanyar tsara kayayyaki, ayyuka da masu aikatawa;

A cikin tsari mai kama da haka, Afrigen zai ci gaba da gudanar da horo da canja wurin fasaha ga abokan hulɗar cibiyar sadarwa. Masu ba da kuɗi suna taka muhimmiyar rawa wajen tallafawa Shirin tare da jimillar kuɗi har zuwa yau a dalar Amurka miliyan 117 kuma Faransa ita ce ta farko da ta ba da kuɗin aikin canja wurin fasahar mRNA. Wakilan da ke halartar taron sun haɗa da wakilan Hukumar Tarayyar Turai, Belgium, Jamus, da Norway, Kanada, Tarayyar Afirka, Afirka ta Kudu, da Gidauniyar ELMA. Caroline Delany, Darakta Janar na GlobalAffairs Canada na Kudancin da Gabashin Afirka ya ce: "Kanada ta sake tabbatar da ci gaba da tallafawa Shirin Canja wurin Fasahar mRNA kuma muna farin cikin sanar da ƙarin gudummawar dalar Kanada miliyan 15 a taron yau. Wannan ya kawo jimillar gudummawar Kanada ga Shirin har zuwa dalar Kanada miliyan 45.

Ana buƙatar ɗaukar matakan gaggawa don magance ci gaban da ya tsaya a kan Manufofin Ci Gaban Lafiya da ke da alaƙa da lafiya WHO tana fitar da bugu na 2023 na rahoton ƙididdigar lafiyar duniya na shekara-shekara tare da sabbin ƙididdiga game da tasirin cutar ta COVID-19 da sabbin ƙididdiga game da ci gaba zuwa Manufofin Ci Gaban Lafiya da ke da alaƙa da lafiya (SDGs). Rahoton tare da bayanai har zuwa 2022 yana jaddada jinkirin ci gaban kiwon lafiya a kan mahimman alamun kiwon lafiya a cikin 'yan shekarun nan idan aka kwatanta da yanayin da aka gani a lokacin 2000-2015. Hakanan yana faɗakar da mu game da ƙaruwar barazanar cututtukan da ba a iya yaduwa ba (NCDs) da canjin yanayi, kuma yana kira ga daidaitawa da ƙarfafa martani. Kudin COVID-19 a cikin rayukan da aka rasa da ci gaban kiwon lafiya Rahoton ya rubuta sabbin ƙididdiga game da ƙarancin cutar a kan lafiyar duniya, yana ba da gudummawa ga ci gaba da raguwar ci gaba zuwa SDGs.

An ba da lambobin yabo ga fitattun masu ba da gudummawa ga lafiyar jama'a a yayin taron lafiya na duniya na saba'in da shida A yayin wani biki mai ban sha'awa a taron lafiya na duniya na saba'in da shida a Geneva, an ba da lambobin yabo ga mutane da cibiyoyi daga ko'ina cikin duniya saboda gagarumar gudummawar da suka bayar ga lafiyar jama'a. "Lambobin yabo na lafiyar jama'a na 2023 da lambobin yabo suna bikin mutanen da suka ba da gudummawa mai mahimmanci ga lafiyar duniya, kuma aikinsu ya wuce kiran aikin yau da kullun", in ji Dokta Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, Darakta Janar na WHO. "A lokacin da duniya ke fuskantar kalubale da yawa, kowannensu abin karfafawa ne da tunatarwa game da ci gaban da za a iya samu don inganta lafiya da walwala ga kowa. "Ana aika da kiran neman 'yan takara don kowace lambar yabo a kowace shekara bayan rufe taron lafiya na duniya.

Ma'anoni: WHO ta kasance tana aiki a fannin kiwon lafiyar jima'i tun aƙalla 1974, lokacin da tattaunawar kwamitin ƙwararru ta haifar da buga wani rahoto na fasaha mai taken "Ilimi da magani a cikin jima'i na ɗan adam" (WHO, 1975). Farawa a 2000, Hukumar Kiwon Lafiya ta Pan American (PAHO) da WHO sun kira wasu shawarwari na ƙwararru don nazarin kalmomin da kuma gano zaɓuɓɓukan shirye-shirye. Ƙarshen waɗannan tarurruka shi ne Tattaunawar Fasaha a 2002, inda aka tsara ma'anar aiki na mahimman kalmomin da suka shafi kiwon lafiyar jima'i a ƙasa. Jima'i: Jima'i yana nufin halayen halittu waɗanda ke bayyana mutane a matsayin mace ko namiji. Yayin da waɗannan saitin halayen halittu ba su da bambanci, kamar yadda akwai mutane waɗanda ke da duka biyun, suna nuna bambanci tsakanin mutane a matsayin maza da mata.

Taron Lafiya na Duniya na 76  27 Mayu 2023 27 Mayu 2023 Dabarun Duniya na farko kan rigakafin kamuwa da cuta da kuma shawo kan cutarTaron Lafiya na Duniya ya amince a yau kan dabarun duniya na farko kan rigakafin kamuwa da cuta da kuma shawo kan cutar (IPC), wanda ya gina kan kusan shekaru ashirin na kokarin da WHO da abokan hulda suka jagoranta. Dabarar ta samar wa kasashe mambobin da jagororin dabarun don rage yawan hadarin da ke tattare da cututtukan kiwon lafiya (HAIs), gami da wadanda ke nuna juriya ga maganin ƙwayoyin cuta. HAIs na daga cikin abubuwan da suka fi faruwa a cikin yanayin bayar da sabis na kiwon lafiya. Cutar COVID-19 da manyan barkewar cututtuka na baya-bayan nan kamar cutar Ebola, cutar numfashi ta Gabas ta Tsakiya da cutar kwayar cutar Sudan sun bayyana gibin da ke akwai a cikin shirye-shiryen IPC a duk ƙasashe.

Ina godiya ga WHO don share fagen sabon bincike da samar da dandalin su na duniya don yada kalmar da samar da bincike kan haɗin fasaha da lafiya. "Ina fatan duk yiwuwar yin aiki mai mahimmanci a ƙasata ta Afirka ta Kudu da kuma duniya don kyakkyawar gobe mai lafiya," in ji Yende. Nadin Fleming da Yende ya jaddada zurfin alaƙar da ke tsakanin fasaha da lafiya. Shiga cikin ayyukan kirkira, kamar kiɗa, zane-zane, da rawa, yana da tasiri mai kyau ga lafiyar jiki, lafiyar hankali, jin daɗin zamantakewa, da ingancin rayuwa gaba ɗaya. Ta hanyar matsayinsu na Jakadun Alheri, Fleming da Yende za su inganta haɗin gwiwar fasaha a cikin tsarin kiwon lafiya, su ba da shawara don samun damar maganin fasaha, kuma su yi gwagwarmaya da mahimmancin bayyanar fasaha wajen inganta sakamakon kiwon lafiya a duniya.

Tetanus da ke faruwa yayin daukar ciki ko tsakanin makonni 6 na ƙarshen ciki ana kiransa tetanus na uwa, yayin da tetanus da ke faruwa a cikin kwanaki 28 na farko na rayuwa ana kiransa neonatal tetanus. Cutar ta kasance muhimmiyar matsalar lafiyar jama'a a sassa da yawa na duniya, amma musamman a ƙasashe masu ƙarancin kuɗi ko gundumomi, inda ɓoyayyen rigakafi ke da ƙaranci kuma ayyukan haihuwa marasa tsabta suna da yawa. WHO ta kiyasta cewa a cikin 2018 (shekarar ƙarshe da aka samu ƙididdigar), jarirai 25 000 sun mutu daga tetanus na jarirai, raguwar 88% daga halin da ake ciki a 2000. Alamomi da alamun tetanus suna bayyana a kowane lokaci daga kwanaki 3 zuwa 21 bayan ƙwayoyin cuta na tetanus sun shiga jiki ta hanyar rauni.

Manyan nade-naden shugabanci da aka yi don jagorantar dabarun WHO da manufofinta Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya (WHO) ta nada sabbin manyan jami'ai biyar a cikin tawagar shugabancin hedkwatarta a Geneva. Sabbin nade-naden sun biyo bayan sake nada Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus zuwa wa'adinsa na biyu na shekaru biyar a matsayin Darakta Janar. An karfafa tawagar shugabanci gaba daya don daidaitawa da abubuwan da Kungiyar ta fi mayar da hankali a cikin shekaru biyar masu zuwa kuma za ta yi aiki tare da Darakta Janar don ciyar da wadannan abubuwan gaba da kuma ajandar canji na WHO. Don hanzarta ci gaba kan aiwatar da Babban Shirin Aiki na 13 na WHO (GPW13), da cimma burinta na "biliyan uku" da kuma manufofin ci gaba da suka shafi kiwon lafiya, aikin WHO na shekaru biyar masu zuwa ya mai da hankali kan manyan abubuwa biyar:

Majalisar Lafiya ta Duniya ta 76 za ta mai da hankali kan "ceton rayuka, inganta kiwon lafiya ga kowa" yayin da WHO ke cika shekaru 75 Yayin da duniya ke fuskantar ci gaba da gaggawa na kiwon lafiya da na jin kai, Majalisar Lafiya ta Duniya ta 76 za ta mai da hankali kan ci gaba da inganta kiwon lafiya ga kowa. Taron wannan shekara na Majalisar Lafiya ta Duniya zai tantance makomar WHO nan gaba da kuma na dogon lokaci, farawa da kasafin kudin shirin na shekaru biyu masu zuwa, mahimman shawarwari game da kudaden ci gaba na Kungiyar da canje-canje da aka sanya don inganta ayyukan WHO da lissafi. Wakilan za su kuma yi la'akari da muhimmiyar rawar da WHO ke takawa a Tsarin Gaggawa na Kiwon Lafiya na Duniya. Bayanin waɗannan batutuwan shine bikin cika shekaru 75 na kungiyar, tare da manyan nasarorin da ta samu na kiwon lafiya na duniya tun lokacin da aka kafa WHO a 1948.

Duk da haka, annobar ta sanya alamomi da yawa da suka shafi kiwon lafiya suka koma baya kuma sun ba da gudummawa ga rashin daidaito wajen samun ingantaccen kiwon lafiya, allurar rigakafi na yau da kullun da kariya ta kudi. A sakamakon haka, an juya yanayin inganta cutar zazzabin cizon sauro da tarin fuka, kuma mutane kalilan ne aka kula da su don cututtukan da ba a san su ba (NTDs). "Kididdigar Kiwon Lafiya ta Duniya ita ce binciken shekara-shekara na WHO game da yanayin kiwon lafiyar duniya. Rahoton ya aika da sako mai ban tsoro game da barazanar cututtukan da ba a san su ba, wadanda ke da matukar tasiri ga rayuka, rayuwa, tsarin kiwon lafiya, al'ummomi, tattalin arziki da al'ummomi", in ji Dokta Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, Darakta Janar na WHO. "Rahoton ya yi kira da a kara yawan zuba jari a harkar kiwon lafiya da tsarin kiwon lafiya don komawa kan hanya zuwa Manufofin Ci Gaban Dorewa. "

Jima'i: Ba za a iya ayyana lafiyar jima'i ba, fahimta ko yin aiki ba tare da yin la'akari da jima'i ba, wanda ke haifar da mahimman halaye da sakamako masu alaƙa da lafiyar jima'i. Ma'anar aiki na jima'i ita ce: "...wani muhimmin bangare na kasancewa mutum a duk rayuwa ya ƙunshi jima'i, asalin jinsi da matsayin, yanayin jima'i, sha'awa, jin daɗi, kusanci da haifuwa. Ana fuskantar jima'i kuma ana bayyana shi a cikin tunani, mafarki, sha'awa, imani, halaye, dabi'u, halaye, ayyuka, matsayi da alaƙa. Yayin da jima'i na iya haɗawa da duk waɗannan fannoni, ba duka ba ne koyaushe ake fuskanta ko bayyanawa. Jima'i yana tasiri ta hanyar hulɗar ilimin halitta, ilimin halayyar mutum, zamantakewa, tattalin arziki, siyasa, al'adu, doka, tarihi, addini da ruhaniya. " (WHO, 2006a)

tallafawa kasashe wajen bunkasa shirye-shiryen kula da lafiyar dan adam na kasa ko na yanki don sunadarai masu damuwa.Dokar da ta shafi: A76/A/CONF./2 - Tasirin sunadarai, sharar gida da gurbatawa kan lafiyar dan adam Ayyukan WHO kan aminci da lafiyar sunadarai Samun walwala: tsarin duniyaKasashe membobin sun amince da "Tsarin duniya don haɗa walwala cikin lafiyar jama'a ta amfani da tsarin inganta lafiya", wanda ke ƙoƙarin ba wa dukkan mutane damar bunƙasa da cimma cikakkiyar lafiyar jiki da tunani a duk tsawon rayuwarsu da tsakanin tsararraki. Tsarin duniya ya ba da shawarar manyan hanyoyi guda shida waɗanda ke mai da hankali kan: kula da lafiyar jama'a, tattalin arziki mai adalci, kare duniya, tsarin kariya na zamantakewa, tsarin dijital don ba da damar lafiya, da auna da kuma kula da walwala.

"Argentina ta saka hannun jari sosai wajen gina karfin kasarmu a fannin kwayoyin cuta da kuma karfin wasu kasashe", in ji Josefina Campos, Daraktan Cibiyar Nazarin Kwayoyin Halitta da Bayanai ta Kasa a ANLIS Malbrán, Argentina. "Cututtuka ba sa mutunta iyakoki: barazanar cuta a wata kasa ma barazana ce ga wasu. Muna fatan yin aiki tare da mambobin IPSN don cimma burinmu na hana cututtuka da ceton rayuka. IPSN za ta magance wadannan kalubalen ta hanyar cibiyar sadarwa ta duniya, ta haɗa yankuna da cibiyoyin da ke da alaƙa da cututtuka, don gina tsarin haɗin gwiwa don ingantaccen ganowa, rigakafi da kuma magance barazanar cututtuka. Mambobin za su yi aiki tare a cikin ƙungiyoyi na musamman da ke mai da hankali kan takamaiman kalubale, tare da tallafin kuɗi ta hanyar IPSN don haɓaka ra'ayoyi da ayyukan a fannin kwayoyin cuta.

Kamuwa da cuta mai matukar karfi na iya haifar da toshewar hanji wanda yakamata a yi masa tiyata.S. stercoralis na iya haifar da cututtukan fata da na hanji kuma an san shi da alaƙa da rashin abinci mai gina jiki a cikin yara.Idan akwai raguwar rigakafin mai gida, kwayar cutar na iya haifar da cutar hyperinfection / dissemination syndrome wanda koyaushe yana da lahani idan ba a warkar da shi da sauri da kuma yadda ya kamata ba kuma sau da yawa yana da lahani duk da magani.A shekara ta 2001, wakilai a Majalisar Lafiya ta Duniya sun amince da ƙuduri (WHA54.19) suna roƙon ƙasashe masu fama da cutar su fara magance tsutsotsi da gaske, musamman cutar schistosomiasis da helminths da ake yadawa ta ƙasa.Dabarar kula da cututtukan helminths ta ƙasa ita ce kula da rashin lafiya ta hanyar maganin lokaci-lokaci na mutanen da ke cikin haɗari da ke zaune a yankunan da cutar ta fi yawa.

Muhimman shawarwari sun hada da: Muna bukatar mu daraja da kuma auna abubuwan da suke da muhimmanci - ci gaban mutane da na duniya - maimakon neman ci gaban tattalin arziki da kara yawan GDP ba tare da la'akari da sakamakon ba. Don cimma lafiya ga kowa, dole ne gwamnatoci su sake tunani game da darajar da kuma sake fasalin tattalin arziki bisa ga zamantakewar al'umma da na duniya, wanda sabbin ma'auni ke jagoranta. Ana buƙatar sake fasalin tsarin ƙasa da na duniya don tallafawa kiwon lafiya, don haka kashe kuɗi a kan kiwon lafiya ana ɗaukarsa azaman saka hannun jari na dogon lokaci. Samar da Kiwon Lafiya ga Kowa zai buƙaci ƙarin kuɗi, da kuma ingantaccen kuɗi. Innovation yana buƙatar ƙwarewar gama gari - ba zai taɓa zama amfanin kamfani ɗaya ko hukumar gwamnati ba. Amma sai dai idan an sarrafa kirkire-kirkire don amfanin jama'a, mutane da yawa sun kasance ba su da fa'idodi.

Furannin mambobin da ke cikin tawagar shugabancin hedkwatar: Dr Samira Asma za ta ci gaba a matsayin Mataimakiyar Darakta-Janar don Bayanai, Nazari da Isar da Tasiri. Dr Asma tana kula da wani furotin wanda ke tabbatar da cewa bayanan kiwon lafiya abin dogaro ne kuma mai sauki, kuma ana amfani da su don inganta sakamakon kiwon lafiya a duk duniya, gami da bin diddigin da hanzarta ci gaba zuwa burin biliyan uku da kuma Manufofin Ci Gaban Lafiya da suka shafi kiwon lafiya. Kafin shiga WHO a 2018, Dr Asma ta rike mukaman jagoranci a Cibiyar Kula da Cututtuka da Rigakafin Cututtuka ta Amurka (CDC) sama da shekaru ashirin. Tana da digiri na digiri a fannin tiyata na hakori da digiri na biyu a fannin kiwon lafiyar jama'a. Dr Bruce Aylward an nada shi Mataimakin Darakta-Janar na Universal Health Coverage, Life Course Division tun daga ranar 4 ga Mayu 2023.

Shahararrun masu fasaha Renée Fleming da Pretty Yende da aka nada a matsayin Jakadun Kyautatawa na WHO don Fasaha da Lafiya WHO tana farin cikin sanar da nadin mashahuran masu fasaha na duniya Renée Fleming da Pretty Yende a matsayin Jakadun Kyautatawa na Fasaha da Lafiya. An yi wannan sanarwa mai daraja a matsayin wani ɓangare na bikin tunawa da shekaru 75 na WHO yayin Babban Taron Lafiya na Duniya na 76 a ranar 22 ga Mayu 2023. Renée Fleming, ɗaya daga cikin shahararrun mawaƙa na zamaninmu, da Pretty Yende, soprano mai ban mamaki da aka sani da wasan kwaikwayonta mai ban mamaki, an zaɓe su don nasarorin fasaha da bayar da shawarwari don inganta sakamakon kiwon lafiya ta hanyar kirkira. A ranar 8 ga Afrilu 2023, Fleming da Yende sun yi waƙa ta musamman mai taken Healing Arts, wanda aka keɓe don bikin cika shekaru 75 na WHO a Geneva, Switzerland.

sake farfadowa; maganin gargajiya, da aikin WHO na amsa dubban matsalolin gaggawa yayin da suke aiki tare da kasashe mambobin don su kasance cikin shiri sosai don fuskantar sababbin matsaloli. A farkon ranar, wakilai a cikin Kwamitin A sun amince da lura da taswirar hanya zuwa shirin kiwon lafiya da zaman lafiya na duniya (tare da ɗan canji a cikin suna daga "Global Health for Peace Initiative"), kuma sun nemi Darakta-Janar ya ba da rahoto game da ci gaban da aka samu wajen ƙarfafa taswirar hanya. A cikin cikakken taro, a matsayin matakin amincewa na ƙarshe na taron, wakilai sun amince da ƙuduri da yanke shawara na kwamitocin biyu, kuma sun amince da rahotannin su. Wannan ya haɗa da amincewa da kasafin kuɗi na 2024-25, da ƙaruwar kashi 20% a cikin gudummawar da aka tantance. Shugabannin kwamitin da wakilai daga yankuna biyu sun yi magana don gane aikin da ci gaban wannan Majalisar.

IPSN na hangen nesa na duniya inda kowace ƙasa ke da damar samun daidaito ga ƙarfin ci gaba don tsarin jerin kwayoyin halitta da nazari a matsayin wani ɓangare na tsarin sa ido kan lafiyar jama'a. Yana da niyyar ƙirƙirar cibiyar sadarwar duniya mai tallafawa juna na masu sa ido kan kwayoyin halitta wanda ke faɗaɗa da hanzarta aikin membobinta don haɓaka samun dama da daidaito. IPSN ta ƙunshi manyan hukumomin aiki guda uku waɗanda ke haɗuwa da nau'ikan masu ruwa da tsaki daban-daban, wanda Sakatariyar ke tallafawa a Cibiyar Cutar ta WHO. Abokan hulɗa suna aiki tare a cikin Al'ummomin Ayyuka (COPs) don magance ƙalubalen gama gari, da nufin haɓaka daidaito da kirkire-kirkire a cikin kwayoyin halittar cuta. A cikin Country Scale-Up Accelerator (CSUA), masu ruwa da tsaki suna aiki tare don daidaita ƙoƙari da ba da damar musayar Kudu-Kudu don haɓaka haɓaka ƙarfin ƙasa.

Kula da Kiwon Lafiyar Duniya hakki ne mai matukar muhimmanci, hakkin dan adam ne ga kowa a duniya. "An kuma ba da kyaututtuka na musamman guda hudu ga fim din da dalibi ya shirya, fim kan Canjin Yanayi da Lafiya, fim kan Lafiya da Hakkokin Jima'i da Haihuwa da kuma Fim mai gajarta. Jigon lafiyar kwakwalwa ya bayyana sosai a cikin shigarwar da suka ci nasara a wannan shekara, gami da wani gajeren fim mai karfi daga Sweden game da damuwa da bakin ciki. Fim din, wanda aka saita shi da sauti mai motsawa, ya nuna jerin 'yan wasan da ke nuna matakai daban-daban na damuwa da yadda zai iya bayyana kansa. Babban sakon shine cewa ba kai kaɗai kake fuskantar tunani mara kyau ba kuma ba laifi ba ne a yarda da irin wannan jin daɗin. Wani fim mai nasara, daga Bangladesh, ya nuna wani saurayi wanda ya fuskanci gubar daga masana'antar gida.

Bayan wani lokaci mara alamun cutar na kwanaki 1 zuwa 20 har zuwa kashi 15% na marasa lafiya suna fuskantar mataki na biyu na cutar wanda ke nuna zazzabi sau da yawa ya wuce 40 °C da alamun shigar da tsarin juyayi na tsakiya, kamar meningitis (misali zazzabi, ciwon kai, da wuyar wuya), encephalitis (misali, bacci, rikicewa, da rikicewar hankali), myelitis ko radiculitis. Encephalitis da ke tasowa a wannan mataki na biyu na iya haifar da shanyewar jiki, sakamako na dindindin ko mutuwa. Kimanin kashi 1% na lokuta tare da cututtukan jijiyoyin jiki na iya mutuwa; an ba da rahoton yawan mace-mace daga tarayyar Rasha, wanda zai iya kasancewa da alaƙa da nau'in kwayar cuta daban. Tsananin cutar yana ƙaruwa tare da shekarun mara lafiya, amma an ba da rahoton mutuwar daga duk rukunin shekaru. Babu takamaiman magani don encephalitis da ke haifar da kuraje.

An bukaci kasashe mambobin kungiyar da su karfafa aiwatar da dabarun WHO da ake da su da suka hada da aiwatar da Tsarin Kimiyyar WHO wanda ya bayyana muhimman ayyukan bangaren kiwon lafiya wajen aiwatar da Tsarin Dabarun Gudanar da Sinadarai na Duniya. Manufofin sufuri da saka hannun jari da ke fifita tsaftataccen sufuri na jama'a, tare da tafiya da keke, na iya yin tasiri sosai ga ingancin iska. Wannan na iya rage haɗarin lafiya da yawa a lokaci guda, gami da bugun jini, bugun zuciya, cututtukan huhu da wasu nau'in ciwon daji. Hakanan suna iya rage kimanin mutuwar miliyan 1.25 a kowace shekara daga raunin zirga-zirga, yayin da kuma inganta samun sabis na kiwon lafiya, musamman a yankunan da ke da yawan jama'a. Manufofin gidaje na ci gaba na iya kara rage fitar da hayaki ta hanyar la'akari da gine-gine da amfani da ƙasa, zaɓin kayan gini, fasalin zane da iska da makamashi. Amsar WHO: Ayyukan WHO suna jagorantar Manufofin Ci Gaban Ci Gaban, musamman Manufa ta 3: "Tabbatar da rayuwa mai kyau da inganta walwala ga kowa a kowane zamani".

Bukatun da ba su dace ba na iya kawo cikas ga samun damar marasa lafiya saboda suna hana kwararar samarwa ko sanya tsarawa da bayarwa da wahala ga kwararrun masu kula da lafiya.Yana da mahimmanci a lura cewa damuwa game da yuwuwar illar da opioids ke haifarwa yana da inganci, kamar yuwuwar haifar da rikicewar amfani da opioid.Saboda wannan dalili, wani adadin taka tsantsan game da yuwuwar cutar da amfani da opioid (misali amfani a cikin ciwo mai tsanani wanda ba na kansa ba) yana da mahimmanci ga lafiyar jama'a tunda amfani da shi an san shi sosai kuma ya dace da haɗari.Irin waɗannan damuwar bai kamata su lalata fa'idodin amfani da opioid ba lokacin da aka nuna asibiti da lokacin da ƙwararrun ƙwararru ke amfani da shi cikin aminci. Damar aikiRahoton ya gabatar da ƙarin ɓangarorin aiki waɗanda ke da nufin inganta samun damar amfani da morphine.

WHO da Jamhuriyar Koriya sun rattaba hannu kan yarjejeniya mai mahimmanci don haɓaka ƙarfin ƙirar halittu WHO da Jamhuriyar Koriya sun sanya hannu kan yarjejeniyar fahimtar juna don kafa cibiyar horarwa ta duniya a cikin ƙirar halittu. Wannan cibiyar horarwa ta duniya za ta yi wa dukkan ƙasashe masu ƙarancin kuɗi da matsakaici (LMICs) hidima don samar da halittu, kamar alluran rigakafi, insulin, ƙwayoyin rigakafi na monoclonal, da magungunan kansar. Cutar COVID-19 ta nuna buƙatar faɗaɗa samar da alluran rigakafi na gida da na yanki da sauran samfuran kiwon lafiya masu mahimmanci a cikin LMICs don tabbatar da samun daidaito. Don samar wa ƙasashe ƙwarewa don samar da alluran rigakafin mRNA cikin sauri, WHO, tare da haɗin gwiwar abokan hulɗa, sun kafa shirin Canja wurin Fasahar mRNA, tare da ƙaddamar da cibiyar Hub a Afirka ta Kudu a watan Afrilu 2023.

A cikin amfani na yau da kullun a cikin harsuna da yawa, ana amfani da kalmar jima'i sau da yawa don nufin "aikin jima'i", amma don dalilai na fasaha a cikin mahallin jima'i da tattaunawar lafiyar jima'i, an fi son ma'anar da ke sama. Lafiya ta jima'i Dangane da ma'anar aiki na yanzu, lafiyar jima'i ita ce: "... yanayin lafiyar jiki, motsin rai, tunani da zamantakewa dangane da jima'i; ba wai kawai rashin cuta, rashin aiki ko rashin lafiya ba. Lafiya ta jima'i tana buƙatar kyakkyawar hanya da girmamawa ga jima'i da alaƙar jima'i, da kuma yiwuwar samun kwarewar jima'i mai daɗi da aminci, ba tare da tilastawa, nuna bambanci da tashin hankali ba. Don samun lafiyar jima'i da kiyayewa, dole ne a mutunta, karewa da cika haƙƙin jima'i na kowa. " (WHO, 2006a)

Samarwa da yada takardun jagororin fasaha da ke da hujja, ka'idoji da ka'idoji don hanawa da kuma mayar da martani ga cin zarafin yara. A kai a kai ana wallafa rahotannin matsayin duniya kan kokarin da kasashe ke yi na magance cin zarafin yara ta hanyar manufofin kasa da tsare-tsaren aiki, dokoki, shirye-shiryen rigakafi da ayyukan amsawa. Taimakawa kasashe da abokan hulda wajen aiwatar da dabarun rigakafi da amsawa bisa hujja, kamar wadanda aka hada a cikin INSPIRE: Dabaru bakwai don kawo karshen cin zarafin yara. Yin aiki tare da hukumomi da kungiyoyi na kasa da kasa don rage da kawar da cin zarafin yara a duniya, ta hanyar shirye-shirye kamar su Global Partnership to End Violence against Children, Global Partnership to End Violence against Children,

A cikin mutane, ƙaruwar haɗarin UV na iya haifar da cutar kansa ta fata, cataracts da lalacewar tsarin garkuwar jiki.Rigakafi: Ƙaruwar adadin masu cutar kansa na fata a cikin shekarun da suka gabata yana da alaƙa da ƙaruwar haɗarin hasken rana yayin ayyukan waje da kuma tushen hasken UV na wucin gadi kamar fitilun rana da gadajen tana. Yawan haɗari shima shine ainihin dalilin tasirin cutar akan idanu da tsarin garkuwar jiki. Yin amfani da wasu matakan kariya masu sauƙi na iya rage haɗarin waɗannan yanayin kiwon lafiya sosai: Ƙuntata lokacin rana a tsakiyar rana daga 10 na safe zuwa 4 na yamma, musamman a ranakun da UV index ya yi yawa Lokacin da hasken UV ya fi ƙarfi kuma dole ne ku kasance a waje, yi ƙoƙarin neman inuwa kuma sanya tufafi masu kariya, gami da hular da ke ba da kariya ga rana ga kai, fuska da wuya.

Cutar Schistosomiasis ta shafi kusan mutane miliyan 240 a duk duniya, kuma fiye da mutane miliyan 700 suna zaune a yankunan da cutar ta yadu. Cutar ta zama ruwan dare a yankunan da ke da zafi da kuma yankunan da ba su da zafi, a cikin al'ummomin da ba su da ruwan sha da kuma tsaftacewa. Cutar Schistosomiasis ta Urogenital tana haifar da Schistosoma haematobium da cutar Schistosomiasis ta hanji ta kowane irin kwayoyin S. guineensis, S. intercalatum, S. mansoni, S. japonicum, da S. mekongi. Miliyoyin mutane a duk faɗin duniya suna fama da rashin lafiya mai tsanani sakamakon cutar ta Schistosomiasis. Dabarun WHO game da amfani da magungunan anthelminthic yanzu yana ba da damar sarrafa cutar ta Schistosomiasis a cikin al'ummomin da ba su da wadata da kuma marasa galihu, tare da ayyukan da aka yi game da cutar lymphatic filariasis, onchocerciasis da helminthiasis da ƙasa ke watsawa.

Duk da raguwar haɗarin da ke tattare da lafiyar jiki - kamar shan taba, shan giya, tashin hankali, ruwa mara kyau da tsaftacewa, da kuma raunin yara - ci gaban da aka samu bai isa ba kuma haɗarin wasu haɗari kamar gurɓataccen iska ya kasance mai girma. Abin damuwa, yawan kiba yana ƙaruwa ba tare da wata alama ta sauyawa ba. Bugu da ƙari, faɗaɗa samun sabis na kiwon lafiya na yau da kullun ya ragu idan aka kwatanta da nasarorin da aka samu kafin 2015, tare da rashin ci gaba mai mahimmanci wajen rage wahalar kuɗi saboda farashin kiwon lafiya. Wannan yana iyakance ikonmu na cimma Haɗin Kiwon Lafiya na Duniya nan da 2030. "Cutar COVID-19 muhimmiyar tunatarwa ce cewa ci gaba ba tsari bane kuma ba a tabbatar da shi ba", in ji Dr Samira Asma, Mataimakin Darakta Janar na WHO don Bayanai, Nazari da Isar da Tasiri.

Ana iya yin maganin akan mutum, ko a matsayin Gudanar da Magunguna na Jama'a dangane da yanayin gida da hanyoyin sarrafawa da ake aiwatarwa. Ana iya magance Taeniasis ta amfani da magungunan anthelmintics (Praziquantel, Niclosamide, Albendazole). A cikin neurocysticercosis, tunda lalata cysts na iya haifar da martani mai kumburi, ana buƙatar magani na musamman na cutar mai aiki kuma yana iya haɗawa da dogon lokaci tare da manyan allurai na maganin anthelmintic, da kuma tallafawa magani tare da corticosteroids da / ko magungunan anti-epileptic, da yiwuwar tiyata. Gwajin da tsawon lokacin magani na iya bambanta sosai kuma ya dogara da yawa akan adadi, girman, wuri da matakin ci gaban cysts, kewaye da kumburi mai kumburi, tsanani da tsananin alamun asibiti ko alamomi.

Cibiyar kuma tana gudanar da ayyukan bincike da bayar da shawarwari don tsara ra'ayoyi da kuma tasiri kan manufofin da suka shafi ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya na karkara a Nepal. Farfesa Vichai Tienthavorn shi ne Shugaban Cibiyar Praboromarajchanok a Ma'aikatar Kiwon Lafiyar Jama'a ta Thailand. Daya daga cikin ayyukan da ya jagoranta a duk fadin kasar shi ne sabon tsarin inganta kiwon lafiya don taimakawa magance cutar thalassemia, tare da aikinsa wanda ya haifar da amincewa da ingantacciyar manufar kasa don rigakafin cutar thalassemia da kuma kula da ita. Ya kuma tsara ingantaccen kayan aikin sadarwa da hanyar bincike don taimakawa 'yan kasa su daidaita halayensu don hana da kuma kula da ciwon sukari da hauhawar jini. Sakamakon wannan aikin, an amince da wata manufa ta kasa tare da tasiri mai kyau ga nauyin cutar a kasar.

Human T-lymphotropic virus type 1 (HTLV-1) Gabaɗaya ba shi da alamomi, nau'in HTLV-1 na yau da kullun na iya haifar da cuta mai tsanani, gami da cutar sankarar T-cell leukaemia / lymphoma (ATL) da kuma ci gaba da yanayin tsarin juyayi da aka sani da HTLV-1-associated myelopathy ko tropical spastic paraparesis (HAM / TSP). Jiyya: Ana samun magani mai tasiri a halin yanzu don yawancin STIs. Kwayoyin cuta guda uku na STI (chlamydia, gonorrhoea da syphilis) da ɗaya STI na ƙwayoyin cuta (trichomoniasis) galibi ana iya warkar da su tare da wadatar magungunan rigakafi ko magungunan rigakafi (a cikin yanayin HTLV-1), waɗanda zasu iya daidaita yanayin cututtukan, kodayake ba za su iya warkar da waɗannan cututtukan uku ba.

A cikin sararin sarrafa vector, akwai sabbin samfura 28 a cikin bututun R&D. Kayan aikin da ake kimantawa sun haɗa da, alal misali, sabbin nau'ikan ƙwayoyin da aka sarrafa da maganin kwari, burbushin da aka yi niyya wanda ke jan hankalin sauro, masu korar sararin samaniya, masu jan hankali na gida mai kisa (tubunan rami) da kuma aikin injiniya na sauro. Masu bincike suna ba da fifiko ga haɓaka magungunan da ba ACT ba a fagen magungunan maganin zazzabin cizon sauro saboda fitowar da yaduwar ɓangaren artemisinin. Ci gaban magunguna na gaba, kamar "triple ACTs," waɗanda ke amfani da haɗin artemisinin da magunguna biyu abokan hulɗa, ana ci gaba don rage haɗarin juriya na magani. Muhimman batutuwa Ana sa ran tattaunawa da yanke shawara kan: Binciken aikin WHO a cikin gaggawa na kiwon lafiya, gami da Dokokin Kiwon Lafiya na Duniya da karfafa shirye-shiryen WHO da amsawa ga gaggawa na kiwon lafiya; Dabaru da ayyukan duniya kan fannoni kamar lafiyar mata, yara da matasa, farfadowa, kula da lafiyar jama'a da kula da lafiyar farko, maganin gargajiya, rigakafin kamuwa da cuta da sarrafawa, magunguna marasa inganci da na jabu, lafiyar 'yan gudun hijira da bakin haure, cututtukan da ba a iya yaduwa ba, lafiyar kwakwalwa, abubuwan da ke haifar da zamantakewa, abinci mai gina jiki da nakasa; Amincewa da Kasafin Kudin Shirin WHO na 2024-2025, gami da yanke shawarar kara gudummawar da aka tantance da sauran batutuwan da suka fito daga Kungiyar Aiki kan Tallafin Dorewa.

Shirin Canja wurin Fasahar mRNA ya koma mataki na gaba na ci gabansa An kaddamar da cibiyar fasahar mRNA a Afrigen, Afirka ta Kudu. Abokan hulda sun taru a Cape Town don tattauna mataki na gaba na ci gaban rigakafin mRNA da musayar ilimi. Fiye da mahalarta 200 na duniya da ke aiki tare da Shirin Canja wurin Fasahar mRNA sun hadu a Cape Town a wannan makon don ganawarsu ta farko. Tare da Darakta Janar na Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya (WHO), Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus da Dr. Joe Phaahla, Ministan Lafiya da Ministan Kasuwanci da Masana'antu, Mista Ebrahim Patel na Afirka ta Kudu tare da manyan jami'ai daga kasashen da ke ba da tallafi, wannan taron na musamman ya sake nazarin ci gaban da aka samu tun lokacin da WHO da Medicines Patent Pool (MPP) suka kaddamar da shi a watan Yunin 2021.

Na yi farin ciki cewa WHO za ta gina kan ka'idodin kiyaye sirri da fasahar zamani na takardar shaidar EU don ƙirƙirar kayan aiki na duniya don yaƙar annoba a nan gaba, "in ji Thierry Breton, Kwamishinan Kasuwancin Cikin Gida. Tsarin WHO na duniya wanda ya dogara da gadon EU Ɗaya daga cikin mahimman abubuwan da ke cikin aikin Tarayyar Turai don yaƙar cutar COVID-19 ya kasance takaddun shaidar COVID-19 na dijital. Don sauƙaƙe zirga-zirga cikin 'yanci a cikin iyakokinta, EU ta hanzarta kafa takaddun shaidar COVID-19 masu aiki tare (wanda ake kira "Takardar Shaidar COVID-19 ta EU" ko "EU DCC"). Dangane da fasahohi masu buɗewa da ƙa'idodi ya ba da damar haɗin ƙasashen da ba na EU ba waɗanda ke ba da takaddun shaida bisa ga ƙayyadaddun EU DCC, ya zama mafita da aka fi amfani da ita a duniya.

Cututtukan da ake ɗauka ta hanyar jima'i da suka haɗa da HIV, kwayar cutar herpes simplex (HSV), kwayar cutar hepatitis B, kwayar cutar papillomavirus (HPV) da kwayar cutar T-lymphotropic ta mutum iri na 1 (HTLV-1) ba su da magani ko kuma suna da iyakantaccen zaɓi na magani. Akwai alluran rigakafi don hepatitis B don hana kamuwa da cutar da za ta iya haifar da cutar sankarar hanta da kuma HPV don hana cutar sankarar mahaifa. HIV, HSV da HTLV-1 cututtuka ne na rayuwa: ga HIV da HSV akwai magunguna waɗanda za su iya hana kwayar cutar, amma a halin yanzu babu magani ga kowane ɗayan waɗannan cututtukan STIs. Kwantena da aka yi amfani da su daidai kuma koyaushe sune ingantattun hanyoyin kariya daga STIs da HIV. Bincike tare da ganewar asali na mutanen da ke da STIs da abokan jima'i suna ba da mafi kyawun damar samun magani mai tasiri da kuma hana rikitarwa da ƙarin yaduwa.

Rikicin da ake yi wa mata Bayani: Rikicin da ake yi wa mata - musamman ma rikicin abokan tarayya da kuma cin zarafin jima'i - babbar matsala ce ta jama'a da kuma rashin lafiyar jiki da kuma keta hakkin bil'adama na mata. Ya samo asali ne daga rashin daidaito tsakanin mata da maza kuma yana ci gaba da hakan. A duniya, mace 1 cikin 3 tana fuskantar cin zarafin jiki da/ko na jima'i a rayuwarsu, galibi daga abokin tarayya. Wannan tunatarwa ce mai tsanani game da girman rashin daidaito tsakanin mata da maza da kuma nuna bambanci ga mata. Majalisar Dinkin Duniya ta ayyana cin zarafin mata a matsayin "duk wani aikin cin zarafin jima'i wanda ke haifar da, ko kuma mai yiwuwa ya haifar da, rauni na jiki, na jima'i, ko na tunani ko wahala ga mata, gami da barazanar irin waɗannan ayyukan, tilastawa ko hana 'yanci ba bisa ka'ida ba, ko da kuwa yana faruwa ne a bainar jama'a ko a cikin rayuwa ta sirri.

Binciken gobarar daji: Gobarar daji tana ƙaruwa a duk faɗin duniya a cikin yawan, tsananin da tsawon lokaci, yana ƙara buƙatar fahimtar tasirin lafiyar haɗuwa da wutar daji. Haɗarin gobarar daji yana ƙaruwa a cikin yanayin bushewa sosai, kamar fari, raƙuman zafi da lokacin iska mai ƙarfi.Haƙar gobarar daji cakuda ce ta gurɓataccen iska mai haɗari, kamar PM2.5, NO2, ozone, aromatic hydrocarbons, ko gubar.Bugu da ƙari ga gurɓata iska da gurɓataccen abu mai guba, gobarar daji kuma a lokaci guda tana tasiri yanayin ta hanyar sakin iskar carbon dioxide da sauran iskar gas a cikin yanayi. Tare da canjin yanayi yana haifar da yanayin zafi da yanayin bushewa da ƙaruwar birane na yankunan karkara, lokacin wuta yana farawa da wuri kuma yana ƙarewa daga baya.

Kusan kashi 20% na kashe kansa na duniya ya faru ne saboda shan magungunan kashe kwari. Yayin da alaƙar da ke tsakanin kashe kansa da yanayin lafiyar hankali (musamman, damuwa da rikicewar shan barasa) da yunƙurin kashe kansa na baya an kafa shi sosai a cikin ƙasashe masu samun kuɗi, yawancin kashe kansa suna faruwa ne cikin hanzari a lokutan rikici. Ƙarin abubuwan haɗari na kashe kansa sun haɗa da asarar ƙwarewa, kadaici, nuna bambanci, rushewar dangantaka, matsalolin kuɗi, ciwo mai tsanani da rashin lafiya, tashin hankali, cin zarafi, da rikici ko wasu matsalolin jin kai. Stigma game da yanayin lafiyar hankali da kashe kansa yana nufin mutane da yawa da ke tunanin kashe kansu ba sa neman taimako. Kashe kansa da yunƙurin kashe kansa suna da tasirin da ke tasiri ga iyalai, abokai, abokan aiki, al'ummomi da al'ummomi.

Ci gaba mai dorewa Bayani: Ci gaba mai dorewa kalma ce mai faɗi don bayyana manufofi, ayyuka da saka hannun jari waɗanda ke ba da fa'idodi a yau ba tare da sadaukar da muhalli, zamantakewa da lafiyar mutum a nan gaba ba. Ana bayyana waɗannan manufofin a matsayin kore saboda suna mai da hankali kan iyakance tasirin ci gaba akan muhalli. Koyaya, ana jin fa'idodin ci gaba mai ɗorewa a duk faɗin ɓangaren lafiyar ɗan adam da jin daɗin rayuwa, gami da ragewa cikin gurbatawa- da cututtukan da ke da alaƙa da muhalli, ingantaccen sakamako na kiwon lafiya da rage damuwa. Yayin da barazanar canjin yanayi ke ƙara zama mai mahimmanci, dabarun cin nasara don ragewa, haɓaka lafiya da rage farashi suna ba da fa'idodi da yawa ga masu ruwa da tsaki daban-daban.

Kasashe 10 da ke da mafi girman yawan kiba a duniya duk SIDS ne a cikin Pacific, inda sama da kashi 45% na manya ke rayuwa tare da kiba. Yanayin lafiyar kwakwalwa ya zama ruwan dare a cikin ƙasashen SIDS, yana shafar kimanin kashi 15.2% na yawan jama'a a cikin Caribbean da kashi 11.2% na yawan jama'a a cikin Pacific. Mutanen da ke da yanayin lafiyar kwakwalwa suna fuskantar haɗarin mutuwa da wuri, gami da yanayin rashin lafiyar jiki da rashin magance kansu. Stigma, ƙarancin ƙwararrun ma'aikata da tasirin canjin yanayi suna ba da gudummawa ga mawuyacin hali a cikin SIDS wanda ke buƙatar kulawa da gaggawa. Yarjejeniyar Bridgetown ta 2023 ta bayyana matakai masu ƙarfin hali don magance kewayon al'amuran zamantakewa, muhalli, tattalin arziki da kasuwanci waɗanda ke haifar da NCDs da yanayin lafiyar kwakwalwa.

Ayyukan WHO kan rigakafin kamuwa da cuta da kuma shawo kan cutar Tabbatar da tarihi ya share fagen karfafa gyaran a tsarin kiwon lafiyaA yau Majalisar Lafiya ta Duniya ta amince da wani muhimmin kudurin kan karfafa gyaran a tsarin kiwon lafiya. Ayyukan gyaran suna taka muhimmiyar rawa wajen tabbatar da jin dadin 'yancin dan adam ciki har da mafi girman matakin da za a iya cimma na lafiyar jiki da tunani. Hakanan yana inganta lafiyar jima'i da haihuwa, kuma ya amince da 'yancin yin aiki da kuma 'yancin ilimi. Wannan muhimmin kudurin yana da nufin magance kalubalen gyaran kamar buƙatar: ƙara wayar da kan jama'a game da gyaran lokacin kafa abubuwan fifiko na kiwon lafiya da ajandar bincike, rarraba albarkatu, inganta haɗin kai da ba da damar canja wurin fasaha;

Wannan zai biyo bayan abubuwan da aka gano ta hanyar shawarwari goma don karfafa tsarin duniya don shirye-shiryen gaggawa na kiwon lafiya, amsawa, da juriya (HEPR). Shirin PRET yana gabatar da sabon zamani don shirye-shiryen annoba kuma yana wakiltar ci gaban ayyukan WHO don tallafawa dukkan kasashe mambobin kungiyar wajen karfafa shirye-shiryen gaggawa na kiwon lafiya, rigakafi, da amsawa da kuma iyawa. Shirin na iya zama mai amfani wajen aiwatar da manufofi da tanade-tanaden Yarjejeniyar Cutar, wanda a halin yanzu kasashe mambobin WHO ke tattaunawa. Bayan shigar da bayanai da tattaunawa tsakanin mahalarta taron, WHO ta gayyaci masu ruwa da tsaki zuwa wannan kiran duniya don aiki don ci gaba da shirye-shiryen annobar cututtukan numfashi.

Tun farkon barkewar cutar, WHO ta yi aiki tare da dukkan Yankunan WHO don ayyana jagororin gaba ɗaya don irin waɗannan takaddun shaida. Don taimakawa ƙarfafa shirye-shiryen kiwon lafiya na duniya yayin fuskantar haɗarin kiwon lafiya, WHO tana kafa cibiyar sadarwar takaddun shaida na dijital ta duniya wacce ke gina kan tushe mai ƙarfi na tsarin EU DCC, ƙa'idodi da buɗaɗɗun fasahohi. Tare da wannan haɗin gwiwar, WHO za ta sauƙaƙe wannan tsari a duniya a ƙarƙashin tsarinta da nufin ba wa duniya damar cin gajiyar haɗuwa da takaddun shaida na dijital. Wannan ya haɗa da saita da tabbatar da daidaitattun sa hannu na dijital don hana zamba. A yin haka, WHO ba za ta sami damar samun kowane bayanan sirri na asali ba, wanda zai ci gaba da kasancewa yanki na musamman na gwamnatoci.

Wannan na iya haifar da mummunan tasirin zamantakewar tattalin arziki, yana ba da gudummawa ga asarar da ke tattare da haɓaka da ƙara kuɗaɗe ga tsarin kiwon lafiya na mutum da na ƙasa. Suna iya isa ga marasa lafiya a cikin yanayin da ke da ƙuntataccen damar samun inganci da ingantattun kayayyakin kiwon lafiya, rashin kyakkyawan shugabanci da ƙarancin ƙarfin fasaha. Kodayake wannan batun yana shafar dukkan ƙasashe, ƙasashen da ke da rauni ko rashin tsarin tsari suna ɗaukar nauyin mafi girma na kayayyakin kiwon lafiya marasa inganci da na jabu. A cikin duniya mai ƙaruwa, babu wata ƙasa da ke da isassun albarkatu da ƙarfin da za ta iya magance wannan batun a ware. Ta hanyar tsarin duniya da matakai kamar Tsarin Kulawa da Kulawa na Duniya na WHO da Tsarin Membobin WHO,

Yana da tasiri, amintacce, kuma mai rahusa. Kodayake sake kamuwa da cutar na iya faruwa bayan magani, haɗarin kamuwa da cuta mai tsanani ya ragu har ma ya juya lokacin da aka fara magani kuma aka maimaita shi a lokacin ƙuruciya. An aiwatar da sarrafa cutar Schistosomiasis cikin nasara a cikin shekaru 40 da suka gabata a cikin ƙasashe da yawa, gami da Brazil, Cambodia, China, Egypt, Mauritius, Jamhuriyar Musulunci ta Iran, Oman, Jordan, Saudi Arabia, Morocco, Tunisia, da sauransu. A Burundi, Burkina Faso, Ghana, Niger, Rwanda, Sierra Leone, Jamhuriyar Tarayyar Tanzania, da Yemen, ya yiwu a haɓaka maganin cutar Schistosomiasis zuwa matakin ƙasa kuma ya yi tasiri ga cutar a cikin 'yan shekaru. Ana buƙatar kimanta matsayin watsawa a cikin ƙasashe da yawa.

"Muna da kayan aikin da za mu iya rage cutar zazzabin cizon sauro, wani tsari na ayyukan da ya hada da kula da kwayoyin cutar, magungunan rigakafi, gwaji, da magani", in ji Dokta Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, Darakta Janar na WHO. "Wadannan sun hada da allurar rigakafin zazzabin cizon sauro mai aminci da inganci, wanda zai iya ceton rayukan dubun dubatan yara a kowace shekara. Tare da ci gaba da saka hannun jari da kuma kokarin da za a yi don kaiwa ga wadanda suka fi fuskantar hadari, kawar da zazzabin cizon sauro a kasashe da dama ya yiwu. "Ranar zazzabin cizon sauro ta duniya ta 2023 tana cikin taken "Lokaci don kawar da zazzabin cizon sauro: zuba jari, kirkire-kirkire, aiwatarwa". A cikin wannan taken, WHO tana kira da a kara aiwatar da ingantattun kayan aiki da dabarun da ake da su don hana, tantancewa da kuma magance zazzabin cizon sauro, musamman a tsakanin al'ummomin da ke fama da matsalar.

WHO ta bukaci a kara aiwatar da kayan aikin da aka bada shawarar don yaki da zazzabin cizon sauro A ranar zazzabin cizon sauro ta duniya, Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya (WHO) tana yin kira da a kara aiwatar da sabbin matakai da ake da su don ceton rayuka daga zazzabin cizon sauro. Kusan yara miliyan 1.5 da ke cikin hadarin kamuwa da cutar da mutuwa daga zazzabin cizon sauro a Ghana, Kenya da Malawi yanzu sun karbi kashi na farko na rigakafin zazzabin cizon sauro na farko, RTS,S / AS01 (RTS,S), godiya ga shirin gwaji na yau da kullun da WHO ke gudanarwa. Gwajin rigakafin zazzabin cizon sauro, wanda aka kaddamar a cikin 2019, yana kara daidaito a cikin samun rigakafin zazzabin cizon sauro ga mafi rauni kuma yana ceton rayuka. Idan aka aiwatar da shi sosai, WHO ta kiyasta cewa alluran rigakafin zazzabin cizon sauro na iya ceton rayukan dubun dubatan yara a kowace shekara.

Kowace shekara Ranar Duniya ta Rashin Shan Taba tana girmama waɗanda ke kawo canji a cikin kula da taba. A wannan shekara an yaba wa ɗaya daga cikin masu karɓar lambar yabo, Ms Sprina Robi Chacha, wata mace mai noma daga Kenya, ba wai kawai don sauya daga noman taba zuwa waken da ke da furotin mai yawa ba, har ma da horar da ɗaruruwan sauran manoma kan yadda za su yi hakan don ƙirƙirar al'umma mai lafiya. 182 Jam'iyyun da ke cikin Yarjejeniyar WHO kan Kula da Taba sun himmatu ga "haɓaka hanyoyin da za su iya taimakawa tattalin arziƙi ga ma'aikatan taba da masu shuka". Hanya mai mahimmanci da ƙasashe za su iya cika wannan wajibin ita ce ta hanyar kawo ƙarshen tallafi ga noman taba da tallafawa amfanin gona mai lafiya. Ta hanyar zaɓar noman abinci maimakon taba, muna fifita kiwon lafiya, adana yanayin halittu, da haɓaka tsaro na abinci.

Rahoton ya lura cewa 1 cikin 10 na jarirai da aka haifa da wuri (< makonni 28) ne kawai ke rayuwa a ƙasashe masu ƙarancin kuɗi, idan aka kwatanta da fiye da 9 cikin 10 a ƙasashe masu wadata. Rashin daidaito da ke da alaƙa da launin fata, kabilanci, samun kuɗi, da samun kulawa mai inganci yana ƙayyade yiwuwar haihuwar da wuri, mutuwa, da nakasa, har ma a ƙasashe masu wadata. Kudancin Asiya da yankin Saharar Afirka suna da mafi girman yawan haihuwar da wuri, kuma jarirai da aka haifa da wuri a waɗannan yankuna suna fuskantar haɗarin mutuwa mafi girma. Tare, waɗannan yankuna biyu suna da fiye da kashi 65% na haihuwar da wuri a duniya. Rahoton ya kuma nuna cewa tasirin rikici, canjin yanayi da lalacewar muhalli, COVID-19, da hauhawar farashin rayuwa suna ƙara haɗarin ga mata da jarirai a ko'ina.

A shekarar 1996, a taron kungiyar kiwon lafiya ta duniya karo na 49, kasashe mambobin kungiyar sun yanke shawarar lalata wannan adadi a watan Yunin 1999, kuma kawai don ba da damar ajiye kananan samfurori don dalilai na bincike a dakunan gwaje-gwaje biyu da aka tsara - daya a Amurka daya kuma a Tarayyar Rasha. Ana amfani da adana na wucin gadi na adadin da ake da shi na kwayar cutar variola don ci gaba da bincike mai mahimmanci, wanda Kwamitin Shawara don Binciken Kwayar cutar Variola ke kulawa. Wannan rukunin yana haɗuwa a kowace shekara. Sakatariyar WHO ta Smallpox da ke hedkwatar WHO tana daidaita duk ayyukan da suka shafi kawar da cutar variola da kuma bayan kawar da ita. Waɗannan sun haɗa da kula da bincike da aka ba da izini tare da kwayar cutar variola mai rai don haɓaka matakan magance su kamar allurar rigakafi da magungunan rigakafi.

Tun lokacin da aka kawar da cutar, an samar da alluran rigakafi masu aminci da magunguna na musamman don cutar kyanda da cututtukan da ke da alaƙa da ita kamar su monkeypox. Sakatariyar kuma tana da alhakin shirye-shiryen gaggawa da kuma kula da ajiyar allurar rigakafin cutar kyanda a cikin yanayin da ba zai yiwu ba idan cutar ta sake bayyana. Sakatariyar tana kula da binciken tsaro da tsaro na halittu na wuraren ajiyar ƙwayoyin cuta na variola kamar yadda Majalisar Lafiya ta Duniya ta ba da umarni, kuma tana tabbatar da bayar da rahoto na shekara-shekara ga Hukumomin Gudanarwa na WHO. Sakatariyar Smallpox tana tallafawa Gidan Tarihi na WHO wajen adana tarihin duniya na cutar kyanda da kuma rubuta darussan da aka koya daga nasarar kawar da cutar kyanda.
